Subject: Exclusive for Freshers | RoboWars Workshop – Batch 2 Registration Open (23 July 2026) - reg
Body:
Dear Freshers,

Greetings from the Office of Innovation, Startup and Technology Transfer

(VIT-IST).

Didn't get a chance to register for RoboWars Workshop – Batch 1? Here's

your opportunity to join Batch 2!

The Office of Innovation, Startup and Technology Transfer (VIT-IST), in

association with the Institution's Innovation Council (IIC),

Entrepreneurship Development Cell (EDC), and Intellectual Property Rights &

Technology Transfer Cell (IPR & TT Cell), is pleased to invite first-year

(Fresher) students to participate in the RoboWars Workshop – Batch 2,

exclusively designed for freshers.

🤖 RoboWars Workshop – Batch 2

Theme: Design • Deploy • Dominate

📅

Date: 23 July 2026 (Thursday)🕤 Time: 9:30 AM – 5:00 PM📍 Venue: PRP

A-Block, Room No. 156

Before You Register

 - Form a team of five students including Team Lead 

 - Ensure your team is finalized before submitting the registration

 form.

Why Should You Attend?

 - Learn robotics from experienced mentors.

 - Design, build, and test your own robot through hands-on practical

 sessions.

 - Explore the fundamentals of robotics, automation, and innovation.

 - Receive a Certificate of Participation.

 - On Duty (OD) will be provided to participants.

 - Take your first step towards robotics competitions and innovation

 projects.

Important Registration Guidelines

 - This workshop is exclusively for first-year (Fresher) students.

 - Batch 2 registration is open only to students who missed registering

 for Batch 1.

 - Students who have already registered for Batch 1 are not permitted

 to register again for Batch 2.

 - Only 40 seats are available, and registrations will be accepted on a

 first-come, first-served basis.

📲 Scan the QR code in the poster to register.

Don't miss this opportunity to learn, build, compete, and innovate. Begin

your robotics journey with RoboWars and become a part of VIT's growing

innovation ecosystem.

We look forward to welcoming you and your team to the workshop!

Body:
Dear VITians,

Connect. Celebrate. Belong.

The Office of Students’ Welfare warmly invites you to the day -II of

Cultural Week ’26, a celebration of creativity, passion, and the vibrant

spirit of the VIT community.

Get ready for an unforgettable evening of music, dance, theatre and

captivating cultural performances that showcase the incredible talent and

artistic excellence of every VITian. More than just a celebration, Cultural

experience the energy, creativity, and traditions that make VIT truly

unique.

Whether you’re taking the stage or cheering from the audience, every moment

is an opportunity to celebrate talent, support one another, and create

memories that will last long after the curtains close.

our community. We look forward to welcoming you to Cultural Week ’26 and

sharing four unforgettable evenings of talent, inspiration, and celebration.

Subject: Important Alert: Beware of Fake Internship/Placement Emails/WhatsApp-reg
Body:
Dear VITians,

It has come to our attention that some students have been receiving

fraudulent emails/WhatsApp claiming to offer internships, training,

certifications, or placements. These messages often reference reputed MNCs

like IBM, Microsoft, Dell, Google, and others, and may include links or

Google Forms asking for your personal information and payments.

We strongly caution you NOT to click on any links or fill out any forms

received through such unofficial Emails/whatsApp messages.

Please note the following:

Career Development Center (CDC) – VIT is the only authorized body for all

official communication regarding internships, placements, certifications,

or training programs.

All legitimate opportunities and instructions will come from CDC’s official

VIT email domain or be posted on authenticated institutional platforms.

If you are unsure about the authenticity of any communication, kindly

verify it by reaching out to the CDC directly.

Stay alert and safeguard your personal information.

Dear Students,

As we embark on another academic year, let us remember about our commitment

to creating a safe, inclusive, and respectful environment on campus.

Ragging, in any form, is strictly prohibited on our campus. It is a

practice that not only undermines the dignity of individuals but also

disrupts the harmony and camaraderie that we strive to foster. As you know,

our institution has a zero-tolerance policy towards ragging, and we ensure

that every student feels secure and respected.

As per the UGC Guidelines

Ragging includes any act of physical or mental abuse, bullying, harassment,

or any conduct by one student towards another that causes harm, fear, or

humiliation. Engaging in ragging can result in severe disciplinary action,

including suspension, expulsion, and legal consequences as per the law. We

have established a dedicated anti-ragging monitoring cell and helpline to

support and protect students.

If you or your friend is experiencing or witnessing ragging, please do not

hesitate to report it immediately. All reports will be handled with

confidentiality and sensitivity. Your cooperation and active participation

are essential in upholding our values and maintaining a safe and nurturing

atmosphere. Let us stand united against ragging and support each other in

creating a community where everyone can thrive without fear or intimidation.

Students from the Freshers Batch of 2026 are requested to inform/report any

unpleasant interactions/incidents that they face in campus, hostels or

outside the campus. Also, you are cautioned not to join any unofficial

whatsapp/telegram groups.

STUDENTS are also requested to not get involved in any such acts which may

invite severe disciplinary actions against them.

In case anybody asks you to meet them in Hostel, Foodys or anywhere inside

or outside the campus for such things, please contact on the following

numbers/Email IDs:

or use the Emergency Button on VITian App (Misuse of this will lead to

disciplinary action as per VIT Student code of conduct)

report any issues faced.

Subject: Updated Placement Norms – 2027 Batch
Body:
Placement Norms – 2027 Batch

Company Selection

Eligibility for further placements/internships

Selected by IT Services Companies (Internship/Fulltime)

1. Will be eligible for 1.5X CTC offer and above

(Applicable for IT Services / IT Product Companies)

Selected by any company for placements

1. Will be eligible for 2X CTC offer and above

2. Will be eligible for Dream (Core) offer

Selected for internship by IT product company (if the CTC on conversion is

more than 10 LPA) or termed as Super Dream Internship

1. Eligible for companies (Placements / Internship + Placements)

if the CTC is more than 2X and above

2. Eligible for companies(only placements) if the CTC is less

than 10 LPA

Selected for an internship by IT product company if the CTC is less than 10

LPA or termed as Dream Internship

1. Eligible for companies (Placements / Internship + Placements) if

the CTC is 2X and above (IT services / IT product)

2. Eligible for companies(only placements) if the CTC is

Less than 6 LPA

Selected in a Core Company for Non CS only

Will be eligible for 2X CTC only

Note:

1. Super Dream(Internship), Dream(Internship), Dream(Core) will be

specified in the placement notice

2. Students who plan for higher studies are eligible to take only the

IT Services companies offer (CTC – less than 6 LPA). IT Services or

regular offer (Sales / BD) will be specified on top of the notice.

3. Students dropping the Dream/ Super Dream (internship/fulltime)

offer after selection, in any of the above categories will have to do one

additional course and they will also be not be allowed for further

placements

4. Students withdrawing from internship before /after joining the

company also will be considered as “dropping of offer”

 Violation of PAT Norms:

1. Students planning for higher studies are not eligible for

Dream/Super Dream offers. They are allowed to attend only Software

services company’s interviews (Like TCS, Cognizant, Infosys etc.). VIT will

not issue “No Objection certificate” or recommendation letters to those

students who get selected in Dream /Super dream companies and later plan to

pursue their higher education. Dream /Super dream companies will be

notified in PAT notices.

2. Students who reject a Dream or Super Dream offer (Placement or

Internship) after getting selected have to do an additional academic course

to complete their degree requirements. The academic course has to be

completed in the final semester (no extension shall be given). The details

of the academic course to be completed will be shared by the Dean

(Academics) later. This also applies to the students who get Pre Placement

Offers after the summer internships. The earlier rule of not getting the

recommendation letter from the Professors for higher education also would

remain. "Once the higher PAT/CDC offer is declined by the student, all the

previous offers through PAT will also get cancelled/not considered"

3. Only registered students will be allowed for campus interviews and

other training programs organized by the placement centre. Those students

attending campus interviews without registering and not fulfilling the

eligibility criteria (as on date of selection test) would be summarily

rusticated from the University for Bringing Disgrace to the University.

4. It is found that Students who get placed in Dream or Super Dream

are violating the PAT norms and attending the off campus placements.

Students who get placed with on campus full time/internship placement

(dream or super dream) must accept the offer without fail and cannot

decline. Those who are going to get placed in Dream or Super Dream

placements should follow the PAT norms. Students who are violating the

norms will face severe disciplinary action.

Note:

All the companies allow students with no current backlogs for the selection

process.

PAT Category 

Category

Details

Category I

60 % in 10th, 12th, UG and PG as applicable and no year gap in studies.

Category II

60 % in 10th, 12th, UG and PG as applicable and upto 2 year gap in studies.

Category III

60 % in 10th /12th /UG and more than 2 year gap in studies.

Category IV

Less than 60 % in 10th /12th /UG and upto 2 year gap in studies.

Category V

Less than 60 % in 10th /12th /UG and more than 2 year gap in studies.

Gap in studies is counted from your Xth STD.

 Work experience is also counted as an academic gap.

Important Note:

1. Registration is purely voluntary.

2. It is informed that students in category III, IV and V may not

expect many companies as almost all the companies visiting VIT for Campus

Placement insist on 60% consistency and less than 2 years gap (i.e.

category I and II). Hence PAT registration is as per your

discretion/decision only.

3. All the companies allow students with no current backlogs /

required credits completed for the selection process.

4. Registration for other campus students will be done separately by

their respective campus.

Body:
Office of the Controller of Examinations

 Ref.No. : VIT/CoE/2026/26010

 Date: 16-July-2026

Paper Seeing and Revaluation for 

Summer Semester 2025-26 FAT – Theory 

 Paper Seeing and Revaluation:

· In the VTop student login, (“Examination → Marks → Summer Semester

2025-26”) Marks for the Courses to which FAT was held during June-July 2026

has been made available now.

· Actual Grades will be released on 20 July 2026 ( Monday ) . The

Pass criteria and Grading Procedure are available in Academics → Regulations

Tab in your login.

· If you want to know the question wise marks awarded to your

answers by the evaluator, you need to apply for it through V-Top. This is

referred to as “Paper Seeing” process. It requires payment of Rs. 100 for

each paper. You can apply through: Examinations →Papersee/Rev → Summer

Semester 2025-26→Paper Seeing. You can choose the course(s) you want to

apply for paper seeing. After Generating the Invoice, you need to make a

payment through “Online Payments” Tab in the same V-Top login.

· Once you have paid, after 24 hours, the paper and question wise

marks awarded will be made available in CodeTantra login. You need to use

the same portal https://vit.codetantra.com for this process. After seeing

the paper, if you feel the mark awarded to a particular question is not

sufficient and the evaluator has missed something and there is a need to

recheck the mark, then you can apply for Revaluation of the Course. You

need to give suitable reasons for the same in the comments section

available just below the mark awarded by the faculty.

· Please note that the Revaluation has to be applied only in V-Top

(in the same way as you have applied for paper seeing) and necessary

payments also need to be paid through the online payments tab. (Rs. 300 per

paper). Revaluation approval process in codetantra will be initiated only

after publishing the Grades, until then the status remains ‘approval

pending’ . Paper seeing and feedback / comments are mandatory for

re-evaluation and are in online mode only.

· Also note that “Paper seeing” and Revaluation is applicable only

for the Theory Courses to which FAT was conducted by the CoE office . For

other components and Courses (like Laboratory / Project Courses IBL mode

courses) there is No Paper seeing and Revaluation Process.

· The students who were involved in Summer Semester 2025-26

examination malpractices are not eligible for the paper seeing/

Re-valuation process.

Particulars

Dates

Paper seeing registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 100]

 16 - July-2026 to 18 - July-2026

Revaluation registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 300]

 17 - July-2026 to 19 - July-2026

Paper Seeing in https://vit.codetantra.com/

https://vit.codetantra.com/

 17 - July-2026 to 19 - July-2026

 Once the Paper seeing request is approved, the evaluated copy of answer

sheets would be made available in CodeTantra as per the above

schedule. Use your VTop login credentials for login.

· After login, follow the instructions given in the platform for

giving comments to the questions which need to be re-examined.

· Give your feedback with respect to the need for revaluation. If

no feedback is given for any question, your answer script will not be

considered for revaluation and No refund will be given for any approved

requests.

· Students should not approach or give any sort of request to any

faculty related to revaluation (increase of marks or grades). If we

receive any complaints from faculty, it will be treated as ‘Malpractice’

and revaluation requests will summarily be rejected.

Controller of Examinations

Subject: Invitation to Participate in the CAG–ICSSR Research Article Competition 2026
Body:
Dear Students and Research Scholars,

Greetings from the Office of Academic Research.

We are pleased to inform you that the Comptroller and Auditor General

(CAG) of India, in collaboration with the Indian Council of Social

Science Research (ICSSR), has announced the CAG–ICSSR Research Article

Competition 2026. This prestigious national initiative provides an

excellent opportunity for Undergraduate (UG), Postgraduate (PG), and Ph.D.

students to showcase their research and contribute innovative ideas

towards strengthening governance, public policy, and sustainable

development in India. (

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1kGfpnG5MRVvSrH-DMGrbBA62h9fuQZGo?usp=sharing

).

SUBMISSION:

Only individual entries are allowed and Only one entry per participant is

permitted. LINK FOR THE REGISTRATION: https://app.icssr.org/

12. Entries should be submitted in PDF format (Must be typed, not

handwritten or scanned), and the word limit for the Research Article will

be:

• UG/PG: 4,000 to 5,000 Words

• Doctoral Programme: 5,000 to 6,000 Words

13. The article should contain:

• Introduction

• Conceptual and theoretical background

• Statement of the problem

• Objectives

• Methodology (covering methodological approach, variables, tools employed)

• Data analysis and findings

• Discussion

• Conclusions

• Policy Suggestions and the Way Forward

14. Submission shall adhere to:

• Modern Language Association (9th edition)

• Times New Roman, 12-Point

• Standard margins

• Double spacing

15. Participants must ensure that the Research Article does not contain any

information revealing the identity of the author(s). Inclusion of such

identifying details shall result in disqualification from the review

process.

The competition encourages participants to develop original,

evidence-based, and policy-oriented research articles based on CAG audit

reports and contemporary governance challenges.

Competition Themes

 - Fiscal Federalism and Governance

 - Social Sector Spending

 - Skilling, Employment, and MSMEs

 - Empowering Urban and Rural Local Bodies

National Awards

 - First Prize: ₹1,25,000

 - Second Prize: ₹1,00,000

 - Third Prize: ₹75,000

Important Dates

 - State/UT Level Submission: 1 July – 31 August 2026

 - National Level Submission: 1 August – 30 September 2026

Students interested in participating are encouraged to identify a research

problem under one of the above themes and prepare a high-quality research

article in accordance with the competition guidelines.

Suggested High-Impact Research Topics

Theme I: Fiscal Federalism and Governance

 1. AI-Based Public Expenditure Monitoring for Improved Fiscal

 Accountability.

 2. Blockchain for Transparent Public Financial Management.

 3. Performance Audit of Digital Governance Initiatives in India.

 4. Fiscal Decentralization and Service Delivery in Indian States.

 5. Data Analytics for Enhancing Government Audit Effectiveness.

 6. Digital Public Infrastructure and Fiscal Sustainability.

 7. Measuring the Impact of GST on State Revenue Generation.

 8. Smart Governance through Digital Twins for Urban Administration.

Theme II: Social Sector Spending

 9. AI-Driven Evaluation of Healthcare Expenditure Efficiency.

 10. Effectiveness of Public Health Spending in Rural India.

 11. Data Analytics for Monitoring Educational Outcomes under Government

 Schemes.

 12. Digital Technologies for Improving Public Distribution Systems.

 13. Social Welfare Programme Performance Assessment Using Machine

 Learning.

 14. Smart Healthcare Monitoring Using IoT and Artificial Intelligence.

 15. Audit Analytics for Evaluating Social Security Schemes.

Theme III: Skilling, Employment, and MSMEs

 16. Artificial Intelligence for MSME Productivity Enhancement.

 17. Digital Transformation and Financial Inclusion of MSMEs.

 18. Skill Development Programmes and Employability: A Data-Driven

 Analysis.

 19. Industry 5.0 and the Future of Workforce Development.

 20. Entrepreneurship Development among Rural Youth.

 21. Women Entrepreneurship and Government Support Schemes.

 22. Digital Platforms for Enhancing MSME Competitiveness.

 23. Predictive Analytics for Employment Generation Policies.

Theme IV: Empowering Urban and Rural Local Bodies

 24. Smart Villages through IoT-Based Governance.

 25. Artificial Intelligence for Municipal Service Delivery.

 26. Digital Water Management and Sustainable Urban Development.

 27. Wastewater-to-Energy Systems for Sustainable Local Governance.

 28. Intelligent Waste Management Using IoT and AI.

 29. Digital Twin Applications for Smart Cities.

 30. Citizen-Centric Governance through Data-Driven Decision Support

 Systems.

Interdisciplinary Emerging Topics

 - AI for Public Policy Evaluation

 - Explainable AI in Governance

 - Climate Finance and Sustainable Public Spending

 - Green Infrastructure Auditing

 - Cybersecurity in Digital Government Systems

 - ESG and Public Sector Accountability

 - Digital Public Infrastructure for Inclusive Development

 - Circular Economy and Municipal Resource Management

We strongly encourage all interested students and research scholars to

participate in this prestigious competition and leverage this opportunity

to contribute towards evidence-based policymaking while gaining national

recognition for their research contributions.

Faculty members are also requested to motivate and mentor interested

students in preparing high-quality research articles.

We wish all participants every success in the competition.

Yours Sincerely,

Subject: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for Patent Incentive Claims – UG/ PG Students & Ph.D. Scholars
Attachment_Names: ['Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Patent Incentive Claim Procedure for UG  PG  Ph.D. Scholars.pdf']
Body:
Dear Students and Research Scholars,

The Intellectual Property Rights & Technology Transfer (IPR & TT) Cell has

formalized the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for Patent Incentive

Claims. This procedure applies to all Undergraduate (UG), Postgraduate

(PG) students, and Doctoral (Ph.D.) scholars who are recognized inventors

on successfully filed patents.

To ensure a seamless financial disbursement process, please carefully

review the three-phased workflow and structural timelines outlined below

(The detailed SOP document and final claim form are attached for your

reference):

🚨 Action Required:

 1. Verify VTOP Immediately: Please log in to VTOP right away and

 ensure your bank account details are entirely accurate. Keeping this

 updated guarantees you fall into the smooth, automated Phase A cycle.

 2. For Past-Due Incentives: If you have missed previous incentive

 cycles, please print the attached Form-3C, secure the required routing

 signatures, and submit the physical form to the IPR & TT Cell office

 immediately.

Please note that Phase C serves as your final manual opportunity to claim

past-due incentives for your patent filing cycle.

For any further queries, please visit the IPR & TT Cell Office.

This SOP is effective immediately and applies to all patents filed from 1st

April 2026 onwards.

Body:
Dear Colleagues and Researchers,

We are pleased to invite you to submit your latest research to the 2nd

IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Systems at the

Edge (ICEdge 2026). The conference will be held at the Indian Institute

of Science (IISc) Bangalore, India, from December 17–19, 2026.

About the Conference

The rapid progress in Artificial Intelligence (AI), the Internet of Things

(IoT), and edge computing technologies has created unprecedented

opportunities for innovation and system-level efficiency. ICEdge 2026 aims

to bring together leading researchers, practitioners, and industry experts

to exchange discoveries and insights spanning devices, architectures, EDA

tools, security, and Edge AI applications.

 https://icedge.org/ [image: Submit your Paper

here]

https://cmt3.research.microsoft.com/User/Login?ReturnUrl=%2FICEDGE2026

Note: For UG and PG students, a student travel grant is available. Please

refer to the conference for the latest updates and apply for the grant when

available. 

Technical Tracks

We welcome paper submissions across the following core tracks:

 - Track 1: Devices and Circuits for Edge Applications

 - Track 2: Hardware Systems and Architectures for Edge AI

 - Track 3: EDA Tools, Systems, and Algorithms for AI at the Edge

 - Track 4: Emerging Memories and Compute Devices for Edge AI

 - Track 5: Security and Privacy at the Edge

 - Track 6: Edge AI Applications

Topics of Interest for Edge IoT and AIoT Systems

 - Emerging Sensing Technologies for Edge IoT

 - Computing Architectures and Technologies at the Edge

 - Tiny Machine Learning for the Edge

 - Generative AI for Edge IoT

 - AI and IoT for the Metaverse

 - Energy-efficient and Secure Communication Techniques for AIoT Systems

 - Emerging AI Algorithms and Architectures for IoT Systems

 - Machine Learning and Deep Learning for IoT Systems

 - AI-driven IoT Security and Privacy Concerns and Solutions

 - AI-based Industrial IoT Data Analytics/Visualization

 - IoT-enabled AI Applications (Smart Cities, Smart Homes, Smart Cars,

 etc.)

 - Natural Language Processing and Conversational AI for the Edge

 - AIoT Applications in Robotics and Industrial Automation

 - Scalability, Performance, and Energy Efficiency in AIoT Systems at the

 Edge

 - Intelligent Battery and Power Management for AIoT Systems

 - Ethical Considerations and Need for Standards in AIoT Systems

Key Dates

Milestone

Date

Portal Closes (Submission Deadline)

July 15 (Extended Deadline)

Author Notifications

September 15

Camera-Ready Versions Due

September 30

Submission Guidelines & Journal Opportunity

 - Journal Fast-Track: The top selected papers will be invited for an

 extended journal version in IEEE Design & Test.

 - Format: Manuscripts must follow the IEEE template, utilizing a

 double-column format in 9- or 10-point font. Submissions must be in

 readable PDF format and must not exceed 6 pages (excluding references,

 which may occupy one additional page).

 - Double-Blind Review: Submissions must be fully anonymous. Do not

 include author names, affiliations, or PDF metadata containing identifying

 details. Citations to prior work must be written in the third person;

 phrases like "omitted for blind review" are not permitted.

 - All accepted and presented papers will be submitted into IEEE Xplore.

About Aganitha

Accelerate drug discovery and development for Biopharma and Biotech R&D

with in silico solutions leveraging Computational Biology & Chemistry,

High throughput Sciences, AI, ML, HPC, Cloud, Data, and DevOps.

In silico solutions are transforming the biopharma and biotech

industries. Our cross-domain science and technology team of experts embark

upon and industrialize this transformation. We continually expand our

world-class multi-disciplinary team in Genomics, AI, and Cloud computing,

accelerating drug discovery and development. What drives us is the joy of

working in an innovation-rich, research-powered startup bridging multiple

disciplines to bring medicines faster for human use. We are working with

several innovative Biopharma companies and expanding our client base

globally. Read about how and what solutions we build

https://www.aganitha.ai/solutions/.

Aganitha (अगणित): “countless” or “limitless” in Sanskrit serves as a

reminder and inspiration about the limitless potential in each one of us.

Come join us to bring out your best and be limitless!

Role Overview

As a Computer Vision Engineer, you will develop custom computer vision and

image processing solutions for biomedical and healthcare applications. You

will work with microscopy and medical imaging datasets, design advanced

image analysis pipelines, and build deep learning models for segmentation,

feature extraction, and modeling.

This role is ideal for candidates with strong computer vision fundamentals,

hands-on OpenCV expertise, and an interest in solving challenging

scientific problems.

Key Responsibilities

 - Design and develop custom computer vision algorithms using Python,

 OpenCV, and deep learning frameworks.

 - Build image analysis pipelines for biomedical imaging applications.

 - Work with imaging datasets including Microscopy (Brightfield, Phase

 Contrast, Fluorescence), MRI, CT, and PET scans.

 - Develop solutions for image segmentation, advanced segmentation, cell

 and tissue detection, feature extraction (featurization), image

 enhancement, denoising, and quantitative image analysis.

 - Design and implement custom algorithms rather than relying solely on

 off-the-shelf software tools.

 - Leverage and fine-tune modern deep learning and vision foundation

 models for biomedical imaging applications.

 - Collaborate with scientists, AI researchers, and domain experts to

 solve real-world biomedical research challenges.

 - Evaluate and optimize machine learning and deep learning models for

 performance and accuracy.

Qualifications, Skills & Candidate Profile

 - M.Tech in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision,

 or related disciplines.

 - Freshers and experienced candidates (0–5 years) are welcome to apply.

 - Strong programming skills in Python and hands-on experience with

 OpenCV.

 - Good understanding of Computer Vision, Image Processing, Machine

 Learning, and Deep Learning.

 - Experience implementing, training, and evaluating deep learning models

 using PyTorch or similar frameworks.

 - Familiarity with modern vision architectures such as CNNs, Vision

 Transformers (ViTs), segmentation models, and vision foundation models.

 - Knowledge of image segmentation, feature extraction, image

 enhancement, and custom image processing pipeline development.

 - Exposure to biomedical imaging datasets such as Microscopy, MRI, CT,

 or PET images is preferred.

 - Experience through industry projects, academic research, internships,

 thesis work, or personal projects.

 - Familiarity with image annotation, model training, fine-tuning, and

 evaluation techniques.

 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and research skills.

 - Prior experience in biomedical imaging or medical image analysis will

 be an added advantage.

to creating a safe, inclusive, and respectful environment on campus.

practice that not only undermines the dignity of individuals but also

disrupts the harmony and camaraderie that we strive to foster. As you know,

our institution has a zero-tolerance policy towards ragging, and we ensure

humiliation. Engaging in ragging can result in severe disciplinary action,

including suspension, expulsion, and legal consequences as per the law. We

have established a dedicated anti-ragging monitoring cell and helpline to

support and protect students.

confidentiality and sensitivity. Your cooperation and active participation

creating a community where everyone can thrive without fear or intimidation.

unpleasant interactions/incidents that they face in campus, hostels or

outside the campus. Also, you are cautioned not to join any unofficial

whatsapp/telegram groups.

invite severe disciplinary actions against them.

or outside the campus for such things, please contact on the following

I encourage you to explore our vast collection of e-resources and make the

Subject: Top coder online test is scheduled on 7th July 2026 as per the batches timings- Update
Body:
Kind attention - PAT registered students!

As mentioned during the orientation, a test will be conducted to identify

the Top Coders (from all branches) on 7th July 2026. Based on the outcome,

the Top Coders list will be shared during the placement season. The Top

Coders list will be shared with all the companies along with the regular

list (based on the CGPA). Based on the company's decision (CGPA/Top Coder)

the students will be allowed for the selection process. The test will be

for one hour and the students have an option of choosing the programming

language (Java/Python/C++/C) for solving the test questions. Students may

choose any of the mentioned programming languages based on their interest.

There will be no Re-Test.

The test will be on the Neopat platform, students are advised to practice

the Mock tests in the neopat platform (2nd to 5th July 2026) before taking

the test .

Batchwise schedule for vellore campus will be shared at the earliest. The

schedule for the other campuses will be shared by the respective campus.

Any malpractice during the test will lead to debarment from attending

further campus recruitment

No Mobile phones / Electronic Gadgets are allowed in the test centers

Please Note that this is a Voluntary registration and students from any

branch/any CGPA) without backlogs) are eligible to apply.

Interested students are requested to register in the following link on or

before 05.07.2026

https://forms.gle/a49jSzKNRKFuHeeV6

Note: CDC Interns who got internship through CDC alone will have another

Test by 1st week of Aug 2026.

Body:
Amazon ML Summer School 2026

Hi Nayan Sharma,

We're excited to inform you that the Amazon ML Summer School 2026 Selection Test is now live! Before you begin, please review the key instructions and guidelines carefully to ensure a smooth and hassle-free test experience.

Kindly read through the following instructions carefully regarding the structure, timeline, and rules for the quiz and coding rounds to ensure a smooth experience.

  • Online Assessment Window: 28th June 2026, 2:00 PM IST to 28th June 2026, 06:00 PM
  • Online Assessment Duration: 1 Hour (60 minutes)
  • Total Questions to be answered: 22 (20 MCQ Questions + 2 Coding Problem Statements)
  • The MCQs will be based on Mathematics and Machine Learning concepts.
  • The Coding Problem Statements will be based on Data Structures & Algorithms.
  • You can attempt the round anytime between the provided round window.
  • Please ensure that you attempt the round in one sitting, as once you start the round, the timer won’t stop.
  • You will see the “Verify/Play” button in the Assessment round to initiate the assessment.
  • Please note that any participant resorting to unfair practices will be directly disqualified from the challenge. All decisions in the matter of eligibility, authenticity & final judgment will be with Unstop and Amazon.

System Requirements:

  • A laptop/desktop (for attempting the assessment) with at least 8GB RAM.
  • If you have an antivirus software installed on your system, please ensure that the Smarthire app is whitelisted. Alternatively, you may temporarily uninstall the antivirus to allow the app to function properly.
  • The assessment must be taken on a Windows or Mac laptop/desktop; mobile phones, tablets, and Linux systems are not allowed.
  • Ensure that the device has webcam & microphone access and is connected to a stable internet connection (> 10 Mbps). Please note that an unstable internet connection can result in your assessment being terminated.
  • Ensure all notifications & interruptions are turned off on the device OR do-not-disturb (DND) is enabled.
  • Ensure that the device is fully charged or is connected to a power outlet.

Webcam Requirements:

  • The assessment must be taken on a device with an integrated (built-in) webcam.
  • The use of external webcams or cameras is strictly prohibited.
  • Please uninstall or disable any virtual camera software, including but not limited to OBS Virtual Camera, XSplit VCam, Snap Camera, ManyCam, or similar applications.
  • Before starting the assessment, verify your camera setup using webcamtests.com and ensure that your integrated webcam is functioning properly.
  • Once the assessment begins, do not switch, disconnect, or connect any cameras.
  • Ensure that your webcam remains enabled, stable, and clearly visible throughout the entire assessment.

Steps to download the SmartHire App:

The assessment will be hosted on the Unstop SmartHire App. Follow the instructions given below to download and use the application:

  • Go to the opportunity page
  • Click on the “Start” button beside the Assessment round. 
  • Download the SmartHire App from the given option according to your system (Windows/Mac). Please note that the assessment is not supported on Linux systems.
  • Copy the Visible Code from the Start page itself.
  • Open the SmartHire App and paste the copied Code, and your assessment will begin. 
  • If you are still facing any issues, do reach out to us at support@unstop.com with a proper screen recording.

Simultaneous Logins and Accessibility:

  • You can attempt the assessment on any desktop or laptop but not on a mobile device.
  • Simultaneous logins are not allowed i.e. you can only attempt the assessment from one laptop or desktop.
  • In case simultaneous logins are detected, the system may terminate the assessment altogether, and you may only get error messages.

Other instructions:

  • If you face any technical problem, clear your browser's cache or try it on a different browser or in incognito mode.
  • If you have an antivirus software/extensions installed on your system, please ensure that the Smarthire app is whitelisted. Alternatively, you may temporarily uninstall the antivirus software to allow the app to function properly.
  • You may also try changing your internet, mobile hotspot, wifi, etc.
  • Please shoot an email to support@unstop.com with a screenshot of the page where you are facing a problem and your registered email ID. Please note that we won't be helping you make decisions, and any email asking us to make decisions will not be entertained.

Proctoring Related:

  • You can attempt the assessments only on a desktop/laptop with webcam access.
  • The assessments will be hosted in full-screen mode.
  • Anything that disturbs the full-screen mode of the assessment is treated as a violation. It may be due to any of the following reasons but not limited to:
    • Tab Switching
    • Screen Sharing with anyone
    • Clicking on the escape button
    • Computer going on Sleep (Adjust your power or sleep mode settings)
    • Windows or Browser or any Application-specific notifications (Put them in No Disturb Mode or switch them off while the quiz is on)
    • Anything else that may result in disturbing the full-screen mode
  • The assessment does not get terminated on the first such instance. Only repeated violations will result in disqualification and termination of the assessment immediately.
  • Your face will be verified before the start of the assessment from the photo that was captured during registration. 
  • Your face may be verified again during the assessment.
  • Your face will be constantly detected, and violations will be tracked and reported while the assessment is on. Eg: Two faces in front of the camera, No one in front of the camera, etc.

All the best!

Regards,
Team Amazon ML Summer School 2026

Amazon ML Summer School 2026

Hi Nayan Sharma,

We're delighted to inform you that you’ve made it to the Selection Test of the Amazon ML Summer School 2026! With the Test lined up for Sunday, 28th June 2026, please make sure you're well-versed with the key instructions and guidelines to ensure a smooth experience.

Kindly read through the following instructions carefully regarding the structure, timeline, and rules for the quiz and coding rounds to ensure a smooth experience.

  • Online Assessment Window: 28th June 2026, 2:00 PM IST to 28th June 2026, 06:00 PM
  • Online Assessment Duration: 1 Hour (60 minutes)
  • Total Questions to be answered: 22 (20 MCQ Questions + 2 Coding Problem Statements)
  • The MCQs will be based on Mathematics and Machine Learning concepts.
  • The Coding Problem Statements will be based on Data Structures & Algorithms and SQL.
  • You can attempt the round anytime between the provided round window.
  • Please ensure that you attempt the round in one sitting, as once you start the round, the timer won’t stop.
  • You will see the “Verify/Play” button in the Assessment round to initiate the assessment.
  • Please note that any participant resorting to unfair practices will be directly disqualified from the challenge. All decisions in the matter of eligibility, authenticity & final judgment will be with Unstop and Amazon.

System Requirements:

  • A laptop/desktop (for attempting the assessment) with at least 8GB RAM.
  • If you have an antivirus software installed on your system, please ensure that the Smarthire app is whitelisted. Alternatively, you may temporarily uninstall the antivirus to allow the app to function properly.
  • The assessment must be taken on a Windows or Mac laptop/desktop; mobile phones, tablets, and Linux systems are not allowed.
  • Ensure that the device has webcam & microphone access and is connected to a stable internet connection (> 10 Mbps). Please note that an unstable internet connection can result in your assessment being terminated.
  • Ensure all notifications & interruptions are turned off on the device OR do-not-disturb (DND) is enabled.
  • Ensure that the device is fully charged or is connected to a power outlet.

Webcam Requirements:

  • Only one active camera should be connected to your device (either the built-in webcam or one external webcam).
  • Disable or uninstall any virtual camera software such as OBS Virtual Camera, XSplit VCam, Snap Camera, ManyCam, or similar tools.
  • Before the exam, verify your camera setup using webcamtests.com and ensure that only one camera device is listed.
  • If multiple cameras are detected, disconnect extra webcams, close/uninstall virtual camera software, and restart your system if required.
  • During the exam, do not switch or connect cameras. Ensure your webcam remains enabled, uninterrupted, and clearly visible throughout the assessment.

Steps to download the SmartHire App:

The assessment will be hosted on the Unstop SmartHire App. Follow the instructions given below to download and use the application:

  • Go to the opportunity page
  • Click on the “Start” button beside the Assessment round. 
  • Download the SmartHire App from the given option according to your system (Windows/Mac). Please note that the assessment is not supported on Linux systems.
  • Copy the Visible Code from the Start page itself.
  • Open the SmartHire App and paste the copied Code, and your assessment will begin. 
  • If you are still facing any issues, do reach out to us at support@unstop.com with a proper screen recording.

Simultaneous Logins and Accessibility:

  • You can attempt the assessment on any desktop or laptop but not on a mobile device.
  • Simultaneous logins are not allowed i.e. you can only attempt the assessment from one laptop or desktop.
  • In case simultaneous logins are detected, the system may terminate the assessment altogether, and you may only get error messages.

Other instructions:

  • If you face any technical problem, clear your browser's cache or try it on a different browser or in incognito mode.
  • If you have an antivirus software/extensions installed on your system, please ensure that the Smarthire app is whitelisted. Alternatively, you may temporarily uninstall the antivirus software to allow the app to function properly.
  • You may also try changing your internet, mobile hotspot, wifi, etc.
  • Please shoot an email to support@unstop.com with a screenshot of the page where you are facing a problem and your registered email ID. Please note that we won't be helping you make decisions, and any email asking us to make decisions will not be entertained.

Proctoring Related:

  • You can attempt the assessments only on a desktop/laptop with webcam access.
  • The assessments will be hosted in full-screen mode.
  • Anything that disturbs the full-screen mode of the assessment is treated as a violation. It may be due to any of the following reasons but not limited to:
    • Tab Switching
    • Screen Sharing with anyone
    • Clicking on the escape button
    • Computer going on Sleep (Adjust your power or sleep mode settings)
    • Windows or Browser or any Application-specific notifications (Put them in No Disturb Mode or switch them off while the quiz is on)
    • Anything else that may result in disturbing the full-screen mode
  • The assessment does not get terminated on the first such instance. Only repeated violations will result in disqualification and termination of the assessment immediately.
  • Your face will be verified before the start of the assessment from the photo that was captured during registration. 
  • Your face may be verified again during the assessment.
  • Your face will be constantly detected, and violations will be tracked and reported while the assessment is on. Eg: Two faces in front of the camera, No one in front of the camera, etc.

All the best!

Regards,
Team Amazon ML Summer School 2026

Body:
Dear Student,

Guidelines – Course Registration (Fall Semester 2026 - 27)

 1. Senior Students and timed-out students of all the programmes except

 BSc (Agri), BSc Catering & Hotel Management, B. Des., B. Arc., BSc

 Multimedia, BSc Visual Communication, M. Des., M. Arc., MSW, B. Tech

 Computer Science and Business Systems (2023 & 2024 Batch) are permitted

 to take part in the course registration.

 2. Course Registration is scheduled to be conducted on 28. 06. 2026.

 3. Information on the course registration schedule for the Fall Semester

 2026 - 27 (time and duration for various groups of students) will be made

 available on VTOP and the VITian Mobile App on 25th June 2026.

 4. Information on courses offered for the Fall Semester 2026 - 27 will

 be made available on VTOP and the VITian Mobile App on 26th June 2026

 5. During the course registration process (on 28.06.2026), all the core,

 elective and compulsory courses with the following options will be

 permitted:

 Regular / Re-register / Substitution (UE / OE / DE / PE and

also in HSM / Language Basket)

 Regular (UC as UE, PE as UE, DE as OE, SPE as OE)

 Minor / Honour / Second Major Programmes

Multidisciplinary Elective (applicable to the 2023 & 2024 Batch B. Tech

Core Programmes only, except BBS): An option is provided to earn the

required credits under the Discipline Elective / Open Elective category by

registering courses listed under multidisciplinary electives. The

eligibility criteria to register for course(s) under the multidisciplinary

elective are to have completed a minimum of 9 credits from the courses

listed under the Discipline Electives. The remaining credits can be earned

from courses listed under either Discipline Electives or Multidisciplinary

Electives to meet the credit requirements as per the curriculum.

 6. The add / Drop option will be enabled for all the students from

 06.07.26 to 08.07.2026. During the Add / Drop period, students can register

 for courses under Audit / Grade Improvement / Additional Course / Minor /

 Honour / Second Major options.

 7. Removal of courses registered under the regular mode is not possible

 unless the course registered under ‘Additional’ is removed first.

 8. The student should generate an invoice on VTOP (in the timetable

 menu) and proceed for payment (under the menu – Online Payments) for the

 courses that demand course fees. The courses of fee defaulters will be

 deregistered after the deadline.

 9. Courses cannot be deleted or withdrawn if the fee payment is made.

 10. Students are required to go through the Academic Regulations for

 further clarification on the terminology.

 11. Queries related to course offerings should be addressed to the

 respective Head of the Department.

Project Registration Rules 

All eligible M. Tech./ MCA /MSc students who were admitted in 2025

-26 will be permitted to register for Internship I/ Dissertation I during

the Fall Semester 2026-27 with a duration of 6 months.

Integrated students of MIC/MID/MIY who are admitted in 2022-23 will be

permitted to register for the Capstone project/Master's thesis with a

duration of 12 months.

BXXX497J - Project I is compulsory for the 2023-24 batch B.Tech. students.

During registration, students should select a guide and a tentative project

title.

BAXXX291 – Innovative Design Project is compulsory for the 2025-26 batch

B.Tech students. During registration, students should select a guide and a

tentative project title.

Kindly note that there will be two options to register for Internship I /

Dissertation I / Capstone Project / Master Thesis:

a) ACAD - ACADEMICS

b) PAT - PLACEMENT AND TRAINING

Students who have already received an Internship offer through CDC have to

register for the course under “PAT - PLACEMENT AND TRAINING”. The remaining

students have to register under ACAD – Academics, for which a “Faculty

Guide” is to be selected. (Guide change option will be enabled during the

Add / Drop period)

Students can change the option from ACAD to PAT whenever an internship

offer is received in future by submitting proof (received from the CDC) and

a consent letter (from the Guide) to the Academics Office.

with regards

behind diseases like Alzheimer's and ALS? This is the key question driving

wrong, it triggers terminal neurodegenerative diseases. This project sits

Subject: Establishment of High-Temperature Fatigue Tester Facility under DST-FIST Grant at CIMR
Body:
Dear All,

We are pleased to inform you that, under the DST-FIST grant, a

High-Temperature Fatigue Testing facility has been successfully established

at the Centre for Innovative Manufacturing Research. The equipment has been

successfully installed, followed by initial trial runs, it is now fully

operational at GDN G14.

The facility is listed in the CRF portal (https://crf.vit.ac.in/) under the

name HIGH TEMPERATURE SERVO HYDRAULIC FATIGUE TEST SYSTEM for slot

booking.

This equipment is capable of performing a wide range of mechanical and

fatigue-related tests, including:

 - Tensile Testing

 - Compression Testing

 - Flexural Testing

 - Low-Cycle Fatigue (LCF) Testing

 - High-Cycle Fatigue (HCF) Testing

 - Temperature-Assisted Fatigue Testing (up to 900°C)

 - Fracture Toughness Testing

 - Fatigue Pre- cracking

We hereby express our sincere gratitude to the management for their

continuous support and for providing additional funding towards the

establishment of this facility. We also thank the support extended by the Vice

Chancellor, Pro-Vice Chancellor, the Director of Purchase and his team; the

Director of Estates and his team throughout the procurement, installation,

and commissioning process.

We extend our sincere thanks to the FIST Implementation Team - Dr. Raja

Annamalai A, Dr. Vasudevan R, Dr. Ashish Kumar, Dr Anoj Giri and Dr.

Pandivelan C for their valuable contributions to the successful

establishment of this facility. We also appreciate the dedicated efforts of

the lab staff, Mr. Kamalakannan S and Mr. Kiran Kumar C M, along with other

SMEC staff members, during the installation and trial period of the

equipment.

The facility is now ready and open to all faculty, scholars, and students

for research and testing activities.

We are also glad to share that the equipment will be available for

24/7 operation during the testing period.

All are invited to make use of this facility!!

Thank you very much.

Kind regards,

Dr. Arivarasu M

Green Tiger Mobility Dream Internship Registration – 2027 Batch. 

Green Tiger Mobility, India’s largest EV retrofit and innovating power

electronics company. Founded in Bengaluru, we are working towards

transforming India’s 30+ crore petrol two-wheelers into cleaner, smarter,

and more affordable mobility solutions.

We hold 6 patents on our technology which spans ARAI/RTO approved EV

retrofit systems, Battery Management Systems (BMS), Vehicle Control Units

(VCU), telematics platforms, fleet analytics, and

hybrid mobility solutions. Our work has received recognition and support

from institutions like ARAI, IIM Bangalore, Ministry of Heavy Industries,

Meaty, BITS Pilani, NASSCOM, and FICCI. We are well funded by

Institutional investors as well industry players like Bajaj Motors, etc.

As Green Tiger continues its growth journey and expands across India and

South Asia, we are looking to engage talented students who aspire to build

careers in Mobility, Power Electronics, AI and Operations.

Why Green Tiger?

Most internships allow students to observe business operations. However,

at Green Tiger, interns become part of the team responsible for building

and scaling them. They work closely with leaders and experts on real

business challenges across functions. Their recommendations are not

confined to presentations—they often translate into actions that directly

impact business performance.

Areas of Internship

 - Strategy & Business Planning

 - Program Management

 - Operations Excellence

 - Product & Process Improvement

 - Business Analytics & Dashboarding

 - Customer Experience & Service Operations

 - Growth & Market Expansion

· Exposure to one of India's most exciting and rapidly evolving industries

· Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership and decision-makers

· Experience solving real operational and business challenges in a

high-growth environment

· Cross-functional exposure across technology, operations, customer

experience, and business strategy

· Development of problem-solving, stakeholder management, analytical, and

execution skills that are critical for future leadership roles

At Green Tiger, we believe the best learning happens when students are

trusted with responsibility and encouraged to create measurable impact. We

look forward to collaborate with your institution and provide students with

an opportunity to contribute, learn, and grow while helping shape the

future of mobility in India

Subject: National Reading Day 2026 Celebration – Invitation to Participate in Library Events and Lucky Draw
Body:
Dear VITians,

Greetings from Periyar EVR Central Library!

Every year, National Reading Day is celebrated in India on 19th June to

commemorate the legacy of Puthuvayil Narayana (P.N.) Panicker, widely

recognized as the Father of India's Library Movement.

In connection with National Reading Day 2026, the Periyar EVR Central

Library is organizing the following events on 19th June 2026:

 1. My Favourite Book (Subject Area)

 2. My Favourite Book (General Category)

 3. Lucky Draw

Venue : Periyar EVR Central Library

Date : 19th June 2026

Time : 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM

The Library Team cordially invites all students, research scholars, faculty

members, and staff to actively participate in the above-mentioned events

during the stipulated time period.

Readers visiting the library on the event day will be provided with a

participation slip to enter their Name, Registration/ Employee Number, and

Mobile Number, which should be dropped into the designated box. At the

time of exit, participants are requested to complete a Google Form (This

google form will be provided at the exit point).

Based on the responses received through the Google Form, prizes will be

awarded under the following categories:

My Favourite Book (Subject Area)

 - First Prize – ₹1,000

 - Second Prize – ₹500

 - Third Prize – ₹250

My Favourite Book (General Category)

 - First Prize – ₹1,000

 - Second Prize – ₹500

 - Third Prize – ₹250

All readers visiting the library on the event day will be automatically

entered into the Lucky Draw. Three winners will be selected and awarded

special book prizes:

Lucky Draw

· First Prize

 - Second Prize

 - Third Prize

Prize Distribution Ceremony

The Prize Distribution Ceremony will be chaired by our esteemed Core Group

Members.

Venue : Periyar EVR Central Library

Date : 19th June 2026

Time : 5:00 PM

All readers are warmly invited to attend the Prize Distribution Ceremony.

Special surprise gifts will be distributed to attendees and participants.

We look forward to your enthusiastic participation and support in

celebrating the joy of reading.

Director Periyar EVR Central Library & Team

Thanks and Regards,

Dear Faculty, Scholars/ Students,

This is a reminder to adhere to VIT’s official norms and procedures when

preparing and communicating articles to journals. Please ensure that:

 - All manuscripts follow the university’s authorship, affiliation, and

 acknowledgement guidelines.

 - Author names should not contain Ms. / Mr. / Dr. / Prof. / Sr./ UG

 /PG/Research Scholar (Example: Kanchana Bhaaskaran V.S.)

 - Author Affiliations should not contain the associated lab

(Example: Department

 of Chemistry, School of Advanced Sciences, Vellore Institute of

 Technology, Vellore, India / Automotive Research Centre, Vellore Institute

 of Technology, Vellore, India )

 - Please avoid the use of your personal email IDs for author

 affiliations and as the corresponding author (for Scholars and Students:

 xxx@vitstudent.ac.in / for faculty yyy@vit.ac.in), also avoid creating a

 new profile in Scopus/WoS for every new publication. You can use your

 personal email ID for account creation and communications in the submission

 portal.

 submission, as per the guidelines circulated from the Institutional

 Ethical Committee on Human Studies, VIT (iech@vit.ac.in <iech@vit.ac.in>)

 dated Jan 22, 2026, 10:56 AM

 - Any use of institutional resources, funding, or laboratories is disclosed

 and acknowledged in the manuscript.

 - Conflicts of interest, funding sources, and ethical approvals (if

 applicable) are clearly stated.

 - All the submitted articles should be checked for the similarity index

 and AI before communication.

 through https://egateway.vit.ac.in/home, databases, Web of Science

 journal title, choose View Journal Impact, and verify that the Category

 Quartile under Journal Impact Factor ™ belongs to Q1/Q2 as per university

 guidelines for APC Support. Scopus suggested Quartiles are not taken

 into account.

Following these norms protects your work and the university’s reputation

and ensures compliance with publisher and funding requirements.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated Prompt Engineer Intern with a

strong Computer Science background and a passion for Artificial

Intelligence and Generative AI technologies. The ideal candidate should be

comfortable using AI tools to solve problems, generate code, automate

workflows, and improve productivity through effective prompt design.

This internship offers an opportunity to work on real-world AI

applications, experiment with Large Language Models (LLMs), and contribute

to AI-powered solutions across recruitment, automation, software

development, and business operations.

· Design, test, and optimize prompts for Large Language Models

(LLMs) such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and similar AI platforms.

· Create AI-assisted solutions for coding, debugging,

documentation, and process automation.

· Develop structured prompt libraries and reusable AI workflows.

· Work closely with product, engineering, and business teams to

understand requirements and translate them into effective AI interactions.

· Evaluate AI-generated outputs and continuously improve response

quality and accuracy.

· Assist in building AI-powered tools, agents, chatbots, and

automation solutions.

· Research emerging trends in Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, AI

Agents, and LLM applications.

· Document best practices, prompt templates, and performance

benchmarks.

· Support experimentation with APIs, AI frameworks, and automation

platforms.

Required Skills

· Strong academic background in Computer Science, IT, AI, or

related disciplines.

· Good understanding of programming concepts and software

development fundamentals.

· Familiarity with at least one programming language such as Python,

Java, JavaScript, C++, or C#.

· Experience using AI coding assistants such as ChatGPT, GitHub

Copilot, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, or similar tools.

· Understanding of Prompt Engineering techniques, including:

· Zero-shot prompting

· Few-shot prompting

· Chain-of-thought prompting

· Role-based prompting

· Structured output generation

· Basic understanding of APIs, JSON, REST services, and data

handling.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

· Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new AI technologies.

Preferred Skills

· Knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented

Generation), AI Agents, or LangChain.

· Experience building personal AI projects, hackathon projects, or

academic projects using AI tools.

· Familiarity with Git/GitHub and software development workflows.

· Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

· Understanding of automation tools and workflow orchestration

platforms.

What We Are Looking For

· Candidates who actively use AI tools for coding, learning, and

problem-solving.

· Individuals who can think critically about AI-generated outputs

and improve them through better prompts.

· Strong curiosity about emerging AI technologies and their

practical applications.

· Self-driven learners who enjoy experimenting and building

innovative solutions.

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [7th June] events.

World Food Safety Day 2026

Observed on 7 June, World Food Safety Day raises awareness about the

importance of safe food for good health and well-being. Foodborne diseases

continue to affect millions of people worldwide but are largely preventable

through proper food safety practices. Food safety is a shared

responsibility involving farmers, food manufacturers, transporters,

vendors, governments, and consumers. By following proper hygiene practices,

safe food handling procedures, and quality standards, we can reduce the

risk of contamination and protect public health.

The 2026 theme, "From burden to solutions – safe food everywhere,"

emphasizes using data and evidence to develop effective, targeted solutions

that reduce foodborne illnesses and save lives.

Let us work together—from farm to table—to ensure safe, nutritious food for

everyone.

Safe Food Today for a Healthy Tomorrow.

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [5th June] events.

World Environment Day

World Environment Day is celebrated annually on 5 June and is the United

Nations' principal vehicle for encouraging awareness and action for the

protection of the environment. First held in 1974, it has been a platform

for raising awareness on environmental issues such as marine pollution,

human overpopulation, global warming, sustainable consumption, and wildlife

crime. World Environment Day is a global platform for public outreach, with

participation from over 143 countries annually. Every World Environment Day

is hosted by a different country, in which official celebrations take

place. Each year, the program has provided a theme and forum for

businesses, non-government organizations, communities, governments, and

celebrities to advocate environmental causes. Millions of people have taken

part over the years, helping drive change in our consumption habits as well

as in national and international environmental policy.

The 2026 World Environment Day theme is “Inspired by Nature. For

Climate. For Our Future”.

 #WorldEnvironmentDay 2026 focuses on climate change—on the urgent signals

recruitment process for the 2026 MCUT Language and Culture Summer Camp!

 Taiwan.

 at MCUT.

 .

 equivalent to CEFR B1 or above.

Subject: Paper Seeing, Revaluation, Re-FAT and Make-up exam Process for Winter Semester 2025-26 (Regular & Week End Intra Semester) FAT – Theory
Body:
Ref.No. VIT/COE/2026/26007

 Date: 22-May-2026

Paper Seeing, Revaluation, Re-FAT and Make-up exam Process for

Winter Semester 2025-26 (Regular & Week End Intra Semester) FAT –

Theory

 Paper Seeing and Revaluation:

· In the VTop student login, (“Examination → Marks → Winter

 Semester 2025-26”) Marks for the Courses to which FAT was held during

Apr-May 2026 has been made available now.

 Marks not displayed for the courses will be released within a

couple of days.

· Actual Grades will be released on 29 May 2026 (Friday). The

Pass criteria and Grading Procedure are available in Academics → Regulations

Tab in your login.

· If you want to know the question wise marks awarded to your

answers by the evaluator, you need to apply for it through V-Top. This is

referred to as the “Paper Seeing” process. It requires payment of Rs. 100

for each paper. You can apply through: Examinations →Papersee/Rev →

 Winter Semester 2025-26→Paper Seeing. You can choose the course(s) you

want to apply for paper seeing. After Generating the Invoice, you need to

make a payment through the “Online Payments” Tab in the same V-Top login.

· Once you have paid, after 24 hours, the paper and question

wise marks awarded will be made available in CodeTantra login. You need

to use the same portal https://vit.codetantra.com for this process.

After seeing the paper, if you feel the mark awarded to a particular

question is not sufficient and the evaluator has missed something and there

is a need to recheck the mark, then you can apply for Revaluation of the

Course. You need to give suitable reasons for the same in the comments

section available just below the mark awarded by the faculty.

· Please note that the Revaluation has to be applied only in V-Top

(in the same way as you have applied for paper seeing) and necessary

payments also need to be paid through the online payments tab. (Rs. 300

per paper). Revaluation approval process in codetantra will be initiated

only after publishing the Grades, until then the status remains ‘approval

pending’ . Paper seeing and feedback / comments are mandatory for

re-evaluation and

are in online mode only.

 · Also note that “Paper seeing” and Revaluation is applicable

only for the Theory Courses to which FAT was conducted by the CoE office .

For other components and Courses (like Laboratory / Project Courses IBL

mode courses) there is No Paper seeing and Revaluation Process.

· The students who were involved in Winter Semester 2025-26

examination malpractices are not eligible for the paper

seeing/ Re-valuation process.

Particulars

Dates

Paper seeing registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 100]

 23 May 2026 to 27 May 2026

Revaluation registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 300]

 24 May 2026 to 28 May 2026

Paper Seeing in https://vit.codetantra.com/

https://vit.codetantra.com/

 24 May 2026 to 28 May 2026

 Once the Paper seeing request is approved, the evaluated copy of answer

sheets would be made available in CodeTantra as per the above schedule.

Use your VTop login credentials for login.

· After login, follow the instructions given in the platform for

giving comments to the questions which need to be re-examined.

· Give your feedback with respect to the need for revaluation. If

no feedback is given for any question, your answer script will not be

considered for revaluation and No refund will be given for any approved

requests.

· Students should not approach or give any sort of request to any

faculty related to revaluation (increase of marks or grades). If we

receive any complaints from faculty, it will be treated as ‘Malpractice’

and revaluation requests will summarily be rejected.

Re-FAT:

As per VIT Academic regulations (Page 22) Re-FAT will be permitted for the

following reasons only:

S. No.

Description

Supporting Evidence(s) Required

1.

Calamity in the family [Death of father / mother / own brother / sister]

Death certificate or Prior communication to the Proctors

2.

Hospitalization of the student

(for in-patient treatment only)

Medical Certificate, Investigation Report, Bills and Discharge Summary.

· Eligible students should apply in VTop student login (

Examination > Re-Exam Application) between 1st June 2026 and 14th June

2026 and upload the necessary evidence.

· Re-FAT requests will be scrutinized by the School Dean and then

by the ‘Re‐examinations Committee’. If needed the student may be asked to

appear before the Committee for presenting the case.

· For the ReFAT approved courses the Grade assigned will be

converted to “---“ by February end. ReFAT will be scheduled along with the

Fall 2026-27 Regular Arrear and the Regular Arrear Process will be followed

for Re-FAT.

· Any student who fails to apply for Re‐FAT through VTop will NOT

be considered for further processing and has to repeat the course(s) by

registering again in subsequent semesters.

· Please note that this process is only for getting approval

for Re-FAT. After it is approved, students need to register in Arrear

/ Re-FAT Tab for registering the course when it is permitted. The

schedule will be available only in Arrear/ Tab. If someone misses the

approved Re-FAT, no second chance will be given, and it will be treated as

absent accordingly, and the grade will be published.

Make-up Examination:

Make-up Exam Registration opens between 8th June 2026 and 21st June 2026.

Use Vtop Student Login (Examinations/Make-Up Exam Registration) for

registration. Make-up exams will be scheduled in the 1st week of

September 2026 ( Tentatively).

Subject: Call for Creators: graVITas 2026 Official Teaser Video Contest!
Body:
Dear Students,

Greetings!

The countdown to the most anticipated techno-management fest of the year

has begun! As we gear up for graVITas 2026, we want to build the hype and

capture the true spirit of the fest—and we want you to be the ones to do it.

We are thrilled to announce the graVITas 2026 Teaser Video Contest. If

you have a talent for cinematography, video editing, or animation, this is

your platform to showcase your skills to the entire campus.

What We Are Looking For

We need a high-energy, captivating, and creative teaser video that sets the

tone for graVITas 2026. Whether it's through fast-paced edits, stunning

motion graphics, or compelling storytelling, your video should leave

everyone counting down the days until the fest.

The Grand Prize

The creator behind the chosen teaser will be rewarded with:

 - 100% Event Fee Waiver: Free registration for ANY ONE graVITas 2026

 event of your choice.

 - Exclusive Merch: A free official graVITas 2026 T-shirt!

Rules & Guidelines

 - Theme: Teaser should reflect the energy, innovation, and

 techno-management spirit of graVITas 2026. May be aligned with tagline

 “Driven by Innovation | Anchored in Sustainability”.

 - Duration: The teaser should be short, impactful, and ideally between

 30 to 60 seconds.

 - Originality: All footage, graphics, and audio must be original or

 copyright-free. Plagiarism will lead to immediate disqualification.

 - Quality: Submissions must be in high definition (1080p or 4K) in MP4

 format.

 - Selection: The final decision on the winning teaser video rests

 entirely with the Core Organizing Team.

How to Submit

 - Upload Link: https://forms.gle/NdLf7kHRF82Xgpcz6 (Use your VIT mail

 ID to access the google form)

 - Submission Deadline: 26.05.2026, 5.00pm

This is your chance to be the visual voice of the fest. We can't wait to

see the creativity you bring to the screen!

For any questions, feel free to reply to this email or reach out to

9003509595, 9942002947

TCS Registration – 2027 Batch

Greetings from Tata Consultancy Services!!!

We are pleased to invite eligible students from your institute to

participate in the TCS Priority Institution National Qualifier Test (NQT)

for the 2027 graduating batch. As TCS accelerates the enterprise adoption

of AI and Generative AI, students joining us will have opportunities to

work on AI-led transformation programs at scale, supported by enterprise AI

platforms, deep industry context, and global technology partnerships.

Kindly ensure that all eligibility criteria and validation checks are

completed before sharing the final student list with us on or before May

16, 2026. Please note, no changes will be permitted after the closure date.

TCS Eligibility Criteria:

Courses & Disciplines

Batch of 2027 Only.

Listed highest qualifications—B.Tech., M.Tech. (2yr & 5yr), M.C.A., M.Sc,

(2yr & 5yr),. from any discipline/department.

Course Type

Only Full-Time courses will be considered

(Part Time / Correspondence Courses will not be considered)

Percentage

Candidates must have a minimum aggregate of 60%

OR

6 CGPA in all semesters up to the latest declared results.

AND

Offer is valid only if the final degree or provisional certificate confirms

'FIRST CLASS' in the highest qualification, completed within the stipulated

time.

Backlogs / Arrears / ATKT:

Application & Test Process: The student should not have more than 1 (one)

pending or active backlog / arrear / ATKT at the time of appearing for

the TCS Selection process.

Onboarding Process: At the time of onboarding, no pending backlogs /

arrears / ATKT will be permitted.

Please note: All pending backlogs / arrears / ATKT should be cleared

within the course duration stipulated by the University.

Gap / Break in Education

Ensure any academic gaps during your education are declared and supported

with valid proof; breaks should not exceed 24 months.

Work Experience

Students with prior work experience of up to two years are eligible to

apply for this hiring process (Applicable only for postgraduate students).

Age

A student should be 18 to 28 years of age to participate in

the TCS Hiring Process.

Sl.No

Important Notes

1

Only students graduating in the year 2027 are eligible to apply, and this

must be clearly indicated in their TCS Application Form

2

All students must ensure that they use their Personal Email ID Only.

Please note: Email ID CANNOT be changed once submitted.

3

Reference ID series starting DT/CT 2023 onwards to be used, as older IDs

will not be accepted; if students have a reference ID prior to 2023, they

should contact us for profile deletion and re-registration should be

completed before the registration date.

4

Please do eligibility check for the candidate data at your end too and

eliminate any ineligible profiles.

All the students are asked to go through the entire mail before

registering.

TCS Registration Process:

1) Visit https://nextstep.tcsapps.com/indiacampus/#/

2) Click “Register Now”

3) Select category as “IT”

4) Fill in details to generate a Reference ID

5) Click “Apply for Drive”

If a candidate already has a Reference ID, please ensure “Apply for Drive”

is clicked.

The registration window for the assessment process will be open from 11

May to 16 May 2026.

VIT Link: https://forms.gle/QmYM3mtDNMxW5J3h8

https://forms.gle/QmYM3mtDNMxW5J3h8

Registration in both links (TCS & VIT) is mandatory.

All the CDC internship selects are eligible for the TCS process, All are

asked to register without fail (if they eligible)

All the M.Tech Integrated Students are asked to fill the highest

qualification as Bachelor of Engineering & Master of Science as of now.

AI-focused Career Opportunities for Students

Students hired through this drive may be aligned to future-ready work

across areas such as AI and data engineering, machine learning, deep

learning and GenAI, cloud data platforms, intelligent automation, and

AI-enabled software engineering.

Career pathways may include AI and Data tracks, including roles such as ML

Engineer and GenAI-focused engineering roles, along with broader digital

roles where AI is embedded into delivery.

As the industry landscape undergoes significant shifts in required skills

and expertise, TCS offers students a strong opportunity to remain relevant,

continuously upskill, and build careers for the new era.

Additional 15% Student Nomination from Group Institutes

The Placement Officer of a TCS Priority Institute may share an additional

list of students who are interested in taking the TCS NQT for Priority

Institutes. This additional list will be limited to 15% of the eligible

students who have applied for the TCS NQT for Priority Institutes from the

parent institute. The eligibility criteria will remain the same as

mentioned above.

Disclaimer

 - Eligibility checks will be conducted at various stages of the hiring

 process

 - Any ineligible candidature or misrepresentation of information will

 lead to disqualification.

 - TCS does not send job offers or hiring-related communications from

 unofficial email IDs such as Gmail, Rediffmail, Yahoo Mail, Hotmail, etc.

 - TCS does not ask candidates to pay any money during the recruitment

 process.

 - TCS is not associated with any external agency or company for

 employment offers.

As part of our continued efforts to enhance the recruitment experience, we

are introducing the following key features for the current hiring cycle:

 - On-premise Internet-based Assessment (IBA) Model and interview

 process: The assessment and interview process will be conducted on

 campus, ensuring a seamless and convenient experience for students.

 - Immediate Release of Offer Letters: Offer Letters will be issued to

 selected candidates immediately upon completion of the hiring process.

 - Focused Candidate Engagement Initiatives: Targeted engagement

The registration window for the Priority NQT will be open from May 8,

xAI, DeepSeek, Claude, Cursor, OpenClaw, Github Copilot, etc.. GitHub will

disqualification. Note that existing online solutions may not accurately

address the questions provided in this assessment.

current skill level: Full Stack, Frontend, or Backend (choose one only).

assessment.

installed, as no additional time will be provided for installation. If

suitable IDE and API clients are not available, candidates must install

them on their system. We recommend using VSCode and Postman/Insomnia. Use

of Online IDEs or code editors is not allowed.

The test link and access code will be shared via email at the exact time of

the test.

Candidates must push their code to GitHub and complete a Google form for

test submission. When pushing code, everything should be included in one

branch and one repository. Use the college roll number as the repository

name, and use separate folders for each attempted question. Submissions

will be disregarded if pushed to a different branch or repository.

Additionally, candidates must add Node Modules, .DS_Store, etc., to

the .gitignore

file before pushing the code.
