Subject: Quality Week 25-26: Day-3 Special Events- reg
Body:
Dear VITians,

VIT celebrates Quality Week 2025–2026, a week-long journey of learning,

innovation, and performance presented by the Office of Students' Welfare.

This year’s theme, “Quality: Drive for Innovation and Sustainability,”

reflects our commitment to fostering creativity, responsible growth, and a

culture of excellence in everything we do. The Office of Students’ Welfare

invites you to today’s Quality Week events, brought to you by the Student

Council and various Clubs and Chapters.

Day 3 Events:

 -

 Agro-waste to Market

 -

 SubGiga Systems

 -

 Drones Decoded

 -

 FlagWars

 -

 IoT-Enabled Quality Healthcare Systems

 -

 Sustain-a-thon

 -

 Prakriti vs Pragathi

 -

 The Sustainable Stack: From Python Data Science to Energy-Efficient

 Hardware

 -

 Survey Says Sustainable

 -

 SustainInk

 -

 Green Computing- Energy Efficient Software Systems

 -

 Quailnova

Scroll down for more details

NUTRITION CLUB

Event Name: Agro-waste to Market 

Event Time: 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM 

Event Description: Teams will ideate an innovative,sustainable product from

assigned agro-waste such as fruit peels or agricultural residuces sourced

from food processing or farming sector.Present the concept,scientific

rationale,target market and business potential.No product making just

powerful ideas driving circular economy and real world impact

Venue: TT VOC Gallery

Registration: VTOP

IEEE COMSOC 

Event Name: SubGiga Systems

Event Time: 2:00 PM To 5:00 PM

Event Description:SubGiga Systems is a 3-hour hands-on event introducing

first-year students to sustainable hardware design for disaster relief. It

begins with a KiCad workshop on schematic capture and PCB design, followed

by a short talk on Digital Twin concepts. Teams then create hardware

solutions like disaster warning systems, focusing on circuit design, PCB

layout, sustainability, teamwork, and innovation

Venue: TT VOC Gallery

Registration: VTOP

VINNOVATEIT 

Event Name: Drones Decoded

Event Time: 02:00 PM - 05:00 PM

Event Description: Drones Decoded is an innovation challenge where

technology meets sustainability. Participants explore live drone demos,

learn how aerial systems solve environmental issues, and tackle real world

problems. Teams brainstorm and pitch drone based solutions for disaster

response, smart agriculture, resource management, and urban sustainability.

Collaborate, compete, and present scalable ideas that power a smarter,

sustainable future.

Venue: MB 305

Registration: VTOP

THE WHITEHAT CLUB

Event Name: Flagwars

Event Time: 02:00 PM - 6:00 PM

Event Description: FlagWars is a high-intensity CTF battle where strategy

meets hacking . Test your skills in web, crypto, reverse engineering,

OSINT, and forensics. Race against time, climb the leaderboard, and capture

the flags before your rivals do. Only the sharpest minds will conquer

FlagWars!

Venue: Shakesphere Gallery

Registration: VTOP

THE INSTRUMENT SOCIETY OF INDIA

Event Name: IoT-Enabled Quality Healthcare Systems

Event Time: 10:30 AM To 01:00 PM 

Event Description: Join us for an engaging online workshop on IoT for

Quality Healthcare, exploring how smart sensors, microcontrollers, and

cloud platforms enable real-time patient monitoring and intelligent medical

systems. Through live virtual demonstrations and interactive discussions,

participants will learn how IoT enhances healthcare quality, accessibility,

and efficiency. Open to all departments.

Venue: Online

Registration: VTOP

INNOVATOR'S QUEST

Event Name: Sustain-a-thon

Event Time: 02:00 PM To 07:00 PM 

Event Description: Sustain-a-thon is an intensive, solution-driven

hackathon designed to address real-world sustainability challenges,

specifically aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals

(SDGs).

Venue: PRP Annex 203

Registration: VTOP

MLA- THANIMA

Event Name: Prakriti vs Pragati 

Event Time: 02:00 PM To 06:00 PM 

Event Description: Prakriti vs Pragathi is a Malayalam presentation and

debate exploring the balance between innovation, economic growth, and

environmental responsibility. Through real-world perspectives, participants

question whether progress without sustainability can truly endure,

redefining responsible development for a future where ambition aligns with

long-term impact.

Venue: MB 310

Registration: VTOP

IEEE-SPS

Event Name: The Sustainable Stack: From Python Data Science to

Energy-Efficient Hardware

Event Time: 07:00 PM To 11:00 PM 

Event Description: The event will take attendees on a holistic journey

through the entire technology stack, from high-level programming and data

analysis in Python to the low-level design considerations of

energy-efficient hardware. Participants will gain insights into how

sustainable practices can be integrated at every layer of technology,

enabling smarter, greener solutions in both research and industry. Python,

one of the most widely used programming languages for data science, will be

highlighted as a versati.

Venue: Online

Registration: VTOP

INDIAN GEOTECHNICAL SOCIETY

Event Name: Survey Says Sustainable

Event Time: 09:00 AM To 12:00 PM 

Event Description: The future is now and changing faster than anyone can

imagine. Both IIChE-VIT and IGS have understood this very well and

therefore taken the initiative to survey the changing times through an

electrifying battle of Survey Says: Sustainable to take participants

through the making of a Sustainable city. Multiple rounds of competitive

battles taken from popular game shows like Family Feud and Weakest Link

will give participants a chance to rise above the competition and not be

left in the dust.

Venue: CDMM 213

Registration: VTOP

PIXELATE CLUB

Event Name: SustainInk

Event Time: 11:00 AM To 10:00 PM 

Event Description: Explore the intersection of creativity and impact

through this Digital Poster Making Competition centered on innovation and

sustainability. The event challenges participants to transform

forward-thinking ideas into compelling digital visuals that address

real-world challenges and envision measurable progress toward a sustainable

future by 2030. By encouraging structured, solution-focused design, the

competition aims to cultivate purposeful creativity and meaningful visual

communication.

Venue: Online

Registration: VTOP

VIT MATHEMATICAL ASSOCIATION

Event Name: Green Computing-Energy Efficient Software Systems

Event Time: 08:00 PM To 11:00 PM 

Event Description:Green Computing - Energy Efficient Software Systems is a

3-hour workshop exploring how innovation and sustainability ensure quality

in modern computing. It examines rapid technological growth and its

environmental impact, introducing global green solutions. A live demo

optimizes inefficient code using energy-efficient practices and memory

reduction techniques, comparing performance before and after to highlight

sustainable, high-quality software engineering.

Venue: Online

Registration: VTOP

BENGALI LITERARY ASSOCIATION

Event Name: QualiNova

Event Time: 09:00 AM To 01:00 PM 

Event Description: QualiNova is an ideation event under Quality Week 2026

themed Drive for Innovation and Sustainability. Participants will develop

innovative solutions to real-world and campus challenges related to

sustainability, efficiency, and quality improvement. Teams will pitch their

ideas, focusing on creativity, feasibility, and impact. The event

encourages students to think critically and propose practical innovations

that enhance quality while promoting a sustainable future.

Venue: PRP Annex 203

Registration: VTOP

Subject: Navigating Your Career in Management
Body:
Dear Students,

When people hear "management," they often think of boardrooms and power

suits. But in reality, management is the engine behind every tech startup,

global NGO, and creative agency. It’s about solving complex problems,

leading teams, and turning ideas into scalable reality.

Whether you are an aspiring entrepreneur or simply curious about how

organizations actually work, we invite you to our upcoming session: "Careers

in Management: Paths, Skills, and Strategies."

Why Attend?

The world of management is vast, and it can be hard to know where you fit.

We’re breaking down the jargon to help you understand:

 -

 1) Detailed overview of the MBA curriculum and academic structure.

 2) Career opportunities across major management streams—finance,

 marketing, sales, operations, and HR.

 3) Understanding management degree options such as MBA, MIM, and

 deferred MBA programs.

 4) Key components of a strong academic and professional profile for MBA

 aspirants.

 5) Important considerations for MBA/MiM applications in India and abroad.

------------------------------

Event Logistics

 -

 📅 Date: 5th March 2026

 -

 ⏰ Time: 6:00 pm

 -

 📍 Location: Zoom Platform

 -

 🔗 Register

 Here: https://vit-ac-in.zoom.us/meeting/register/3ZBMBeMQRQqzXomzPXYrkw

 https://vit-ac-in.zoom.us/meeting/register/3ZBMBeMQRQqzXomzPXYrkw

Who is this for?

This session is designed for students from all academic backgrounds. You

don’t need to be a business major to succeed in management—some of the best

managers in the world started in engineering, the arts, or the social

sciences.

Come with your questions and leave with a roadmap for your future.

Subject: WiSH 2026 Invitation | Texas Instruments
Body:
Greetings from Texas Instruments!

We are pleased to invite applications for WiSH 2026 – Women in

Semiconductors and Hardware, the 5th edition of our comprehensive month

long mentorship program designed to inspire and encourage women

engineering students to pursue rewarding careers in the semiconductor

industry.

Eligibility Criteria

Degree Requirements:

 - Bachelor's Students: 2nd year women engineering students (B. Tech/B.E

 graduating in 2028)

 - Master's Students: 1st year women engineering students with the

 opportunity to pursue an internship in their 2nd year

 - Dual Degree Students: Students in their pre-internship year can apply

 for the program (i.e., if institute allows summer internships in 3rd

 year of dual degree, then students in 2nd year can apply)

Additional Requirements:

 - Candidates should be pursuing an engineering degree in

 Electrical/Electronics/Circuit related streams

 - Maintaining a minimum CGPA of 7 (70%) in current degree program

 without any backlogs

 - Should be curious about semiconductors and enthusiastic to learn

Selection Process

 1. After registering, students will be shortlisted for the online

 assessment based on their profile

 2. Online assessment:

 1. Basic mathematics and physics assessment for everyone

 2. Additional software assessment for students interested in Embedded

 Software domain

 3. Interview shortlist will be based on the candidate’s application

 profile and test performance

 4. Mentorship program selection will be based on profile, test scores

 and interview with a TI engineer

Note: The registration form asks for the student’s domain interest

(Hardware/Embedded Software). While students can apply for both domains,

final program selection is restricted to a single domain, depending on the

result of the assessment and interview rounds.

Program Format

When:

 Summer 2026, in the semester break between the 2nd and 3rd Year

for bachelor’s students / between 1st and 2nd year for master’s students.

Mode:

 Hybrid mode with selected students participating virtually for

the first three weeks and coming to the TI site at Bangalore for the final

fourth week (accommodation and travel costs will be borne by TI)

How to Register for the Program

 Students can register by scanning the QR code in the poster below

or accessing the registration link WiSH 2026 Registration Form

https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/57BDXY8. Registrations will close by 20th

March 2026.

We request placement coordinators to fill this survey

https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/9CPGKPK to confirm Campus participation

for WiSH 2026 and share the details of the program along with the

registration link and poster with their students.

Subject: Quality Week 25-26: Day-2 Special Events- reg
Body:
Dear VITians,

VIT celebrates Quality Week 2025–2026, a week-long journey of learning,

innovation, and performance presented by the Office of Students' Welfare.

This year’s theme, “Quality: Drive for Innovation and Sustainability,”

reflects our commitment to fostering creativity, responsible growth, and a

culture of excellence in everything we do. The Office of Students’ Welfare

invites you to today’s Quality Week events, brought to you by the Student

Council and various Clubs and Chapters.

Day 2 Events:

 -

 SustainX: CAD for Quality and Sustainability

 -

 BizCon: Build. Bid. Brand

 -

 CHITRAYAN

 -

 AgriSphere- Smart Farming & Sustainable Systems

Scroll down for more details

Bengali Literary Association (Aikyataan)

Event Name: Chitrayan

Event Time: 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM

Event Description: Chitrayan is an art showcase under Quality Week 2026

where participants present handmade or digital artworks based on the theme

“Drive for Innovation and Sustainability.” Students will submit and display

their work, expressing ideas on sustainability, innovation, and quality

through visual art. The event provides a platform to showcase creativity,

artistic skills, and meaningful concepts while promoting awareness through

impactful and high-quality artwork.

Venue: Google forms (online)

Registration: VTOP

Society of Automotive Engineering(SAE)

Event Name: SustainX: CAD for Quality and Sustainability

Event Time: 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM

Event Description: QW' 26: SustainX: CAD for Quality and Sustainability is

a 2-hour innovation challenge where teams redesign an existing product or

process to improve its quality, efficiency, and sustainability.

Participants analyze real-world problems and propose practical,

eco-friendly solutions using quality principles, encouraging innovative

thinking and responsible engineering.

Venue: TT VOC Gallery

Registration: VTOP

IEEE WOMEN IN ENGINEERING (IEEE-WIE)

Event Name: Chitrayan

Event Time: 02:00 PM - 07:00 PM

Event Description: BizCon is a business simulation event where teams

transform a sustainability related problem statement into a unique brand.

Participants build their concept and earn BizCoins through quick

challenges. Teams make strategic decisions involving mergers, acquisitions

and expansion while strengthening their business idea. Innovation

sustainability and smart thinking shape the journey leading to a final

pitch where teams present their evolved business model and vision.

Venue: TT-311

Registration: VTOP

THE AI & ML CLUB

Event Name: AgriSphere- Smart Farming & Sustainable Systems

Event Time: 08:00 PM - 11:00 PM

Event Description: This workshop explores how AI and IoT drive the More

from Less revolution, turning precision data into high yield, low impact

farming strategies. You will master predictive tools and computer vision to

build smarter, more sustainable food systems. It is a concise deep dive

into bridging the gap between raw data and real world agricultural impact.

Venue: Google meet (Online)

Registration: VTOP

Subject: 2026 NCKU Taiwan AISSM Semiconductor International Summer School
Body:
Dear Students,

Please attend if you are interested

 NCKU TAIWAN AISSM Semiconductor Summer School 2026 to be held

at National

Cheng Kung University (NCKU), Tainan, Taiwan from July 28 – August 7,

2026.

Participants can choose one of the following 3‑credit courses:

A. Digital IC Design and Synthesis

B. Analog IC Design and Layout

C. Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing and Packaging Testing

Key details:

Language of instruction: English

Target participants: Senior undergraduate and fresh graduate students

with relevant background

Intake: Maximum 25 students per course

Deliverables: NCKU transcript and certificate on successful completion

Features: Lab work and hands‑on training, interaction with industry

experts, research center and institute visits, international peer group

Nomination period: January 2026 – March 2026.

Interested students are requested to submit their nomination in person

(CV, transcript, Statement of Purpose and faculty recommendation) to Dr

Raghuram Dy Director International Office on or before 31 March 2026

For programme‑specific information, please refer to the NCKU Summer School

website or contact the coordinator mentioned in the brochure.

your projects and thinking about what comes next, the word "internship" is

probably living rent-free in your head.

If you’ve been dreaming of working in a world-class lab, contributing to

cutting-edge papers, or simply want to see if a career in R&D is for you,

we’ve got your back. We’re hosting a dedicated knowledge session to help

you navigate the often-mysterious world of Research Internships.

What’s on the Agenda?

We’re skipping the fluff and getting straight to what actually works:

 -

 The Hunt: How to find labs and professors that align with your

 interests.

 -

 The "Cold" Truth: Mastering the art of the cold email (and how to

 actually get a reply).

 -

 Paperwork that Pops: Crafting a Research CV and Statement of Purpose

 (SOP) that stands out from the pile.

Subject: vivo KanyaGyaan Scholarship Program 2025-26
Body:
Attn: All first-year and Second Female students enrolled in undergraduate

courses such as B.Tech / B.E., B.Sc, BCA, etc .

Dear Students,

Greetings!

Applications are invited from All first-year and second year Female

students enrolled in STEM undergraduate courses such as B.Tech / B.E.,

B.Sc, BCA, etc .

Eligibility Criteria:

 -

 - Open to young women across India who are currently enrolled in

 full-time, regular STEM undergraduate courses such as B.Tech / B.E.,

 B.Sc, BCA, etc. (first or second year) .

 - Annual parental income must not exceed INR 5 lakh from all sources.

 - Applicants must have secured at least 70% marks in both Class 10

 and Class 12, as well as in their most recent academic year/semester.

 - Children of employees of Buddy4Study or vivo India are ineligible.

 - Note: Students already receiving full financial assistance under

 other scholarships or government schemes are also not eligible.

Preference will be given to the following applicants:

 - Single-parent children 

 - Children from the Aspirational District 

 - Have deceased parents

 - Children from SC, STs and De-Notified Tribes

 - Priority for first-generation learners or those from marginalised

 communities.

 - Children of Police Forces/Armed Forces/Martyr families

 - Girls Representing State and National Level Sports

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a final interview conducted by

a selection panel.

Subject: YANTRA'26: Day-8 Events (14-02-26) - Reg.
Body:
Dear VITians,

As VIT continues its journey of excellence and innovation, the Office of

Students’ Welfare is proud to invite you to the 6th edition of Yantra —

VIT’s flagship week-long technical fest. Yantra’26, scheduled from 7th

February to 15th February 2026, promises an engaging and impactful

exploration of technology, creativity, and innovation.

This edition features 70+ diverse events, thoughtfully curated to

inspire, educate, and challenge participants across disciplines and skill

levels. The theme for Yantra’26, “Leveraging Web3 for Social

Responsibility”, highlights the transformative role of decentralization

and blockchain technology in fostering safe and transparent systems,

driving growth, enhancing societal well-being, and delivering sustainable

solutions to real-world challenges.

Visit our website for more details:

https://yantra.vit.ac.in/?utm_source=mail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=yantra_mail

Don’t miss this opportunity to showcase your talent, strengthen your

technical skills, and collaborate on ideas that create meaningful impact.

Following are the events scheduled for YANTRA’26 – Day 8:

SPECIAL EVENTS:

CENTRAL HACK

Date : 13-02-2026 to 15-02-2026

Time : 8 AM Onwards (56 hr hack - overnight)

Venue : ANNA AUDITORIUM

Event Details : The Yantra’26 is back with Central Hack, designed to bring

together the brightest minds, bold ideas, and passionate problem-solvers

from diverse academic backgrounds. With a prize pool of INR 6,00,000+,

Yantra Central Hack is a flagship 56-hour hackathon organized by the Office

of Students’ Welfare. The event brings together participants from multiple

disciplines to collaborate, innovate, and solve real-world challenges in an

intense, fast-paced environment.

BRAIN TO BRAND: BUSINESS CHALLENGE

Date : 14-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 1 PM

Venue : HOMIBABA GALLERY - TT

Event Details : Brain to Brand is a dynamic business case challenge that

guides participants from innovative ideas to real-world execution. Spanning

three intense rounds, it evaluates business savvy, strategic thinking,

creativity, and pitching prowess as teams convert pressing real-world

challenges into viable, scalable brand and business solutions.

COMPUTER SOCIETY OF INDIA (CSI)

Event Name : DEVSPACE

Date : 12-02-2026 to 14-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 8 PM

Venue : CS HALL

Event Details : Devspace is CSI-VIT’s flagship hackathon, held alongside

engaging and insightful speaker sessions led by professionals from the tech

world. It brings together developers, entrepreneurs, tech enthusiasts, and

students in a high-energy environment to learn, collaborate, and showcase

their skills under one roof, while offering organisations a unique

opportunity to connect with some of the brightest minds at VIT Vellore.

THE BIOTECH RESEARCH SOCIETY INDIA (BRSI)

Event Name : Bio-Chain

Date : 13-02-2026 to 14-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 7 PM

Venue : SMV 110

Event Details : BIO-CHAIN: PHAGEWARS is a hands-on biotech event where

participants design engineered bacteriophage genomes using real data,

connect bioinformatics and explore blockchain-based systems for

transparent, tamper-proof storage of phage research and patient–phage

matching records.

IEEE ROBOTICS & AUTOMATION SOCIETY (IEEE-RAS)

Event Name : Reboot 3.0

Date : 13-02-2026 to 14-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 6 PM

Venue : HOMIBABA GALLERY

Event Details : REBOOT is a premier 36-hour overnight hackathon organized

by the IEEE Robotics and Automation Society (RAS). The event is designed to

move beyond traditional robotics competitions by fostering a high-intensity

environment focused on interdisciplinary innovation and real-world problem

solving.

PIXELATE CLUB

Event Name : Design Odyssey

Date : 14-02-2026 to 15-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : VOC GALLERY

Event Details : Design Odyssey 2.0, hosted by Pixelate — the design club of

go beyond crypto hype and design for what truly matters: people, trust, and

social responsibility. While Web3 promises decentralization and

transparency, it often struggles with poor accessibility and complex

interfaces. Design Odyssey 2.0 invites creators to bridge this gap, using

design as the link between decentralized technology and real-world users.

Working within thematic tracks such as transparency, inclusivity, ethics,

sustainability, and privacy, teams will craft intuitive digital experiences

that make responsible choices simple and engaging — from transparent

donation platforms to ethical identity interfaces. This is not a coding

hackathon.

IEEE TECHNOLOGY AND ENGINEERING MANAGEMENT SOCIETY ( IEEE-TEMS)

BENGALI LITERARY ASSOCIATION (AIKYATAAN)

Event Name : Culturix

Date : 14-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : SAROJINI NAIDU GALLERY

Event Details : Culturix organized by IEEE-TEMS in collaboration with BLA,

challenges participants to build technology-driven solutions leveraging

Web3 for social responsibility, inspired by culture, community, and

societal needs. Teams will ideate, design, and pitch innovative solutions

that are globally relevant, with culture serving only as inspiration.

CUBING CLUB

Event Name : Script Showdown

Date : 14-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 12 PM

Venue : CS HALL

Event Details : Script Showdown is a head‑to‑head programming battle where

two participants (one from each team) are brought on stage to solve

rapid‑fire questions on core programming concepts. Each duel tests how well

participants understand logic, data structures, syntax, and debugging under

time pressure. The event is designed to be entertaining for the audience

while showcasing clean thinking, code clarity, and problem‑solving speed.

VIT MODEL UNITED NATIONS SOCIETY (VITMUN)

Event Name : MUNtra 2.0

Date : 14-02-2026 to 15-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 5 PM

Venue : RAJAJI HALL

technologies are transforming global systems. Through structured debates

and role-based discussions, participants will examine topics such as data

ownership, digital sovereignty, cross-border payments, decentralised

identity, and governance of borderless platforms. The workshop progresses

from Web3 fundamentals to real-world geopolitical and social responsibility

challenges, encouraging critical analysis of how technology influences

global power structures and international cooperation.

DREAM MERCHANTS

Event Name : TECHCRAFT 2.0

Date : 14-02-2026

Time : 1 PM to 8 PM

Venue : MB 210

Event Details :TechCraft 2.0 is a three-round, skill-based competitive

event designed to evaluate participants on financial awareness, strategic

thinking, design sense, and communication skills without requiring any

coding background. The event is structured to progress logically from

knowledge testing to solution building and finally to pitching, ensuring

consistent engagement and a realistic professional environment throughout

the day. It is carefully designed to remain accessible for beginners while

still being competitive for strong thinkers, making it suitable for

students from all academic backgrounds.

To: All Students (Vellore Campus) who registered and got approved for

Make-up Examination

Exam Schedule & Seating: 

Make-up Exams are scheduled from 18th Feb. 2026 to 24th Feb. 2026. The

schedule and seating details for the registered & approved courses is

 available in your VTOP ( Examinations -> Make-up Exam - > ME Exam

Schedule). All the exams are scheduled only in the PRP Block.

Grading Policy:

The maximum grade that will be awarded in the Make-up Examination is an

‘E’, regardless of the absolute marks obtained.

Minimum passing conditions as per the academic regulations is as follows:

 - Theory Only: Minimum 40 marks in Make-up Examination and 50% in

 Grand Total for PASS.

 - Embedded: Minimum 40 marks in Make-up Theory Examination, 50% in

 Make-up Lab Examination and 50% in Grand Total for PASS. If a student

 PASSED in one of the components, then he/she is allowed to write the exam

 only for the failed component.

 - Absent in the Make-up Exam FAT retains the earlier Grade obtained

 during the regular semester.

 FAT (Theory) Instructions

General Instructions

· Students must enter the examination hall 15-30 Minutes before

the commencement of examination (between 9.00 - 9.15 AM )

· You need to WEAR Student IDENTITY CARD during the ENTIRE

EXAMINATION PERIOD. If you don’t have a Proper ID Card contact the

Registrar Office and apply for a new one and get it before coming to the

Exam. The ID card should be scratches free with a proper tag. Exchange of

ID cards or Tags will be considered as Malpractice. If you have misplaced

your ID card or forgot to bring it to the Examination Hall, Report to the

Control Room (PRP 275) of your test venue to get One Time Permit Slips.

You need to pay Rs. 100 through V-TOP online payment only.

· You will NOT be permitted to use the toilet/washroom during the

examination, so be prepared for it.

· Exchange of Calculators, Stationeries, Code Books, pen, pencil

etc., are not permitted. The code Books or standard tables should have been

signed by either the faculty or School office. No markings of any kind

should be found in such booklets.

· As per VIT rules, even if you keep your mobile phone/smart watch

in a switched off position inside the examination hall, it will be treated

as examination malpractice. Such malpractices will lead to confiscation of

the devices (including SIM card) for one semester and ’N’ grade (ALL PAPER

ZERO) in all the registered courses including lab & project components in

that semester. Hence, before entering the examination hall, students should

check their pockets thoroughly to avoid carrying mobile phones/smart

watches by mistake.

· Possession of any Electronic Gadget (Mobile Phone, Smart Watch,

Bluetooth device, any device embedded with scanner /camera, etc.), holding

chit papers/ suspicious content in the examination hall is considered as

malpractice.

 A. Pre-Exam Activities

1.

Note down your seating arrangement (Building, Room Number and Seat Number)

from the V-TOP students login. Seating arrangement will not be displayed

for courses in which a student has been debarred. Please report yourself

half an hour prior to the exam. No student would be permitted to enter the

hall after 9.15 AM.

2.

Possession of unauthorised material, even if you do not intend to use it

will be considered as malpractice. Before starting the exam, check any

materials written on desks or walls, or found papers nearby/ around you in

the floor and inform the same to the invigilators.

B. During the exam

1.

Candidate has to sit in the allotted seat only. Listen to the invigilator

and follow their instructions at all times. Strict Silence should be

maintained in the examination hall. Discussions/ communications of any kind

inside the exam hall are treated as examination malpractices.

2.

Check the course code in the Question paper with the Attendance sheet

Course Code. If you have not received the right question paper or

incomplete or badly printed, please contact the invigilator immediately. If

you have any doubt on class number, course name, course code, slot, and any

other details related to your question paper, please check while signing in

the attendance sheet.

3.

Read carefully and follow the instructions printed in the question paper

and in the answer booklet.

4.

Fill required details (Register No., course code, course title etc.) in the

answer booklet before you start writing the exam. After signing in the

attendance sheet, check the barcode sticker pasted on your answer booklet

for its correctness as your answer booklets will be scanned for valuation

using this barcode only.

5.

First clearly write the Question number in the space provided and then

start writing your answers. USE BLUE / BLACK PEN ONLY for writing the

Answers. Writings on any thin pens, / light colours may not be visible on

the scanned images used for evaluation. Remember to write the answers

within the space provided in the answer booklet. If you write anything

outside the margin, it will be cut during the scanning process. If you are

using extra sheets like graph sheets / templates given by faculty, write

your answer booklet number alone on the top left edge outside the margin

and keep it immediately after the first sheet. Do not fold it as it needs

to be scanned for valuation. Do your rough work in the last page of the

main answer booklet itself. Before finishing the exam, strike out all the

rough works.

6.

Don’t write anything in the question paper or in your hand or leg or on a

desk or on walls nearby you.

7.

Correcting pens, fluid or tape and erasable pens are not to be used for

corrections in the answer booklet.

8.

Do not discuss / borrow anything with other candidates during the

examination.

9.

Do not get involved in any unfair or dishonest practice during the exam. If

you try to cheat or break the rules in any way, it will invite appropriate

sanctions under malpractice.

10.

Students are not allowed to ask questions of any kind during the

examination. Invigilators have been instructed not to answer any enquiry

whatsoever relating to the question papers, whether an explanation or

meaning or correction or typographical error

11.

On the day of the exam, if you feel that you are affected by ill health,

please contact the Chief Superintendent or Invigilator. You can write the

examination at the Health Centre.

12.

Do not leave the examination hall until told to do so by the invigilator.

You cannot leave the examination hall until 30 min from the start of the

examination. If any student leaves the exam hall before 12.00 noon, he/she

has to submit the question paper along with answer sheet.

13.

Do not take your answer booklets or unused ones, from the examination hall.

It is a serious Malpractice.

14.

Answer booklet contains 42 pages and no additional sheets, no

threads, will be provided.

C. If booked under Malpractice

1.

Be calm and give a written response to the allegation and follow the

instructions from the exam squad / Invigilator / Asst. CS / CS.

2.

Do not indulge in any disrespectful activities such as shouting / creating

/ diverting attention of all other students, a scene in the examination

hall.

3.

Hand over the materials and get a receipt for electronic devices.

NON-COOPERATION WILL BE VIEWED AS AN ACT OF INDISCIPLINE WHICH MAY INVITE

SEPARATE DISCIPLINARY ACTION.

4.

Examination malpractice actions/punishments are very serious, may lead to

All paper ZERO or suspension of one semester. All malpractice actions are

informed to the students / published in VTOP student Login. Please go

through it follow the examination rules appropriately

5.

OBEY ALL THE EXAMINATION RULES SERIOUSLY

Controller of Examinations

With Regards

Subject: YANTRA'26: Day-7 Events (13-02-26) - Reg.
Body:
Dear VITians,

As VIT continues its journey of excellence and innovation, the Office of

Students’ Welfare is proud to invite you to the 6th edition of Yantra —

VIT’s flagship week-long technical fest. Yantra’26, scheduled from 7th

February to 15th February 2026, promises an engaging and impactful

exploration of technology, creativity, and innovation.

This edition features 70+ diverse events, thoughtfully curated to

inspire, educate, and challenge participants across disciplines and skill

levels. The theme for Yantra’26, “Leveraging Web3 for Social

Responsibility”, highlights the transformative role of decentralization

and blockchain technology in fostering safe and transparent systems,

driving growth, enhancing societal well-being, and delivering sustainable

solutions to real-world challenges.

Visit our website for more details:

https://yantra.vit.ac.in/?utm_source=mail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=yantra_mail

Don’t miss this opportunity to showcase your talent, strengthen your

technical skills, and collaborate on ideas that create meaningful impact.

Following are the events scheduled for YANTRA’26 – Day 7:

SPECIAL EVENTS:

CENTRAL HACK

Date : 13-02-2026 to 15-02-2026

Time : 8 AM Onwards (56 hr hack - overnight)

Venue : ANNA AUDITORIUM

Event Details : The Yantra’26 is back with Central Hack, designed to bring

together the brightest minds, bold ideas, and passionate problem-solvers

from diverse academic backgrounds. With a prize pool of INR 6,00,000+,

Yantra Central Hack is a flagship 56-hour hackathon organized by the Office

of Students’ Welfare. The event brings together participants from multiple

disciplines to collaborate, innovate, and solve real-world challenges in an

intense, fast-paced environment.

NEXTEDGE 1.0 - TECH TALK ON BIOFAB 3D

Date : 13-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 12 PM

Venue : CHANNA REDDY AUDITORIUM

Event Details : The session will be headed by Dr. Gopal Shankar from NIT

Calicut, a VIT alumnus (B.Tech. in Biotechnology, 2009), featuring his

transformative research insights, real challenges, and what it really takes

to turn biology into engineered tissues, offering students an excellent

opportunity to learn, interact, and gain inspiration from the expert.

COMPUTER SOCIETY OF INDIA (CSI)Event Name : DEVSPACE

Date : 12-02-2026 to 14-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 8 PM

Venue : CS HALL

Event Details : Devspace is CSI-VIT’s flagship hackathon, held alongside

engaging and insightful speaker sessions led by professionals from the tech

world. It brings together developers, entrepreneurs, tech enthusiasts, and

students in a high-energy environment to learn, collaborate, and showcase

their skills under one roof, while offering organisations a unique

opportunity to connect with some of the brightest minds at VIT Vellore.

THE AI & ML CLUB - TAMEvent Name : Bidathon 2.0

Date : 12-02-2026 to 13-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : BHAGAT SINGH GALLERY - SJT

Event Details : Bidathon is a unique competitive hackathon that blends

technical innovation with strategic decision making. Unlike conventional

hackathons, Bidathon introduces a bidding-based constraint system, where

teams must strategically bid points to impose constraints on their own

projects mid way through development. Participants are challenged not only

on what they build, but also on how effectively they adapt under self

imposed limitations. Success depends on innovation, execution, risk

management, and smart planning.

GOOGLE DEVELOPERS GROUPS (GDG)

Event Name : Hexathon

Date : 12-02-2026 to 13-02-2026

Time : 2 PM to 6 PM

Venue : SAROJINI NAIDU GALLERY - SJT

Event Details : Hexathon is a 24-hour long beginner-friendly designathon

that gives UI/UX designers and enthusiasts an opportunity to work on a

variety of real-life based problem statements. What makes this design

hackathon stand out is its unique marketplace system, where participants

can choose their problem statements and access a variety of design elements.

THE BIOTECH RESEARCH SOCIETY INDIA (BRSI)

Event Name : Bio-Chain

Date : 13-02-2026 to 14-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 7 PM

Venue : SMV 110

Event Details : BIO-CHAIN: PHAGEWARS is a hands-on biotech event where

participants design engineered bacteriophage genomes using real data,

connect bioinformatics and explore blockchain-based systems for

transparent, tamper-proof storage of phage research and patient–phage

matching records.

SOCIETY FOR INDUSTRIAL AND APPLIED MATHEMATICS (SIAM)Event Name : Coding

Relay

Date : 13-02-2026 to 13-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 1 PM

Venue : MB 210

Event Details : Coding Relay is an electrifying team challenge where coding

meets strategy. Teams of four race against time by tackling easy, medium,

and hard coding problems, while one teammate dives into a rapid-fire Web3

round to unlock crucial hints. With constant role swaps, no one stays

comfortable for long - every participant must adapt, think fast, and

collaborate smartly. Blending logic, speed, and teamwork, Coding Relay

keeps the pressure high and the excitement nonstop till the final score is

revealed.

IEEE ROBOTICS & AUTOMATION SOCIETY (IEEE-RAS)Event Name : Reboot 3.0

Date : 13-02-2026 to 14-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 6 PM

Venue : HOMIBABA GALLERY

Event Details : REBOOT is a premier 36-hour overnight hackathon organized

by the IEEE Robotics and Automation Society (RAS). The event is designed to

move beyond traditional robotics competitions by fostering a high-intensity

environment focused on interdisciplinary innovation and real-world problem

solving.

IEEE POWER ELECTRONICS SOCIETY (IEEE - PELS)Event Name : Beyond Code:

Creating Social Impact Through the Web

Date : 13-02-2026 to 13-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 1 PM

Venue : KAMARAJ AUDITORIUM - TT

Event Details : This tech talk focuses on how the web can be used

responsibly to create real social impact. Featuring insights from a Philips

industry expert, the session highlights real-world applications, ethical

design, and human-centric web solutions. It aims to inspire students to

build technology that goes beyond code and contributes meaningfully to

society.

ASTRONOMY CLUB- VIT STELLAREvent Name : Cosmic Odyssey : The Last Light

of Earth

Date : 13-02-2026 to 13-02-2026

Time : 2 PM to 7 PM

Venue : KAMARAJ AUDITORIUM - TT

Event Details: Cosmic Odyssey: The Last Light of Earth is a story-driven,

offline astronomy mega-event where participants become crew members of

spaceships docked to the International Space Station (ISS). Set in the year

2045, Earth faces multiple cosmic dangers — orbital debris chaos, rogue

asteroids, and a mysterious space virus threatening all docked ships.

Through real-time simulations using professional tools such as CelesTrak,

Stuff in Space, NASA Eyes, Impact Earth, Celestia, and Stellarium,

participants will learn, explore, and experiment in a visually rich space

environment. They are then thrown into a high-stakes crisis, where they

must solve a sequence of difficult puzzles to reboot their infected

spaceships and escape before total power loss. Each round reveals critical

codes needed to progress, turning scientific understanding into life-saving

decisions under pressure. This event blends science, teamwork, immersive

visualization, and problem-solving into a thrilling, escape-room-style

experience — not a lecture, but a mission.

INDIAN SOCIETY FOR TECHNICAL EDUCATION (ISTE)Event Name : Cipher.cli

Date : 13-02-2026 to 13-02-2026

Time : 2 PM to 7 PM

Venue : SAROJINI NAIDU GALLERY

Event Details : This workshop introduces participants to how Web3

technologies can be applied to build transparent, trust-based digital

systems for social impact. The session focuses on understanding how

blockchain enables verifiable transactions, decentralized record-keeping,

and tamper-proof logs - concepts that are increasingly relevant in areas

such as donations, public records, and accountability systems. Session

includes how blockchain interactions can be triggered programmatically

using a custom Command Line Interface (CLI), demonstrating how

decentralized networks can be accessed beyond traditional web interfaces.

The workshop emphasizes practical system design and real-world relevance

rather than abstract theory.

IEEE POWER ELECTRONICS SOCIETY (IEEE - PELS)

Event Name : FlagWars Arena

Date : 13-02-2026 to 13-02-2026

Time : 10 AM to 4 PM

Venue : PRP ANNEX 203

Event Details : FlagWars Arena is an ultimate Capture The Flag (CTF)

competition where logic meets exploitation and only the sharpest minds

survive. Participants will face a series of cybersecurity challenges

ranging across cryptography, web exploitation, reverse engineering, OSINT,

forensics, Web3 and binary exploitation. Each challenge hides a flag—find

it, submit it, and climb the leaderboard. Whether you’re a beginner testing

your skills or a seasoned hacker aiming for dominance, FlagWars Arena

promises intense competition, learning, and adrenaline. Think fast. Hack

smart. Capture the flag.

Subject: Congratulations to Team SANTRA for Achievement at DR DEV Hackathon
Body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to share that Team SANTRA secured First Place at the DR

DEV Hackathon, conducted at SRM Institute of Science and Technology,

Kattankulathur (SRM-KTR) on 4th and 5th February 2026.

Team SANTRA emerged as the winner after presenting a final 3-minute pitch,

supported by a working prototype and a dedicated website, achieving an

impressive final score of 58.5 out of 60.

The team presented “LATERAL X”, an innovative fall-prevention and

rehabilitation support device designed to assist patients facing

balance-related challenges. The solution focuses on posture correction and

movement stabilization over time, offering significant potential in

rehabilitation and assistive healthcare technologies.

Team Members:

1. Rudrabha Dasgupta – 24BBT0175

2. Neil Roy – 24BBT0168

3. Prashanth Kumar – 24BBT0158

4. Preyoshi Chakrabarti – 24MSI0155

This achievement reflects the team’s innovation, technical excellence, and

collaborative effort, bringing pride to the VIT community on a competitive

inter-university platform.

Congratulations once again to Team SANTRA on this remarkable achievement.

Subject: YANTRA'26: Day-6 Events (12-02-26) - Reg.
Body:
Dear VITians,

As VIT continues its journey of excellence and innovation, the Office of

Students’ Welfare is proud to invite you to the 6th edition of Yantra —

VIT’s flagship week-long technical fest. Yantra’26, scheduled from 7th

February to 15th February 2026, promises an engaging and impactful

exploration of technology, creativity, and innovation.

This edition features 70+ diverse events, thoughtfully curated to

inspire, educate, and challenge participants across disciplines and skill

levels. The theme for Yantra’26, “Leveraging Web3 for Social

Responsibility”, highlights the transformative role of decentralization

and blockchain technology in fostering safe and transparent systems,

driving growth, enhancing societal well-being, and delivering sustainable

solutions to real-world challenges.

Visit our website for more details:

https://yantra.vit.ac.in/?utm_source=mail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=yantra_mail

Don’t miss this opportunity to showcase your talent, strengthen your

technical skills, and collaborate on ideas that create meaningful impact.

Following are the events scheduled for YANTRA’26 – Day 6:

IEEE SOCIETY ON SOCIAL IMPLICATIONS OF TECHNOLOGY (IEEE-SSIT)

Event Name : Code4Change 3.0

Date : 10-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : CS Hall

Event Details: Continuing from the success of code4change 1.0 and 2.0,

IEEE-SSIT brings you code4change 3.0 where we'll be continuing our flagship

hackathon event for yantra considering the success we have had the past 2

years. It will be an overnight 48 hour hackathon event where we will have 4

panels of judges who will judge the teams and their ideas/products based on

a set rubrics.

INDIAN SOCIETY OF EARTHQUAKE TECHNOLOGY(ISET)

Event Name : Structur - A- Thon

Date : 11-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : SJT Foodys

Event Details: Structr-a-Thon: Seismic Edition (Design, Test, Fail,

Improve, Survive the Shake) is a hands-on structural design challenge where

participants conceptualise, design, and construct scaled building models

and test their performance under simulated earthquake loading. The event

bridges theory and practice by allowing students to experience how

structures behave during seismic excitation and understand the principles

of earthquake-resistant design in a fun, competitive, and practical

environment. Teams will be provided with limited materials and a design

brief, after which they must create a structure optimised for stability,

strength, and ductility. These models will then be tested on a shake table

that simulates ground motion of varying intensity. Performance will be

evaluated based on structural integrity, damage patterns, lateral

displacement, and efficiency of material usage.

SOLAR ENERGY SOCIETY OF INDIA

Event Name : OriginX

Date : 11-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 2 PM

Venue : SJT G07

Event Details: This event challenges participants to solve the "First Mile

Problem," the difficulty of verifying data at the very start of a supply

chain. Teams must select a problem statement prone to fraud or unethical

practices. Their goal is to design a "Digital Product Passport"—a

blockchain-based system that tracks the item from raw material to the final

consumer.

FEP - SI

Event Name : NEXERA

Date : 12-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 1 PM

Venue : AMBEDKAR AUDITORIUM

Event Details:

NEXERA is a power packed tech talk on IT infrastructure and Agentic AI.

Learn how modern systems work. Understand how AI agents think and act.

Build your own AI agent from scratch. Clear. Practical. Future ready.

INDIAN CONCRETE INSTITUTE

Event Name : Blockchain Unchained: Theory to Application

Date : 12-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 6 PM

Venue : CDMM 303

Event Details:

A high-velocity journey from Web3 theory to tangible action. Participants

move from understanding decentralization to deploying "Social Contracts"

on-chain, bridging the gap between blockchain hype and real-world social

utility.

COMPUTER SOCIETY OF INDIA (CSI) AND HEALTH CLUB

Event Name : Hack the Hospital

Date : 12-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 7 PM

Venue : KAMARAJ AUDITORIUM

Event Details: “Hack the Hospital” is a two-round collaborative technical

competition that challenges participants to solve real-world healthcare

problems using Web3 technologies. The event focuses on trust, transparency,

and accountability.

THE ELECTRONICS CLUB (TEC)

Event Name : SparkLab

Date : 12-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : SHAKESPEARE GALLERY

Event Details:

SparkLab is a structured academic technical event aimed at enhancing

students’ practical understanding of electronic system design through

PCB-centric development, while introducing emerging technology perspectives

such as Web3-enabled systems. The event provides participants with an

opportunity to conceptualize hardware solutions and translate them into

well-documented schematics and professionally designed PCB layouts, with

emphasis on fundamental electronics, appropriate component selection, and

manufacturable design practices. Selected problem statements may explore

the integration of PCB-based hardware with decentralized and secure Web3

applications, thereby promoting interdisciplinary learning aligned with

current technological trends.

COMPUTER SOCIETY OF INDIA (CSI)

Event Name : DEVSPACE

Date : 12-02-2026 to 14-02-2026

Time : 9 PM to 8 AM

Venue : ANNA AUDITORIUM

Event Details : Devspace is CSI-VIT’s flagship hackathon, held alongside

engaging and insightful speaker sessions led by professionals from the tech

world. It brings together developers, entrepreneurs, tech enthusiasts, and

students in a high-energy environment to learn, collaborate, and showcase

their skills under one roof, while offering organisations a unique

opportunity to connect with some of the brightest minds at VIT Vellore.

VIT MATHEMATICAL ASSOCIATION (VITMAS)

Event Name : The Numbers Behind Web3

Date : 12-02-2026 to 14-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 2 PM

Venue : MB 210

Event Details : This event is a technical talk/workshop that explores the

mathematical foundations powering decentralized systems. The session breaks

down how cryptographic hash functions, Merkle trees, zero-knowledge proofs,

and game theory enable trust, transparency, privacy, and fair governance in

Web3 applications. Rather than focusing on tools or hype, the event

emphasizes why these systems work and how mathematics makes Web3 a viable

framework for social responsibility and ethical digital infrastructure.

THE AI & ML CLUB - TAM AND ROTARACT CLUB

Event Name : Bidathon 2.0

Date : 12-02-2026 to 13-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : HOMI BHABHA GALLERY

Event Details : Bidathon is a unique competitive hackathon that blends

technical innovation with strategic decision making. Unlike conventional

hackathons, Bidathon introduces a bidding-based constraint system, where

teams must strategically bid points to impose constraints on their own

projects mid way through development. Participants are challenged not only

on what they build, but also on how effectively they adapt under self

imposed limitations. Success depends on innovation, execution, risk

management, and smart planning.

ASSOCIATION FOR COMPUTING MACHINERY (ACM)

Event Name : Reverse Coding

Date : 12-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : ANNA AUDITORIUM

Event Details : Reverse Coding is ACM-VIT’s legacy event that puts a unique

twist on competitive coding. Instead of the traditional method of writing

code to produce an output, participants work backwards from the given

results to uncover the logic. The format is challenging, intuitive and will

challenge your logical thinking and teamwork throughout the event.

GOOGLE DEVELOPERS GROUPS (GDG)

Event Name : Hexathon

Date : 12-02-2026 to 13-02-2026

Time : 2 PM to 6 PM

Venue : VOC GALLERY

Event Details : Hexathon is a 24-hour long beginner-friendly designathon

that gives UI/UX designers and enthusiasts an opportunity to work on a

variety of real-life based problem statements. What makes this design

hackathon stand out is its unique marketplace system, where participants

can choose their problem statements and access a variety of design elements.

INDIAN INSTITUTE OF CHEMICAL ENGINEERS (IICHE)

Event Name : META - Materials. Energy. Trade. Advance

Date : 12-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 2 PM

Venue : VOC GALLERY

Event Details : Teams are given a problem, but the twist it they have to

build everything from scratch. That includes their supply chain, material

harvesting capabilities, and industrial ecosystem, as well as applying

their wits to best the other teams to prove their monopoly in the

competition. Different suppliers of various items and advisors who are

ready to stand by in the case of Difficulty is just one of the elements

that can trip up the teams in how they navigate their way through the

advancement of technology and society.

AMERICAN SOCIETY OF CIVIL ENGINEERS (ASCE)

Event Name : Build with Trust

Date : 12-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 2 PM to 7 PM

Venue : MB 210

Event Details : Build with Trust is a technical poster-making competition

that highlights ethics, transparency, and social responsibility in civil

engineering. Participants visually present real-world infrastructure

challenges and propose responsible solutions inspired by Web3 values, with

emphasis on conceptual understanding and creative expression.

IEEE PROFESSIONAL COMMUNICATION SOCIETY (IEEE-PCS)

Event Name : WEB3VERSE 1.0

Date : 12-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 6 PM

Venue : SAROJINI NAIDU GALLERY

Event Details : WEB3VERSE 1.0 is a one-day, team-based, fresher-friendly

Web3 experience designed to introduce students to the future of the

internet, Blockchain, Cryptocurrency, NFTs, and DAOs through interactive,

game-based learning. The event removes the intimidation of Web3 by focusing

on hands-on activities, simulations, and creative challenges, making it

accessible even to participants with zero prior technical knowledge.

Attachment_Names: ['IEEEPELS_IMPACT.JS.jpg', 'ISET_STRUCR-A-THON.jpg', 'RoboVITics_Cruise the Web3Verse (1).png', 'SAE-VIT Trace to pace CC poster.jpg', 'SEDS-VIT_HERMES.png', 'SESIxAyuda_OriginX - 1.png', 'SIAM_Trace the Traitor.png', 'image.png']
Body:
Dear VITians,

As VIT continues its journey of excellence and innovation, the Office of

Students’ Welfare is proud to invite you to the 6th edition of Yantra —

VIT’s flagship week-long technical fest. Yantra’26, scheduled from 7th

February to 15th February 2026, promises an engaging and impactful

exploration of technology, creativity, and innovation.

This edition features 70+ diverse events, thoughtfully curated to

inspire, educate, and challenge participants across disciplines and skill

levels. The theme for Yantra’26, “Leveraging Web3 for Social

Responsibility”, highlights the transformative role of decentralization

and blockchain technology in fostering safe and transparent systems,

driving growth, enhancing societal well-being, and delivering sustainable

solutions to real-world challenges.

Visit our website for more details:

https://yantra.vit.ac.in/?utm_source=mail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=yantra_mail

Don’t miss this opportunity to showcase your talent, strengthen your

technical skills, and collaborate on ideas that create meaningful impact.

Following are the events scheduled for YANTRA’26 – Day 5:

CODECHEF VIT

Event Name : DevSOC'26

Date : 08-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 9 PM to 2 PM

Venue : HOMIBABA GALLERY - SJT

Event Details : DevSOC (Developers' Sprint Of Code), in its seventh

edition, is the flagship annual event by CodeChef-VIT, aiming at empowering

young minds by fostering meaningful connections between tech enthusiasts

and innovators. This 48-hour sprint-style hackathon is designed to

encourage creativity, collaboration, and problem-solving in an intense yet

engaging environment. As a Free and Open-Source Software (FOSS) event,

DevSOC’26 emphasizes innovation, teamwork, and technological advancement

over four days of continuous ideation and development.

ROBOVITICS

Event Name : Cruise the Web3Verse

Date : 10-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : CS HALL

Event Details : Step into the future of technology with a 2-day Web3

workshop designed to bridge theory and real-world impact. Participants will

dive into blockchain fundamentals, smart contracts, and decentralized

identity, then experience these concepts in action through an interactive,

multiplayer game. Teams will play unique roles in a dynamic simulation,

navigating challenges, earning points, and facing real-time chaos as they

manage digital certificates and system integrity. The workshop blends

lectures, hands-on coding, and live simulations, making complex Web3

concepts accessible and exciting. With quizzes and expert guidance, this

event is perfect for anyone curious about blockchain, smart contracts, and

digital innovation. You’ll also get the chance to build real blockchain

projects and see how Web2 and Web3 approaches differ in practice.

STUDENTS FOR THE EXPLORATION AND DEVELOPMENT OF SPACE (SEDS) & AMERICAN

SOCIETY OF MECHANICAL ENGINEERS (ASME)

Event Name : HERMES

Date : 10-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : SHAKESPEARE GALLERY - TT

Event Details : The Satellite Design Challenge is a 36-hour competition

where teams of 2–4 participants design, document, and demonstrate

innovative small satellite concepts. The event begins with a Fusion 360

workshop, followed by two rounds: documentation and final working model

presentation. Participants tackle real-world challenges such as

environmental monitoring, disaster response, and Earth observation,

designing feasible satellite systems with defined payloads, power budgets,

and orbits. All submissions are made through the official event website.

Judged by experts, HERMES encourages creativity, technical precision, and

teamwork, offering participants a deep dive into practical aerospace

systems design. The top three designs will be specially rewarded with a

physical 3D-printed model of their satellite, bringing the best concepts

from screen to reality.

IEEE SOCIETY ON SOCIAL IMPLICATIONS OF TECHNOLOGY (IEEE-SSIT)

Event Name : Code4Change 3.0

Date : 11-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : ANNA AUDITORIUM

Event Details : Continuing from the success of code4change 1.0 and 2.0,

IEEE-SSIT brings you code4change 3.0 where we'll be continuing our flagship

hackathon event for yantra considering the success we have had the past 2

years. It will be an overnight 48 hour hackathon event where we will have 4

panels of judges who will judge the teams and their ideas/products based on

a set rubrics.

IEEE WOMEN IN ENGINEERING (IEEE-WIE)

Event Name : TRIATHLON: Code for Social Trust

Date : 11-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 1 PM

Venue : SAROJINI GALLER - SJT

Event Details : Understand the problem. Enforce trust through logic. Defend

your design. TRIATHLON: Code for Social Trust challenges participants to

move beyond writing code and start designing systems people can rely on.

Through three progressive rounds, teams analyze persona-based social

scenarios, implement trust-enforcing logic, and explain how their systems

ensure fairness, transparency, and responsible technology. TRIATHLON is

where technical thinking meets real-world impact.

SOCIETY OF AUTOMOTIVE ENGINEERS (SAE)

Event Name : Trace to Pace: The Race Car Telemetry and Strategy Workshop

Date : 11-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 3 PM

Venue : VOC GALLERY - TT

Event Details : Ever wondered how top-tier teams in F1, DTM, and F4 shave

milliseconds off their lap times? It isn’t just about the driver’s right

foot , rather it’s about the data. We are excited to announce Trace to

Pace: The Race Car Telemetry & Strategy Workshop, a comprehensive 6-hour

workshop dedicated to the high-stakes world of motorsport engineering.

INDIAN SOCIETY OF EARTHQUAKE TECHNOLOGY(ISET)

Event Name : Structur - A- Thon

Date : 11-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : BHAGAT SINGH GALLERY - SJT

Event Details : Structr-a-Thon: Seismic Edition (Design, Test, Fail,

Improve, Survive the Shake) is a hands-on structural design challenge where

participants conceptualise, design, and construct scaled building models

and test their performance under simulated earthquake loading. The event

bridges theory and practice by allowing students to experience how

structures behave during seismic excitation and understand the principles

of earthquake-resistant design in a fun, competitive, and practical

environment. Teams will be provided with limited materials and a design

brief, after which they must create a structure optimised for stability,

strength, and ductility. These models will then be tested on a shake table

that simulates ground motion of varying intensity. Performance will be

evaluated based on structural integrity, damage patterns, lateral

displacement, and efficiency of material usage.

SOLAR ENERGY SOCIETY OF INDIA & AYUDA

Event Name : OriginX

Date : 11-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 2 PM

Venue : SJT G07

Event Details : This event challenges participants to solve the "First Mile

Problem," the difficulty of verifying data at the very start of a supply

chain. Teams must select a problem statement prone to fraud or unethical

practices. Their goal is to design a "Digital Product Passport"—a

blockchain-based system that tracks the item from raw material to the final

consumer.

SOCIETY FOR INDUSTRIAL AND APPLIED MATHEMATICS (SIAM)

Event Name : Trace the Traitor

Date : 11-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 1 PM to 9 PM

Venue : TT 725

Event Details : Trace the traitor is a three-round investigative challenge

that simulates a real-world crypto fraud case, where participants

progressively clean corrupted blockchain data, trace wallets and

cross-chain fund movements, and finally reconstruct the complete scam.

Teams of 2 to 4 members must strictly use the provided datasets and tools,

adhere to time limits, and maintain fair play, as plagiarism or unfair

collaboration will result in disqualification.

IEEE POWER ELECTRONICS SOCIETY (IEEE - PELS)

Event Name : impact.js

Date : 11-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 2 PM to 7 PM

Venue : HOMIBABA GALLERY

Event Details : Impact.js – Web Impact Sprint is a 4-hour team-based coding

event where participants create a single-page web experience around

real-world social issues. The idea is to use the web in a meaningful

way—whether it’s spreading awareness, encouraging better choices, or

helping people take action. Through simple yet creative web solutions,

teams show how technology can be used to make a positive difference.

INDIAN GEOTECHNICAL SOCIETY

Event Name : MODEL MAYHEM : Revit Edition

Date : 11-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 2 PM to 6 AM

Venue : MB 210

Event Details : This intensive hands-on workshop introduces Autodesk Revit

through practical, step-by-step software training. You will learn core

Revit tools and techniques in astructured environment designed for

immediate application.

AMERICAN INSTITUTE OF CHEMICAL ENGINEERS (AICHE)

Event Name : Night at the Chem-Museum

Date : 11-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 3 PM to 6 AM

Venue : VOC GALLERY - TT

Event Details : As the sun sets, the "Grand Museum of Chemical History"

transforms. Participants act as the Night Security Squad, trapped with the

spirits of legendary scientists like James Watt and Marie Curie. Offended

by modern reliance on AI, the Ghosts have stolen all data books. Teams must

prove their worth by winning challenges to unlock missing formulas, then

apply fundamental engineering principles to stabilize the chaos before dawn.

Body:
SDOT Training for PG 2027 Batch 2 & B.Tech Batch 1 scheduled from 12th

February 2026 onwards

Please find the attached revised students list with their

Trainer, Classroom details.

Career Development Centre (CDC) has scheduled training programmes in phases

starting 3rd February 2026 onwards

The training will be conducted in the evenings and during weekends.

Periodical tests during the training and after the training also will be

conducted.

Please note that attending the training and tests are mandatory to attend

Super Dream and Dream companies.

CDC will monitor the training attendance and the test scores and will allow

only those students who do well in the assessments to appear for the super

dream and dream (IT/Core) companies. This is done to give opportunity for

those students who are sincere and may have a lesser CGPA. All the students

(including 9 pointers) have to attend the training and assessments.

This measure is taken to mitigate the industry slowdown which is impacting

the campus placements that may be seen with the current year placements.

The CDC Office will inform the hostel authorities for the later hour food

up to 9.30 pm.

Students who are coming late will not be allowed for

the training sessions. Even if they are coming 10 mins late also will not

Subject: YANTRA'26: Day-4 Events (10-02-26) - Reg.
Body:
Dear VITians,

As VIT continues its journey of excellence and innovation, the Office of

Students’ Welfare is proud to invite you to the 6th edition of Yantra —

VIT’s flagship week-long technical fest. Yantra’26, scheduled from 7th

February to 15th February 2026, promises an engaging and impactful

exploration of technology, creativity, and innovation.

This edition features 70+ diverse events, thoughtfully curated to

inspire, educate, and challenge participants across disciplines and skill

levels. The theme for Yantra’26, “Leveraging Web3 for Social

Responsibility”, highlights the transformative role of decentralization

and blockchain technology in fostering safe and transparent systems,

driving growth, enhancing societal well-being, and delivering sustainable

solutions to real-world challenges.

Visit our website for more details: Yantra 2026: A Week of Technical

Innovation

https://yantra.vit.ac.in/?utm_source=mail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=yantra_mail

Don’t miss this opportunity to showcase your talent, strengthen your

technical skills, and collaborate on ideas that create meaningful impact.

Following are the events scheduled for YANTRA’26 – Day 4:

CODECHEF VIT

Event Name : DevSOC'26

Date : 08-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 9 PM to 2 PM

Venue : ANNA AUDITORIUM

Event Details: DevSOC (Developers' Sprint Of Code), in its seventh

edition, is the flagship annual event by CodeChef-VIT, aiming at empowering

young minds by fostering meaningful connections between tech enthusiasts

and innovators. This 48-hour sprint-style hackathon is designed to

encourage creativity, collaboration, and problem-solving in an intense yet

engaging environment. As a Free and Open-Source Software (FOSS) event,

DevSOC’26 emphasizes innovation, teamwork, and technological advancement

over four days of continuous ideation and development.

SOCIETY OF MANUFACTURING ENGINEERS (SME)

Event Name : ManuHack

Date : 10-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 2 PM

Venue : MB 210

Event Details : ManuHack is a one-day design-a-thon where teams receive a

random manufactured product and creatively communicate its value. Instead,

they focus on explaining the product’s manufacturing process, quality

standards, applications and social responsibility in a simple and engaging

way. Teams may choose to present their ideas through a website mockup,

pitch deck, brochure or visual process flow.

BULLS AND BEARS CLUB

Event Name : Protocol X-Change

Date : 10-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 7 PM

Venue : CS Hall

Event Details : Protocol X-change is an immersive simulation where

participants step into a live, blockchain-inspired digital economy that is

already in motion. There are no turns, no pauses, and no reset points. From

the moment participants enter, prices fluctuate, risks exist, and every

decision made is recorded within the system. Actions are executed

transparently, outcomes are rule-driven, and no single authority controls

the market. The system does not guide participants toward a single path.

Instead, it allows them to choose how they want to survive, grow, and

influence the economy through their decisions. The experience is designed

to reflect how modern Web3 systems operate, testing decision-making under

uncertainty, risk awareness, strategic thinking, and adaptability in

response to unexpected changes in market conditions.

SOLAR ENERGY SOCIETY OF INDIA

Event Name : Powering Care

Date : 10-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 7 PM

Venue : BHAGAT SINGH GALLERY - SJT

Event Details : Powering Care is a high-intensity technical event that

challenge participants to engineer next-generation healthcare systems using

W3 technologies. The event focuses on distributed system design, fault

tolerance, autonomous execution, and verifiable trust, rather than

conventional application development. Participants work on one of two

predefined problem statements and move from deep system-level ideation to

core prototype implementation, demonstrating how decentralized

architectures and W3 logic can be applied to life-critical healthcare

infrastructure and data governance systems.

INSTITUTE OF ELECTRICAL & ELECTRONICS ENGINEERING (IEEE)Event Name : Red

Flag

Date : 10-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : VOC GALLERY - TT

Event Details : Red Flag is an immersive workshop that shows you how

cryptocurrencies actually work by guiding you through building your own

Ethereum-based token from scratch. You will explore the fundamentals of

blockchain, understand the difference between coins and tokens, learn how

smart contracts define rules in code, and see how wallets and transactions

function in practice. The highlight of the event is deploying a custom

ERC-20 token on a local Ethereum blockchain and using wallets like MetaMask

to transfer and manage it. You will observe transactions, blocks, and gas

usage in real time while simulating how tokens can be used within a

community. By the end, you will walk away with a working token and a clear,

practical understanding of blockchain and cryptocurrencies.

ROBOVITICS

Event Name : Cruise the Web3Verse

Date : 10-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : HOMIBABA GALLERY - SJT

Event Details : Step into the future of technology with a 2-day Web3

workshop designed to bridge theory and real-world impact. Participants will

dive into blockchain fundamentals, smart contracts, and decentralized

identity, then experience these concepts in action through an interactive,

multiplayer game. Teams will play unique roles in a dynamic simulation,

navigating challenges, earning points, and facing real-time chaos as they

manage digital certificates and system integrity. The workshop blends

lectures, hands-on coding, and live simulations, making complex Web3

concepts accessible and exciting. With quizzes and expert guidance, this

event is perfect for anyone curious about blockchain, smart contracts, and

digital innovation. You’ll also get the chance to build real blockchain

projects and see how Web2 and Web3 approaches differ in practice.

STUDENTS ASSOCIATION OF BIO-ENGINEERING SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

(SABEST)Event Name : Crop Crypt

Date : 10-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 7 PM

Venue : SAROJINI NAIDU GALLERY - SJT

Event Details : Crop Crypt is an interdisciplinary ideathon where

participants are introduced to the fundamentals of Genetically Modified

Crops (GMOs) and Web3 technologies. Based on this, participants engage in

an ideathon where they apply these concepts to address ethical issues

associated with GMOs through innovative Web3-based solutions. These will

then be assessed across various mediums, including a Shipwreck round, and

ultimately a presentation to the panel of judges.

STUDENTS FOR THE EXPLORATION AND DEVELOPMENT OF SPACE (SEDS) & AMERICAN

SOCIETY OF MECHANICAL ENGINEERS (ASME)

Event Name : HERMES

Date : 10-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : SHAKESPEARE GALLERY - TT

Event Details : The Satellite Design Challenge is a 36-hour competition

where teams of 2–4 participants design, document, and demonstrate

innovative small satellite concepts. The event begins with a Fusion 360

workshop, followed by two rounds: documentation and final working model

presentation. Participants tackle real-world challenges such as

environmental monitoring, disaster response, and Earth observation,

designing feasible satellite systems with defined payloads, power budgets,

and orbits. All submissions are made through the official event website.

Judged by experts, HERMES encourages creativity, technical precision, and

teamwork, offering participants a deep dive into practical aerospace

systems design. The top three designs will be specially rewarded with a

physical 3D-printed model of their satellite, bringing the best concepts

from screen to reality.

THE AI & ML CLUB - TAM

Event Name : RedHandedDate : 10-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 5 PM

Venue : AMBEDKAR AUDITORIUM - TT

Event Details : This workshop is a security-first, hands-on deep dive

into modern cyber defense systems where participants learn how real-world

attacks occur, why traditional logging systems fail, and how to design

tamper-proof security architectures. Participants will explore

cybersecurity fundamentals, threat modeling, and attack forensics, followed

by building a blockchain-backed event logging system that ensures log

integrity, immutability, and verifiable audit trails—without focusing on

cryptocurrency or mining. The workshop culminates in integrating AI-based

anomaly detection to identify suspicious behavior patterns directly from

immutable security logs, demonstrating how AI augments—not

replaces—cybersecurity controls. By the end of the session, participants

will have built an end-to-end cyber event monitoring system that simulates

attacks, proves tampering cryptographically, and detects anomalies

intelligently—mirroring how SIEM, audit, and SOC systems operate in

industry.

IEEE COMPUTER SOCIETY (IEEE-CS)

Event Name : BattleCode

Date : 10-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 10 AM to 6 PM

Venue : KAMARAJ AUDITORIUM - TT

Event Details : Battlecode is a multi stage competitive programming

tournament that transforms traditional coding contests into a real time,

strategy driven battle arena. Designed to test not only algorithmic

knowledge but also decision making under pressure, Battlecode combines

synchronous rounds, live 1v1 duels, dynamic matchmaking, bounty challenges,

and a final hacking phase into a single cohesive experience. Unlike static

contests where participants solve problems in isolation, Battlecode

introduces direct player interaction, adaptive difficulty, and live

leaderboard movement. As participants progress, the competition evolves

from individual problem solving to head to head matches and finally into a

high stakes elite round where participants must both defend their solutions

and analyze other’s code.

ADVANCE DEVELOPERS CLUB

Event Name : SharkTech 2.0Date : 09-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : MB 210

Event Details : This is a 24-hour event that incorporates a designathon

and a hackathon with a Shark Tank format that focuses on using Artificial

Intelligence for social causes. This event aims to develop solutions using

Artificial Intelligence to solve some of the most pressing problems faced

by society today, which include eradicating poverty, ensuring quality

education for all, women’s equality, ensuring inclusivity in healthcare

facilities, and conservation of the environment.

CUBING CLUB

Event Name : Code Your Cube

Date : 10-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 3 PM to 7 PM

Venue : PRP ANNEX 203

Event Details : A hands-on workshop demonstrating how algorithms can

solve a 3×3 Rubik’s Cube, with insights into how puzzles like 2×2, 4×4, and

megaminx differ and why they require separate solving approaches.

IEEE ENGINEERING IN MEDICINE & BIOLOGY SOCIETY (IEEE-EMBS)

Event Name : Crypt-a-Pharm

Date : 10-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 7 PM

Venue : SMV 110

Event Details : Delve into the fusion of Web3 and healthcare as you

explore how to secure patient data and inventory management. You will

explore the journey of a drug from manufacturer to patient and how Web3

authenticates every step of the way.
