collaboration at Hackovate, the flagship hackathon by the Instrument

Society of India (ISOI) – VIT Student Chapter, part of Yantra 2026. On Feb

8–9 at VIT Vellore, solve real-world challenges across AI, IoT, robotics,

healthcare, and Web3. Code, connect, and build the future.

IEEE CIRCUITS AND SYSTEMS (IEEE-CAS)Event Name : ElectroHack 2.0

Date : 08-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : VOC Gallery, TT

Event Details : ElectroHack 2.0 is a hardware-centric hackathon that

brings together electronics and emerging digital technologies to build

innovative systems. Participants compete across three tracks - Embedded

Systems with IoT, VLSI Design, and PCB Designing - with an emphasis on

hardware implementation. The hackathon encourages exploration of

decentralized systems inspired by Web3, enabling teams to naturally

integrate such ideas into their designs where they add value. ElectroHack

2.0 fosters innovation, collaboration, and hands-on problem solving at the

intersection of modern hardware and evolving system architectures.

CODECHEF VITEvent Name : DevSOC'26

Date : 08-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 9 PM to 2 PM

Venue : Anna Auditorium, TT

Event Details : DevSOC (Developers' Sprint Of Code), in its seventh

edition, is the flagship annual event by CodeChef-VIT, aiming at empowering

young minds by fostering meaningful connections between tech enthusiasts

and innovators. This 48-hour sprint-style hackathon is designed to

encourage creativity, collaboration, and problem-solving in an intense yet

engaging environment. As a Free and Open-Source Software (FOSS) event,

DevSOC’26 emphasizes innovation, teamwork, and technological advancement

over four days of continuous ideation and development.

IEEE PROFESSIONAL COMMUNICATION SOCIETY (IEEE-PCS) & IEEE - COMMUNICATIONS

SOCIETY (IEEE-COMSOC)Event Name : Connectron 2.0

Date : 08-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 9 PM to 6 AM

Venue : Sarojini Naidu Gallery, SJT

Event Details : Connectron 2.0 is a 36-hour overnight hackathon presented

through a collaboration between IEEE PCS, VIT Vellore and IEEE COMSOC, VIT

Vellore, set alongside the overarching theme of Yantra ’26: Web3-based

Solutions. The event brings together innovators to ideate and build

decentralized, future-ready solutions across three focused

tracks—Cybersecurity, Safety & Wellness, and Ethical AI—encouraging

participants to merge technical excellence with real-world impact through a

fast-paced, innovation-driven hackathon experience.

MATRIX- THE MULTIMEDIA CLUBEvent Name : Green Ledger Buildathon

Date : 09-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 6 AM

Venue : Kamaraj Auditorium, TT

Event Details : GreenLedger Build-a-thon is a high-octane

"Animation-thon" where creators architect multi-scene narratives bridging

Web3 logic with sustainability. Participants must bypass single-prompt AI

to build "Motion Logic" NFTs that visualize real-world impact. By merging

decentralized transparency with ownership, these digital assets transform

abstract environmental data into tangible, animated stories of global

change and verifiable ecological stewardship.

ADVANCE DEVELOPERS CLUBEvent Name : SharkTech 2.0

Date : 09-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : Homi Bhabha Gallery

Event Details :This is a 24-hour event that incorporates a designathon

and a hackathon with a Shark Tank format that focuses on using Artificial

Intelligence for social causes. This event aims to develop solutions using

Artificial Intelligence to solve some of the most pressing problems faced

by society today, which include eradicating poverty, ensuring quality

education for all, women’s equality, ensuring inclusivity in healthcare

facilities, and conservation of the environment.

AMERICAN SOCIETY OF CIVIL ENGINEERS (ASCE)Event Name : Green Credits

Date : 09-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 6 PM

Venue : Bhagat Singh Gallery, SJT

Event Details :Green Credits is a 1-day Innovation Hackathon that

challenges civil engineering and technology students to design

blockchain-based incentive systems for sustainable construction.

Participants will conceptualise tokenized carbon credit platforms that

reward eco-friendly construction practices, align with international

sustainability standards (ASCE/COS 73-23, ISO 14040/44), and address the

construction industry's most urgent crisis: embodied carbon emissions.

SOCIETY FOR BIOLOGICAL ENGINEERING (SBE)Event Name : Block and Key

Date : 09-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 6 PM

Venue : MB 210

Event Details : A workshop on blockchain, its importance, applications

and a session on pseudocodes and their working was given pre-lunch.

Participants are given problem statements at the beginning of round 2 that

require them to create a blockchain model pseudocode (with loops that work

like a pathway) that would comprise valid checkpoints and pass the judgment

criteria on all fronts.

INTERNATIONAL SOCIETY OF AUTOMATION (ISA)Event Name : Binary Battles 3.0

Date : 09-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 10 AM to 7 PM

Venue : CS Hall

Event Details : Step into 'Binary Battles 3.0', where strategy, logic and

teamwork collide. Tackle high-energy challenges, crack cryptic Web3

challenges and race through an intense final CodeSprint where ideas turn

into execution. Collaborate, compete, and outthink the challenge!

INTERNET OF THINGS COMMUNITY (IOTHINC)Event Name : Link the Future

Date : 09-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 7 PM

Venue : SMV 110

Event Details : Experience the internet’s next evolution in this

design-first challenge—no/minimal coding required. We kick off with a

beginner-friendly masterclass on the fundamentals of decentralisation and

digital ownership, followed by an architectural competition where you’ll

re-imagine iconic global brands for the blockchain era. Instead of writing

scripts, you will focus on high-level strategy and logic, blueprinting new

ecosystems of transparency and community governance for the world's biggest

products. Whether you are a creative strategist or a tech-curious thinker,

join us to transform today’s household names into the decentralized

powerhouses of tomorrow!

ALPHA BIO CELL (ABC)Event Name : The Data Detectives

Date : 09-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 7 PM

Venue : Ambedkar Auditorium, TT

Event Details : This immersive event explores themes like drug tampering,

medical record manipulation, forensic investigation and many more within

the biotechnology and healthcare ecosystem. It begins with a focused

workshop on using Web3 for social responsibility, followed by a round wise,

team-based challenge, where participants analyze blockchain-inspired

datasets to uncover discrepancies in clinical reports and pharmaceutical

data, ending with a high-stakes competitive round, where participants will

be tested on their understanding of Web3.

Society of India (ISOI) – VIT Student Chapter, part of Yantra 2026. On Feb

8–9 at VIT Vellore, solve real-world challenges across AI, IoT, robotics,

healthcare, and Web3. Code, connect, and build the future.

IEEE CIRCUITS AND SYSTEMS (IEEE-CAS)

Event Name : ElectroHack 2.0

Date : 08-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time: 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : VOC Gallery, TT

Event Details: ElectroHack 2.0 is a hardware-centric hackathon that brings

together electronics and emerging digital technologies to build innovative

systems. Participants compete across three tracks - Embedded Systems with

IoT, VLSI Design, and PCB Designing - with an emphasis on hardware

implementation. The hackathon encourages exploration of decentralized

systems inspired by Web3, enabling teams to naturally integrate such ideas

into their designs where they add value. ElectroHack 2.0 fosters

innovation, collaboration, and hands-on problem solving at the intersection

of modern hardware and evolving system architectures.

VINNOVATEIT CLUB

Event Name : B³ - Block. Build. Break.

Date : 07-02-2026 to 08-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 2 PM

Venue : Shakespeare Gallery, TT

Event Details : B³ is an overnight hackathon where teams first break down

real-world Web2 products, rethink them using Web3 principles, and build

smarter, decentralized solutions through creativity, collaboration, and

continuous improvement.

INSTITUTION OF ENGINEERS INDIA IE(I)

Event Name : Hacksphere

Date : 07-02-2026 to 08-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 12 PM

Venue : Sarojini Naidu Gallery, SJT

Event Details : HackSphere is a 24-hour innovation sprint where teams

collaborate to turn ideas into impactful, working solutions. The event

guides participants from theme orientation and ideation to prototyping,

mentorship-driven refinement, and final presentations evaluated by an

expert jury.

INDIAN SOCIETY OF EARTHQUAKE TECHNOLOGY (ISET)

Event Name : SeismoSolve : Structural Case Challenge

Date : 07-02-2026 to 08-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 6 PM

Venue : SMV 209

Event Details : SeismoSolve is a two-day hands-on workshop that connects

structural engineering theory with practical earthquake-resistant design

through expert-led sessions on seismic behavior, failure mechanisms, and

strengthening techniques. Participants then work on a real-world case

study, using engineering tools and calculations to propose and present

robust structural solutions for seismic safety.

ARCHI-TECH

Event Name : 3Design

Date : 07-02-2026 to 08-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 6 PM

Venue : MGB 111

Event Details : The proposed workshop is a skill-development–oriented event

by SATYAM SUJAY and DEON DUTTA , focused on introducing and training

students in current industry-standard software tools - Autocad, SketchUp,

Rhino and Blender. The content will be geared towards progressively

educating students from an introductory level to achieving practical skills

with these programs. The workshop will demonstrate how students can

leverage digital design and visualization technologies to develop solutions

to real-world social challenges such as sustainable infrastructure planning

and virtual environments relevant to Web3-based ecosystems.

CENTRE FOR SOCIAL ENTREPRENEURSHIP DEVELOPMENT (CSED)

Event Name : Code2Innovate

Date : 07-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 12 PM to 10 AM

Venue : Anna Auditorium

Event Details : Code2Innovate is a 48-hour hackathon organized by CSED in

collaboration with MFC, focused on building innovative Web3-driven

solutions for real-world social challenges. Participants will work in teams

to design and develop impactful software or hardware projects using

blockchain, IoT, and emerging technologies, supported by expert mentorship

and speaker sessions.

IEEE PROFESSIONAL COMMUNICATION SOCIETY (IEEE-PCS) & IEEE -COMMUNICATIONS

SOCIETY (IEEE-COMSOC)

Event Name : Connectron 2.0

Date : 08-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 9 PM to 6 AM

Venue : Sarojini Naidu Gallery

Event Details : Connectron 2.0 is a 36-hour overnight hackathon presented

through a collaboration between IEEE PCS, VIT Vellore and IEEE COMSOC, VIT

Vellore, set alongside the overarching theme of Yantra ’26: Web3-based

Solutions. The event brings together innovators to ideate and build

decentralized, future-ready solutions across three focused

tracks—Cybersecurity, Safety & Wellness, and Ethical AI—encouraging

participants to merge technical excellence with real-world impact through a

fast-paced, innovation-driven hackathon experience.

ASSOCIATION FOR COMPUTING MACHINERY (ACM)

Event Name : The Neural Hack

Date : 08-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : Shakespeare Gallery

Event Details : The Neural Hack is a data-centric AI and Machine Learning

hackathon designed to push innovation through data-driven problem solving.

The event challenges participants to look beyond models and uncover the

patterns and structure hidden within data. Whether it’s refining datasets

or building robust pipelines, this hackathon is a platform to foster the

development of intelligent solutions that reflect real-world impact.

Subject: YANTRA'26: Day-1 Events (07-02-26)-reg
Body:
Dear VITians,

As VIT continues its journey of excellence and innovation, the Office of

Students’ Welfare proudly invites you to the 6th edition of Yantra —

VIT’s flagship weeklong technical fest. Yantra’26, scheduled from 7th

February to 15th February 2026, promises an engaging and impactful

exploration of technology, creativity, and innovation.

This edition features 70+ diverse events, curated to inspire, educate,

and challenge participants across disciplines and skill levels. The theme

for Yantra’26, “Leveraging AI for Social Sustainability,” underscores the

powerful role of Artificial Intelligence in driving inclusive growth,

societal well-being, and sustainable solutions for real-world challenges.

Don’t miss this opportunity to showcase your talent, strengthen your

technical skills, and collaborate on ideas that create meaningful impact.

Following are the events scheduled for YANTRA’26 – Day 1:

YANTRA Special Event

Event Name : Yantra: Proctor Proctee Hack

Date : 07-02-2026 to 08-02-2026

Time : 8AM to 9PM

Venue : CS Hall

Event Details : Unlock the opportunity to work together with a proctor who

will mentor the proctees. You can form teams to work on groundbreaking

projects which will drive innovation, fostering teamwork and creativity.

INSTITUTION OF ELECTRONICS AND TELECOMMUNICATION ENGINEERS (IETE)

Event Name : Chain2Circuit

Date : 07-02-2026 to 08-02-2026

Time : 8AM to 4PM

Venue : MB 210

Event Details : Chain2Circuit is a two-day hands-on workshop that

demonstrates how blockchain transactions can securely trigger and control

electronic circuits and IoT devices using virtual hardware and real-time

communication protocols. Participants will build an end-to-end workflow

integrating embedded systems, IoT messaging, and Web3 automation to bridge

decentralized technologies with physical electronics.

CENTRE FOR SOCIAL ENTREPRENEURSHIP DEVELOPMENT(CSED)

Event Name : Code2Innovate

Date : 07-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 12PM to 10AM

Venue : Anna Auditorium

Event Details : Code2Innovate is a 48-hour hackathon organized by CSED in

collaboration with MFC, focused on building innovative Web3-driven

solutions for real-world social challenges. Participants will work in teams

to design and develop impactful software or hardware projects using

blockchain, IoT, and emerging technologies, supported by expert mentorship

and speaker sessions.

IEEE COMPUTER SOCIETY (IEEE-CS)

Event Name : ModelArena

Date : 07-02-2026 to 08-02-2026

Time : 8AM to 8AM

Venue : Kamaraj Auditorium

Event Details : ModelArena is a 24-hour high-intensity Machine Learning

hackathon where participants build and optimize predictive models on a

real-world dataset in a live, leaderboard-driven competition. With

real-time rankings and multiple resubmissions, the event rewards not just

accuracy but true model robustness, strategy, and performance under

pressure.

INNOVATOR'S QUEST

Event Name : CyberShield X

Date : 07-02-2026 to 07-02-2026

Time : 10AM to 4PM

Venue : Homi Bhaba Gallery, SJT

Event Details : CyberShield X is a beginner-friendly, hands-on workshop

introducing core concepts of Cybersecurity and Web3. Guided by an industry

expert, participants gain practical exposure, real-world insights, and

career awareness in emerging technologies.

INSTITUTION OF ENGINEERS INDIA IE(I)

Event Name : Hacksphere

Date : 07-02-2026 to 08-02-2026

Time : 8AM to 8AM

Venue : Sarojini Naidu Gallery, SJT

Event Details : HackSphere is a 24-hour innovation sprint where teams

collaborate to turn ideas into impactful, working solutions. The event

guides participants from theme orientation and ideation to prototyping,

mentorship-driven refinement, and final presentations evaluated by an

expert jury.

VINNOVATEIT CLUB

Event Name : B³ - Block. Build. Break.

Date : 07-02-2026 to 08-02-2026

Time : 8AM to 2PM

Venue : Shakespeare Gallery

Event Details : B³ is a overnight hackathon where teams first break down

real-world Web2 products, rethink them using Web3 principles, and build

smarter, decentralized solutions through creativity, collaboration, and

Subject: Congratulations to Team Levitate Hyperloop - Achievements at the Global Hyperloop Competition 2026
Body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to inform you that Team Levitate Hyperloop proudly

represented Vellore Institute of Technology, Vellore at the second edition

of the Global Hyperloop Competition (GHC 2.0), held from 22nd to 25th

January 2026 at the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras.

emerged as the top performer, securing the maximum number of awards at the

competition.

Subject: Congratulations to Team Unlabeled for Achievement at Data Science Hackathon 2026 | IIT Kharagpur
Body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to share that Team Unlabeled has secured Second Place at

the IIT Kharagpur in Data Science Hackathon 2026, a prestigious

national-level competition, with a cash prize of ₹1,25,000.

The competition was conducted from 5th to 12th January 2026, with the final

round held on 17th January 2026 at IIT Kharagpur. Out of 13,500+

registrations, only 18 teams were shortlisted nationwide, and Team

Unlabeled was the only team representing VIT Vellore among the finalists.

The team presented a project focused on enabling Large Language Models

(LLMs) to incorporate global contextual understanding for more accurate and

informed predictions. The project was highly appreciated by the judging

panel, which included industry experts from HSBC Bank and Pathways, for its

innovation, technical rigor, and real-world relevance.

We would like to invite applications for our Apprenticeship Programme 2027

in DTI.

As you all know the eligibility criteria is 7 CGPA & above without any

backlogs hence please share the details of the students interested in DBS

Tech India Apprenticeship Programme 2026 in the below format by 05.02.2026

6:00 pm

Request you to share the details in an excel sheet as an attachment.

Note: Only CS/IT students’ details are to be shared. Other allied branches

like AI, ML, Cybersecurity, Data Science, are also considered.

 Apprenticeship Programme, DBS Tech India (DTI), Hyderabad

Business Function

At DBS, Group Technology and Operations (T&O) enables and empowers the bank

with an efficient, nimble and resilient infrastructure through a strategic

focus on productivity, quality & control, technology, people capability and

innovation. In Group T&O, we manage the majority of the Bank's operational

processes and inspire to delight our business partners through our multiple

banking delivery channels.

The Programme

Are you keen to apply your technological knowledge to real-world challenges?

Join the DTI Apprenticeship Programme where you can get a head start in

your technology career with DBS!

During this program, you will have the opportunity to learn and contribute

to DTI's growth story in digital transformation, as we strive to evolve

into a World-Class Engineering Organization. You will experience a

transformative journey with dynamic challenges through real-time projects,

unlocking multifaceted expertise providing springboard for your corporate

adventure.

This is a hybrid programme spanning - virtual for 8 months and 4 months

from our impressive workspace in Hyderabad.

Throughout the program's duration, you will receive a competitive stipend

and benefits while pursuing your studies.

Successful completion of the programme also offers an opportunity to secure

a spot in the Flagship DTI Skill Enhancement Education & Development (SEED)

Programme (Full-time opportunity with DBS).

Do refer to the below image for the journey of an apprentice with DTI.

Eligibility Criteria

 - Candidates currently in the third year (graduating in 2027) of their

 BE/BTech program in Computer Science or Information Technology, holding a

 GPA of 7 or above without any backlogs.

 - Committed to work from Hyderabad location for 4 months, commencing in

 February 2027.

 - Self-motivated team player who enjoys working in a fast-paced

 environment.

 - Adaptable, creative, decisive, and resilient, and demonstrate good

 interpersonal and communication skills.

Note: Interested & eligible students are said to apply in the below link

on or before 05.02.2026 (6:00 pm)

https://forms.gle/TV4DoZU7nfQdhLCq8

invent."

 VIT undergraduate students entering their final year

Subject: Innovation Week 2026 - Thank you
Body:
Dear VITians,

Greetings. Our heartfelt thanks to all VITians for their enthusiastic

participation and support in making Innovation Week 2026 a grand success.

We thank our Honorable Chancellor and Core Group Members for their

encouragement and support in making this Innovation week a remarkable one.

Throughout the week, we witnessed an inspiring series of events including

the InnoHack Hackathon, Technology Transfer Sessions, HCC Fireside Chat,

Demo Day, Tech Showcase, Tech Conclave,IP conclave and Idea Showcases,

along with interactive workshops with our alumni and industry experts from

leading corporate industry such as Google and LinkedIn, Mahindra & Mahindra

and India Block Chain forum. 

 - On the first day, the InnoHack saw an active participation of 225

 teams (1000+ students) out of which 175 teams were from various

 institutions from South India.

 - Five agreements were signed with industries for transfer of

 technologies.

 - Two of our startup teams have received funding support from the

 investors during the DeepTech Pitching event conducted on the fourth day.

 - The five day event also witnessed exchange of MoUs with

 industries.

The active involvement of our faculty members in mentoring and guiding

students, along with the energetic participation of students, created a

vibrant environment of learning, experimentation, and knowledge exchange.

The discussions during the IP conclave, insights shared during the HCC

Fireside Chat and the hands-on exposure from industry-led workshops helped

bridge the gap between ideas and real-world applications.

Events like these are possible only because of your commitment to nurturing

a culture of innovation and continuous learning. We are proud of what we

have achieved together and look forward to even greater milestones in the

future.

Thank you once again for your valuable contributions and support.

A BIG thanks to the VIT Innovation Team (VIT Innovation, startup, TT, IPR

and IIC) for leading us from the front and for their tireless efforts

towards creating a vibrant innovation ecosystem in the campus.

Subject: International Summer Research Internships at Colorado State University, USA
Body:
Kind Attention: Final Year Undergraduate Students 

International Summer Research Internships at Colorado State University,

USA

Colorado State University is excited to host an International Summer

Research Internship for international scholars in Summer 2026. This unique

program allows you to work alongside high-achieving students and

award-winning staff at CSU’s state-of-the-art facilities to gain valuable

research experience related to your area of study.

This opportunity is available to non-U.S. citizens who are entering their

final year of an undergraduate degree program at an accredited

international university.

The internship is designed to provide visiting scholars with the

opportunity to experience the U.S. educational setting while fulfilling the

educational objectives for his or her current degree program at your home

institution.

You can carry this experience with you to your next educational

opportunity, or use it to get a start on your educational career at CSU.

Visiting scholars will be immersed in on-campus laboratories and complete

research projects for either 4 weeks, 6 weeks, or 8 weeks in fields like:

 - Biomedical Sciences

 - Business/Data Analytics/Finance

 - Computer Science

 - Engineering

 - Health and Human Sciences

 - Mathematics

 - Natural Resources

 - Natural Sciences: Biology/Molecular

 - Biology/Biochemistry

Program attendees will be granted a certificate upon completion. Please

note that subjects cannot be guaranteed and placements will be made upon

acceptance into the program following coordination with available faculty.

For more information and instructions on how to apply, please refer to the

link below :

https://international.colostate.edu/iec/summer-research-internship/

https://international.colostate.edu/iec/summer-research-internship/

Best Wishes,

Dr.R.Seenivasan

Dear VITians,

Greetings!

The Office of Students’ Welfare is pleased to invite you to a Drug

Awareness Session, organized in collaboration with the Indian Red Cross

Society (IRCS), Vellore District Branch. This interactive session aims to

educate students on the risks associated with substance abuse, promote

informed decision-making, and encourage healthy lifestyle choices.

 -

 Date: 23 January 2026

 -

 Time: 10:30 AM – 12:30 PM

 -

 -

of society. Awareness, early identification, and timely intervention play a

crucial role in prevention. This session will provide practical insights

into understanding the risks of substance abuse, recognizing early warning

signs, resisting peer pressure, and making responsible choices for a safe

and healthy life.

meaningful session.

Dear Students,

 Al Akhawayn University in Ifrane, Morocco is inviting nominations for the

Fall 2026 semester.

 Please find the following:

 - AUI Fact Sheet 

 - Nomination procedures and deadlines

 - Necessary documents for the student's application

 - Important dates to remember for the Fall 2026 semester

Nomination procedure and deadlines:

The nomination period for the Fall 2026 semester is now open and will

remain so until February 20th 2026.

Course pre-registration procedure starts in April 2026.

Please note that to be eligible for exchange or study abroad at Al Akhawayn

University, students must meet the following criteria: a minimum CGPA of

2.75, at least 45 completed credits, and, if applicable, proof of English

proficiency with a TOEFL iBT score of 79-80 or an IELTS overall score of

6.5.

Documents for the application: 

When nominating following documents need to be mailed:

1. a scanned copy of the student's most recent official transcript

2. a scanned copy of the student's passport

student's AUI ID.

Subject: Reminder: NPTEL: Exam Registration is open now for Jan 2026 courses!
Body:
Dear Learner,

Here is the much-awaited announcement on registering for the Jan 2026 NPTEL course certification exam. 

1. The registration for the certification exam is open only to those learners who have enrolled in the course. 

2. If you want to register for the exam for this course, login here using the same email id which you had used to enroll to the course in Swayam portal. Please note that Assignments submitted through the exam registered email id ALONE will be taken into consideration towards final consolidated score & certification. 

3. 
Date of exam: April 25, 2026

CLICK HERE
 
to register for the exam.

Choose from the Cities where exam will be conducted:
 
Exam Cities

4. Exam fees: 

If you register for the exam and pay before 
Feb 09, 2026
, Exam fees will be 
Rs. 1000/- per exam.

5. 50% fee waiver for the following categories: 

Students belonging to the SC/ST category: please select Yes for the SC/ST option and upload the correct Community certificate.

Students belonging to the PwD category with more than 40% disability: please select Yes for the option and upload the relevant Disability certificate. 

6. 
Last date for exam registration: Feb 13, 2026 (Friday). 

7. 
Between Feb 09, 2026 & Feb 13, 2026 late fee will be applicable.

8. Mode of payment: Online payment - debit card/credit card/net banking/UPI. 

9. 
HALL TICKET: 

The hall ticket will be available for download tentatively by
 
2 weeks prior to the exam date
. We will confirm the same through an announcement once it is published. 

10. FOR CANDIDATES WHO WOULD LIKE TO WRITE MORE THAN 1 COURSE EXAM:- you can add or delete courses and pay separately – till the date when the exam form closes. Same day of exam – you can write exams for 2 courses in the 2 sessions. The same exam center will be allocated for both the sessions. 

11. 
Data changes: 

Last date for data changes: 
Feb 13, 2026: 

We will charge an additional fee of Rs. 200 to make any changes related to name, DOB, photo, signature, SC/ST and PWD certificates after the last date of data changes.

The following 6 fields can be changed (until the form closes) ONLY when there are NO courses in the course cart. And you will be able to edit those fields only if you: - 

REMOVE unpaid courses from the cart And/or - CANCEL paid courses 

1. Do you come under the SC/ST category? 

2. SC/ST Proof 

3. Are you a person with disabilities? 

4. Are you a person with disabilities above 40%? 

5. Disabilities Proof 

6. What is your role? 

Note: 
Once you remove or cancel a course, you will be able to edit these fields immediately. 

But, for canceled courses, refund of fees will be initiated only after 2 weeks. 

12. 
LAST DATE FOR CANCELING EXAMS and getting a refund: 
Feb 13, 2026 

13. Click here to view Timeline and Guideline :
 
Guideline

Domain Certification

Domain Certification helps learners to gain expertise in a specific Area/Domain. This can be helpful for learners who wish to work in a particular area as part of their job or research or for those appearing for some competitive exam or becoming job ready or specializing in an area of study. 

Every domain will comprise Core courses and Elective courses. Once a learner completes the requisite courses as per the mentioned criteria, you will receive a Domain Certificate showcasing your scores and the domain of expertise. Kindly refer to the following link for the list of courses available under each domain: 
https://nptel.ac.in/domains

Outside India Candidates

Candidates who are residing outside India may also fill the exam form and pay the fees. Mode of exam and other details will be communicated to you separately.

Subject: Welcome to NPTEL Online Course : Education for Sustainable Development
Body:
Dear Learner
Welcome to SWAYAM-NPTEL Online Courses and Certification!
Thank you for signing up for our online course "
Education for Sustainable Development
"
. We wish you an enjoyable and informative learning experience.
Details regarding the course:
Name of the course:
 
Education for Sustainable Development
 
Course url:
 
https://onlinecourses.nptel.ac.in/noc26_hs58/preview
Course duration :
 
12 weeks
 
 
The course will begin on 
19 January 2026
 When content is released on the portal, you will get an email alerting you.
CONTENT AND ASSIGNMENTS
Every week, about 2.5 to 4 hours of videos containing content by the Course instructor will be released along with an assignment based on this. Please watch the lectures, follow the course regularly and submit all assessments and assignments before the due date. Your regular participation is vital for learning and doing well in the course. This will be done week on week through the duration of the course.
Please do the assignments yourself and even if you take help, kindly try to learn from it. These assignment will help you prepare for the final exams. Plagiarism and violating the Honor code will be taken very seriously if detected during the submission of assignments.
ANNOUNCEMENT AND DISCUSSION GROUPS TO CLEAR DOUBTS:
The announcement group - will only have messages from course instructors and teaching assistants - regarding the lessons, assignments, exam registration, hall tickets etc.
The discussion forum (Ask a question tab on the portal) - is for everyone to ask questions and interact.Anyone who knows the answers can reply to anyone's post and the course instructor/TA will also respond to your queries. Please make maximum use of this feature as this will help you learn much better.
If you have any questions regarding the exam, registration, hall tickets, results, queries related to the technical content in the lectures, any doubts in the assignments, etc can be posted in the forum section
TO GET A CERTIFICATE - PROCESS AND CRITERIA:
The course is free to enroll and learn from. But if you want a certificate, you have to register and write the proctored exam conducted by us in person at any of the designated exam centres.
The exam is optional for a fee of Rs 1000/- (Rupees one thousand only).
Date and Time of Exams: 
25 April 2026
 Morning session 9am to 12 noon; Afternoon Session 2pm to 5pm.
Registration url: Announcements will be made when the registration form is open for registrations.
The online registration form has to be filled and the certification exam fee needs to be paid. More details will be made available when the exam registration form is published. If there are any changes, it will be mentioned then.
Please check the form for more details on the cities where the exams will be held, the conditions you agree to when you fill the form etc.
CRITERIA TO GET A CERTIFICATE
Average assignment score = 25% of average of best 8 assignments out of the total 12 assignments given in the course.
Exam score = 75% of the proctored certification exam score out of 100
Final score = Average assignment score + Exam score
YOU WILL BE ELIGIBLE FOR A CERTIFICATE ONLY IF AVERAGE ASSIGNMENT SCORE >=10/25 AND EXAM SCORE >= 30/75. If one of the 2 criteria is not met, you will not get the certificate even if the Final score >= 40/100.
Certificate will have your name, photograph and the score in the final exam with the breakup.It will have the logos of NPTEL and IIT Kharagpur. It will be e-verifiable at 
nptel.ac.in/noc
.
Only the e-certificate will be made available. Hard copies will not be dispatched.
Once again, thanks for your interest in our online courses and certification. Happy learning.
- NPTEL team

Subject: Welcome to NPTEL Online Course : Human Computer Interaction (In English)
Body:
Dear Learner
Welcome to SWAYAM-NPTEL Online Courses and Certification!
Thank you for signing up for our online course "
Human Computer Interaction (In English)
"
. We wish you an enjoyable and informative learning experience.
Details regarding the course:
Name of the course:
 
Human Computer Interaction (In English)
 
Course url:
 
https://onlinecourses.nptel.ac.in/noc26_cs70/preview
Course duration :
 
12 weeks
 
 
The course will begin on 
19 January 2026
 When content is released on the portal, you will get an email alerting you.
CONTENT AND ASSIGNMENTS
Every week, about 2.5 to 4 hours of videos containing content by the Course instructor will be released along with an assignment based on this. Please watch the lectures, follow the course regularly and submit all assessments and assignments before the due date. Your regular participation is vital for learning and doing well in the course. This will be done week on week through the duration of the course.
Please do the assignments yourself and even if you take help, kindly try to learn from it. These assignment will help you prepare for the final exams. Plagiarism and violating the Honor code will be taken very seriously if detected during the submission of assignments.
ANNOUNCEMENT AND DISCUSSION GROUPS TO CLEAR DOUBTS:
The announcement group - will only have messages from course instructors and teaching assistants - regarding the lessons, assignments, exam registration, hall tickets etc.
The discussion forum (Ask a question tab on the portal) - is for everyone to ask questions and interact.Anyone who knows the answers can reply to anyone's post and the course instructor/TA will also respond to your queries. Please make maximum use of this feature as this will help you learn much better.
If you have any questions regarding the exam, registration, hall tickets, results, queries related to the technical content in the lectures, any doubts in the assignments, etc can be posted in the forum section
TO GET A CERTIFICATE - PROCESS AND CRITERIA:
The course is free to enroll and learn from. But if you want a certificate, you have to register and write the proctored exam conducted by us in person at any of the designated exam centres.
The exam is optional for a fee of Rs 1000/- (Rupees one thousand only).
Date and Time of Exams: 
17 April 2026
 Morning session 9am to 12 noon; Afternoon Session 2pm to 5pm.
Registration url: Announcements will be made when the registration form is open for registrations.
The online registration form has to be filled and the certification exam fee needs to be paid. More details will be made available when the exam registration form is published. If there are any changes, it will be mentioned then.
Please check the form for more details on the cities where the exams will be held, the conditions you agree to when you fill the form etc.
CRITERIA TO GET A CERTIFICATE
Average assignment score = 25% of average of best 8 assignments out of the total 12 assignments given in the course.
Exam score = 75% of the proctored certification exam score out of 100
Final score = Average assignment score + Exam score
YOU WILL BE ELIGIBLE FOR A CERTIFICATE ONLY IF AVERAGE ASSIGNMENT SCORE >=10/25 AND EXAM SCORE >= 30/75. If one of the 2 criteria is not met, you will not get the certificate even if the Final score >= 40/100.
Certificate will have your name, photograph and the score in the final exam with the breakup.It will have the logos of NPTEL and IIIT Delhi. It will be e-verifiable at 
nptel.ac.in/noc
.
Only the e-certificate will be made available. Hard copies will not be dispatched.
Once again, thanks for your interest in our online courses and certification. Happy learning.
- NPTEL team

Call for Applications – Ireland Government Scholarship 2026 (Fully Funded)

Dear Students,

applications for the Ireland Government Scholarship 2026. This is a fully

funded opportunity for international students to pursue Master’s, MPhil, or

Doctoral degrees at top Irish universities.

Key Highlights of the Scholarship:

 - Host Country: Ireland

 - Degree Levels: Master’s, and PhD programs.

 - Financial Support:

 - Annual Stipend: €19,000

 - Tuition Fee Waiver: Up to €5,750 per year

 - Research Expenses: €3,250 per annum

 - Eligible Fields: Science, Technology, Humanities, and Social

 Sciences.

Participating Institutions:

Students may apply to recognized institutions such as Dublin City

University, Dublin Institute for Advanced Studies, Athlone Institute of

Technology, and others listed in the scholarship guidelines.

Application Deadline:

All interested candidates must submit their applications online by 12

March 2026.

How to Apply:

For detailed eligibility criteria and to submit your application, please

visit the official website: www.irishaidscholarships.ie

http://www.irishaidscholarships.ie

for global academic exposure.

Thank you,

Best Wishes,

Dr.R.Seenivasan

Body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to share that Parnika Prakash (24BBT0242) has achieved a

notable literary milestone at the national level Competition.

Parnika’s short story titled “My Therapist” was shortlisted and awarded

as one of the Top Ten Stories at the Crooked Lines Literary Festival, a

national-level literature festival held on 14th and 15th November 2025 at Shiv

Nadar University (SNU), Delhi NCR.

The Crooked Lines Literary Festival is a reputed platform that celebrates

emerging voices in literature, and Parnika’s work stood out among numerous

entries from participants across the country. This recognition reflects her

creativity, narrative skill, and literary excellence.

We congratulate Parnika Prakash on this commendable achievement and

appreciate her efforts in bringing recognition to our institution at a

prestigious national literary forum.

Subject: Wishing you all a happy Lohri, Pongal, Makar Sankranti, and Magh Bihu!
Body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare wishes you all a Happy Lohri, Pongal, Makar

Sankranti, and Magh Bihu!

Lohri, Pongal, Makar Sankranti and Bihu are festivals that represent

different cultures but unite under one country – India. All the festivals

are loosely related to one single premise – crops, but vary depending on

the part of the country it is celebrated in. Let’s look at each of these

four festivals that people celebrate together.

Pongal, the four-day harvest festival celebrated in South India, especially

Tamil Nadu, will be celebrated with great enthusiasm from January 15-18

this year. Celebrated in mid-January every year, it also marks the

beginning of Uttarayan- the sun's journey towards the north and the end of

the winter season.

A large bonfire with people dancing, singing, and having a good time is

what contains the essence of this festival. Lohri is celebrated a day

before Makar Sankranti and is primarily celebrated in North India,

especially in the agricultural state of Punjab. It marks the end of the

sowing season. Delicacies and snacks, for example, Rewri, Peanuts, Sarson

Ka Saag, Makke Ki Roti, etc., are enjoyed with full vigor.

Makar Sankranti follows Lohri by a day and is a popular festival in most

parts of the country, but the festivity is at its prime, mainly in North

India. The festival marks the advent of the harvest season and also

signifies the end of Winter as the days start getting longer. Many people

dip in the sacred waters of the Ganga and offer their prayers to the Sun.

In many parts of North India, kites take over the skies, and delicious

sweets such as Til Ke Laddoo are enjoyed.

The same spirit and the same premise, when it travels all the way to North

East India, takes the shape of Magh Bihu. The end of the harvest season is

what the festival represents. Traditional dance, traditional games, and

activities such as Cooking in Meji (Bamboo Huts) define the festival in the

state of Assam.

Subject: Congratulations to Rohit N for Receiving A+ Grade Certification – Carbon Management Program | New Delhi
Body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to announce that Rohit N (Reg. No: 21MID0138), a

final-year student of M.Tech. (Integrated) – Computer Science and

Engineering with Specialization in Data Science, has achieved a noteworthy

accomplishment as a Student Innovator and Entrepreneur.

He had the privilege of representing Vellore Institute of Technology

(VIT) at the Carbon Management Program, held on 3rd and 4th December

2025 at the India International Centre, New Delhi. During the program, he

presented his innovation work developed through his startup, Sri Naagha

Electronics and Systems Pvt. Ltd., and delivered a technical presentation

titled “Autonomous Beehive Systems for Quantification and Valuation of

Bees-Driven Nature-Based Carbon Credits.” The project focuses on

technology-driven sustainability and nature-based climate solutions.

As part of the program, Rohit also participated in the quiz competition and

secured a commendable score. In recognition of his overall contribution and

performance, he was awarded an A+ Grade Certification by Dr. Srikant

Nagulapalli, IAS, Secretary, Ministry of Power, Government of India.

We also acknowledge the invaluable guidance and mentorship of Dr. Priyanka

N (Employee ID: 19728), Assistant Professor Sr. Grade 1, Department of IoT,

School of Computer Science and Engineering, whose support played a

significant role in this achievement.

This accomplishment highlights the spirit of innovation, entrepreneurship,

Attachment_Names: ['Pécs Summer School Info Session, January 29 18.00 PM CET.pdf']
Body:
Dear Student,

Would you like to earn credits, explore Central Europe, and make

friends from around the world next summer?

Join our online info session and learn all about the Pécs Summer School

2026 programs at the University of Pécs, Hungary – one of Central

Europe’s most welcoming university cities, full of culture, history, and

vibrant student life!

 - Date: Thursday, January 29

 - Time: 18:00 Central European Time (CET) 

 - Format: Online via Microsoft Teams

Register for the session: https://forms.gle/dUDcesTqsHyZaonr7

https://forms.gle/dUDcesTqsHyZaonr7

During the session, you will hear about:

 - Academic programs and ECTS credits

 - Program fees and accommodation

 - Exciting cultural and social events that make the experience

 unforgettable

Pécs Summer School 2026 Programs:

Two-week programs | July 4–18, 2026 | 6 ECTS credits each | €1,050–€1,450

 1. European Studies Summer School (1,050 EUR)

 Explore the political, cultural, and social achievements of Europe

 through engaging lectures on art, gastronomy, migration, and diversity.

 2. Leadership Skills Summer School (1,050 EUR)

 Develop essential leadership, communication, and teamwork skills to

 become an effective and confident leader.

 3. Sustainability – Social Ecology (1,050 EUR)

 Combine theory and practice as you engage with local NGOs on

 sustainability and inclusion projects.

 4. International Human Rights Law (1,450 EUR)

 Gain insight into major international human rights issues, EU human

 rights law, and humanitarian protection.

 (Open only to Law students.)

 5. Debate Academy (July 19 – August 2, 1,050 EUR)

 Strengthen your critical thinking and public speaking in this hands-on,

 international debate program.

Four-week Combined Programs | July 5 – August 2, 2026

Combine any of the above with the Debate Academy for a four-week

experience and double your learning and intercultural exposure:

 - European Studies + Debate Academy (2,100 EUR)

 - Leadership Skills + Debate Academy (2,100 EUR)

 - Sustainability + Debate Academy (2,100 EUR)

 - International Human Rights Law + Debate Academy (2,500 EUR)

Program fees include:

✔ Tuition and materials

✔ Dormitory accommodation

✔ Lunch on teaching days + two dinners per week

✔ Cultural and social programs: sightseeing, Intercultural Evening, Quiz

Night, wine tasting, dragon boat race, darts contest, pool party, museum

visits

Why you should choose our Summer Schools:

 - Earn up to 12 ECTS credits

 - Join students from 40+ countries

 - Experience affordable, high-quality education in Europe’s hidden gem

Watch our 2025 highlights: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RPfokv5CvEQ

Visit our website: https://summerschool.pte.hu/

Follow us on Instagram: @pecssummerschool

The Pécs Summer School Program was founded in 2016 with the aim of

organizing an increasing number of summer schools each year. In 2026, we

are planning to host 150 students from all across the world, studying a

wide range of disciplines in our two- and four-week summer programs.

Participants will attend very enjoyable social and cultural programs

together, offering a unique intercultural student experience in one of

Central Europe’s most beautiful cities, the 2,000-year-old city of Pécs.

We look forward to welcoming you online on January 29 — and hopefully to

Pécs this summer!

 Best Regards,

R Seenivasan

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students' Welfare,VAIAL School, HOT School, Department of

Physical Education & Tamil Literary Association, invite you all for

the PONGAL CELEBRATION 2026. We have a lot of traditional events and games

lined up to help you experience the traditional festival of Tamil Nadu!

Here are some of the exciting features that we have got for you:

 - Special traditional cultural events like Tanjavur Melam, Karagattam,

 Poikkal Kuthiraiattam, Bharathanatyam, Sevaiattam, Jikkaattam,

 Silambattam, Devarattam, Parayattam and Periya Melam performed by

 invited professional artists and VIT students.

 - Pongal Making Competition for Faculty, Staff Members and Research

 Scholars

 - Distribution of Sweet Pongal and Sugarcane for all the attendees.

 - Food stalls (40+ traditional food items)

 - Pottery Making Stall

 - Palm Leaf Craft Stall

 - Mulai pari procession by VAIAL School students

 - VAIAL School Students Exhibition Stall

 - Release of Agriculture-related booklets authored by faculty

 - Fun events stall by SW Office: Bambaram, Pallankuzhi & Karumbudaithal.

VAIAL School presents a Model Village reflecting the holistic Tamil

culture, inspired by the Five Landscapes of Tamil Culture.

 - Kurinji (Mountain region)

 - Mullai (Forest region)

 - Marutham (Rice field)

 - Neithal (Coastal region)

 - Pallai (Dry region)

The village showcases traditional bulls, heritage village homes, grain

shops and a native lifestyle. Visitors can experience traditional games,

rural practices and the spirit of Tamil agrarian life, simple, sustainable

and rooted in tradition.

 - Students' cultural performances start by 10:00 AM.

 - Event Schedule and Stall Details Attached.

All are invited!

Subject: Mandatory 2-Step Verification starting 21 January 2026 to access VIT Email Accounts
Body:
Dear VITians,

To improve the security of our email system and to better protect user

accounts, an additional layer of security will be enforced. From 21

January 2026, 2-Step Verification (2FA) will be mandatory for all VIT

Email accounts.

This means that when you sign in using your username and password, you will

be required to verify your identity through a second step, such as:

 -

 A one-time code sent to your registered mobile number, or

 -

 A Google Authenticator app.

Important: Please note that VIT Email access will not be available from

21 January 2026 onwards if 2-Step Verification is not activated on your

account.

What you need to do:

 -

 Users who have already enrolled in 2-Step Verification may ignore this

 email.

 -

 Others are requested to enroll in 2-Step Verification on or before 20

 January 2026.

For assistance, please contact the CTS Helpdesk: https://helpdesk.vit.ac.in

Thank you for your cooperation in helping us keep our systems secure.

Thanks and Regards,

Dr. Anthoniraj Amalanathan, PhD.

Director Centre for Technical Support,

Professor School of Computer Science and Engineering,

VIT, Vellore - 632014

Website: https://www.anthoniraj.in

Dear Students,

The Office of Innovation, Startup & Technology Transfer (VITIST) invites

you to participate in a two-day Workshop on Drone Technology, organized

as part of Innovation Week 2026. This hands-on workshop aims to provide

practical exposure to modern UAV systems, covering drone design,

operation, safety protocols, and real-world applications such as

agriculture, surveillance, and mapping, along with insights into career

opportunities, regulations, and the future scope of drone technology.

participation is limited to 60 students on a first-come, first-served

basis. The workshop is open to UG, PG, and PhD students.

Interested students are requested to register at the earliest using the

link https://events.vit.ac.in/, as seats are limited.

Subject: Pride of Nation Awards 2025: VIT Honoured for Excellence & Service by Veterans India
Body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that our institution has been conferred with

the PRIDE

OF NATION AWARDS 2025 - National Excellence Honour by Veterans India.

This award is conferred for excellence in nationalism, patriotism, and

nation-building beyond academic activities. This prestigious recognition is

a testament to our collective efforts, commitment, and dedication towards

nation-building and social responsibility. The award was received by us on

Vijay Diwas, 16 December 2025 at NDMC Convention Centre, New Delhi.

The award was conferred after a rigorous evaluation across multiple

categories, highlighting our consistent and impactful contributions in the

following areas:

 - National Day celebrations honouring Ex-Servicemen

 - Welfare initiatives for Armed Forces personnel and martyrs’ families

 - Community outreach and rural development programs

 - Promotion of Indian Knowledge Systems and Cultural Heritage

 - Women Empowerment and Safety initiatives

 - Sports and Wellness activities

 - Implementation of NEP 2020 and Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)

 - Youth Leadership development and active participation

 - Defence career preparedness and awareness programs

 - Upliftment and support for martyrs’ families and disabled soldiers

This remarkable achievement belongs to every VITian whose sincere efforts

have made a meaningful difference. Let us continue to uphold these values

and work together towards a stronger, inclusive, and empowered nation.

Registrar, Director and Assistant Director, Student Welfare received the

award in New Delhi.

Congratulations to all!

Hi NAYAN SHARMA,

As today, 11.59pm is the deadline to apply for the Finlatics Investment Banking Experience Program (IBEP), please note:

1. In case you have any upcoming assignment, examination, or personal commitment, you will have the option to pick a project start date that is after its completion to help the project fit in with your schedule.

2. You will be allowed a break during the project tenure, for any academic or personal commitment. You would also be allowed a Project Extension of an additional month.

3. Please note that no prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to be a part of the project as it comes with training and live sessions.

4. You can apply for the project using the following link :

https://www.finlatics.com/ibep_application?src=vitd

5. The Project Duration is: 1 month / 2 months (based on selected student choice) and the time commitment required for the project is 3 - 5 hrs per week.

If selected, the program has a minimal induction fee: Rs.1999 + GST.

Fee Waiver: A 15% fee waiver shall be given to all students of Vellore Institute of Technology on the above-mentioned minimal induction fee.

To be eligible for the waiver, kindly apply before tonight's deadline.

The first mail circulated at the campus is attached below.

Hi NAYAN SHARMA,

We're pleased to extend applications for the Finlatics Investment Banking Experience Program (IBEP), an online live project that helps students gain work experience in private equity & venture capital at the Vellore Institute of Technology. The project provides glimpses into start-ups, their way of working, and financing.

The project is running at leading campuses including IIT Bombay, IIT Madras, IIT Kanpur and BITS Pilani among others.

STRUCTURE of the Live Project:

1. Investment banking, private equity & venture capital-oriented project

2. Assess investment proposals and identify start-ups with high growth potential

3. From a private equity fund perspective, understand various stages of PE investing

4. Engage in the set-up of a Private Equity Fund, with emphasis on investor onboarding, investing cycles & sectoral orientation

5. Author case-based projects on successful exits in the private e quity space, by analyzing mergers & acquisitions

6. Learn how to apply Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Valuation & Excel-based modeling to companies

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificate of Work Experience as an Investment Banking Analyst

2. Letter of Recommendation based on performance

Apply Here (takes 2-3 mins):

https://www.finlatics.com/ibep_application?src=vit

No prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to be a part of this project. All necessary training and mentoring will be imparted.

Project Duration: 1 month / 2 months (on selected student choice, with a flexible start date option on selected student choice.

Students will also be eligible for a break or extension during the project if they need it for any academic or personal commitments.

If selected, the program has a minimal induction fee: Rs. 1999 + GST.

Fee Waiver: A 15% fee waiver shall be given to all students of Vellore Institute of Technology on the above-mentioned minimal induction fee.

To be eligible for the fee waiver, kindly apply through the above link only.

We are looking forward to a fruitful engagement.

Subject: VIT International Relations Office is pleased to announce an International Seminar-25–27 March 2026
Body:
Dear All,

VIT International Relations Office is pleased to announce an International

Seminar, to be held during 25–27 March 2026, sponsored by the

Department of Youth Affairs, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports,

Government of India.

The seminar is centered on the theme “Digital Dreamscapes: Youth

Navigating AI, Creativity & Virtual Expression.” It aims to explore how

young minds can harness artificial intelligence and emerging technologies

to reimagine fields such as performing arts, architecture, and content

creation, while emphasizing responsible innovation and ethical foresight.

The main objective of this international conference is to provide Indian

youth with a comprehensive understanding of global issues and international

research, and to equip them with perspectives on themes relevant to their

context, thereby enhancing their knowledge and confidence to articulate

their views at international forums.

Eligibility:

Open to faculty members, research scholars, and students under 35 years of

age who have an interest and relevant expertise in the seminar theme.

 Submission & Selection Process:

 - Interested applicants are invited to submit abstracts and concise

 research summaries aligned with the seminar theme.

 - All submissions will undergo academic review by an expert committee

 constituted by the Vellore Institute of Technology(VIT).

 - Selected participants will be invited to present their research

 papers during the seminar sessions.

 Important Dates:

 - Registration & Abstract Submission Link: 

 https://forms.gle/Ko9Kht131HZ1T3hTA

 - Last Date of Registration: 20th January 2026

 - Notification of Acceptance: 25th January 2026

 - Full Research Paper Submission Deadline: 30th January 2026

 - International Seminar / Paper Presentation Dates: March 25-27, 2026

 - Email for queries: iconclave@vit.ac.in

 - Conference Website Link:www.vit.ac.in

Best Wishes,

Dr.R.Seenivasan

Director -International Relations

Subject: Congratulations to Dhruv N on Receiving the Prestigious G. N. Ramachandran Fellowship Award
Body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to announce that Dhruv N (24MSP0001), M.Sc. Physics

student has brought great pride to our institution through his exceptional

academic achievement.

Dhruv has been awarded the highly prestigious G. N. Ramachandran

Fellowship for young and promising researchers by IIT Madras on 26th

September 2025. This fellowship is instituted in honour of Professor G. N.

Ramachandran, one of India’s most eminent scientists and the pioneer of

the Ramachandran Plot.

Earlier this year, he was selected as one of only fourteen students

nationwide for the highly competitive Summer Research Fellowship Programme

(SRFP) at IIT Madras, which saw participation from students representing

top institutions such as IISc, IITs, NITs, and other premier universities

across India. Based on the quality of his research work and presentation

during the programme, he was conferred with this fellowship in recognition

of his outstanding research potential.

This honour marks a significant milestone in his academic journey and

further strengthens his pursuit of high-quality research in experimental

condensed matter physics and related interdisciplinary domains.

We extend our heartfelt congratulations to Dhruv for this remarkable

achievement. His dedication and excellence stand as an inspiration to the

VIT community.

Subject: Congratulations to Team BaldMann – Achievement at Cardano Hackathon Asia 2025 | Bengaluru
Body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that Team BaldMann has brought laurels to VIT

with their remarkable achievement at the Cardano Hackathon Asia 2025 –

Grand Finale held in Bengaluru on November 29th and 30th, securing the 2nd

Prize along with a cash award of 5000 USD.

Competing against top innovators, the team developed a decentralised,

blockchain-based medical records application designed to enable secure,

privacy-focused, and efficient healthcare data sharing among key

stakeholders, including patients, doctors, hospitals, and insurance

providers.

Team Members:

 - Ketan Chouhan (22BML0090)

 - Vaibhav Jangid (23BCE2356)

 - Garv Bansal (23BKT0144)

 - Pannaga Ravindra Hegde (23MSI0072)

We extend our heartfelt appreciation to Dr. Aarthy S. L. (Emp.ID 12466) 

and Dr. Pradheep T. (Emp.ID 15266) for their unwavering mentorship and

continuous support throughout the team’s journey.

Congratulations once again to Team BaldMann for this outstanding

achievement!

Subject: Request to participate in GeoRift Hackathon 8th Jan 2026 !!
Body:
Dear VITians,

Greetings!

We are pleased and delighted to announce that the School of Biosciences

and Technology (SBST), in association with the Society for Biological

Engineering (SBE-VIT), proudly presents GEORIFT: Geographic Exploration &

Innovation Fest, a multidisciplinary innovation event open to students from

all the branches across the VIT campus.

GEORIFT will be conducted as a fully offline event on 8th & 9th January,

2026, focusing on the theme “Exploration of life: Beyond Boundaries.” This

event challenges participants to explore extreme and unconventional

environments, such as the deep sea, outer space, radioactive zones, mining

habitats, and microbial ecosystems, and develop biotechnology-driven

solutions to survive, adapt, or thrive in these settings.

GEORIFT is designed to foster creativity, scientific thinking, and

interdisciplinary collaboration. Participants will work in teams to ideate,

pitch, and develop innovative concepts, supported by expert insights and

structured evaluation rounds.

Who can participate?:

Undergraduate and postgraduate students from all disciplines, including

biotechnology, life sciences, biomedical engineering, agriculture,

bioinformatics, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, electronics,

computer science, and other technical or non-technical fields.

Key Highlights of GEORIFT:

• Expert Session – Learn from specialists in applied and environmental

biotechnology.

• Creative Ideation & Pitching – Translate complex problems into compelling

concepts through structured pitching rounds.

• Prototype Development – Design digital or conceptual prototypes

showcasing scientific feasibility and innovation.

• IoT Workshop for Beginners – A hands-on workshop introducing prototyping

from scratch, making the event accessible even to students with no prior

experience.

• Crisis Challenge Round – Test adaptability and problem-solving skills

through a surprise scenario.

GEORIFT offers students a unique opportunity to apply classroom learning to

real-world challenges, develop critical research and innovation skills, and

collaborate across disciplines.

Subject: Paper Seeing, Revaluation and Re-FAT Process for Fall Semester 2025-26 (Regular & Week End Intra Semester) FAT – Theory
Body:
Ref.No. : VIT/CoE/2025/25017

 Date: 17-December-2025

Paper Seeing, Revaluation and Re-FAT Process for

Fall Semester 2025-26 (Regular & Week End Intra Semester) FAT – Theory

 Paper Seeing and Revaluation:

· In the VTop student login, (“Examination → Marks → Fall

 Semester 2025-26”) Marks for the Courses to which FAT was held during

Nov-Dec 2025 has been made available now.

 Marks not displayed for the courses will be released within

this week

· Actual Grades will be released on 24 December 2025

(Wednesday). The Pass criteria and Grading Procedure are available in

Academics → Regulations Tab in your login.

· If you want to know the question wise marks awarded to your

answers by the evaluator, you need to apply for it through V-Top. This is

referred to as the “Paper Seeing” process. It requires payment of Rs. 100

for each paper. You can apply through: Examinations →Papersee/Rev → Fall

 Semester 2025-26→Paper Seeing. You can choose the course(s) you want

to apply for paper seeing. After Generating the Invoice, you need to make

a payment through the “Online Payments” Tab in the same V-Top login.

· Once you have paid, after 24 hours, the paper and question wise

marks awarded will be made available in CodeTantra login. You need to use

the same portal https://vit.codetantra.com for this process.

After seeing the paper, if you feel the mark awarded to a particular

question is not sufficient and the evaluator has missed something and there

is a need to recheck the mark, then you can apply for Revaluation of the

Course. You need to give suitable reasons for the same in the comments

section available just below the mark awarded by the faculty.

· Please note that the Revaluation has to be applied only in V-Top

(in the same way as you have applied for paper seeing) and necessary

payments also need to be paid through the online payments tab. (Rs. 300

per paper). Revaluation approval process in codetantra will be initiated

only after publishing the Grades, until then the status remains ‘approval

pending’ . Paper seeing and feedback / comments are mandatory for

re-evaluation and

are in online mode only.

 · Also note that “Paper seeing” and Revaluation is applicable

only for the Theory Courses to which FAT was conducted by the CoE office .

For other components and Courses (like Laboratory / Project Courses IBL

mode courses) there is No Paper seeing and Revaluation Process.

· The students who were involved in Fall Semester 2025-26

examination malpractices are not eligible for the paper

seeing/ Re-valuation process.

Particulars

Dates

Paper seeing registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 100]

 17-Dec

2025 to 22- Dec2025

Revaluation registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 300]

 18-Dec 2025 to 23- Dec-2025

Paper Seeing in https://vit.codetantra.com/

https://vit.codetantra.com/

 18- Dec-2025 to 23- Dec-2025

 Once the Paper seeing request is approved, the evaluated copy of answer

sheets would be made available in CodeTantra as per the above schedule.

Use your VTop login credentials for login.

· After login, follow the instructions given in the platform for

giving comments to the questions which need to be re-examined.

· Give your feedback with respect to the need for revaluation. If

no feedback is given for any question, your answer script will not be

considered for revaluation and No refund will be given for any approved

requests.

· Students should not approach or give any sort of request to any

faculty related to revaluation (increase of marks or grades). If we

receive any complaints from faculty, it will be treated as ‘Malpractice’

and revaluation requests will summarily be rejected.

Re-FAT:

As per VIT Academic regulations (Page 22) Re-FAT will be permitted for the

following reasons only:

S. No.

Description

Supporting Evidence(s) Required

1.

Calamity in the family [Death of father / mother / own brother / sister]

Death certificate or Prior communication to the Proctors

2.

Hospitalization of the student

(for in-patient treatment only)

Medical Certificate, Investigation Report, Bills and Discharge Summary.

· Eligible students should apply in VTop student login (

Examination > Re-Exam Application) between 5th January 2026 and 18th

January 2026 and upload the necessary evidence.

· Re-FAT requests will be scrutinized by the School Dean and then

by the ‘Re‐examinations Committee’. If needed the student may be asked to

appear before the Committee for presenting the case.

· For the ReFAT approved courses the Grade assigned will be

converted to “---“ by February end. ReFAT will be scheduled along with the

Winter 2025-26 Regular Arrear and the Regular Arrear Process will be

followed for Re-FAT.

· Any student who fails to apply for Re‐FAT through VTop will NOT

be considered for further processing and has to repeat the course(s) by

registering again in subsequent semesters.

· Please note that this process is only for getting approval

for Re-FAT. After it is approved, students need to register in Arrear

/ Re-FAT Tab for registering the course when it is permitted. The

schedule will be available only in Arrear/ Tab. If someone misses the

approved Re-FAT, no second chance will be given, and it will be treated as

absent accordingly, and the grade will be published.

Make-up Examination:

A separate circular will be issued by the COE regarding the registration

process for Make-up examination on 5th January 2026 (tentatively).

Body:
Dear Students

Greetings from Team Lambda!

We are excited to inform you that Team Lambda, a recognized SELECT team of

VIT Vellore, is now accepting applications for multiple internship roles

across technical and non-technical departments. This is a valuable

opportunity for motivated students to contribute to active industrial

research, real-world product development, and international project

collaborations—while gaining hands-on experience through government-funded

initiatives.

About Team Lambda

Team Lambda functions as a multidisciplinary group dedicated to developing

solutions in autonomous robotics, predictive maintenance for solar-energy

systems, and smart infrastructure with digital-twin integration. Our work

is supported by the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government

of India, along with partner industries.

Skilled interns have the chance to secure a long-term position in the

team.

Why Join Us?

• Work on fully funded government and industry projects

• No membership fee required

• Internship Completion Certificate provided

• Opportunity to transition into a long-term core role based on performance

• Project exposure at national-level technical events

• Enhancement of technical, research, and leadership capabilities

• Top-performing interns may be considered for core team positions

Professional Master of Embedded and Cyber-Physical Systems (MECPS) program

Dear Students,

Greetings from the International Relations Office!

The University of California, Irvine (UCI), USA-one of VIT’s partner

universities—recently conducted an orientation session on various

partnership programs for all VIT campuses. One such opportunity is the 4+1

Professional Master of Embedded and Cyber-Physical Systems (MECPS) program

offered at UCI.

The details are provided below.

Application Deadline:

Students must apply directly through the MECPS website. The application

deadline is January 15, 2026.

Early submission is encouraged, as applications are reviewed on a rolling

basis and decisions may be communicated earlier. Application link:

https://mecps.uci.edu/mecps/apply/#application

The brochures related to the MECPS program are attached herewith.

Admission Requirements:

 -

 Applicants are expected to hold a bachelor’s degree in Computer

 Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering (final year or

 graduated students). Students from other disciplines may also be considered

 if they can demonstrate sufficient foundational knowledge in embedded

 systems.

 -

 A minimum undergraduate GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale is required.

 -

 TOEFL (for international applicants): Minimum score of 80, or other

 acceptable evidence of English language proficiency.

For queries regarding the program, please visit the International Relations

Office at your respective VIT campus.

Attachment_Names: ['WhatsApp Image 2025-12-09 at 10.07.05_a18b0e20.jpg', 'WhatsApp Image 2025-12-09 at 10.21.26_1e190d11.jpg', 'WhatsApp Image 2025-12-09 at 10.21.26_7225db6a.jpg', 'WhatsApp Image 2025-12-09 at 10.21.27_58b2a4b0.jpg', 'WhatsApp Image 2025-12-09 at 10.21.27_ebac1e58.jpg', 'WhatsApp Image 2025-12-09 at 10.22.58_ea417815.jpg']
Body:
Dear VITians,

Greetings!

The Office of Students' Welfare invites you to spring into action on Day-5

as we dive into an exciting week filled with cultural vibrance. After long

schedules and academic fatigue, this is the perfect moment to unwind,

recharge, and rediscover the joy of campus life.

We proudly present the 6th edition of Prima Vera - a week-long cultural

festival celebrating the creativity, passion, and spirit of VIT’s dynamic

student community. Get ready for a series of thrilling competitions, each

designed to bring out your best and help you showcase your unique talents.

Expect energetic performances, artistic showdowns, and engaging events, all

culminating in an unforgettable cultural experience.

And yes — there are exciting cash prizes waiting for the winners, along

with the pride of taking center stage in one of VIT’s most anticipated

festivals.

Gear up, participate, cheer, and make Prima Vera’25 a celebration to

remember!

Day-5 Schedule

Débat d’Idées – Debate invites students to engage in thoughtful and

articulate discussions on contemporary topics, encouraging critical

thinking and persuasive communication. Participants present arguments,

defend perspectives, and respond to counterpoints in a structured and

intellectually stimulating environment. The event aims to develop clarity

of thought, confidence in speech, and the ability to analyse issues from

multiple viewpoints while promoting healthy dialogue and logical

reasoning.

Vogue Vortex – Fashion Fusion brings creativity, glamour, and

self-expression to the spotlight as students showcase innovative fashion

concepts through a dynamic runway performance. This event encourages

participants to experiment with themes, styling, and costume design while

blending aesthetic vision with confident presentation. It aims to celebrate

individuality, artistic flair, and fashion-forward thinking, offering a

vibrant platform for students to redefine style and creativity on stage.

Cinescatto – Reel Making offers students an exciting opportunity to dive

into digital storytelling through short-form video content. Participants

are encouraged to conceptualise, script, shoot, and edit engaging reels

that blend creativity, narrative clarity, and visual appeal. The event aims

to inspire budding creators to experiment with themes, explore cinematic

techniques, and showcase their filmmaking potential in an online format

that resonates with modern digital audiences.

Move N Grove – Group Dance (Western) showcases the vibrance and energy of

modern Western choreography, inviting teams to perform dynamic routines

across genres like hip-hop, contemporary, jazz, and fusion. This event

encourages creativity, precision, and strong stage presence as groups come

together to deliver impactful performances. It aims to spotlight teamwork,

innovation, and versatility while celebrating the global spirit of Western

dance.

Nritya Sangha – Group Dance (Eastern) celebrates the elegance and

cultural richness of Indian dance traditions, bringing together teams to

perform synchronised and expressive routines. This event encourages

participants to explore classical, semi-classical, or folk styles while

highlighting unity, rhythm, and collective storytelling. It aims to foster

teamwork, creativity, and artistic expression as groups create visually

captivating performances rooted in India’s diverse heritage.

Get ready to shine at the 6th edition of Prima Vera — our annual cultural

extravaganza packed with creativity, energy, and endless fun. This year’s

edition brings together a vibrant lineup of competitions, performances, and

showcases designed to highlight the incredible talents of our students.

Whether you’re stepping onto the stage, behind the lens, or into the

spotlight, Prima Vera’25 is your moment to express, explore, and excel.

Come be a part of the excitement, the artistry, and the unforgettable

memories waiting to be made!

Join us for an unforgettable celebration!

Body:
Webinar on 2+2 Transfer to University of Edinburgh

Dear Students,

This is to inform you all that on 17th Dec'25, we are organising a webinar

about the 2+2 international transfer to the University of Edinburgh, UK

at 6:00 PM. The webinar will address the application process and Timelines

for applying to the University of Edinburgh. Interested students can

register and join the session using the link given below.

https://ed-ac-uk.zoom.us/meeting/register/Byyv0_MmS32byYkS4_wpyA

Date: 17th Dec'25

Time:6:00 PM

Kindly note that the application deadline is 14th January and students

should apply through UCAS https://accounts.ucas.com/account/login.

Attached is the application guide which will help students through the

process.

Following the submission of the application, we may contact the student to

request additional documents such as their:

 - Transcript

 - English language qualification (such as IELTS or TOEFL or Class XII

 English)

 - Copy of their passport ID page (if they have this)

 - List of courses they are currently studying but have not yet completed

Students must submit their English language qualification by 30th April

2026 if they do not have this by the application deadline.

As a reminder, students should be on track for an 80% or above cumulative

GPA in order to be considered as well as good grades in

engineering-specific subjects. Our minimum English language requirements

are 6.5 overall and 5.5 in each component in IELTS (or equivalent).

In terms of tuition fees for entry in 2026/27 these are set to £34,800/year

and students will receive an automatic scholarship of £3,500/year. Costs

for the 3-week Transitional Course will be deducted from this, meaning

students will receive approximately £1,000 during their first year in

Edinburgh.

Edinburgh is the fourth-largest university in the United Kingdom by total

enrolment and the second largest university in Scotland, receiving over

66,000 undergraduate applications per year, making it the fifth-most

popular university in the UK by application volume. Notable alumni of the

University of Edinburgh include inventor Alexander Graham

Bell, naturalist Charles Darwin, philosopher David Hume, physicist James

Clerk Maxwell, and writers such as Oliver Goldsmith, Sir J. M. Barrie,

Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, Sir Walter Scott, and Robert Louis Stevenson.

The University of Edinburgh is a global top-tier university, consistently

ranked in the world's top 50, specifically placing 34th in the latest QS

World University Rankings (2026 edition)

Dear VITians,

Greetings!

The Office of Students' Welfare invites you to spring into action on Day-3

as we dive into an exciting week filled with cultural vibrance. After long

schedules and academic fatigue, this is the perfect moment to unwind,

recharge, and rediscover the joy of campus life.

We proudly present the 6th edition of Prima Vera - a week-long cultural

festival celebrating the creativity, passion, and spirit of VIT’s dynamic

student community. Get ready for a series of thrilling competitions, each

designed to bring out your best and help you showcase your unique talents.

Expect energetic performances, artistic showdowns, and engaging events, all

culminating in an unforgettable cultural experience.

And yes — there are exciting cash prizes waiting for the winners, along

with the pride of taking center stage in one of VIT’s most anticipated

festivals.

Gear up, participate, cheer, and make Prima Vera’25 a celebration to

remember!
