Body:
Dear NAYAN SHARMA,

We're pleased to open applications for the Finlatics Financial Analyst program, an online live project that helps students gain work experience in Financial Markets and Investment Banking (private equity & venture capital) at the Vellore Institute of Technology.

The project is running at leading campuses, including IIT Delhi, IIT Bombay, IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Bangalore, and BITS Pilani, among others.

STRUCTURE of the Live Project:

Financial Markets

1. Equity trading, research, and analysis based program.

2. Create, manage and maintain a real-time simulated portfolio on BSE 500 listed companies.

3. The simulated portfolio will be assessed by linking it to the real-time BSE 500 INDEX, akin to an asset management company.

4. Learn and apply Fundamental & Technical Analysis to companies.

Investment Banking

1. Assess investment proposals and identify companies with high growth potential and understand various stages of private equity investing.

2. Engage in setting up a Private Equity Fund, emphasizing investor onboarding, investing cycles & sectoral orientation.

3. Author case-based projects on successful exits in the private equity space, by analyzing mergers & acquisitions.

4. Learn how to apply Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Valuation & Excel-based modeling to companies.

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificate of Work Experience in:

a. Financial Markets as an Equity Markets Analyst

b. Private Equity and venture Capital as an Investment Banking Analyst

2. Letter of Recommendation on performance

3. Engage in an Artificial Intelligence-driven mock interview

To apply, students can fill out the form below, and we will get in touch :

https://www.finlatics.com/fa_applications?utm_src=vitv

No prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to participate in this project. Personalized guidance and mentoring, as well as live sessions, will be provided to train students.

Project Start: Flexible Start date option on selected student choice. 100% Online.

Project Break & Extension: Selected students will be eligible for a break or extension during the project if needed for any exams, assignments, or personal commitments.

Incentives: up to Rs. 6000 (to monthly top-performing students)

We are looking forward to a fruitful engagement.

Subject: CCE - Call for Young Innovators-AY2025-26
Body:
Dear Students,

The Centre for Clean Environment (CCE) at Vellore Institute of Technology

(VIT) invites motivated and passionate undergraduate and postgraduate

students to join our dynamic research teams and contribute to cutting-edge

projects addressing pressing environmental challenges.

As environmental issues continue to evolve, so does the need for

innovative, interdisciplinary, and sustainable solutions. CCE provides a

collaborative platform for students from diverse disciplines to work

alongside experienced researchers and faculty in creating a cleaner and

healthier planet.

Thrust Areas of Research

Students will have the opportunity to contribute to ongoing projects in the

following domains:

 - Air Pollution and Climate Change Studies

 - Environmental Forensic Analysis

 - Water and Wastewater Treatment & Management

 - Solid Waste Management and Waste-to-Wealth Concepts

 - Emerging Contaminants 

 - Green Chemistry, Material Synthesis & Sustainable Materials

 - Clean Energy

 - Environmental Remediation Techniques

 - Bioremediation of Organic Pollutants in Soil and Water

 - Heavy Metal Removal Technologies

 - Health Risk and Environmental Impact Assessment

 - Environmental System Design, Computations, and Modeling

 - Mathematical Modeling

 - AI/ML Applications in the Environment

 - Environmental Monitoring and Sensor Development

 - Other Emerging Areas of Environmental Concern

Who Can Apply?

 - Undergraduate and Postgraduate students from VIT across all

 departments and Schools.

What You Will Gain?

 - Hands-on research experience on real-world problems

 - Mentorship from leading faculty and researchers

 - Opportunities to contribute to publications, patents, and products

 - Exposure to interdisciplinary tools, including AI/ML, advanced lab

 techniques, and sustainability frameworks

How to Apply?

Interested students can submit a concept in any one of the above thrust

areas and mail it to director.cce@vit.ac.in on or before 03rd October

2025.

------------------------------

Join us in shaping a sustainable future—Be a part of the solution. Be a

researcher at CCE.

------------------------------

In an effort to create awareness on the National Education Policy (NEP)

2020, the Office of Students' Welfare is pleased to organize the NEP 2020

Awareness Quiz, an initiative driven by the NEP SAARTHIs.

The NEP 2020 marks a transformative step in shaping the future of

education in India. With its focus on multidisciplinary learning,

inclusivity, skill development, and holistic growth, it lays the

foundation for a more flexible and learner-centric education system.

This quiz offers an opportunity to become acquainted with the key ideas and

reforms of NEP 2020, while also allowing you to assess your existing

knowledge. Beyond answering questions, it is designed to help you gain new

insights into aspects of the policy that are important for every student’s

academic journey.

Take the Quiz here:

 https://forms.gle/SN6RKNCnzwB6wSJz9

Note:

Deadline: 25th September 2025, 09.00 pm

All the Participants will be receiving an e-certificate upon successful

completion of the Quiz.

Subject: Dengue Awareness – Precautions and Safety
Body:
Dear Students,

There has been a noticeable increase in dengue cases, and it is important

for us to remain alert and take preventive measures. Dengue spreads through

mosquito bites, and simple steps can go a long way in protecting ourselves

and those around us.

Please ensure that there is no stagnant water near your surroundings, as it

becomes a breeding ground for mosquitoes. Keep your environment clean, and

use mosquito repellents or nets whenever necessary. Wearing full-sleeved

clothing can also help reduce the risk.

Be aware of common symptoms such as sudden high fever, severe headache,

body pain, nausea, or skin rashes. If you notice these, seek medical

attention immediately—early treatment makes a difference.

Together, let us take responsibility to stay safe and prevent the spread of

dengue.

Subject: Invitation to Participate in MAR-a-THON: India’s Maritime Hackathon 2025
Body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to share that the Sagarmala Startup Innovation Initiative

(S212), under the aegis of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways

(MoPSW), in collaboration with the National Technology Centre for Ports,

Waterways & Coasts (NTCPWC), IIT Madras, IMU, IIT-KGP, and IIT-B, is

organizing MAR-a-THON : India’s Maritime Hackathon 2025

This initiative aims to accelerate innovation across the maritime sector by

harnessing entrepreneurial prowess of Indian startups to devise, develop,

and deploy cutting-edge solutions. Selected startups will also receive funding

support up to ₹1 Crore, based on the maturity of their solutions.

Key Details

 -

 Event: MAR-a-THON : INDIA’S MARITIME HACKATHON 2025

 -

 Application Window for Startups: 25 August 2025 – 29 September 2025

 -

 Hackathon Dates: 16 – 18 October 2025

 -

 Award Ceremony & Signing of Agreements: During Maritime India Week 2025

 (Exact date to be announced)

 -

 Official Website: https://ntcpwcit.in/hackathon/

Funding Support Categories

 -

 Proof of Concept: Up to Rs.10 Lakhs

 -

 Seed Funding Grant (Developing Minimum Viable Product): Up to Rs. 60

 Lakhs

 -

 Tech Pilot Grant (Scale-Up Commercialized Solution): Up to Rs. 1 Crore

Attachments:

 -

 Official Invitation Letter

 -

 Event Brochure (with detailed timeline & highlights)

We strongly encourage students with registered startups to actively

participate and leverage this excellent opportunity to innovate in India’s

maritime sector.

Welcome to the New Academic Year with the Arm School Program

Empowering educators. Inspiring learners. Shaping the future.

We’re excited to share what’s new and what’s next from the Arm School Program (ASP), your go-to for free, high-quality teaching and learning materials in computing, AI, and physical computing.

What’s New? Say Hello to AI.

Earlier this year we launched our Introduction to AI course, a friendly, accessible way for teachers and students to understand the fundamentals of AI. From everyday AI applications to machine creativity, the course demystifies AI and sparks curiosity. It’s ideal for upper-secondary students (especially post-16) and a strong springboard into further study or projects.

Explore it here on [EdX](https://www.edx.org/learn/computer-science/arm-education-introduction-to-ai) or [Coursera.](https://www.coursera.org/learn/intro-to-ai-arm)

Inspiring the Next Generation: The CAS micro:bit Challenge

This summer, we supported Computing At School in their [micro:bit competition](https://www.computingatschool.org.uk/forum-news-blogs/2025/july/cas-physical-computing-competition-review/), where students tackled real-world problems with creative tech solutions. Their impressive innovations were a reminder of the power of physical computing in education.

[The CAS micro:bit Challenge](https://www.computingatschool.org.uk/forum-news-blogs/2025/july/cas-physical-computing-competition-review/)

Looking Ahead: Sneak Peek at What’s Coming

We know teachers love planning ahead, so here’s a look at what’s in the pipeline:

Wildlife Tracker Project

Imagine tracking endangered animals in the wild using a Raspberry Pi Zero W and GPS! This project links real-world conservation with computing, ideal for upper-secondary learners working towards UN Sustainable Development Goal 15: Life on Land.

Micro:bits Meet Formula 1

In an exciting collaboration between Arm and Aramco Aston Martin, we’re creating a new resource using micro:bits and CreateAI. Students will explore how AI and sensors can support high-performance racing, from track telemetry to pit stop predictions, then train micro:bits to recognize gestures.

Join the Community: CAS & CSTA Groups

Want to swap ideas, share triumphs, and pick up new tricks for the classroom? Join the Physical Computing groups in both [CAS](https://community.computingatschool.org.uk/) (UK) and [CSTA](https://csteachers.org/) (US). These growing educator communities are full of creativity, and we’re proud to help fuel the conversation.

ASP Resources: Always Free, Always Expanding

If you haven’t visited our [resource hub](https://www.arm.com/resources/education/schools?#community), now’s the time! You’ll find a growing collection of free classroom materials that blend computing, science, and AI, grounded in evidence-based pedagogy, and powered by real-world tech.

Thanks for being part of the ASP community. Whether you’re just starting out or a seasoned STEM superhero, we’re here to support you every step of the way.

Here’s to another year of curious learners, creative classrooms, and computing with purpose.

Dear Students,

KICK-START YOUR START-UP

For those of you who are interested in building Technology Products or

aspiring to be entrepreneurs, here is an opportunity to avail Student

Startup Venture (SSV) Grant from VIT!

SSV support has been extended to students since 2017, over 160 projects

have been supported and 47 startups have emerged…

Startups like https://vicara.co/ ; https://alfaleus.in/ ;

https://www.punar.in/; kuppismart solutions pvt ltd/ have emerged with the

support of SSV.

activities. The duration of the project will be from October 2025 to July

2026. All students of UG, PG programs, and Research Scholars on the campus

are eligible to apply.

A faculty mentor is mandatory for every team of SSV (Maximum of 3

students + 1 faculty mentor). 

Only those who are engaged in technology product development (hardware)

can apply/ this is not for app development/ pure software products

/research activities.

This fund purely supports technology innovations leading to novel products,

prototypes, and venture creation.

1. Sustainability (including energy/ renewable energy

technologies)

2. Cleantech/ GreenTech Revolution

3. HealthTech Horizons

4. Smart Cities and Digital Realities

5. AgriTech – including post-harvest technologies

6. Clean Energy Breakthroughs

7. Smart devices based on AI/ML (including consumer &

enterprise AI solutions), IoT and IIoT

8. BioTech and Life Sciences

9. Robotics, Drones and Automation

10. Sports tech

or before the 24th of September 2025.

Dear Students,

Kind Attn: All Final Year B.Tech Students

We are organising two events exclusive for final year students of VIT.

These events invite final-year B.Tech students to showcase their skills in

artificial intelligence, robotics, and software development, and solve

real-world problems with innovative solutions

1. NeuroHack, a 24-hour AI & Robotics Hackathon during graVITas ’25,

jointly organised by Neuralzome Cybernetics in collaboration with

RoboVITics. .

Neuralzome Cybernetics is at the forefront of AI-powered robotics and

automation, developing smart solutions that transform industries and

improve everyday life. With a focus on innovation, real-world

problem-solving, and cutting-edge technology, Neuralzome empowers the next

generation of engineers to build smarter systems for a better future.

Duration: 26th September 9:00 AM – 27th September 1:00 PM

Bangalore office with a stipend of ₹20,000–₹25,000/month

https://gravitas.vit.ac.in/events/0afe3579-3274-412e-b318-c4542227c080

https://neuralzome.com

Shortlisted teams of two will compete to create impactful solutions in the

domains of artificial intelligence and software development.

Gamasome is a pioneer in AI and software innovation, developing advanced

solutions that tackle real-world challenges. With a strong emphasis on

research and collaboration, the company actively engages with young talent

to push the boundaries of technology and drive meaningful impact.

Event Details:

Date: 26th September, 9 AM – 27th September, 1 PM

Venue: PRP 117

Team Size: 2 members per team

Eligibility: Final-year B.Tech students only

Entry Fee: ₹150 per person (exclusive of GST)

Internship & Prize Details:

1st Prize: ₹10,000 cash prize and a 6-month paid internship at Gamasome's

Bangalore office with a stipend of ₹15,000–₹20,000/month

https://www.gamasome.com/

the other (i.e., you can only participate in either GamaLab or NeuroHack).

As you are aware, our nation has completed 75 years as а Republic and has

emerged as one of the world's largest and most vibrant democracies. Our

Nation's journey reflects Unity in diversity, democratic strength,

progressive transformation, resilience, innovation and inclusive growth. It

that lie ahead in further strengthening our nation, deepening democratic

values, ensuring inclusive development and position India as Vikshit Bharat

in 2047.

Proposals are invited to organize a one-day Seminar/Workshop on the

theme “Indian

Republic @ 75 – Milestones and Challenges Ahead.”

Interested CCs are requested to submit their proposals through the Google

Form linked below.

https://forms.gle/Z8BgGZQdN1jWqzfT9

Subject: SAP opportunity at Naresuan University, Thailand
Body:
Kind Attention: Pre-Final and Final Year Students:

 Naresuan University, Thailand has introduced a new inbound exchange

student program, the Naresuan University Long-term Inbound Exchange

Program for the 2025-2026 academic year. It provides a valuable

opportunity for international students to engage in academic exchange

activities and spend a semester at the Naresuan University.

About the NU Long-term Inbound Exchange Program 2025-2026

The program offers two distinct plans for students to choose from:

Plan A: Global Linkage Inbound Program (GLIP) or Plan B.

Both programmes offer a variety of projects such as academic coursework

aligned with their field of study to gain academic credits, professional

internships, or research assistants of research projects. They offer

extensive support apart from each programme features, which includes

airport pick-up at Phitsanulok airport, a comprehensive orientation, a Thai

Buddy Program to help them settle in, and dedicated assistance with visa

and other necessary documents.

Programme Features

Plan A: GLIP

The programme offers participants the flexibility to select their preferred

exchange period. The exchange duration is one semester (approximately 3-4

months), following the participant's academic calendar. The university has

also established a scholarship scheme to provide financial support to

qualified program participants.

Important Note: The chosen period must fall within the project's designated

timeframe. Some projects may have specific duration requirements that are

longer than four months.

Plan B

A key feature of Plan B is that participants in this program will have all

tuition fees waived, and will earn academic credits for their involvement.

The number of credits awarded is determined by the specific project a

student chooses.

Program Duration: One semester based on the Naresuan University academic

calendar. Participants may choose to join in either November 2025 - March

2026 (2nd Semester of 2025) or June - October 2026 (the 1st Semester of

2026).

Program Benefits

To ensure a successful and rewarding experience, comprehensive support and

benefits are provided throughout your stay at Naresuan University.

 - Scholarships: Various scholarships are provided for each plan,

 including

 - Plan A: GLIP: tuition fee waivers, a shared room in an on-campus

 dormitory with another international student (excluding electricity

 charges), and a stipend of 240 THB per day for living expenses.

 - Plan B: tuition fee waivers

Important remark: Please be advised that applicants are permitted to

apply for only one project. The University will select the most

qualified candidates to attend the programmes at Naresuan University. The

final selection result will be made by the Naresuan University committee.

Important Dates

Registration: 16 September - 15 October 2025

Deadline of registration: 15 October 2025

Announcement of awardee: 31 October 2025

Visa support: 1 month before arrival date

Onsite Program: Depending on each preferred period which starts on November

2025 onwards

Applicants may refer to the attached files and submit the required

application materials via the GLIP website at

https://www.diald.nu.ac.th/glip/index.php by October 15, 2025.

【Naresuan University Fact Sheet】

https://www.diald.nu.ac.th/download/Brochure_20250722.pdf

【Naresuan University Academic Calendar】

https://www.reg2.nu.ac.th/registrar/calendar.asp?schedulegroupid=1000&acadyear=2568&semester=2

SAP registration on VTOP is a must.

Please contact Dr Sainu Franco, International Relations Officer, MB 105,

for more details.

Dear Students,

 KICK-START YOUR

START-UP “Student Start-up Venture 2025-26 - 1st call”

For those of you who are interested in building Technology Products or

aspiring to be entrepreneurs, here is an opportunity to avail Student

Startup Venture (SSV) Grant from VIT!

SSV support has been extended to students since 2017, over 160 projects

have been supported and 47 startups have emerged…

Startups like https://vicara.co/ ; https://alfaleus.in/ ;

https://www.punar.in/; kuppismart solutions pvt ltd/ have emerged with the

support of SSV.

activities. The duration of the project will be from October 2024 to July

2025. All students of UG, PG programs, and Research Scholars on the campus

are eligible to apply. 

A faculty mentor is mandatory for every team of SSV (a Maximum of 3

students + 1 faculty mentor). 

Only those who are engaged in technology product development (hardware)

can apply/ this is not for app development/ pure software products

/research activities.

This fund purely supports technology innovations leading to novel products,

prototypes, and venture creation.

1. Sustainability (including energy/ renewable energy

technologies)

3. HealthTech Horizons

Watch Video https://app.response.oracle-mail.com/e/er?elq_mid=268574&sh=3422352331242325232323303127283625253131242726233027223123293521&cmid=CORP250829P00035C00001&s=1973398186&lid=652849&elqTrackId=fea74517a1be404888f9d498bff3df07&elq=8dbb9d0650824edd9d908c2bdef4fe89&elqaid=268574&elqat=1&elqak=8AF58412E29547128107CB05C26566767E8E0CA2137928FAE7E2757A03A5CA9C2023 

MFA is a quick extra step to keep your account—and data—safer. 

Why MFA?

Stops unauthorized logins—even if your password is known.

Easy setup in under 5 minutes. 

How will this affect you? 

MFA adds an extra layer of security by requiring a second verification step when signing into Oracle owned portals (like Cloud Customer Connect, My Oracle Support, Oracle Customer Center, etc.)

This will not affect products purchased from Oracle.

MFA helps prevent unauthorized access even if your account password is compromised.

You will use MFA each time you log in to any Oracle owned applications. 

How to prepare: 

Once enabled, you will be prompted to enroll in MFA upon your first login at any Oracle portal. Watch this video https://app.response.oracle-mail.com/e/er?elq_mid=268574&sh=3422352331242325232323303127283625253131242726233027223123293521&cmid=CORP250829P00035C00001&s=1973398186&lid=652849&elqTrackId=b8796453182b4ec2af89ceff11876ed0&elq=8dbb9d0650824edd9d908c2bdef4fe89&elqaid=268574&elqat=1&elqak=8AF59641138A4EC2C6347DDCE8262BA1AE450CA2137928FAE7E2757A03A5CA9C2023 to see the setup process.

Follow the on-screen guide to choose your preferred MFA method (Oracle Mobile Authenticator, Mobile SMS or email ID-based One-Time Password), enter details, and verify your code.

Oracle Mobile Authenticator (OMA) is available on Windows https://app.response.oracle-mail.com/e/er?elq_mid=268574&sh=3422352331242325232323303127283625253131242726233027223123293521&cmid=CORP250829P00035C00001&s=1973398186&lid=652606&elqTrackId=bd8b4368ad33428fba9c340f19db9292&elq=8dbb9d0650824edd9d908c2bdef4fe89&elqaid=268574&elqat=1&elqak=8AF53FB753DB2912267978A7C3C2046CBC3D0CA2137928FAE7E2757A03A5CA9C2023, Android https://app.response.oracle-mail.com/e/er?elq_mid=268574&sh=3422352331242325232323303127283625253131242726233027223123293521&cmid=CORP250829P00035C00001&s=1973398186&lid=652605&elqTrackId=60dcad404b62440cb9d85d4e2cd142fd&elq=8dbb9d0650824edd9d908c2bdef4fe89&elqaid=268574&elqat=1&elqak=8AF5BBBDBD2CE9576EB18F6830BC84BE479D0CA2137928FAE7E2757A03A5CA9C2023, and Apple https://app.response.oracle-mail.com/e/er?elq_mid=268574&sh=3422352331242325232323303127283625253131242726233027223123293521&cmid=CORP250829P00035C00001&s=1973398186&lid=652604&elqTrackId=c8625664301d4cc8bdbda672424aebb0&elq=8dbb9d0650824edd9d908c2bdef4fe89&elqaid=268574&elqat=1&elqak=8AF5B0412AFDE60EC80448AE96E6FF140BD70CA2137928FAE7E2757A03A5CA9C2023

Subject: Generating and Uploading APAAR ID on VTOP Student Login
Body:
Dear Student,

Kindly be advised that having an "Automated Permanent Academic Account

Registry (APAAR) ID" for each student is one of the initiatives by the

Government of India.

In this direction, you may discuss with your parents and generate the APAAR

ID with their consent.

The following steps are to be followed to generate the APAAR ID

APAAR ID Registration Online

 1. Visit the Academic Bank of Credits (ABC Bank) website. (

 https://www.abc.gov.in/)

 2. Click on 'My Account' and select the 'Student' option.

 3. Click 'Sign up' and enter the mobile, address and Aadhaar card

 details to create a DigiLocker account.

 4. Log in to the DigiLocker account using the credentials

Once the APAAR ID is generated, the same is to be posted on the VTOP Student

Login (Have to upload the APAAR ID Card in PDF)

Proctors/HoDs/Guides may advise the Proctees/PG students/Research Scholars

respectively to complete the task before 20th September 2025.

Foreign Students / NRI Students who are not having AADHAR Card issued by

the Government of India may ignore this mail

Those who have already uploaded the APAAR ID may ignore this mail

Refer to the screenshot given below to upload the APAAR ID details on VTOP

Note: "VIEW" option is also provided in the same menu. Kindly view the

document that you have uploaded and press the submit button. (Avoid

Subject: Congratulations to Team DuoDrive – Finalists at Apollo Tyres Revolve’25 Global Design Challenge
Body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share the achievement of Team DuoDrive from VIT

Vellore, who emerged among the Top 5 finalists and won the Fourth Position

at the prestigious Apollo Tyres Revolve’25 Global Design Challenge, held

on 10th July 2025 at the Apollo Tyres Global R&D Centre, Chennai.

Team Members:

 - Emmadi Sai Sri Vardhan Reddy (22BME0403)

 - Ayushi Ashok Raut (22BME0400)

Competing against more than 200 teams nationwide, the students presented

their innovative concept – the OASIS Tyre, a futuristic smart tyre for the

EV ecosystem of 2040, featuring a regenerative self-healing gel core,

terrain-adaptive tread, embedded sensor intelligence, and an

oxygen-generating sidewall system.

The team secured 4th place at the Grand Finale, receiving a finalist prize

of Rs. 10,000.

We extend our heartfelt congratulations to the team for their creativity,

futuristic thinking, and outstanding representation of VIT on this national

platform.

Subject: Invitation to Participate: JETRO Talent for Japan Student Contest 2025
Body:
Dear Students,

Kind Attention: UG and PG Students.

 JETRO Talent for Japan Student Contest 2025—a national-level

competition designed to highlight the talent, creativity, and global

readiness of Indian university students. Organized under JETRO’s Open for

Professionals initiative, the contest aims to spark student interest in

career opportunities in Japan, promote cross-cultural thinking, and enable

meaningful engagement with Japanese industry leaders.

It will give the students the opportunity to tackle real-world challenges

posed by Japanese companies across sectors like EdTech, AgriTech, FoodTech,

AI, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain.

There are no commercials or costs involved for students at any stage of the

contest.

About the Contest:

This contest aims to:

 -

 Inspire Indian students to explore future career opportunities in Japan.

 -

 Create a platform for real-life engagement between students and Japanese

 companies.

 -

 Celebrate cross-cultural thinking, innovation, and problem-solving.

Key Details About the Contest:

 -

 6 curated themes provided by Japanese companies will be shared with

 participating universities.

 -

 Students will work on these themes and submit creative, research-driven

 proposals.

 -

 The top 10-12 winners will be selected after a rigorous multi-level

 screening process.

 -

 These winners will travel to Japan for a 7-day immersive experience,

 including

 -

 Meetings the Japanese companies involved in the contest

 -

 Having networking and discussion opportunities with them

 -

 Cultural immersion in Japan

Timelines:

 -

 Student registrations: September 1 - September 10

 -

 Mandatory orientation session: September 11

Other Details:

 -

 Event details and registration link:

 https://acumen.education/talent-for-japan/

Why This Is Unique:

 -

 Only 15 universities across India will be part of this exclusive contest.

 -

 Carefully curated themes directly shared by Japanese companies.

 -

 First-hand interaction with industry leaders in Japan.

 -

 A 7-day all-expense paid trip to Japan for the 10-12 winners of the

 contest. (Terms and Conditions Apply)

Subject: Interactive session on the theme “Mind Your Heart” by Dr. V. Chockalingam, M.D, D.M (Cardiology)
Body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

The Office of Students’ Welfare cordially invite you to an interactive

session organised by VIT Health Club on the theme “Mind Your Heart” by

Dr. V. Chockalingam, M.D, D.M (Cardiology), F.A.C.C (USA), D.Sc, Professor

Emeritus, Cardiology, TN Dr. MGR Medical University, Chennai.

Dr. Chockalingam is a globally renowned cardiologist with decades of

experience in preventive cardiology, patient care, and medical education.

He has delivered numerous lectures worldwide and is a strong advocate of

lifestyle-based heart health practices. His insights on stress management,

healthy living, and preventive heart care have benefited countless

students, professionals, and communities.

Pollution Control Board (CPCB) is organizing a National Hackathon on

Pollution Reduction Campaign.

 -

 Showcase innovative efforts to develop eco-alternatives to banned Single

 Use Plastic (SUP) items

 -

 Identify the best scalable, eco-friendly, and economically viable

 solutions for national adoption

Eligibility:

 -

 Start-ups registered under various Government schemes

 -

 Science, research & educational institutions

 -

 Industrial entities

Problem Statements:

 1.

 Develop an eco-friendly, economically viable, and scalable alternative

 to banned thin plastic carry bags (less than 120 μm thickness)

 2.

 Develop an eco-friendly, technically, and economically feasible

 alternative to thin plastic packaging

Subject: The first Chair Professor of VIT
Body:
Dear VITians

Greetings

Professor Arun Balakrishnan, a distinguished scientist and Industry expert

of India joined VIT today as the GV Chair Professor (the first Chair

Professor of VIT). Chair Professors are there in most of the top

institutions of India and abroad. It is one of the key requirements of a

world class university.

Professor Arun Balakrishnan did his PhD from Cancer Research Institute

(University of Madras) and Post Doctorate from University of California,

Berkeley. He served the “Centre for Biotechnology, Anna University” as

Director and several top industries as Sr Vice President. He is well known

in the country for his outstanding contribution to interdisciplinary,

multidisciplinary and trans-disciplinary research.

Let us welcome Professor Arun Balakrishnan. 

We thank our VIT Alumni Association (VITAA) for sponsoring the GV Chair

Professor.

Proctor–Proctee dashboard: “ Chat with Your Proctee.” This enables

faculty members to engage in secure, one-to-one communication with their

proctees via the SelfCare app (for faculty) and the VITian app (for

proctor system and enhancing faculty–student connectivity.

their dedicated efforts in making this possible.

Dear Students / Research Scholars,

Single Use Plastic (SUP). In line with the clarion call given by Hon’ble

PM, Shri Narendra Modi, to phase out SUP items, the Ministry of

Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India notified the

Plastic Waste Management Amendment Rules, 2021, prohibiting the identified

SUP items, which have low utility combined with high environmental impact &

littering potential. In line with the theme for World Environment Day

(WED), 2025 - Ending Plastic Pollution Globally, a hackathon has been

launched by the

Pollution Control Board with the following objectives:

 To provide a platform to showcase the efforts which

are being taken across the country to develop eco-alternatives to SUP items.

 To select the best available solutions, which can be

adopted as alternatives to the SUP items

digital artists of the future. Students will learn how to generate custom

art assets using AI and integrate them into interactive AR filters using

Snap’s Lens Studio. The session culminates in a creative mini-hackathon

 1. Understand how Generative AI can be used for creative visual asset

 production

 2. Learn the basics of Snap Lens Studio and real-time AR integration

 3. Design and develop an immersive AR experience using AI-enhanced assets

 4. Apply interaction logic using face, hand, and body tracking

 5. Build and showcase a working AR art filter for Snapchat

Dear all,

Greetings.

Glad to announce that the Centre for Nanotechnology Research (CNR), Vellore

Institute of Technology (VIT), Vellore, has been recognised as one of

India’s Top 20 Premier Nanotechnology Research Centres and Labs by

NanoHelp.eu—an international platform dedicated to advancing global

nanotechnology innovation.

To explore the complete list of India’s Top 20 Nanotechnology Research

Centres and Labs, visit:

https://nanohelp.eu/news/ https://nanohelp.eu/news/ 

https://nanohelp.eu/indias-top-20-nanotechnology-research-centres-labs/

https://nanohelp.eu/indias-top-20-nanotechnology-research-centres-labs/

About NanoHelp.eu:

NanoHelp.eu is an international, community-focused nanotechnology portal,

renowned for its curated resources, news, expert interviews, global event

directories, and comprehensive databases for jobs and fellowships. Led by

scientists and researchers from esteemed institutes, including the Polish

Academy of Sciences, NanoHelp.eu is valued for its reliability and

expertise - making it one of the most trusted platforms for information and

networking in the field.

The Centre for Nanotechnology Research at VIT stands at the forefront of

cutting-edge research in nanoscience, particularly excelling in printed and

Flexible Electronic Devices for Energy, Sensors, and Healthcare. Our

vibrant, interdisciplinary environment brings together experts across

scientific domains, empowering breakthroughs that address critical national

and global priorities. CNR’s achievements and innovative research culture

foster excellence, nurture talent, and drive impactful collaborations with

leading institutions worldwide.

This recognition places CNR-VIT among India’s most distinguished research

institutes - a testament to our faculty, researchers, students, and global

partners who relentlessly pursue advances in nanomaterials, flexible

electronics, and transformative health technologies.

We sincerely thank our VIT management for supporting us to establish the

state-of-the-art infrastructure in par with the International standards and

reaffirm our commitment to driving innovation and excellence in

nanotechnology research.

Body:
Dear Students/ Scholars,

Greetings of the day

You are cordially invited to a public lecture organized by the Quantum

Science and Technology Club.

Our distinguished guest speaker is Mr. Venkata Swamy Tadikonda, Emerging

Tech Policy Researcher, Barnet, London, UK.

About the Speaker:- Mr. Venkata Swamy is a seasoned policy researcher and

innovation strategist with over 24 years of global experience at the

intersection of emerging technologies, governance, and societal

transformation. With a solid academic foundation in public policy economics

from the University of Oxford and a postgraduate degree in management from

SPJIMR, Venkat brings a rare combination of policy acumen, strategic

foresight, and executional excellence. His expertise spans artificial

intelligence, quantum technologies, cybersecurity, and digital

infrastructure. Venkat has worked extensively with Fortune 500 companies

and FTSE 100 firms during his leadership roles at Deloitte, TCS, and LTI

Mindtree. He has led digital transformation and innovation programs across

sectors such as financial services, retail, healthcare, e-commerce, and

public services, contributing to both operational agility and long-term

value creation. Venkat plays an active role in shaping policy for

responsible technology adoption. He has worked on regulatory alignment and

ethical frameworks related to the EU AI Act, data privacy and governance

principles, and national quantum strategies. His current focus is on

building inclusive, secure, and agile policy frameworks that help

governments and industries responsibly harness the power of frontier

technologies. In recognition of his contribution to sustainable innovation,

he was awarded by the Tata Group Innovation Forum for the “Smart Farms”

project—a low-cost, RF-based water management solution for agriculture

under Tata Innovista. He is also deeply engaged in research around energy

transition, sustainability economics, and the convergence of DeepTech and

policy to enable resilient, smart infrastructure. As part of his commitment

to democratizing advanced science, Venkat recently led the translation of

Quantum Nation, a seminal work on quantum technologies, into Telugu. This

initiative aims to make complex quantum concepts accessible to a broader

regional audience and inspire the next generation of scientists,

policymakers, and innovators. Venkat is a frequent guest speaker and

academic collaborator, contributing to thought leadership on AI ethics,

cybersecurity, and quantum innovation. He actively advises universities,

think tanks, and industry forums on ecosystem development, tech governance,

and digital inclusion. With a strong belief in aligning science, society,

and strategy, Venkat continues to work toward shaping a future where

innovation is both inclusive and impactful.

Title:- Quantum Nation: Demystifying Quantum Concepts, Careers &

Opportunities for Students & Startups

Abstract:- This session introduces students and startups to the world of

quantum technologies—from core concepts like superposition, entanglement,

and quantum tunnelling to practical applications in computing,

communication, sensing, and materials.We’ll also spotlight quantum

algorithm development and quantum hackathons, including upcoming events in

India such as those from Amaravati Quantum Valley, as well as global

competitions.Drawing on insights from the Quantum Nation book (English and

Telugu editions) and blending scientific knowledge with relatable analogies

from the Bhagavad Gita, this talk aims to inspire the next generation to

engage early with quantum technologies—not just as learners, but as

creators, innovators, and leaders.

Bonus: All participants will receive the Quantum Nation: Student Companion

Resource Pack—a curated collection of links to learning resources, career

pathways, competitions, and opportunities in quantum technologies.

Dear Sir/Madam,

Greetings from the Centre for Nanotechnology Research (CNR), VIT, Vellore.

We are delighted to inform you that we are organizing the 3rd International

Conference on Nanoscience and Nanotechnology (ICNAN’25) at VIT, Vellore,

from December 16th to 19th, 2025.(https://icnan.vit.ac.in/

https://icnan.vit.ac.in/)

Nobel Laureate Dr. Moungi G. Bawendi, Massachusetts Institute of

Technology (MIT), USA (Nobel Laureate in Chemistry, 2023 - Discovery of

Quantum Dots), will inaugurate the event with a special lecture.

Well-renowned Scientists and Professors from top QS-ranked universities,

Editors of Top Journals, and Industrial experts have agreed to be our

Plenary Speakers. We have more than 60 speakers across the globe who will

share their expertise at the event.

ICNAN-2025 aims to bring together Indian and International communities

(students, scientists, engineers, and stakeholders from academia,

government laboratories, industry, and other organizations) working in

Nanoscale science and technology to discuss new and exciting advances in

the field. The conference covers a broad theme in this area to accommodate

a wide range of interests and to facilitate interdisciplinary

collaboration/interaction in both academia and industry. The conference

will also provide an ideal environment for developing new collaborations

and opportunities to meet experts in various areas of this field.

Subject: Circular on Make-up Examination
Body:
Dear Student,

VIT strives to excel in academics, research and to offer students good

placement opportunities without any history of arrears. In order to

facilitate the above, the Make-up Examination system is being introduced

from the Fall 2025-26 Semester onwards. After the declaration of semester

results, any student who has received an ‘F’ or ‘N1’ grade in a

course—whether it is a Theory-only course or a Theory course with an

embedded laboratory component - is eligible to apply for the Make-up

Examination. The Make-up Examination will be conducted by the Office of the

Controller of Examinations (CoE) during the early part of the subsequent

semester itself. Students shall register for the Make-up Examination for

the courses in which they have been awarded an ‘F’ or ‘N1’ grade in the

semester results. The maximum grade that will be awarded in the Make-up

Examination is an ‘E’, regardless of the absolute marks obtained, provided

the minimum passing condition is satisfied as per the academic regulations.

Passing a course through a make-up examination will be considered as a

“first-time appearance” in the academic history of the student, and it will

not be reflected as an arrear examination. If a student fails in the

Make-up Examination, he/she is required to re-register for the course in a

subsequent semester. Make-up Examination does not apply to any

re-registered course.

Since the make-up examination system is being introduced, WEI semester will

be discontinued (as a policy) from the forthcoming Winter 2025-26 onwards.

However, to help the senior students who already have a history of backlog

courses, such students will be permitted to reregister as a final resort

for the courses during the Winter 2025-26 WEI Semester and clear the

backlog courses.

Additionally, for the UG students, the Summer Semesters are to be utilised

for registering courses for earning Double Major, Honours, Minor and

Students Undergraduate Research Experience (SURE 1,2,3 & 4).

with regards

Oracle University Learning Community http://community.oracle.com/ou/

Julie Stirling-Oracle Started a new discussion. Beyond the Barrel: How Oil & Gas Giants Conquer Their Supply Chain with Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM

Have you ever wondered how the titans of the energy world manage their colossal supply chains? What challenges do they face every day—whether it’s procuring a tiny critical valve for a deep-sea rig or disposing of a multi-million-dollar asset? And is crude oil really the only thing they sell?

Let’s dive into the high-stakes world of the oil and gas supply chain and see how Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM acts as the digital engine that keeps it all running.

The Scale of the Challenge: A Global Jigsaw Puzzle

The oil and gas industry is a multi-trillion-dollar global market, and its supply chain is nothing short of critical—one small delay can ripple into millions in costs. Imagine a company with multiple onshore and offshore rig sites, each a complex operation demanding a vast array of items, including:

 MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) items: filters, lubricants, safety gear, thousands of spare parts

 Specialized capital equipment: blowout preventers, top drives, seismic imaging tools

 Consumables: drilling fluids, specialized chemicals, industrial gases

Delivering the right part, to the right rig, at precisely the right time is a monumental task—and it’s exactly where Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM begins to transform the business.

Solving Procurement: From Request to Payment at Lightning Speed

Procurement in oil and gas means sourcing thousands of items from potentially thousands of suppliers. Oracle Fusion Procurement’s Procure-to-Pay (P2P) lifecycle streamlines this end-to-end process:

 Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Management Suppliers are vetted through Supplier Qualification Management for compliance, safety, and performance.

 Oracle Sourcing enables competitive bidding and complex negotiations to secure optimal terms.

 Smart Contracts Blanket Purchase Agreements (BPAs) and Contract Purchase Agreements (CPAs) pre-negotiate pricing and terms for frequently needed items.

 Rig managers submit a requisition via Self-Service Procurement; the system automatically generates a purchase order against the pre-approved agreement.

 Seamless Financial Settlement Once the goods arrive, Accounts Payable performs an automated three-way match (PO, receipt, invoice).

 This reduces manual effort and payment cycle times, ensuring suppliers are paid promptly and strengthening partnerships.

Inspired to turbocharge your Procure-to-Pay cycle? Explore the Oracle Procurement Cloud: Procurement Implementation - Oracle MyLearn and see Procurement and Financials in action.

Mastering a Global Inventory: Moving Assets with Precision

What about assets you already own? A specialized pump idle at one location might be needed on a rig halfway across the globe. Misplacing it or losing track is simply not an option. Oracle Inventory Management Cloud offers full control and visibility:

 Centralized Visibility The main logistics hub is configured as the primary Inventory Organization; each rig, refinery, or depot becomes a Subinventory.

 Planners gain a real-time view of every item across the enterprise.

 Fluid Inventory Transactions Subinventory Transfer: Move an item within the same facility.

 Interorganization Transfer: Send assets from the main hub to a remote rig, updating financial records and audit trails automatically.

 Movement Requests: Field personnel raise requests via mobile, triggering an approval workflow for traceability.

Ready to gain end-to-end visibility of your global inventory? Check out the Oracle SCM Cloud: Advanced Supply Chain and Fulfillment Techniques - Oracle MyLearn.

Controlling the Uncontrollable: A Project-Driven Supply Chain

Rig projects aren’t just routine—they’re often major capital initiatives. Tracking millions of dollars per project requires integration with Oracle Project Management Cloud:

 Costing at the Source Engineers charge high-value components directly to specific project and task numbers.

 Real-Time Budget vs. Actuals PO approvals register as “commitments” against the project budget; receipts and invoices post as “actuals.”

 Meaningful Reporting Project managers access real-time reports on materials, labor, and equipment costs, enabling proactive budget control.

Looking to master project-driven supply chains? Dive into the Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management: Project Financial Management Implementation - Oracle MyLearn.

Beyond the Barrel: Managing and Selling High-Value Assets

Oil isn’t their only product—these companies manage a vast portfolio of depreciating assets. When it’s time to retire or sell an older rig, vessel, or machinery, Oracle Maintenance Cloud’s Asset Management steps in:

 Track an asset’s full financial and operational lifecycle.

 Manage complex maintenance schedules to maximize uptime.

 Accurately calculate final book value and execute the sale like any other product transaction.

Next time you think about the energy that powers our world, remember the powerful digital nervous system behind it: Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM. Oil and gas giants aren’t just drilling for oil—they’re harnessing data, efficiency, and unparalleled control to master one of the world’s most complex and vital supply chains.

Body:
Office of the Controller of Examinations

 Ref.No. : VIT/CoE/2025/25011

 Date : 08-Aug-2025

 Fall 2025-26 Regular Arrear and Winter 24-25 Re-FAT Approved Courses

Registration

To: All Students (Vellore Campus)

Sub: Registration for 

(i) Fall 2025-26 Regular Arrear Examinations for Timed

out Students for the courses in which they have appeared and failed to

clear ['F' & 'N1' grades] & absent in FAT ['N3' grade] 

(ii) Approved Re-FATs –Winter 2024-25 

 Debarred students in FAT (N2 and N4) are NOT Eligible.

Registrations are open for the Re-FAT and Regular Arrear Examinations to be

scheduled from 3rd October 2025 onwards. (Tentatively)

For Re-FAT approved students, only the components to which approval has

been given should be registered and should adhere to the schedule given for

Re-FAT / Regular Arrear. Please note that there will not be any second

chance whatsoever be the reason for not appearing in Re-FAT. There is no

Fee for Re-FAT Process.

For Regular Arrear, Students should register for ALL the Components of a

selected course. Component wise registration is NOT permitted. For

example, if a course has both theory and laboratory components, the student

should register for both theory and laboratory components to clear the

backlog, even though the student would have cleared either the theory or

laboratory component of that particular course earlier. If a course has a

‘J’ component, the student should appear for the final review again. It

will be considered equivalent to FAT for the project component of the

course.

If a student fails to clear in the arrear examination, the student can once

again register for the subsequent arrear examination or for re-registration

in subsequent semester again as a complete course (all components).

No individual component of a course is permitted once someone registers

for an arrear for that course.

Regular Arrear Registration Dates

Registration Link & Online Fee Payment [Open/Close] [available in Student

login]

 08-August-2025 to 25-August-2025

· Under No circumstances late registration/ payment

will be entertained.

· Students should register in V-Top and make necessary

payments (Rs.1000

per course only for Arrear Courses. No need to make any payment for Re-FAT)

.

· Kindly contact SDC for any V-Top login related issues.

Controller of Examinations

Prof.S.Sivabalan Ph.D

Dear Nayan Sharma,

 Greetings from the SWAYAM-NPTEL team! You are receiving this email as you

 have enrolled in one or more NPTEL courses in the current semester.

 

 We’re excited to share that we will soon be rolling out a pilot program to

 introduce new GenAI-based features across select SWAYAM-NPTEL courses. This

 initiative is part of our efforts to enhance the learning experience using

 innovative tools and is completely 
FREE
 for all participating learners.

 
What’s the pilot about?

 The Pilot will provide early access to GenAI-powered features designed to

 support learning in different ways. These may include things like

 course-specific AI chatbots, AI-generated notes and practice questions,

 multi-lingual translation of videos, intelligent video segmentation,

 video summarization, AI mock interviews and assessments etc.

 

 There are three different AI feature sets available in the pilot program.

 Learners selected for the Pilot will be randomly assigned to one of these

 feature sets. Do note that each feature set contains a different combination

 of features, but all the feature sets aim to improve the learning experience

 in meaningful ways.

 

 Click here to see a short overview of feature set 1

 

 Click here to see a short overview of feature set 2

 
Want to participate?

 If you're interested in being considered for the pilot, please fill out the

 short form below:

 

 Click here to access the Google Form

 

 As this is a pilot, there are a limited number of slots available in each

 course. Do note that participation is completely optional, and, as slots

 for the Pilot are limited, expressing interest does not guarantee a slot.

 

 We’ll share more information with selected participants closer to the rollout.

 The pilot is expected to begin in the near future.

 
Thank you for your interest.

 SWAYAM-NPTEL Team

Body:
Dear Students,

Greetings!!

We are pleased to invite you to participate in a series of impactful

workshops being organized under the prestigious Industry Academia Conclave

2025, themed: Electronics Renaissance: Accelerating Indian Leadership for

Global Sustainability.

As part of this initiative, we are hosting the following cutting-edge

workshops that bridge academia, industry, and innovation:

1. Python as a Tool for AI

What will be covered:

 -

 Introduction to Python in the context of machine learning and

 artificial intelligence

 -

 Popular libraries and frameworks: NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn,

 TensorFlow, and PyTorch

 -

 Real-world applications and hands-on coding sessions

2. AI on the Edge: Exploring Hardware Accelerators for ML and DL

What will be covered:

 -

 Overview of Edge AI and its growing significance in real-time

 applications

 -

 Introduction to hardware accelerators: GPUs, TPUs, NPUs, and FPGAs

 -

 Designing and deploying ML/DL models on edge devices

 -

 Case studies from industry showcasing Edge AI in action

Subject: Unveiling the "19th Global Congress on Manufacturing and Management (GCMM 2025)
Body:
Dear Faculty Members, Research Scholars and Students,

The Global Congress on Manufacturing and Management (GCMM) is a

non-profit organization governed by a board comprising academic and

industry members from various countries. It serves as a global platform for

leading researchers and industry partners to exchange knowledge and

insights on the evolving landscape of manufacturing and management. GCMM

hosts international conferences every two years, with recent editions held

in Thailand (2024), Malaysia (2023), New Zealand (2022), the UK (2021),

Australia (2018), China (2016), India (2014), New Zealand (2012), and

Thailand (2010). These events have consistently attracted participants from

over 25 countries.

We are pleased to announce that the 19th Global Congress on Manufacturing

and Management (GCMM2025) will be hosted by the School of Mechanical

Engineering, Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT), Vellore, India, in

collaboration with the following international institutions:

 1.

 University of Southern Queensland, Australia

 2.

 Coventry University, United Kingdom

 3.

 Wroclaw University of Science and Technology, Poland

 4.

 Liverpool John Moores University, United Kingdom

 5.

 University of Minho, Portugal

 6.

 Rajamangala University of Technology Krungthep, Thailand

On behalf of the GCMM Board, the Organizing Team is delighted to invite you

to GCMM2025, which will be held from 10th to 12th December 2025 at VIT

Vellore Campus, India.

Dear Esteemed Students,

Greetings from the Career Development Centre (CDC) at VIT!!

VIT's Career Counselling and Higher Education facility, established in

2007, has been a guiding beacon for students, aiding them in their pursuit

of higher education both in India and abroad. Our program is committed to

helping students make well-informed decisions, aligning their academic

choices with personal interests and career goals.

Admission Slots:

We are pleased to offer two admission slots for your convenience:

- SLOT 1: February/March

- SLOT 2: August/September

This flexibility allows students to embark on their higher education

training journey at a time that suits their schedules and aspirations. The

inclusion of various agencies running courses within the VIT campus across

diverse disciplines enriches the program, exposing students to a broad

spectrum of educational possibilities. The strategic organization of

seminars during these admission periods is a commendable effort to foster

awareness and promote the significance of higher studies. These seminars

not only inform students about available courses but also inspire them to

explore and consider diverse fields of study.

Sunday Classes: (Offline mode)

Understanding the varied commitments students may have during weekdays,

offline classes are scheduled only on Sunday. This thoughtful consideration

ensures accessibility for a wider student demographic.

We also provide classes in Online mode(Live and Pre-recorded classes

whichever you select.

(Kindly check the google form below which will give you a clear picture)

Courses Offered:

Our array of courses, including GATE, GRE, GMAT, CAT, IELTS, and TOEFL,

reflects our holistic approach in addressing the diverse needs and

aspirations of our students.

--------------------------------------

The following are authorized training teams for higher education

programs—in-campus classes:

1. GradSquare

GradSquare has been selected for the following programs:

- CAT - Common Admission Test & XAT, NMAT, SNAP 

- GRE - Graduate Record Examinations & IELTS/TOEFL

- GMAT—The Graduate Management Admission Test

2. T.I.M.E. (Triumphant Institute of Management Education)

 T.I.M.E has been selected for the following programs:

- CAT - Common Admission Test & XAT, NMAT, SNAP

- GRE - Graduate Record Examinations

- GMAT—The Graduate Management Admission Test

- GATE—Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering

Welcome to Slot 2 Offline Admissions: August/September 2025 of Career

Counselling and Higher Education Admission Season

(GRE / GMAT / 

CAT / GATE / IELTS / TOEFL)

The authorized training teams of VIT (Gradsquare &TIME) are now open for

admissions. 

Please note the following important details:

Admission Process:

For a secure and streamlined payment process, all admissions will be

facilitated through VIT-CDC.

Students are kindly requested not to enroll directly with the training

institute.

Steps for Admission to

(GRE / GMAT / 

CAT / GATE / IELTS / TOEFL)

Step 1: Registration

Please select your preferred course and vendor in the Google form below.

Once you click the link below, you will get a clear picture of the

different courses, the authorized training teams of VIT who offer these

courses, and also the fee structure they are offering exclusively for VIT

students.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSePX3rNumNa5w_xD3T-ylR4CN9U-5BFbS4n1Tro4RiaeIGCZQ/viewform

You are allowed to choose only 1 course.

Deadline to register:

2nd August 2025, 3 PM

No registration will be entertained after the deadline under any

circumstances.

Note:

After the deadline, we will be closing the admission process and will be

mailing payment processes and all details related to payment to only

those students who have filled the google form . 

Step 2: Payment

All payments related to career counseling and higher education training

should be made only through the VIT-authorized payment processing platform

DABB.

 All those who have registered in the Google form above will be receiving

an Email with a payment link from

 university@mydabb.com <university@mydabb.com>

between 3rd August 2025 to 8th August 2025.

For any queries regarding payment process

You can contact

Payment Deadline:

 8th August, 12 pm

No payment should be made directly to any training teams. Only names in

our DABB database who have made the payment will be allowed for online

and offline classes.

The SLOT 2 class online and offline schedule will be communicated to you

by the respective training teams you have selected within 7 days after your

payment.

NO REFUND POLICY:

Once you have made the payment, under no

 circumstances: is there a refund.

We request you to discuss thoroughly with your parents

 and decide on the course and training team and then

 make the payment as there is no refund once payment is done.

For a secure and streamlined payment process, all admissions and

communication will be facilitated only through the VIT-CDC.

Students are kindly requested not to enroll directly with the training

institute.

Happy Admissions!!!

journey at VIT! Get ready to experience an unforgettable evening filled

with talent, rhythm, and the true spirit of togetherness. Let this be the

and community that define campus life.

The evenings are spread across four days, with different schools joining on

seniors alike.

makes VIT special !

Body:
Dear Esteemed Students,

Greetings from the Career Development Centre (CDC) at VIT!!

VIT's Career Counselling and Higher Education facility, established in

2007, has been a guiding beacon for students, aiding them in their pursuit

of higher education both in India and abroad. Our program is committed to

helping students make well-informed decisions, aligning their academic

choices with personal interests and career goals.

Admission Slots:

We are pleased to offer two admission slots for your convenience:

- SLOT 1: February/March

- SLOT 2: August/September

This flexibility allows students to embark on their higher education

training journey at a time that suits their schedules and aspirations. The

inclusion of various agencies running courses within the VIT campus across

diverse disciplines enriches the program, exposing students to a broad

spectrum of educational possibilities. The strategic organization of

seminars during these admission periods is a commendable effort to foster

awareness and promote the significance of higher studies. These seminars

not only inform students about available courses but also inspire them to

explore and consider diverse fields of study.

Sunday Classes: (Offline mode)

Understanding the varied commitments students may have during weekdays,

offline classes are scheduled only on Sunday. This thoughtful consideration

ensures accessibility for a wider student demographic.

We also provide classes in Online mode(Live and Pre-recorded classes

whichever you select.

(Kindly check the google form below which will give you a clear picture)

Courses Offered:

Our array of courses, including GATE, GRE, GMAT, CAT, IELTS, and TOEFL,

reflects our holistic approach in addressing the diverse needs and

aspirations of our students.

--------------------------------------

The following are authorized training teams for higher education

programs—in-campus classes:

1. GradSquare

GradSquare has been selected for the following programs:

- CAT - Common Admission Test & XAT, NMAT, SNAP 

- GRE - Graduate Record Examinations & IELTS/TOEFL

- GMAT—The Graduate Management Admission Test

2. T.I.M.E. (Triumphant Institute of Management Education)

 T.I.M.E has been selected for the following programs:

- CAT - Common Admission Test & XAT, NMAT, SNAP

- GRE - Graduate Record Examinations

- GMAT—The Graduate Management Admission Test

- GATE—Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering

Welcome to Slot 2 Offline Admissions: August/September 2025 of Career

Counselling and Higher Education Admission Season

(GRE / GMAT / 

CAT / GATE / IELTS / TOEFL)

The authorized training teams of VIT (Gradsquare &TIME) are now open for

admissions. 

Please note the following important details:

Admission Process:

For a secure and streamlined payment process, all admissions will be

facilitated through VIT-CDC.

Students are kindly requested not to enroll directly with the training

institute.

Steps for Admission to

(GRE / GMAT / 

CAT / GATE / IELTS / TOEFL)

Step 1: Registration

Please select your preferred course and vendor in the Google form below.

Once you click the link below, you will get a clear picture of the

different courses, the authorized training teams of VIT who offer these

courses, and also the fee structure they are offering exclusively for VIT

students.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSePX3rNumNa5w_xD3T-ylR4CN9U-5BFbS4n1Tro4RiaeIGCZQ/viewform

You are allowed to choose only 1 course.

Deadline to register:

2nd August 2025, 3 PM

No registration will be entertained after the deadline under any

circumstances.

Note:

After the deadline, we will be closing the admission process and will be

mailing payment processes and all details related to payment to only

those students who have filled the google form . 

Step 2: Payment

All payments related to career counseling and higher education training

should be made only through the VIT-authorized payment processing platform

DABB.

 All those who have registered in the Google form above will be receiving

an Email with a payment link from

 university@mydabb.com <university@mydabb.com>

between 3rd August 2025 to 8th August 2025.

For any queries regarding payment process

You can contact

Payment Deadline:

 8th August, 12 pm

No payment should be made directly to any training teams. Only names in

our DABB database who have made the payment will be allowed for online

and offline classes.

The SLOT 2 class online and offline schedule will be communicated to you

by the respective training teams you have selected within 7 days after your

payment.

NO REFUND POLICY:

Once you have made the payment, under no

 circumstances: is there a refund.

We request you to discuss thoroughly with your parents

 and decide on the course and training team and then

 make the payment as there is no refund once payment is done.

For a secure and streamlined payment process, all admissions and

communication will be facilitated only through the VIT-CDC.

Students are kindly requested not to enroll directly with the training

institute.

Happy Admissions!!!

Subject: Academic Regulations on Attendance Requirements - Reg.
Body:
Dear Students,

Kind attention !!!

School of Computer Science and Engineering

Academic Regulations on Attendance Requirements

1. The attendance percentage will be calculated from the ‘date of

registration’ into a course to one day before the start of the exam

component. Computerized attendance monitoring system is adopted for posting

the attendance by the faculty.

2. A student is expected to maintain 100% attendance in all courses.

3. A student may need leave due to ill-health or to attend family

emergency is permitted to maintain a minimum of 75% (i.e. absent for 25% of

instructional hours) in each course, without producing any proof for the

absence.

· 25% absence includes medical, personnel, casual, official leave of

absence for organizing events/ seminars/ workshops/ technical/ cultural

festivals/competitions/ participation in co-curricular/ extra-curricular

events/ NSS & NCC camps, any other (valid or otherwise) reason.

4. Students who fail to maintain the minimum attendance criteria will

not be permitted to write the next evaluation component of the course

(CAT/FAT), and they will be debarred from writing the exam.

· If a student fails to meet the minimum attendance requirement, then

the attendance software will indicate the status of that exam component as

“Debarred” for the respective course.

5. Students having a CGPA of 9.00 and above (CGPA ≥ 9.00) and with no

current backlog courses are exempted from the minimum attendance

requirements.

· It is expected that these students will continue to attend all the

classes without absence and will not take this as an advantage to skip

classes.

· If such students’ CGPA falls below 9.00, they will be subjected to

the minimum attendance requirements again.

· The nine-pointers list will be dynamically generated and applied at

the time of preparation of the debarred list of each exam component

(CAT/FAT) of a course.

6. In case of emergency

· The first intimation must be given to the proctor.

· If he/she has been admitted to the hospital as an inpatient due to

medical reasons, they must submit their discharge summary, fitness

certificate, and hospital bills to the Head of the Department (

hod.ss@vit.ac.in) through the Proctor with a copy to the Programme

Secretary (secretary.ss@vit.ac.in) within two days after rejoining or

before the last working day whichever is early.

· Medical prescriptions are not considered under any circumstances.

· Based on the nature of the request, the school-level committee will

decide on Attendance Relaxation. Medical leaves will not be updated on

VTOP.

· After submitting the request, students are expected to attend all

the classes regularly and if absences are found at later stages, then

medical leave will not be considered.

7. During the exam period to avail permission for Re-CAT and Re-FAT due

to Hospitalization/ Death in the family, Students are expected to follow

the circular from Dean Academics and CoE respectively (refer to the emails

from the respective office).

fraudulent emails/WhatsApp claiming to offer internships, trainings,

Google Forms asking for your personal information.

received through such unofficial Emails/whatsApp messages.

Please note the following:

Career Development Center (CDC) – VIT is the only authorized body for all

official communication regarding internships, placements, certifications,

or training programs.

All legitimate opportunities and instructions will come from CDC’s official

VIT email domain or be posted on authenticated institutional platforms.

If you are unsure about the authenticity of any communication, kindly

verify it by reaching out to the CDC directly.

Stay alert and safeguard your personal information.

implemented by United Way of Mumbai, Sattva Consulting, and MindMap

across all years of study and will feature hybrid training workshops,

FREE

 support learning in different ways. These may include things like 

 course-specific AI chatbots, AI-generated notes and practice questions, 

 multi-lingual translation of videos, intelligent video segmentation, 

 video summarization, AI mock interviews and assessments etc.

 in meaningful ways.

Subject: [Oracle University Learning Community] Julie Stirling-Oracle Started a new discussion. Rethinking Receivables: New Controls to Streamline Manual and Imported Transactions
Body:
Oracle University Learning Community http://community.oracle.com/ou/

Julie Stirling-Oracle Started a new discussion. Rethinking Receivables: New Controls to Streamline Manual and Imported Transactions

In today’s fast-paced business world, finance teams need more than just efficiency; they need control, transparency, and accountability. 

For many organizations, the Receivables team is crucial in protecting revenue integrity and keeping strong customer relationships.

But what happens when manual errors and unauthorized invoice processing slip through? 

Oracle Fusion Cloud Receivables is stepping up to address this issue with a new feature: Receivables Transaction Review and Control, introduced in update 24D and improved in 25A. 

Let’s explore the challenges this feature addresses and why it’s a significant advancement for Accounts Receivables (AR) teams. 

The Hidden Risks of Manual Receivables Processing

Despite more automation, most Finance teams still create some invoices and credit memos manually. This practice carries various risks: 

Lack of Review Before Completion: There was previously no built-in approval step for manually created transactions. This allowed incorrect or incomplete invoices to be finalized and sent to customers. 

Limited Audit Trail Tracking: Who reviewed or approved a transaction often depended on emails and offline logs, resulting in poor visibility and compliance gaps.

No Control Over Auto-Invoice Imports: Organizations using Auto-Invoice to import transactions from third-party systems could not pause and review these transactions before completion. 

Why It Matters 

Ignoring these processes can have serious consequences: 

Revenue Leakage: Mistakes in invoice amounts, dates, and tax can delay payments or lead to disputes. 

Compliance Risks: Being ready for audits requires clear, traceable approval records. 

Operational Inefficiencies: Without system-driven controls, Finance teams revert to spreadsheets and manual follow-ups. 

What’s New in Oracle Fusion Cloud Receivables 24D and 25A? 

Oracle now offers complete control over the transaction completion process with the Receivables Transaction Review and Control feature. 

24D: Introducing Review and Approval for Manual Transactions 

This update introduces a review process for manually entered invoices and credit memos, allowing organizations to: 

Route transactions for review and approval before completion. 

Use role-based or user-based controls to define approvers. This has long been a common request from clients who wanted similar approval capabilities in Receivables, as seen in Payables and General Ledger.

Prevent transaction completion until approval is granted. 

View full approval history and audit trail in the Billing Work Area. 

Note: A new status, Pending Approval, is introduced. These transactions cannot be updated, printed, or sent to customers, ensuring only validated invoices reach completion. 

25A: Extending Control to Auto-Invoice Imports 

Update 25A goes further by including third-party imported transactions created through Auto-Invoice in the review process. You can: 

Apply the same approval controls to imported invoices and credit memos. 

Use the Transaction Approval info tile to easily view all pending approvals. 

Withdraw transactions needing rework before approval. 

Sweep pending transactions to a future accounting period if they cannot be approved before the period closes. 

Review instalments and payment schedules before approving transactions. 

This update places Auto-Invoice transactions under the same governance, giving AR teams confidence to manage all transaction types and not just those entered manually. 

How It Works 

Getting started doesn’t need custom development or workflow setup. Here’s how: 

Set up control on your transaction sources and types. 

Define approval rules using the Simplified Rules Configuration (SRC) spreadsheet.

Assign approvers based on roles or specific users. 

Use the Manage Transactions and Review Transactions pages in the Billing Work Area to process approvals. 

Choosing the Right Type of Control for Your Transaction Source 

When setting up a transaction source, Oracle allows you to define how much control you want over transaction completion. You can choose from three options depending on your business needs: 

No Control Transactions: These can be created and completed without review or approval. 

Use Case: Best for low-risk, recurring billing scenarios like intercompany invoices or monthly fixed charges. These transactions are routine and standardized with minimal error risk, so speed and automation take precedence over review. 

Role-Based Control Only: Users with the “Approve Receivables Transaction” privilege (usually assigned via security roles) can approve transactions before completion. 

Use Case: Helpful for high-value or sensitive billing transactions needing approval by a Finance Manager or Controller, like invoices above a $100,000 threshold. This setup works well for centralized approval models. 

User-Based Control Approval: It is driven by specific users listed in the SRC spreadsheet. This option allows for precise control over who approves what, based on factors like business unit, customer account, transaction amount, or currency. 

Use Case: Suitable for project-driven or decentralized organizations where regions or service lines have designated approvers. For example, credit memos over a set amount might go to a specific controller for review. This approach offers the most flexibility in tailoring the approval process. These control types let you match the system behavior to your organization’s risk profile and approval structure without complex workflow customizations. 

Business Benefits 

Stronger Internal Controls: Enforce checks and balances for manual and imported transactions. 

Enhanced Audit Trail: Track reviewer details, timestamps, and comments for every approved transaction. 

No More Unintended Completions: Prevent incorrect invoices from being finalized or sent to customers. 

Improved Period Close Discipline: Sweep pending transactions and keep a clean subledger. 

A Modern Approach to Receivables Governance 

With the Receivables Transaction Review and Control feature, Oracle is changing how Finance teams manage both manual and imported transactions. Teams no longer need to rely on emails, offline spreadsheets, or post-facto approvals. 

Built-in workflows, visibility tools, and error-prevention mechanisms enable Finance teams to build a safer, smarter, and more controlled Receivables environment. 

Want to Get Started? 

Follow these steps: 

Explore the updated setup tasks: Manage Transaction Sources - Manage Transaction Types 

Manage User-Defined Rules for Receivables: Download and configure the SRC spreadsheet to define your approval process. 

Review these useful Oracle resources: 

Receivables Transaction Review and Control (24D)

Additional Options for Receivables Transaction Review and Control (25A)

Oracle University – Explore training and demonstrations. 

 

Final Thoughts 

Controlling transaction completion is now essential. Whether you’re manually creating invoices or importing them via Auto-Invoice, Oracle Fusion Cloud Receivables provides the tools to ensure every transaction is reviewed, approved, and ready for audits. The Receivables teams can now operate with confidence, control, and clarity, marking a significant change worth celebrating!

Check it out: http://community.oracle.com/ou/discussion/15450/rethinking-receivables-new-controls-to-streamline-manual-and-imported-transactions
