Subject: Welcome to NPTEL Online Course : Wild Life Ecology
Body:
Dear Learner
Welcome to SWAYAM-NPTEL Online Courses and Certification!
Thank you for signing up for our online course "
Wild Life Ecology
"
. We wish you an enjoyable and informative learning experience.
Details regarding the course:
Name of the course:
 
Wild Life Ecology
 
Course url:
 
https://onlinecourses.nptel.ac.in/noc25_ge69/preview
Course duration :
 
12 weeks
 
 
The course will begin on 
21 July 2025
 When content is released on the portal, you will get an email alerting you.
CONTENT AND ASSIGNMENTS
Every week, about 2.5 to 4 hours of videos containing content by the Course instructor will be released along with an assignment based on this. Please watch the lectures, follow the course regularly and submit all assessments and assignments before the due date. Your regular participation is vital for learning and doing well in the course. This will be done week on week through the duration of the course.
Please do the assignments yourself and even if you take help, kindly try to learn from it. These assignment will help you prepare for the final exams. Plagiarism and violating the Honor code will be taken very seriously if detected during the submission of assignments.
ANNOUNCEMENT AND DISCUSSION GROUPS TO CLEAR DOUBTS:
The announcement group - will only have messages from course instructors and teaching assistants - regarding the lessons, assignments, exam registration, hall tickets etc.
The discussion forum (Ask a question tab on the portal) - is for everyone to ask questions and interact.Anyone who knows the answers can reply to anyone's post and the course instructor/TA will also respond to your queries. Please make maximum use of this feature as this will help you learn much better.
If you have any questions regarding the exam, registration, hall tickets, results, queries related to the technical content in the lectures, any doubts in the assignments, etc can be posted in the forum section
TO GET A CERTIFICATE - PROCESS AND CRITERIA:
The course is free to enroll and learn from. But if you want a certificate, you have to register and write the proctored exam conducted by us in person at any of the designated exam centres.
The exam is optional for a fee of Rs 1000/- (Rupees one thousand only).
Date and Time of Exams: 
02 November 2025
 Morning session 9am to 12 noon; Afternoon Session 2pm to 5pm.
Registration url: Announcements will be made when the registration form is open for registrations.
The online registration form has to be filled and the certification exam fee needs to be paid. More details will be made available when the exam registration form is published. If there are any changes, it will be mentioned then.
Please check the form for more details on the cities where the exams will be held, the conditions you agree to when you fill the form etc.
CRITERIA TO GET A CERTIFICATE
Average assignment score = 25% of average of best 8 assignments out of the total 12 assignments given in the course.
Exam score = 75% of the proctored certification exam score out of 100
Final score = Average assignment score + Exam score
YOU WILL BE ELIGIBLE FOR A CERTIFICATE ONLY IF AVERAGE ASSIGNMENT SCORE >=10/25 AND EXAM SCORE >= 30/75. If one of the 2 criteria is not met, you will not get the certificate even if the Final score >= 40/100.
Certificate will have your name, photograph and the score in the final exam with the breakup.It will have the logos of NPTEL and IIT Kanpur. It will be e-verifiable at 
nptel.ac.in/noc
.
Only the e-certificate will be made available. Hard copies will not be dispatched.
Once again, thanks for your interest in our online courses and certification. Happy learning.
- NPTEL team

Subject: Warning on Use of Pirated or Unlicensed Software at VIT
Body:
Ref:VIT/Regr./2025/100

 17 July 2025

CIRCULAR

Sub: Warning on Use of Pirated or Unlicensed Software at VIT

Dear All,

This is to issue a serious institutional warning regarding the use of

pirated, unlicensed, or unethical software within the VIT

network—including academic departments, administrative offices,

laboratories, and hostel networks. The use of such software is strictly

prohibited, as it:

· Violates software licensing and copyright laws,

· Introduces major cybersecurity vulnerabilities, and

· Endangers the university’s legal and reputational standing.

This applies to all faculty, staff, and students.

Mandatory Guidelines:

1. All required software (for academic, research, or administrative

purposes) must be procured only through the Centre for Technical Support

(CTS) to ensure compliance with licensing and institutional policies.

2. Students are strictly prohibited from using pirated, cracked, or

unauthorized software on any device connected to the campus or hostel

network.

3. Use of expired licenses, shared credentials, or unauthorized

installations will be treated as a serious violation.

4. Individuals or departments found non-compliant will be personally

responsible for any legal or disciplinary consequences.

Encourage use of Open-Source Software:

All users are strongly encouraged to adopt open-source alternatives wherever

possible. VIT promotes open-source solutions for sustainability,

transparency, and affordability. CTS will be happy to assist in identifying

suitable open-source options based on user requirements.

Let us all work together to ensure a secure, ethical, and legally compliant

software environment at VIT.

Registrar

Body:
Dear Students,

As we embark on another academic year, let us remember about our commitment

to creating a safe, inclusive, and respectful environment on campus.

Ragging, in any form, is strictly prohibited on our campus. It is a

practice that not only undermines the dignity of individuals but also

disrupts the harmony and camaraderie that we strive to foster. As you know,

our institution has a zero-tolerance policy towards ragging, and we ensure

that every student feels secure and respected.

Ragging includes any act of physical or mental abuse, bullying, harassment,

or any conduct by one student towards another that causes harm, fear, or

humiliation. Engaging in ragging can result in severe disciplinary action,

including suspension, expulsion, and legal consequences as per the law. We

have established a dedicated anti-ragging monitoring cell and helpline to

support and protect students.

If you or your friend is experiencing or witnessing ragging, please do not

hesitate to report it immediately. All reports will be handled with

confidentiality and sensitivity. Your cooperation and active participation

are essential in upholding our values and maintaining a safe and nurturing

atmosphere. Let us stand united against ragging and support each other in

creating a community where everyone can thrive without fear or intimidation.

Students from the Freshers Batch of 2025 are requested to inform/report any

unpleasant interactions/incidents that they face in campus, hostels or

outside the campus. Also, you are cautioned not to join any unofficial

whatsapp/telegram groups.

STUDENTS are also requested to not get involved in any such acts which may

invite severe disciplinary actions against them.

In case anybody asks you to meet them in Hostel, Foodys or anywhere outside

the campus for such things, please contact on the following numbers/Email

IDs:

Paper Seeing and Revaluation for 

Summer Semester 2024-25 FAT – Theory 

 Paper Seeing and Revaluation:

· In the VTop student login, (“Examination → Marks → Summer Semester

2024-25”) Marks for the Courses to which FAT was held during July 2025 has

been made available now.

· Actual Grades will be released on 14 July 2025 (Monday). The

Pass criteria and Grading Procedure are available in Academics → Regulations

Tab in your login.

· If you want to know the question wise marks awarded to your

answers by the evaluator, you need to apply for it through V-Top. This is

referred to as “Paper Seeing” process. It requires payment of Rs. 100 for

each paper. You can apply through: Examinations →Papersee/Rev →

Summer Semester

2024-25→Paper Seeing. You can choose the course(s) you want to apply

for paper seeing. After Generating the Invoice, you need to make a

payment through “Online Payments” Tab in the same V-Top login.

· Once you have paid, after 24 hours, the paper and question wise

marks awarded will be made available in CodeTantra login. You need to use

the same portal https://vit.codetantra.com for this process. After seeing

the paper, if you feel the mark awarded to a particular question is not

sufficient and the evaluator has missed something and there is a need to

recheck the mark, then you can apply for Revaluation of the Course. You

need to give suitable reasons for the same in the comments section

available just below the mark awarded by the faculty.

· Please note that the Revaluation has to be applied only in V-Top

(in the same way as you have applied for paper seeing) and necessary

payments also need to be paid through the online payments tab. (Rs. 300 per

paper). Revaluation approval process in codetantra will be initiated only

after publishing the Grades, until then the status remains ‘approval

pending’ . Paper seeing and feedback / comments are mandatory for

re-evaluation and are in online mode only.

· Also note that “Paper seeing” and Revaluation is applicable only

for the Theory Courses to which FAT was conducted by the CoE office . For

other components and Courses (like Laboratory / Project Courses IBL mode

courses) there is No Paper seeing and Revaluation Process.

· The students who were involved in Summer Semester 2024-25

examination malpractices are not eligible for paper seeing/ Re-valuation

process.

Dates

Paper seeing registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 100]

schedule. Use your VTop login credentials for login.

· After login, follow the instructions given in the platform for

giving comments to the questions which need to be re-examined.

· Give your feedback with respect to the need for revaluation. If

no feedback is given for any question, your answer script will not be

considered for revaluation and No refund will be given for any approved

requests.

· Students should not approach or give any sort of request to any

faculty related to revaluation (increase of marks or grades). If we

receive any complaints from faculty, it will be treated as ‘Malpractice’

and revaluation requests will summarily be rejected.

Controller of Examinations

Adobe India Hackathon

Hi Nayan Sharma,

Thank you for embarking on the Adobe India Hackathon journey with us! The Round 1: MCQ Assessment + Coding is now LIVE! Please make sure to review the essential instructions and guidelines to tackle it smoothly. 

A combined score of the quiz round and the coding round will be ascertained, on the basis of which top-performing teams will be moved to the next round.

Kindly read through the following key instructions regarding the structure, timeline, and rules of the quiz and coding round:

Timelines & Questions:

Round 1 - MCQ Assessment and Coding

  • Online Quiz Window: 11th July 2025, 12:00 PM - 8:00 PM IST
  • Online Quiz Duration: 60 Minutes
  • Total Questions to be answered: 16 Questions
  • 15 MCQs and 1 problem statement based on DSA and Algo ought to be solved in 60 minutes for this round.
  • You can attempt the round anytime between the provided round window.
  • Please ensure that you attempt the round in one sitting, as once you start the round, the timer won’t stop.
  • You will see the Play button in the Preliminary round to initiate the assessment.
  • Please note that team members don't need to be present at the same location while attempting the assessment.
  • While you are taking the assessment, your code and time of submission are also tracked by the system question-wise. 

System Requirements:

  • A laptop/desktop (for attempting the assessment) with at least 8GB RAM.
  • Ensure that the device has webcam & microphone access and is connected to a stable internet connection (> 10 Mbps). Please note that an unstable internet connection can result in your assessment being terminated.
  • Ensure all notifications & interruptions are turned off on the device, OR do-not-disturb (DND) is enabled.
  • Ensure that the device is fully charged or is connected to a power outlet.

Proctoring Related:

  • You can attempt the assessments only on a desktop/laptop with webcam access.
  • The assessments will be hosted in full-screen mode.
  • Anything that disturbs the full-screen mode of the quiz is treated as a violation. It may be due to any of the following reasons but not limited to:
    • Tab Switching
    • Screen Sharing with anyone
    • Clicking on the escape button
    • Computer going on Sleep (Adjust your power or sleep mode settings)
    • Windows or Browser or any Application specific notifications (Put them in No Disturb Mode or switch them off while the quiz is on)
    • Anything else that may result in disturbing the full-screen mode
  • The assessment does not get terminated on the first such instance. Only repeated violations will result in disqualification and termination of the assessment immediately.
  • Your face will be verified before the start of the quiz from the photo that was captured during registration. 
  • Your face may be verified again during the quiz.
  • Your face will be constantly detected and violations will be tracked and reported while the quiz is on. Eg: Two faces in front of the camera, No one in front of the camera, etc.
  • Please note, that any participant resorting to unfair practices will be directly disqualified from the challenge. 
  • If you come across any instance of cheating or unfair means, please report it to support@unstop.com.
  • All decisions in the matter of eligibility, authenticity & final judgment will be with Unstop and Adobe.

All the best!

Regards,
Team Adobe India Hackathon

Body:
Dear Students,

As we embark on another academic year, let us remember about our commitment

to creating a safe, inclusive, and respectful environment on campus. Ragging,

in any form, is strictly prohibited on our campus. It is a practice that

not only undermines the dignity of individuals but also disrupts the

harmony and camaraderie that we strive to foster. As you know, our

institution has a zero-tolerance policy towards ragging, and we ensure that

every student feels secure and respected.

Ragging includes any act of physical or mental abuse, bullying, harassment,

or any conduct by one student towards another that causes harm, fear, or

humiliation. Engaging in ragging can result in severe disciplinary action,

including suspension, expulsion, and legal consequences as per the law. We

have established a dedicated anti-ragging committee and helpline to support

and protect students.

If you or your friend is experiencing or witnessing ragging, please do not

hesitate to report it immediately. All reports will be handled with

confidentiality and sensitivity. Your cooperation and active participation

are essential in upholding our values and maintaining a safe and nurturing

atmosphere. Let us stand united against ragging and support each other in

creating a community where everyone can thrive without fear or intimidation.

Students from the Freshers Batch of 2025 are requested to inform/report any

unpleasant interactions/incidents that they face in campus, hostels or

outside the campus. Also, you are cautioned not to join any unofficial

whatsapp/telegram groups.

Seniors are also requested to not get involved in any such acts which may

invite severe disciplinary actions against them.

Subject: Participation in the SWAYAM user feedback
Body:
Dear Candidate,
You are receiving this email as you were a learner in a SWAYAM course in the previous year. 
This questionnaire is part of an independent evaluation study of the SWAYAM scheme. This study falls under the broader evaluation of
the National Mission on Education through Information and Communication Technology (NMEICT), funded by the Ministry of Education, Government of India.
The main goal of this study is to assess the experiences of learners like you who have used the SWAYAM platform. Your valuable feedback will help us evaluate the relevance, effectiveness, and impact of SWAYAM courses. It will also help us find ways to improve the platform for current and future learners.
We assure you that:
• Your responses will remain completely confidential and will be used only for research purposes.
• There are no right or wrong answers; we want your honest opinions and experiences.
• The questionnaire will take about 10 to 15 minutes to complete.
Your feedback will directly inform policymakers, educators, and platform developers about what works well and what needs attention. Your voice truly matters.
If you have taken more than one course on SWAYAM, please base your responses on the course that impacted you the most or that you remember best.
You can access the questionnaire by 
clicking here
.
Please feel free to reach out to me 
pratdas@deloitte.com
, if you have any queries either related to the questionnaire or related to this study.
-NPTEL Team

Guidelines – Course Registration (Fall Semester 2025 - 26)

 1. Senior Students and timed-out students of all the programmes except

 BSc (Agri), BSc Catering & Hotel Management, B. Des., B. Arc., BSc

 Multimedia, BSc Visual Communication, M. Des., MBA, M. Arc., MSW, B.

 Tech Computer Science and Business Systems are permitted to take part

 in the course registration.

 2. Course Registration is scheduled to be conducted on 28. 06. 2025.

 3. Information on courses offered for the Fall Semester 2025 - 26 is

 available on VTOP and the VITian Mobile App.

 4. Information on the course registration schedule for the Fall Semester

 2025 - 26 (time and duration for various groups of students) is available

 on VTOP and the VITian Mobile App.

 5. During the course registration process (on 28.06.2025), the system

 will prompt students to register for the applicable Soft Skill Course,

 English Course, SET and NASSCOM Course as per the curriculum of the

 respective programmes. Subsequently, UC: University Core, PC: Programme

 Core, FC: Foundation Core, DLESC: Discipline linked Engineering Sciences,

 DC: Discipline Core, PE: Programme Elective, UE: University Elective, DE:

 Discipline Elective, SPE: Specialization Elective, OE: Open Elective and

 compulsory courses with the following options will be permitted:

Lois Houston-Oracle Started a new discussion. Introducing Oracle AI Agent Studio for Fusion Applications Training and Certification

The rapid evolution of cloud technology is changing what it means to deliver value as an Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications professional. Implementation consultants and IT professionals now face increasing expectations to build smarter, more automated, and adaptive business processes—demands that are driving the integration of generative AI across core enterprise workflows. 

To support this vision, Oracle University has launched the Oracle AI Agent Studio for Fusion Cloud Applications training and certification, available through the Oracle Cloud Applications Learning Subscription. 

Developed in close collaboration with AI thought leaders and innovators from Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications Product Development, this new offering is designed to equip Fusion Applications professionals with hands-on skills to seamlessly create, extend, deploy, and manage AI agents and agent teams across the enterprise. 

Unlock Intelligent Automation in Oracle Fusion Cloud with AI Agent Studio 

Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio empowers consultants and IT professionals to build, deploy, extend and manage “fusion native” AI agents that are tightly integrated with existing business objects, workflows, and security configurations. These capabilities enable: 

 Automation of both straightforward and complex, multi-step business processes 

 Integration of real data and prebuilt templates across HCM, ERP, SCM, and CX.  

 Maintenance of trusted enterprise standards for security, explainability, and extensibility 

Mastering AI Agent Studio ensures Fusion Applications professionals can deliver efficient, intelligent automation tailored to their business or clients’ needs—supporting transformative solutions in Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications. 

Build Practical AI Agent Expertise  

The Oracle AI Agent Studio for Fusion Applications course offers over three hours of structured, hands-on content, including: 

 A deep dive into technical features and architecture, emphasizing proven integration patterns and practical use cases 

 Step-by-step guidance for building and deploying AI agents that support business goals 

 Examples and demonstrations focused on HCM, ERP, SCM and CX domains 

 Principles for secure and trusted AI development, including testing, validation, and governance 

Upon completion, you can earn the Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio Foundation Associate (Beta) certification, confirming your readiness to create, extend, deploy, and manage AI-powered automation within Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications. 

Advance Your Career with In-Demand AI Agent Studio Skills 

Developing expertise with AI agents and AI Agent Studio positions you to respond effectively to rising demand for advanced automation capabilities in Oracle Fusion Applications.  For consultants, the credential distinguishes service expertise in a competitive landscape; for IT teams, it represents preparedness to lead enterprise AI adoption and deliver measurable impact. 

Get started today

Subject: [Oracle University Learning Community] Kris-Ann -Oracle Started a new discussion. Transforming Employee Support: Solving HR Helpdesk Challenges with Oracle HCM
Body:
Oracle University Learning Community http://community.oracle.com/ou/

Kris-Ann -Oracle Started a new discussion. Transforming Employee Support: Solving HR Helpdesk Challenges with Oracle HCM

In today’s dynamic business environment, employees expect fast, reliable, and personalized support from their HR departments. The HR Helpdesk plays a critical role in meeting these expectations, acting as the first line of support for everything from payroll queries to policy clarifications. However, many organizations still rely on outdated or inefficient systems, leading to frustration, delays, and operational inefficiencies.

Let’s explore the common challenges employees face with traditional HR Helpdesks—and how Oracle HCM offers a powerful solution.

The Most Common HR Helpdesk Challenges

Despite their best efforts, many HR teams struggle to keep up with the increasing demands of today’s workforce. Here are some of the key issues that employees encounter:

1. Slow Response Times

Delays in resolving queries can negatively impact employee satisfaction and productivity. Employees often have to follow up multiple times to get the information they need.

2. Lack of Personalization

Many helpdesk systems provide one-size-fits-all responses, which don't address the unique needs or circumstances of each employee.

3. Disjointed Communication Channels

When queries come in via email, phone, or intranet portals with no centralized system, it becomes difficult to ensure consistent service and follow-up.

4. Limited Self-Service Options

Employees often have to reach out to HR for routine tasks that could be handled with a user-friendly self-service platform.

Why These Challenges Matter

Ignoring these issues can have far-reaching consequences:

 Decreased Employee Morale: When support is slow or unhelpful, employees feel undervalued.

 Increased Workload for HR: Time-consuming manual processes prevent HR from focusing on strategic initiatives.

 Lower Operational Efficiency: Repeated queries and unresolved issues lead to wasted time and effort.

 Compliance Risks: Miscommunication or unresolved issues can create legal vulnerabilities.

Oracle HCM: A Smart Solution to Modern HR Helpdesk Problems

Oracle Human Capital Management (HCM) is designed to tackle these challenges head-on. Its integrated HR Help Desk module combines intelligent automation with a user-friendly interface to streamline HR service delivery.

Here’s how Oracle HR Helpdesk makes a difference:

Contextual Routing

The system uses simple assignment rules to route helpdesk requests to the right agent based on various employee attributes. Whether it's location, business unit, job, department, or the category of the request, Oracle HR Helpdesk offers the flexibility to match your business needs.

Personalized Employee Experiences

Customize employee Redwood pages with Visual Builder to improve user experience and align with your business needs.

Whether you need to add custom fields to the service request intake page, validate input data, or auto-populate fields based on selected values, Oracle Redwood Helpdesk provides all these capabilities.

Integrated Knowledge Base

A robust knowledge base empowers employees to find answers quickly through self-service, reducing unnecessary HR workload.

Concise and well-structured knowledge articles enable employees to find the information they need efficiently. This empowers them to resolve issues independently, reducing the volume of calls to the service center and minimizing the reliance on Helpdesk agents.

Some tips to optimize knowledge articles.

 Create clear, concise knowledge article titles - Clear titles and subheadings help readers quickly decide if your article is relevant. Avoid vague wording that may confuse them.

 Stick to one topic per article - Avoid covering too many topics in one article. Focus on a single subject and link to related content for deeper insights.

 Use the customer's language - Use simple, everyday language instead of company jargon. It makes your content more relatable and easier to find through search

Multichannel Access

Employees can submit queries through the Web, Email, Telephony, or Chat, making support easily accessible anytime, anywhere.

Conclusion

A modern HR Helpdesk is not just about resolving employee issues—it’s about creating a seamless, supportive, and responsive experience that builds trust and engagement. Oracle HCM offers the tools organizations need to elevate HR service delivery, reduce manual workload, and improve employee satisfaction.

Body:
Dear Students,

 This is a reminder email regarding the AICTE Productization Fellowship

(APF) . Interested students can apply. Below are the details which is

already been shared with all the students on 28th May. Use this

opportunity.

Thanks and regards

C Ramesh Kumar 

Director Innovations

Apply for the AICTE Productization Fellowship (APF), aimed at identifying

and supporting student innovations that are ready to be translated into

real-world products.

We are particularly looking for projects at Technology Readiness Levels

(TRL) 1 to 6, accompanied by a basic Minimum Viable Product (MVP)

or a Proof

of Concept (PoC). The product does not have to be perfect—our goal is to

validate the feasibility and innovation potential. If you don't have a PoC

or MVP, you are still eligible to apply just with an idea.

Key Highlights:

 -

 Eligibility: Open to student teams (average 3 members) from

 AICTE-approved institutions, including recent graduates (within the last 2

 years).

 -

 Funding Support:

 -

 Stage 1: ₹37,000 per team member per month for 12 months.

 -

 Contingency Grant: ₹50,000 per team per year.

 -

 Additional Benefits:

 -

 Access to incubation facilities.

 -

 Expert mentorship.

 -

 Opportunity for Stage-2 funding based on project progress.

 -

 Application Deadline: 15th June 2025.

Below are the pilot steps for students to follow:

------------------------------

Pilot Steps for Students:

 1.

 Upload Innovation on YUKTI Portal

 Visit https://yukti.mic.gov.in, log in or register, and upload the

 innovation details. Students can register directly through this link

 https://yukti.mic.gov.in/registration/SUMyMDE4MTA3ODM

 2.

 Obtain Innovation ID

 Upon submission, an Innovation ID will be generated. This is required

 for the fellowship application.

 3.

 Fill the Google Form

 Submit the Innovation ID and other required details through the official

 application form. Last Date for Internal Registration (Google Form): 10th

 June 2025. Upon this, you'll receive a mail if you are eligible to apply

 for the fellowship.

 Guidelines Document: Link

 https://docs.google.com/document/d/1WE5TZe2jLnQg2yD04GOD3jkChcC7djzePM_UuWGXIOI/

 Google Form: Link https://forms.gle/7CApjzktyLnwdeQC7

Subject: Inviting students to Sparkathon 2025: Walmart Global Tech’s open innovation challenge
Body:
We are very excited to invite your students to the 2025 edition of

Sparkathon. This is a great opportunity for them to showcase their talent

to solve real-world challenges in retail using technology, win exciting

prizes and a chance to work with Walmart.

About Sparkathon

Sparkathon https://bit.ly/0110lmk is an open innovation challenge for

Indian students, designed as a part of our flagship retail-tech event,

Converge https://walmart.converge.tech/content/converge/en_in.html .

This year, participants will have the opportunity to develop cutting-edge

technology solutions that enhance shopping experiences, aligned with the

following themes:

 - Reimagining customer experience with emerging technologies

 - Transforming retail supply chains

 - Retail with purpose: Building a sustainable and responsible future

 - Building trust in retail with cybersecurity

Why participate?

By participating in this challenge, your students will have the chance to:

 - Showcase their talent and innovation to one of the world's leading

 retailers

 - Pursue potential interviews for internships and full-time roles at

 Walmart Global Tech in India

 - Win exciting cash prizes up to INR 2,90,000 (subject to tax deduction)

 - Be recognized at Converge (main event)

How to apply?

Please click here https://bit.ly/0110lmk for the application form and

to know more about our eligibility criteria and timelines. Applications

close on 14th July, 2025.

Subject: Poster Exhibition Competition - Celebrating 150 Years of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel @ VIT, Vellore 4-5 Aug 2025 - SSL - reg.
Body:
Dear Professors and Students

CALL FOR POSTERS!

🎉 Poster Exhibition Competition Announcement 🎉

Celebrating 150 Years of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel

Organized by Department of Social Sciences, SSL, VIT, Vellore, as part of

the

Rashtriya Ekta (National Unity) Seminar in collaboration with ICSSR on

“Vision of Self-reliant Bharat: Revisiting Pragmatism, Idealism, and

Unification in Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel’s Thought”

📍 VIT Vellore | 4–5 August 2025

CALL FOR ENTRIES – POSTER EXHIBITION COMPETITION

Inviting creative and thoughtful poster submissions from college and

university UG/PG students to commemorate the life, legacy and ideals

of Sardar

Vallabhbhai Patel, the Iron Man of India.

The poster exhibition commemorates the 150th birth anniversary of Sardar

Vallabhbhai Patel, inviting students to visually depict his role in

national integration, administrative vision, and the making of a

self-reliant India. Through creative expression, the exhibition seeks to

highlight Patel’s legacy as the Iron Man of India and his enduring

relevance in contemporary nation-building.

Eligibility & Instructions:

 -

 Open to all undergraduate and postgraduate students.

 -

 Lunch and participation certificates will be provided to all.

 -

 Posters must be in A2 size (420 mm × 594 mm)

 -

 Deadline for Registration: 05 July 2025

 -

 Each poster must be an original creation and must include the student’s

 name, institution, course, and contact details.

 -

 Posters will be displayed during the seminar on 4–5 August 2025 at

Body:
HackOn With Amazon - Season 5

Hi Nayan Sharma,

We're delighted to have you on board for the HackOn with Amazon - Season 5 journey! With the Assessment round now live, make sure you're well-versed with the key instructions and guidelines to ensure a smooth experience:

  • Assessment Duration: 1 Hour 40 Minutes (100 minutes)
  • Total Questions to be answered: 23 (20 MCQ Questions + 3 Coding Problem Statements)
  • 20 MCQs and 3 problem statements ought to be solved in 100 minutes for this round.
  • The Coding Problem Statements will be based on Data Structures & Algorithms and SQL.
  • You can attempt the round anytime between the provided round window.
  • Please ensure that you attempt the round in one sitting, as once you start the round, the timer won’t stop.
  • You will see the “Start” button in the Assessment round to initiate the assessment.
  • You will be allowed to switch between Sections and browse through the questions.
  • It is mandatory for all team members to attempt the Assessment.
  • Each team member must attempt and clear the coding round individually for the team's submission to be eligible for evaluation and qualification.
  • Please note, that any participant resorting to unfair practices will be directly disqualified from the challenge. All decisions in the matter of eligibility, authenticity & final judgment will be with Unstop and Amazon.

System Requirements:

  • A laptop/desktop (for attempting the assessment) with at least 8GB RAM.
  • Ensure that the device has webcam & microphone access and is connected to a stable internet connection (> 10 Mbps). Please note that an unstable internet connection can result in your assessment being terminated.
  • Ensure all notifications & interruptions are turned off on the device OR do-not-disturb (DND) is enabled.
  • Ensure that the device is fully charged or is connected to a power outlet.

Proctoring Related:

  • You can attempt the assessments only on a desktop/laptop with webcam access.
  • The assessments will be hosted in full-screen mode.
  • Anything that disturbs the full-screen mode of the assessment is treated as a violation. It may be due to any of the following reasons but not limited to:
    • Tab Switching
    • Screen Sharing with anyone
    • Clicking on the escape button
    • Computer going on Sleep (Adjust your power or sleep mode settings)
    • Windows or Browser or any Application specific notifications (Put them in No Disturb Mode or switch them off while the quiz is on)
    • Anything else that may result in disturbing the full-screen mode
  • The assessment does not get terminated on the first such instance. Only repeated violations will result in disqualification and termination of the assessment immediately.
  • Your face will be verified before the start of the assessment from the photo that was captured during registration. 
  • Your face may be verified again during the assessment.
  • Your face will be constantly detected and violations will be tracked and reported while the assessment is on. Eg: Two faces in front of the camera, No one in front of the camera, etc.

All the best!

Regards,
Team HackOn with Amazon

I am writing to let you know that our next webinar will be delivered by Dr

Computing,

Wednesday 11th June 2025 from 10am UK time

Please register for the webinar using this link

https://city-ac-uk.zoom.us/meeting/register/h1KOJfHATeOTLDjQV3rlsA. An

abstract for June’s topic is as follows:

Quantum Computing is a computing paradigm fundamentally different to

classical computing. Since its inception in the 1980s, theoretical (and

more recently also experimental) results have supported the notion of a

quantum advantage for a number of specialised computational tasks. In this

seminar, fundamental principles of quantum computing and major quantum

algorithmic concepts will be introduced. Following that, taking into

account current quantum hardware progress, future prospects for quantum

computing to become an indispensable tool for numerical simulations in the

sciences and business will be discussed.

Dr Felix Tennie is a Presidential Fellow within the Department of

Engineering.

Subject: Important Rules and Guidelines for the Assessment! | HackOn with Amazon - Season 5
Body:
HackOn With Amazon - Season 5

Hi Nayan Sharma,

We're delighted to have you on board for the HackOn with Amazon - Season 5 journey! With the Assessment round just around the corner, make sure you're well-versed with the key instructions and guidelines to ensure a smooth experience.

Please note that only eligible teams will be permitted to attempt the Assessment. Teams that do not meet the eligibility criteria will unfortunately not be allowed to proceed. Eligibility requires at least two team members to be enrolled in eligible programs (B.Tech, M.Tech, Integrated Dual Degree, or MCA) from specified branches (CS, IT, Electrical/Electronics, or related) and to have a minimum CGPA of 6.5.

The final eligibility confirmation will be shared on the day of the Assessment.

Your overall performance in both the MCQ and Coding sections will be combined to determine your ranking and qualification for the next stage.

Kindly read through the following instructions carefully regarding the structure, timeline, and rules for the quiz and coding rounds to ensure a smooth experience.

  • Online Assessment Window: 29th May 2025, 12:00 PM IST to 29th May 2025, 11:59 PM
  • Online Assessment Duration: 1 Hour 40 Minutes (100 minutes)
  • Total Questions to be answered: 23 (20 MCQ Questions + 3 Coding Problem Statements)
  • 20 MCQs and 3 problem statements ought to be solved in 100 minutes for this round.
  • The Coding Problem Statements will be based on Data Structures & Algorithms and SQL.
  • You can attempt the round anytime between the provided round window.
  • Please ensure that you attempt the round in one sitting, as once you start the round, the timer won’t stop.
  • You will see the “Verify/Play” button in the Assessment round to initiate the assessment.
  • You will be allowed to switch between Sections and browse through the questions.
  • It is mandatory for all team members to attempt the Assessment.
  • Each team member must attempt and clear the coding round individually for the team's submission to be eligible for evaluation and qualification.
  • Please note, that any participant resorting to unfair practices will be directly disqualified from the challenge. All decisions in the matter of eligibility, authenticity & final judgment will be with Unstop and Amazon.

System Requirements:

  • A laptop/desktop (for attempting the assessment) with at least 8GB RAM.
  • Ensure that the device has webcam & microphone access and is connected to a stable internet connection (> 10 Mbps). Please note that an unstable internet connection can result in your assessment being terminated.
  • Ensure all notifications & interruptions are turned off on the device OR do-not-disturb (DND) is enabled.
  • Ensure that the device is fully charged or is connected to a power outlet.

Proctoring Related:

  • You can attempt the assessments only on a desktop/laptop with webcam access.
  • The assessments will be hosted in full-screen mode.
  • Anything that disturbs the full-screen mode of the assessment is treated as a violation. It may be due to any of the following reasons but not limited to:
    • Tab Switching
    • Screen Sharing with anyone
    • Clicking on the escape button
    • Computer going on Sleep (Adjust your power or sleep mode settings)
    • Windows or Browser or any Application specific notifications (Put them in No Disturb Mode or switch them off while the quiz is on)
    • Anything else that may result in disturbing the full-screen mode
  • The assessment does not get terminated on the first such instance. Only repeated violations will result in disqualification and termination of the assessment immediately.
  • Your face will be verified before the start of the assessment from the photo that was captured during registration. 
  • Your face may be verified again during the assessment.
  • Your face will be constantly detected and violations will be tracked and reported while the assessment is on. Eg: Two faces in front of the camera, No one in front of the camera, etc.

All the best!

Regards,
Team HackOn with Amazon

Subject: Winter Semester 2024-25 (Regular & Week End Intra Semester) FAT Theory - Paper Seeing, Revaluation and Re-FAT Process
Body:
Office of the Controller of Examinations

 Ref.No. : VIT/CoE/2025/25009

 Date: 23-May-2025

Paper Seeing, Revaluation and Re-FAT Process for 

Winter Semester 2024-25 (Regular & Week End Intra Semester) FAT –

Theory 

 Paper Seeing and Revaluation:

· In the VTop student login, (“Examination → Marks → Winter

Semester 2024-25”) Marks for the Courses to which FAT was held during

Apr-May 2025 has been made available now.

· Actual Grades will be released on 30 May 2025 (Friday). The

Pass criteria and Grading Procedure are available in Academics → Regulations

Tab in your login.

· If you want to know the question wise marks awarded to your

answers by the evaluator, you need to apply for it through V-Top. This is

referred to as “Paper Seeing” process. It requires payment of Rs. 100 for

each paper. You can apply through: Examinations →Papersee/Rev → Winter

Semester 2024-25→Paper Seeing. You can choose the course(s) you want to

apply for paper seeing. After Generating the Invoice, you need to make a

payment through the “Online Payments” Tab in the same V-Top login.

· Once you have paid, after 24 hours, the paper and question wise

marks awarded will be made available in CodeTantra login. You need to use

the same portal https://vit.codetantra.com for this process. After seeing

the paper, if you feel the mark awarded to a particular question is not

sufficient and the evaluator has missed something and there is a need to

recheck the mark, then you can apply for Revaluation of the Course. You

need to give suitable reasons for the same in the comments section

available just below the mark awarded by the faculty.

· Please note that the Revaluation has to be applied only in V-Top

(in the same way as you have applied for paper seeing) and necessary

payments also need to be paid through the online payments tab. (Rs. 300 per

paper). Revaluation approval process in codetantra will be initiated only

after publishing the Grades, until then the status remains ‘approval

pending’ . Paper seeing and feedback / comments are mandatory for

re-evaluation and are in online mode only.

· Also note that “Paper seeing” and Revaluation is applicable only

for the Theory Courses to which FAT was conducted by the CoE office . For

other components and Courses (like Laboratory / Project Courses IBL mode

courses) there is No Paper seeing and Revaluation Process.

· The students who were involved in Winter Semester 2024-25

examination malpractices are not eligible for the paper seeing/

Re-valuation process.

Particulars

Dates

Paper seeing registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 100]

 23 - May-2025 to 28-

May-2025

Revaluation registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 300]

 24- May -2025 to 29- May -2025

Paper Seeing in https://vit.codetantra.com/

https://vit.codetantra.com/

 24- May-2025 to 29- May-2025

 Once the Paper seeing request is approved, the evaluated copy of answer

sheets would be made available in CodeTantra as per the above

schedule. Use your VTop login credentials for login.

· After login, follow the instructions given in the platform for

giving comments to the questions which need to be re-examined.

· Give your feedback with respect to the need for revaluation. If

no feedback is given for any question, your answer script will not be

considered for revaluation and No refund will be given for any approved

requests.

· Students should not approach or give any sort of request to any

faculty related to revaluation (increase of marks or grades). If we

receive any complaints from faculty, it will be treated as ‘Malpractice’

and revaluation requests will summarily be rejected.

Re-FAT:

As per VIT Academic regulations (Page 22) Re-FAT will be permitted for the

following reasons only:

S. No.

Description

Supporting Evidence(s) Required

1.

Calamity in the family [Death of father / mother / own brother / sister]

Death certificate or Prior communication to the Proctors

2.

Hospitalization of the student

(for in-patient treatment only)

Medical Certificate, Investigation Report, Bills and Discharge Summary.

· Eligible students should apply in VTop student login (

Examination > Re-Exam Application) between 2nd June 2025 and 23rd June

2025 and upload the necessary evidence.

· Re-FAT requests will be scrutinized by the School Dean and then

by the ‘Re‐examinations Committee’. If needed the student may be asked to

appear before the Committee for presenting the case.

· For the ReFAT approved courses the Grade assigned will be

converted to “---“ by August end. ReFAT will be scheduled along with the

Fall 2024-25 Regular Arrear and the Regular Arrear Process will be followed

for Re-FAT.

· Any student who fails to apply for Re‐FAT through VTop will NOT

be considered for further processing and has to repeat the course(s) by

registering again in subsequent semesters. 

· Please note that this process is only for getting approval for

Re-FAT. After it is approved, students need to register in Arrear / Re-FAT

Tab for registering the course when it is permitted. The schedule will be

available only in Arrear/ Tab. If someone misses the approved Re-FAT, no

second chance will be given and it will be treated as absent accordingly

grade will be published.

Controller of Examinations

Prof.S.Sivabalan Ph.D

Dear Faculty Members, Staff and Students,

It is with immense pride, joy, and a deep sense of admiration that I join

the entire academic community in congratulating our Hon’ble Chancellor on

being conferred with the prestigious Honorary Doctorate of Pedagogy

(Honoris

Causa) by Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), USA on 9th May 2025.

This remarkable recognition comes as a tribute to his outstanding

contributions to the field of education, his visionary leadership in the

realm of higher education, and his unwavering commitment to societal

development through higher education.

Our Chancellor has exemplified values that define true leadership—integrity,

innovation, resilience, philanthropy, and an enduring passion for education

as a transformative force to the society. His unwavering commitment

to equality

and inclusive access to higher education, especially for the

underprivileged, reflects his deep belief in the power of education to

uplift communities and bridge social divides. His achievements stand

as a beacon

of inspiration for all of us, reminding us that dedication to purpose and

a commitment to excellence can leave a lasting impact on countless lives.

This honour is a proud moment for our entire institution. Previously, he

has also been bestowed with an honorary doctorate from West Virginia

University, USA, in 2009 and from the State University of New York (SUNY),

Binghamton University, USA, in 2024. These moments reaffirm our shared

vision and strengthen our resolve to pursue academic and professional

excellence with renewed vigor. As he always says, “VIT shall lead India

and India shall lead the world”. Let us take this opportunity to reflect

on the Chancellor’s journey and draw motivation to cultivate the same

spirit of purpose, leadership, and service in our respective roles—be it as

students, educators, researchers, or administrators.

Please join me in offering our heartfelt congratulations to our Hon’ble

Chancellor on this well-deserved recognition. May his continued guidance

inspire us all to reach greater heights in all the years to come!

contribute to student initiatives, and play a vital role in shaping student

life at VIT.

process and the role of the Student Council, please visit the following

link.

 any subject that concerns students.

 - To promote and encourage the involvement of students in organizing

 school / institute level activities.

 - To inform students about any subject that concerns them.

 - To consult students on any issue of importance and bring it to the

 notice of the Students' Welfare office.

 - To support and contribute to achieve better / higher accreditation for

 the institute.

 - To participate in the development of the school activities.

 - To propose activities to the school/institute administration that

 would improve the quality of student life in the school/institute.

Dear Sir/Madam,

Greetings. In a momentous event on 30th April, VIT celebrated the signing

of two technology transfer (TT) agreements in the presence of our Honorable

Chancellor, Vice President and others. This is the 3rd TT from VIT patents.

Our Chancellor mentioned that "VITians have the potential for filing more

patents and commercializing them".

Technology Transfer 1:

About the technology: Eco-bacterial lime mortars (patent No: 372595) were

developed based on the requirement for compatible Lime mortars for

restoring Heritage Structures. A composition made up of shell lime,

fermented Jaggery ( Unrefined Sugar), and Kadukai (Terminalia Chebula) in

proper proportions was used.

Inventors: Dr. Thirumalini Selvaraj, Professor, CO2 Research and Green

Technologies Centre, Dr. S.K. Sekar, Director Estates, and Professor,

School of Civil Engineering, Dr Ravi Ramadoss, graduated Research

scholar (2015 Batch), School of Mechanical and Building Science.

The Licensee: ALCOLAB (INDIA) LLP, (formerly known as Alcolab (India)

Private Limited), Goa.

 License amount: Rs 9.00 Lakhs +18% GST

Technology Transfer 2: 

About the technology: The patent [No 202541018408] describes a Method for

the synthesis of nano-ceria selenium composite suspension for selenium

bio-fortification and bulb enlargement in Allium spp. This nano formulation

acts as a slow-release fertilizer for garlic and other crops.

Inventors: Dr Amitava Mukherjee, Convener, IPR & TT cell, and

Professor, Centre for Nanobiotechnology, and Ms Abisha Christy C, Ms

Dhivya V, research scholars at Centre for Nanobiotechnology,

The licensee: Sri Meenakshi Trading Company LLP, Madurai

License amount: Rs 5.00 Lakhs + 18% GST

Body:
Dear Students,

Ming Chi University of Technology, Taiwan has announced the start of the

recruitment process for the 2025 MCUT Language and Culture Summer Camp!

Dates:

Session 1 : 2025 / 7 / 7 ~ 7 / 16 (7th July - 16th July)

Session 2 : 2025 / 8 / 4 ~ 8 / 16

 8/14-8/16 Engaging in Cultural Exchange with Taiwanese High School

Students

Interested students may express your interest by filling the Google Form

Using the link:

https://forms.gle/rhDYRWcqakoLHQHR7 https://forms.gle/rhDYRWcqakoLHQHR7

 (Only two students can be nominated.)

Participation Details:

 1. The camp fee includes course fees, one or two meals per day,

 accommodation, tour bus transportation (including airport transfers and

 cultural trips).

 2. Participating students need to cover living expense, visa fee, and

 Round-trip flight tickets.

 3. Each partner university of MCUT is entitled to nominate up to

two students

 for the camp.

 4. Please note that the two students may only participate in one session

 of the camp.

 5. Undergraduate students at their beginning years of study and with

 majors related to either the Engineering, Management or Design field

 are preferred .

 6. Students are required to submit an English proficiency certificate

 equivalent to CEFR B1 level.

Objectives:

 1. To inspire participants to consider pursuing further education in

 Taiwan.

 2. To provide students with insights into the degree programs available

Your Latest Arm University Program News

From AI breakthroughs to hands-on projects and global conference highlights—this month’s newsletter is packed with ways to elevate your teaching, learning, or research on Arm.

New AI & ML Learning Pathway

Arm Education is launching a new AI and ML learning pathway designed to take learners on a comprehensive, end-to-end journey through one of the most transformative technologies of our time.

Produced in partnership with the Institute of Continuing Education at the University of Cambridge, Module 1 is available now, with the rest of the course going live soon.

- For educators, our [Teaching AI on the Edge](https://www.coursera.org/learn/teaching-ai-on-the-edge/?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_content=na&utm_campaign=na_na) course offers practical strategies and insights for integrating edge AI into academic programs—linking real-world applications with societal impact.

- Coming Soon: ML Inference on Arm guides more experienced developers through optimizing generative AI workloads on Arm architectures.

These new resources build on our popular [ML at the Edge](https://www.edx.org/learn/machine-learning/arm-education-machine-learning-at-the-edge-on-arm-a-practical-introduction?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_content=na&utm_campaign=na_na) course, creating a seamless learning experience for novices to experts.

Introducing Project Labs

ProjectLabs is now live. This open-access collection of hands-on projects helps students and educators build real-world skills on Arm-based platforms. From IoT to embedded systems, ProjectLabs supports practical learning through ready-to-use code, documentation, and hardware guidance. Start exploring and building today.

[Access ProjectLabs](https://github.com/arm-university/Arm-Projects-Labs?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_content=na&utm_campaign=na_na)

Catch Up on Our Latest AI Webinars

GenAI Inference on Arm CPUs

Run in partnership with the Linux Foundation, this session explores how to run GenAI models efficiently on optimized Arm CPUs.

[Catch Up Here](https://www.linuxfoundation.org/webinars/unlocking-the-power-and-speed-of-genai-inference-on-cpus?hsLang=en&utm_source=na&utm_medium=email&utm_content=na&utm_campaign=na_na#:~:text=We'll%20discuss%20the%20key,IT%20students%20and%20developers%20alike)

See how YOLOv8 runs on Arm Cortex-M55 and Arm Ethos-U55 using the HX6538 Grove board. This practical session showcases low-power, low-cost ML applications for teaching and research.

At the ICSA conference on March 31st, we hosted an interactive tutorial on virtual prototyping using SystemC TLM-2.0, the [VCML open-source library](https://github.com/machineware-gmbh/vcml?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_content=na&utm_campaign=na_na), and [Arm Fast Models](https://developer.arm.com/Tools%20and%20Software/Fast%20Models?utm_source=na&utm_medium=email&utm_content=na&utm_campaign=na_na). The workshop will be available to watch on demand soon.

n

The Computational Biology network at the University of Coimbra is pleased

to announce the 8th edition of the Summer School in Computational Biology -

from molecules to tissues (https://www.uc.pt/events/computationalbiology/),

to take place in Coimbra (Portugal),during September 2 - 13, 2025.

This is an intensive introductory course targeted to students from the M.

Sc. to post-doctoral levels, with either biological or exact sciences

backgrounds, who wish to acquire skills in Computational Biology.

Applications from UG students with outstanding CVs/skills will also be

considered. It will have four components:

 -

 Introductory lectures (parallel tracks: mathematics and physics for

 biologists, biology for exact sciences students),

 -

 Courses on specialized topics, from the molecular level to integrated

 physiological systems,

 -

 Seminars on cutting-edge developments by world-leading scientists in

 their fields,

 -

 Mini-research projects giving the opportunity to apply acquired skills

 to real research problems.

Topics covered include:

 -

 Core knowledge for modeling biological systems

 -

 Molecular dynamics for lipid membranes and proteins

 -

 Protein-ligand interactions and drug discovery

 -

 Data Science and Artificial Intelligence in Biology and Biomedicine

 -

 Genomics/Transcriptomics to characterize cellular mechanisms

 -

 Kinetic modeling of metabolic and signaling processes

 -

 Modeling of physiological systems

 -

 Computational Neuroscience / NeuroAI (new module)

Illustrative applications will emphasize biomedical problems.

All proceedings will be in English.

In order to apply, please fill in this application form (

https://forms.gle/pfeLsPVerVJaktdC6) no later than May 20.

Subject: Invitation: Deakin University Blue Marble Study Tour 2025
Body:
Dear Students,

Applications for the 2025 Blue Marble Study Tour, hosted by Deakin

University’s Faculty of Science, Engineering and Built Environment, are now

open and we are excited to invite students from your institution to apply!

Designed for students who aspire to study a Science, Engineering, IT,

Architecture, or Construction Management degree at Deakin University, this

immersive study tour offers a range of academic workshops tailored to

specific discipline areas and the opportunity to collaborate with peers

from diverse backgrounds, fostering a global perspective. Students will

also participate in a variety of cultural activities that will enable them

to experience all that Melbourne and Geelong have to offer.

Please find attached the 2025 program flyer, and a summary of the program

details below. We kindly request your support in promoting this information

to targeted students from your institution. Selection for this program is

competitive, and we seek your guidance in promoting this to the ideal

candidates.

Program Details - Deakin Blue Marble Study Tour 2025

Program dates

26 October – 8 November 2025 (2 weeks)

No. of students

30 in total across select partner institutions worldwide (students selected

via a competitive application process)

Program costs

Deakin will cover:

 - Program fees

 - Australian cultural and wildlife tours (including the Great Ocean Road)

 - Accommodation and most meals

 - Private shuttle transportation during the program

 - Airport transfers (in Australia) and public transport ‘Myki’ card

Students will pay for:

 - International flights and visa costs

 - International travel insurance

 - Extracurricular activities not provided as part of the program

 - Food and drink not covered as part of the program

Target students

 - Students interested in studying on-campus at Deakin University in the

 next 1-2 years

 - Passionate about study abroad and willing to promote the Deakin

 University brand

 - Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program at your institution

Selection criteria

 - Completion of the application questionnaire (students will be

 required to submit a short video outlining their motivation to participate

 in the program)

 - Discipline area of interest for future study (students who plan to

 study Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, IT, Environment,

 Sustainability, and Science)

 - Academic Results (CGPA/GPA)

 - English proficiency level

 - Gender balance

Application link

https://researchsurveys.deakin.edu.au/jfe/form/SV_5pgOKLjqSAsu3Yi

Application deadline

Sunday 18 May 2025, 11:59PM AEST

Offers 

Selected students will receive an email offer after 11 June 2025.

Students will have 1 week to accept this offer, otherwise their spot in the

program will be forfeited.

Queries

Students are welcome to direct questions to sebe-international@deakin.edu.au

Should you have any questions or require further details about the program,

please feel free to contact me or my team. My colleague Jacinta Smith will

be responsible for coordinating the study tour and will be in touch to

inform you of any shortlisted students in the week of 2 June, before

issuing offers to students directly.

Thank you for considering this invitation, and we look forward to welcoming

your students to the Deakin University Blue Marble Study Tour.

Please note that Deakin University will be closed over the Easter Holiday

period (Friday 18 April – Tuesday 22 April inclusive). Our response during

this time may be delayed, but we will endeavour to get back to you as soon

as possible. Thank you!

Kind regards,

Rachel

Subject: WINTER SEMESTER 2024-25 THEORY FAT INSTRUCTIONS
Body:
INSTRUCTIONS TO STUDENTS APPEARING FOR WINTER SEMESTER 

 2024-25 THEORY FAT

General Instructions

· Students must enter the examination hall 15-30 Minutes before

the commencement of examination (between 9.00 - 9.15 AM for FN Session)

· You need to WEAR Student IDENTITY CARD during the ENTIRE

EXAMINATION PERIOD. If you don’t have a Proper ID Card contact the

Registrar Office and apply for a new one and get it before coming to the

Exam. The ID card should be scratches free with a proper tag. Exchange of

ID cards or Tags will be considered as Malpractice. If you have misplaced

your ID card or forgot to bring it to the Examination Hall, Report to the

Control Room (PRP 115/SJT G02/TT 104) of your test venue to get One Time

Permit Slips. You need to pay Rs. 100 through V-TOP online payment only.

· You will NOT be permitted to use the toilet/washroom during the

examination, so be prepared for it.

· Exchange of Calculators, Stationeries, Code Books, pen, pencil

etc., are not permitted. The code Books or standard tables should have been

signed by either the faculty or School office. No markings of any kind

should be found in such booklets.

· As per VIT rules, even if you keep your mobile phone/smart watch

in a switched off position inside the examination hall, it will be treated

as examination malpractice. Such malpractices will lead to confiscation of

the devices (including SIM card) for one semester and ’N’ grade (ALL PAPER

ZERO) in all the registered courses including lab & project components in

that semester. Hence, before entering the examination hall, students should

check their pockets thoroughly to avoid carrying mobile phones/smart

watches by mistake.

· Possession of any Electronic Gadget (Mobile Phone, Smart Watch,

Bluetooth device, any device embedded with scanner /camera, etc.), holding

chit papers/ suspicious content in the examination hall is considered as

malpractice.

 A. Pre-Exam Activities

1.

Note down your seating arrangement (Building, Room Number and Seat Number)

from the V-TOP students login. Seating arrangement will not be displayed

for courses in which a student has been debarred. Please report yourself

half an hour prior to the exam. No student would be permitted to enter the

hall after 9.15 AM.

2.

Possession of unauthorised material, even if you do not intend to use it

will be considered as malpractice. Before starting the exam, check any

materials written on desks or walls, or found papers nearby/ around you on

the floor and inform the invigilators.

B. During the exam

1.

Candidate has to sit in the allotted seat only. Listen to the invigilator

and follow their instructions at all times. Strict Silence should be

maintained in the examination hall. Discussions/ communications of any kind

inside the exam hall are treated as examination malpractices.

2.

Check the class number in the Question paper with the Attendance sheet

Class Number. If you have not received the right question paper or

incomplete or badly printed, please contact the invigilator immediately. If

you have any doubt on class number, course name, course code, slot, and any

other details related to your question paper, please check while signing in

the attendance sheet.

3.

Read carefully and follow the instructions printed in the question paper

and in the answer booklet.

4.

Fill required details (Register No., course code, course title etc.) in the

answer booklet before you start writing the exam. After signing in the

attendance sheet, check the barcode sticker pasted on your answer booklet

for its correctness as your answer booklets will be scanned for valuation

using this barcode only.

5.

First clearly write the Question number in the space provided and then

start writing your answers. USE BLUE / BLACK PEN ONLY for writing the

Answers. Writings on any thin pens, / light colours may not be visible on

the scanned images used for evaluation. Remember to write the answers

within the space provided in the answer booklet. If you write anything

outside the margin, it will be cut during the scanning process. If you are

using extra sheets like graph sheets / templates given by faculty, write

your answer booklet number alone on the top left edge outside the margin

and keep it immediately after the first sheet. Do not fold it as it needs

to be scanned for valuation. Do your rough work in the last page of the

main answer booklet itself. Before finishing the exam, strike out all the

rough work.

6.

Don’t write anything in the question paper or in your hand or leg or on a

desk or on walls nearby you.

7.

Correcting pens, fluid or tape and erasable pens are not to be used for

corrections in the answer booklet.

8.

Do not discuss / borrow anything with other candidates during the

examination.

9.

Do not get involved in any unfair or dishonest practice during the exam. If

you try to cheat or break the rules in any way, it will invite appropriate

sanctions under malpractice.

10.

Students are not allowed to ask questions of any kind during the

examination. Invigilators have been instructed not to answer any enquiry

whatsoever relating to the question papers, whether an explanation or

meaning or correction or typographical error

11.

On the day of the exam, if you feel that you are affected by ill health,

please contact the Chief Superintendent or Invigilator. You can write the

examination at the Health Centre.

12.

Do not leave the examination hall until told to do so by the invigilator.

You cannot leave the examination hall until 30 min from the start of the

examination. If any student leaves the exam hall before 12.00 noon, he/she

has to submit the question paper along with the answer sheet.

13.

Do not take your answer booklets or unused ones, from the examination hall.

It is a serious Malpractice.

14.

Answer booklet contains 42 pages and no additional sheets, no threads,

will be provided. 

C. If booked under Malpractice

1.

Be calm and give a written response to the allegation and follow the

instructions from the exam squad / Invigilator / Asst. CS / CS.

2.

Do not indulge in any disrespectful activities such as shouting / creating

/ diverting attention of all other students, a scene in the examination

hall.

3.

Hand over the materials and get a receipt for electronic devices.

NON-COOPERATION WILL BE VIEWED AS AN ACT OF INDISCIPLINE WHICH MAY INVITE

SEPARATE DISCIPLINARY ACTION.

4.

Examination malpractice actions/punishments are very serious, may lead to

All paper ZERO or suspension of one semester. All malpractice actions are

informed to the students / published in VTOP student Login. Please go

through it follow the examination rules appropriately

5.

OBEY ALL THE EXAMINATION RULES SERIOUSLY

With Regards

Prof.S.Sivabalan Ph.D

Controller of Examinations

Vellore Institute of Technology ( VIT)

Vellore 632014, TN, India

Dear Students,

Greetings from the Centre for Bioseparation Technology (CBST).

CBST invites applications for its Summer Internship Program for students

registered under B.Tech./M.Tech./M.Sc. or other equivalent programs at

VIT Vellore, to carry out a short-term (one-month) internship at Centre

for Bioseparation Technology (CBST), VIT Vellore. The program provides

aspiring researchers with early exposure to Research and Development (R&D)

in Science and Technology, offering hands-on training to prepare them for

engaging in Biotechnology Research focused on ‘Separation science;

Proteomics; Polymer chemistry; Microfluidics; Molecular biology;

Immunotechnology- antibody production and characterization; Autoimmune

disorders; Cardiovascular diseases; Anti-microbial resistance; Protein

structural biology and protein crystal studies; Phytonanotechnology;

Bioactive compounds from natural products for diabetes, obesity etc.’ 

The Internship program will be conducted in two spells.

First spell: From 8th May 2025 to 6th June 2025.

Second spell: From 9th June to 8th July 2025.

The students can opt for any one of the above periods to do the summer

internship program.

Eligibility: UG/ PG students from B.Tech./ M.Tech./ M.Sc.; Integrated

M.Tech./M.Sc.

We are pleased to announce an Internship and Training Program designed to

provide practical experience and relevant skills in several key technology

and business domains. This program, in collaboration with industry

partners, aims to bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world

application. The program is aligned with guidelines from the Ministry of

Corporate Affairs (MCA).

 examinations)

 - Eligibility: Exclusively for enrolled VIT students.

Learning Structure:

 with practical, hands-on learning exercises.

 - Internship Phase (Month 3): Apply your acquired knowledge through

 participation in real-world projects under the guidance of industry mentors.

 - Data Science & Artificial Intelligence (Python, SQL, Machine Learning)

 - Web Development (React.js, Node.js, REST APIs)

 - Cybersecurity (Ethical Hacking, Cloud Security)

 - Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure, DevOps)

 - Finance & Human Resources (Financial Modeling, HR Analytics)

 - Hybrid Electric Vehicles (HEV) (Powertrain, Battery Management)

 - Self-Paced Learning with Live Q&A: Access pre-recorded content and

 participate in weekend discussion sessions.

 - Mentor-Led Program: Attend 2-3 live Zoom sessions per week (6:30 PM)

 with six months of access to program resources.

 - Official program completion certificate.

 - Letter of recommendation to support your professional profile.

 - Practical experience and mentorship from industry professionals.

 - Opportunities for career development and professional networking.

development.

Sincerely,

The Skillumni Team

Subject: Exciting Summer Internship Opportunity at our startup Livestockify
Body:
Dear VIT Students,

Kuppismart Solutions Pvt. Ltd., the company behind Livestockify, is excited

to announce opportunities for a 3-month Summer Industrial Offline

Internship in Hyderabad! We're looking for passionate and driven students

to join our team and contribute to our innovative AgriTech solutions.

About Kuppismart Solutions Pvt. Ltd.:

We are a rapidly growing AgriTech company developing AI-powered IoT

solutions for the livestock industry. We are proud to be backed by

prestigious organisations, including VIT University, IIT Kanpur, George

Mason University, USA, and the Telangana & Assam State and Central

Governments.

We have openings in the following areas:

 - AI/ML Developer (1 Opening):

 - Description: Design and develop machine learning algorithms for

 real-time analysis of poultry health data. Build user-friendly interfaces

 for data visualization and actionable insights. Collaborate with

engineers

 and data scientists to create robust and scalable solutions.

 - Required Skills: Proficiency in Python, machine learning

 libraries (Numpy, Pandas, Matplotlib, TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn),

 data analysis, strong problem-solving skills, CNN architectures (ResNet,

 U-Net), Vision Transformers, YOLO models and strong research skills

 - Eligible Courses: CS, IT, or related fields with AI/ML experience.

 - Eligible Courses: Open to students with a strong foundation in

 CS, IT, or other relevant courses with experience in AI/ML.

 - Hardware Engineer (2 Openings):

 - Description: Design, develop, and test hardware components for

 our AI-powered livestock monitoring devices. Integrate sensors and

 communication modules to ensure accurate data collection and

transmission.

 Collaborate on hardware prototypes and ensure robust production processes.

 - Required Skills: Knowledge of electronics, PCB circuit design,

 sensor integration, IoT, embedded systems, Soldering,

 communication Protocols and strong analytical skills.

 - Eligible Courses: Electrical or Electronics Engineering, Diploma

 in Engineering (Electronics).

 - Animation Designer (1 Opening):

 - Description: Create compelling animations and visual content for

 marketing materials, product demonstrations, and educational videos.

 Collaborate with the marketing team to enhance brand storytelling.

 - Required Skills: Proficiency in animation software (Maya,Adobe

 After Effects, Blender, etc.), strong visual design skills, and

creativity.

 - Eligible Courses: Animation, Design, or related fields.

 - Marketing (2 Openings):

 - Description: Develop and execute marketing strategies, conduct

 market research, manage social media campaigns, and create engaging

 content. Assist in building brand awareness and generating leads.

 - Required Skills: Strong communication skills, understanding of

 marketing principles, social media proficiency, and creative thinking.

 - Eligible Courses: MBA or BBA.

Internship Details:

 - Stipend:- Rs. 10,000/- Per Month

 - Tentative Dates: May 1st, 2025 - July 2025 (Dates may be subject to

 change)

 - Performance-Based Progression: Opportunity to extend paid internship

 and then a full-time position.

How to Apply:

Interested candidates are requested to apply through the following link:

https://forms.gle/qndmFpzM9HPD2kys8

This is a fantastic opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic

and innovative environment. We encourage all eligible students to apply.

We look forward to receiving your applications!

Sincerely,

The Kuppismart Solutions Pvt. Ltd. Team

https://livestockify.com/

https://www.linkedin.com/company/livestockify/?viewAsMember=true

With thanks and regards,

Dr. Chitra A., PhD, SMIEEE

Body:

We are proud to share that Sai Manas Golla (21BMM0028), the Chairperson

and former Vice Chairperson of the Society of Manufacturing Engineers

(SME-VIT), has been awarded the prestigious President’s Award by SME

Body:
Dear Students,

 Chungnam National University, South Korea is pleased to announce that the

2025 CNU summer school SSIS (Summer Session for International Students)

will be held from 30 June to 25 July 2025.

You can find the flyer as an attachment for more information about courses

and schedule.

This program is for partners exclusively and provided at a reasonable price

(900USD) which covers tuition, accommodation and field trips.

Since the enrollment capacity is 60 students only, it is first come

and first served.

On the flyer, it indicates that students need to be nominated by home

university, however, it is not necessary now.

If any student is interested in CNU SSIS, they can submit the application

to below link by themselves and contact SUJIN LEE (Ms.) directly for any

inquiries.

There is no number limit from one partner university.

Application Link: https://forms.gle/K2aAj5AnNDMvq2Q6A

https://forms.gle/K2aAj5AnNDMvq2Q6A

Steps to join the SSIS. (Some dates are different from the flyer. Please

refer to the below dates because the deadlines have been extended.)

Step 1. Submit an online application (google survey form) by 15

May. (It may

close early if all spots are filled.)

- Application Link: https://forms.gle/K2aAj5AnNDMvq2Q6A

https://forms.gle/K2aAj5AnNDMvq2Q6A

- Attached, please find course descriptions (subjects can be changed) to

help course choice.

- To complete the application, applicants should upload the documents

below on google form.

A. Passport Copy

 Passport picture page only

 Passport expiration date should be later than February 2026

 If a passport is not issued yet, please send it by email (to

sujinlee@cnu.ac.kr) by 31st May.

B. Certificate of Enrollment (Home University)

 Official document issued from home university or copy of the student ID

card

 C. Oversea health insurance 

 If it is not ready yet, please send it by email (sujinlee@cnu.ac.kr) by 31st

May.

D. CNU Inbound Agreement

 Interested applicants can contact Sujin Lee (sujinlee@cnu.ac.kr) to

receive the form.

 Please print it out, sign it by hand (in English) and upload it

Step 2. Receive an invoice by email within a week of application

 Stpe 3. Pay the program fee USD 900 through overseas transfer by

23rd May.

 The sender's name should be the same as the applicant. (Otherwise, we

can't find the payment record.)

 If there are service charges/commissions occuring during transfer, the

sender should pay for those extra other than program fee of 900 USD.

Stpe 4. Receive an invitation letter after payment. 

 If the applicant needs the original paper for the VISA application,

send an email right after the application with the postal address.

Step 5. Acaquire entrance permit to South Korea (Short-Term Visitor's VISA

or K-ETA)

 Participants should figure out what type of entrance permit is needed for

them, depending on citizenship.

 Consult with the Korean embassy in your home country and follow their

guidance.

 When a VISA application is necessary, please contact by email (

sujinlee@cnu.ac.kr) as soon as possible.

 Step 6. Book the flight and arrive at CNU.

 As long as a VISA or K-ETA allows, participants can enter into South

Korea earlier than program start date.

 However, CNU dormitories are only available from 30th June. 

 CNU dormitory check-in is strictly open from 9am and closes at 6pm on

30th June. (12:00-13:00 lunch break)

 If arrival time is not between designated time, participants should find

a place to stay outside on their own.

 It is unfortunate to inform no-flexibility of dorm arrival policy and I

should ask participant's understanding and cooperation.

Incheon international airport(ICN) is three hours away from Daejeon city,

so it is highly recommended to arrive at ICN before noon.

For any inquiries about application and program details, please do not

hesitate to contact Sujin Lee (sujinlee@cnu.ac.kr).

CNU welcomes you this summer.

Students are requested to inform the concerned school and IR Officer Dr

Sainu Franco (Office of International Relations Main Building 105) in VIT.

Contact Person: SUJIN LEE (Ms.)

E1-1 206 Office of International Affairs

Chungnam National University

99 Daehakro, Yuseong-gu

Daejeon 34134, Republic of Korea

Tel: +82-42-821-7084

Fax: +82-42-821-5125

E-mail: sujinlee@cnu.ac.kr
