Subject: City St George’s, University of London UK -Student Webinars: Photoplethysmography in cardiovascular and neurocritical care applications (16/04/2025)
Body:
FYI

City Student Webinar for Partner Universities

School of Science & Technology

City St George’s, University of London

Dear Students and Colleagues,

I am writing to let you know that our next webinar will be delivered by

Professor Panicos Kyriacou on the topic of Photoplethysmography in

cardiovascular and neurocritical care applications on Wednesday 16th April

2025 from 10am UK time. Please register for the webinar using this link

https://city-ac-uk.zoom.us/meeting/register/tZ0lf-qtrjosG9Ql-_P0qvjdGRDJrSwVDvOf.

Professor Kyriacou is considered a global leading expert in the fields of

Pulse oximetry and Photoplethysmography. His primary research focuses on

the understanding of the relation of Photoplethysmography (PPG) and

Spectrophotometry with haemodynamics, vascular mechanics and hemorheology.

His main motivation is the utilisation of PPG and other optical based

modalities for the innovation of new non-invasive disruptive sensor

technologies, including wearables, for the early diagnosis of disease and

the facilitation of unobtrusive health and fitness monitoring. This lecture

will focus on Photoplethysmography in cardiovascular and neurocritical care

applications.

Professor Panicos Kyriacou is a Professor of Biomedical Engineering at the

School of Science and Technology, City St George’s, University of London

and Founder and Director of the Research Centre for Biomedical Engineering,

also at City St George’s. A full biography can be found here

https://www.citystgeorges.ac.uk/about/people/academics/panicos-kyriacou.

Register for the April webinar here: Register here

https://city-ac-uk.zoom.us/meeting/register/tZ0lf-qtrjosG9Ql-_P0qvjdGRDJrSwVDvOf

I also wanted to make you aware that videos of previous 2024 webinars are

available here

https://connect.city.ac.uk/city/sst/city-student-webinar-for-partner-universities/_nocache

(please note that in the instance that recording was not possible for

confidentiality reasons a recording will not be provided). Details of the

upcoming 2025 webinars are also listed here and will be updated to provide

further information in due course. Each month will feature a new topic,

delivered by an expert within the field, and will showcase research and

teaching currently taking place within the School. Sessions will consist of

an hour’s lecture followed by 30 minutes for audience questions.

Please note that Zoom is used for webinar delivery. Attendees will need an

existing Zoom account in order to register. If you need to register for a

free account, please visit Zoom https://zoom.us/signup#/signup for

details.

Body:
Dear All

ICSSR-Sponsored Two Days National Seminar on “Vision of Self-reliant

Vallabhbhai Patel’s Thought”, scheduled on 4-5 August 2025, Organised by

Department of Social Sciences, SSL, Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT),

Vellore, Tamil Nadu, India.

Themes:

 1. Patel’s Vision of an Independent India:

 - His interpretation of Swaraj, Constructive programme and

 self-reliant India.

 - Challenges and horrors faced in post-Partitioned India and Patel’s

 insurmountable contribution to ensuring the safety of the Indian Citizens

 as Home Minister and Deputy Prime Minister of India.

 2. Integration of Princely States:

 - The strategic, pragmatic and diplomatic brilliance of Sardar Patel

 behind the unification of over 556 princely states.

 - The role of the Instrument of Accession and related negotiations in

 ensuring an indestructible Union, known as Bharat.

 - Lessons from Patel's integration policies for contemporary federal

 challenges, not limited to India but worldwide.

 3. Constitutionalism in Patel’s Thought:

 - Sardar Patel's emphasis on social harmony, justice, equality,

 fraternity and inclusivity.

 - His contribution in shaping the values enshrined in the Indian

 Constitution.

 - Sardar Patel’s role in administrative reorganization and

 institutional consolidation after Independence.

 - His contributions to long-term peace, industrialization and

 governance reforms.

 5. Sardar Patel and India’s Foreign Policy:

 - His approach to maintaining India’s sovereignty in international

 relations.

 - Challenges and strategies in dealing with neighbouring countries

 and global powers.

 - Sardar Patel’s China Policy, on Pakistan and the West.

 6. Sardar Patel & Contemporary India:

 - The relevance of Patel’s vision in addressing present-day

 challenges to India’s unity and integrity.

 - Insights for policy-making and governance.

 - Sardar Patel’s Pragmatism and the art of governance in India.

7. National Security & Geopolitics 8. Freedom Struggle & Leadership

Subject: NPTEL Newsletter: Exclusive masterclass on "Stability Analysis of Dynamical Systems in Fluid Dynamics" - Register Today!
Body:
Dear Candidate,

We are excited to bring you an exclusive masterclass on "Stability

Analysis of Dynamical Systems in Fluid Dynamics" by Prof. Anirban Guha,

Senior Lecturer (Associate Professor) in the School of Science and

Engineering at the University of Dundee.

Prof. Anirban Guha's research focuses on developing reduced-order physical

and mathematical models for complex problems in fluid dynamics. His work

addresses geophysical and environmental flows with applications in ocean

mixing, climate change, and aquatic pollution mitigation. He is a recipient

of the Alexander von Humboldt Research Fellowship (2019), awarded by the

Government of the Federal Republic of Germany.

Spread across 4 sessions, timed at 2 hours each, this workshop is

ideal for students,

faculty members, industry professionals, academicians, and researchers who

are working in different domains. Kindly share this masterclass in your

network.

Session-1: Introduction to Dynamical Systems and Stability

AnalysisIntroduction

to dynamical systems – linearizing nonlinear system of ODEs, Phase Plane

Analysis, fixed points and their stability, Bifurcation Analysis with the

damped oscillator example, Lyapunov and Asymptotic stability.Date: 14th

June, 2025, 7 pm - 9 pm (IST)

Session-2: Stability Analysis of Fluid Dynamical Systems

Motivating linear stability analysis of generic Fluid Dynamical Systems,

normal mode analysis, problems with density variation having exact

solutions, e.g. Rayleigh- Taylor Instability and Rayleigh–Bénard

Convection, shear flow problem with exact solution – Kelvin-Helmholtz

instability.

Date:15th June, 2025, 7 pm - 9 pm (IST)

Session-3: Advanced Fluid Dynamics - Governing Equations and Theorems

Stability of smooth Velocity profiles, Rayleigh’s inflexion point Theorem,

Squire’s Theorem, deriving the governing equation for density stratified

shear flows with Viscosity – the density stratified Orr-Sommerfeld equation

(also known as the Viscous Taylor- Goldstein equation).

Date: 21st June, 2025, 7 pm - 9 pm (IST)

Session-4: Numerical Solutions and Real-World Applications

Exploring numerical solutions (using MATLAB) of the density stratified Orr-

Sommerfeld equation with various examples – boundary layer instabilities in

channel (or pipe) flows, Kelvin-Helmholtz instability in mixing layers,

discussion of applications in industry (e.g. combustion in IC engines,

multiphase flows, industrial displacement flows) and geophysics (ocean

mixing, barotropic instability of atmospheric jets). Limitations of normal

mode theory and pointers to recent developments in linear stability

analysis, including data-driven stability analysis.

Date:22nd June, 2025, 7 pm - 9 pm (IST)

On the momentous occasion of University Day & Annual Sports Day 2025 held

on 5th April 2025, we proudly celebrated the outstanding achievements of

our students. Among these, the Best Outgoing Students were honored for

their exceptional academic performance, leadership, and contributions to

the VIT community.

The prestigious Chancellor’s Gold Medal was awarded to the Best Outgoing

Engineering Student, while the Chancellor’s Special Awards recognized

excellence in six other categories: Non-Engineering, Three-Year UG,

Two-Year PG, Five-Year Integrated, Foreign, and NRI.

We extend our heartfelt congratulations to the following winners:

Chancellor's Gold Medal (Engineering Category) - Ms. SHRUJANA K 

(21BBT0027)

"Shrujana, a final-year Biotechnology student at VIT Vellore, is a

dedicated researcher passionate about developing targeted therapeutics for

chronic illnesses. She has interned at prestigious institutes like IBAB,

InSTEM, MITACS, and Anthem Biosciences. As President of Brisa VIT, she

earned accolades from Toastmasters International for her contributions to

public speaking. Additionally, serving as a program representative and

student council member secretary honed her leadership and interpersonal

skills. Committed to scientific excellence, she aspires to pursue higher

education at top institutions and return to India as a researcher,

contributing meaningfully to the nation's scientific community."

Chancellor's Special Award (Non Engineering Category) - Ms. KISHORATHI D

K (21BAG0020)

"Kishorathi DK, a passionate B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture student at VIT, is

dedicated to advancing the agricultural sector while honoring a

five-generation family legacy. Committed to excellence, she has served as a

Program Representative for two consecutive years and as Vice Chairperson of

the Solai Club, showcasing her leadership and teamwork skills. Actively

participating in various VIT clubs and chapters, she has strengthened her

communication and organizational abilities. With a deep-rooted passion for

agriculture, she strives to make a meaningful impact in the field,

contributing to sustainable practices and community development."

Chancellor's Special Award (3 Year UG Category) - Ms. CHAMAN TAHSEEN K

N (22BHM0010)

"Chaman Tahseen, a final-year B.Sc. Hotel and Tourism Management student,

holds a stellar CGPA of 9.88 and has ranked first for five consecutive

semesters. A dynamic leader, he has served as Programme Representative,

Member Secretary, and now Executive Member of the Student Council. Gaining

hands-on experience, he interned at Vitara Guest House and contributed to

events like Gravitas, Yantra, and themed hospitality weeks. Beyond

academics, he channels his passion for baking into his home bakery, Brownie

and Cream in Ambur. With a blend of leadership, creativity, and excellence,

he aspires to make a mark in the hospitality industry."

Chancellor's Special Award (5 Year Integrated Category) - Ms. DURGA

SHREE N (20MIS0054)

"Durga Shree N is an accomplished researcher, having received prestigious

scholarships such as the Future Research Talent Award (Australia), DAAD

WISE (Germany), Mitacs Globalink (Canada), and the Khorana Scholarship

(USA). She is currently completing her final-year project at the

Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, Harvard, applying AI in cancer therapeutics.

With multiple research publications and conference presentations, she has

demonstrated academic excellence. As Head of Operations and Co-Secretary of

Sigma Xi at VIT, she promoted research awareness and mentored aspiring

researchers. Passionate about data science, she aims to bridge AI and life

sciences, driving impactful, data-driven innovations."

Chancellor's Special Award (2 Year PG Category) - Mr. ARUN KUMAR M 

(23MTW0026)

"Arun Kumar M is an interdisciplinary professional with a Master of Social

Work from VIT and a background in Mechanical Engineering. A Tamil Nadu

Chief Minister’s Fellow (2024–26) with the National Health Mission, he has

also earned the prestigious National Child Rights Research Fellowship

(NCRRF) from CRY, Mumbai. His diverse experience spans industrial

engineering, public policy, and community health, with internships at the

Centre for Public Policy Research and Christian Medical College. A

Chancellor’s Special Awardee and UGC NET JRF qualifier, he is pursuing a

postgraduate certificate in Public Policy at BIM Trichy, committed to

impactful community development."

Chancellor's Special Award - Best Performing Student (NRI) - Mr. BRYAN

ANTHONY GONSALVES (22BCS0180)

"Bryan Gonsalves is an outstanding student at VIT, excelling in academics,

leadership, and innovation. As Member Secretary of the Student Council and

a Senior Core Member of IEEE-CS, he spearheaded impactful events and

workshops. He secured a dream offer from PwC and contributed to fintech

development at FinMitr. His victory at the Toastmasters Toast-a-Thon

highlights his exceptional communication skills. Consistently ranking among

the top students, Bryan exemplifies excellence and initiative. With a

strong foundation in technology and leadership, he is poised to make

significant contributions to the industry."

Chancellor's Special Award - Best Performing Student (Foreign)- Mr. ISHAN

JAIN (21BCE3959)

"Ishan Jain, a BTech Computer Science student from Nepal, has been an

integral part of the VIT Vellore community, excelling in academics,

leadership, and cultural initiatives. As a two-year Student Council member,

he represented over 600 foreign students, advocating for their needs. He

spearheaded the Nepali New Year celebration, contributed significantly to

Yantra '25, and played a key role in events by the Office of Students'

Welfare. His leadership in multi-college fests and high-pressure events

showcases his dedication and adaptability. Ishan’s passion, persistence,

and commitment have left a lasting impact on the university community."

Each of these students has demonstrated excellence in academics,

leadership, and involvement in various clubs and chapters, setting a

benchmark for their peers. Their journey at VIT is an inspiration to all,

and we take immense pride in their achievements.

We wish them great success in their future endeavors and look forward to

seeing them make a meaningful impact in their respective fields.

Subject: Fuel Cell Racing Team Registration-reg
Body:
Dear Students,

We are excited to announce the opportunity to form a dedicated racing team

to participate in an upcoming Fuel Cell Vehicle Racing Competition. The

team will be operating under the guidance of ARC and TIFAC.

This initiative presents a unique platform for engineering students to

apply theoretical knowledge to practical, cutting-edge technology and gain

invaluable hands-on experience.

This project will encompass various engineering disciplines, including:

 - Mechanical Engineering: Chassis design, vehicle dynamics, fabrication

 and testing.

 - Electrical and Electronics Engineering: Fuel cell integration, power

 management, and control systems.

 - Chemical Engineering: Membrane technology, hydrogen storage, system

 optimization.

 - Computer Science/Engineering: Data acquisition, control algorithms,

 and simulation.

This is an exceptional opportunity to:

 - Develop practical engineering skills and gain real-world experience.

 - Work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team.

 - Apply your knowledge to a sustainable and innovative technology.

 - Enhance your resume and professional portfolio.

 - Compete against other leading institutions.

ARC and TIFAC offer the following for the racing team;

 - Research expertise and mentorships

 - Partial funding

 - Research facilities and working space

Students wishing to join the team, are encouraged to complete the following

enrollment form:

Subject: Congratulations to SAE-VIT’s Assailing Falcons for Global Achievement at SAE AeroDesign West 2025
Body:
Dear VITians,

It is with immense pride that we announce the exceptional achievements of

SAE-VIT’s Advanced Class Aircraft team – Team Assailing Falcons, at the SAE

Aero Design West 2025 competition held at Van Nuys, California, USA,

from April 4th to 6th, 2025.

Organized by industry giants Lockheed Martin, Haas, and Boeing, the event

brought together participants from various countries, challenging teams to

design and build a fully autonomous delivery aircraft under the Advanced

Class category. Our team earned three major awards, standing out among top

competitors from the USA, China, Poland, Brazil, Spain, and Mexico.

We are thrilled to share the accolades earned by the team under the Advanced

Class category:

• Design Report Award – 1st Place

Subject: Congratulations to IEEE-CS for Achievement at IIT Kanpur
Body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to share that IEEE-CS VIT secured Second Place at the AI

Finance Hackathon, held as part of Techkriti ’25 at IIT Kanpur in

collaboration with the National Financial Reporting Authority (NFRA),

Government of India, from March 28th to 29th, 2025. The team was awarded a

cash prize of Rs. 1,00,000.

For the competition, the team developed two open-source financial analysis

tools. The Financial Insights Analyzer uses Deepseek-r1-14b to simplify

complex financial metrics for beginners, while the Financial Report

Summarizer, powered by a locally running Deepseek-r1-7b, generates concise

summaries of financial reports to improve accessibility for novice users.

Team Members:

 - Ashutosh Dash (22BML0054)

 - Medhansh Jain (22BCE0725)

 - Akshit Anand (22BCE2242)

 - Arya Patil (22BEC0663)

 - ⁠Ishan Urgaonkar (22BEC0702)

Boominathan P (12392) and Dr. Swathi J N (10946) throughout the

competition.

Dear all,

Greetings!!

The School of Electronics Engineering at Vellore Institute of Technology

(VIT) is proud to announce that Mr. Kushagra Narang (21BML0031) and Ms.

Jhanvi Chaturvedi (21BML0053) have been awarded the Second Prize for their

outstanding paper oral presentation at the International Conference on "AI

Systems and Sustainable Technologies" (IISU-ASSET 2025).

The conference, organized by the Department of Computer Science & IT, IIS

(deemed to be University), Jaipur, took place on March 28th and 29th, 2025.

Mr. Narang and Ms. Chaturvedi presented their research paper titled "A

Data-Driven Aircraft Health Monitoring System: IoT Integration, Predictive

Maintenance, and Cybersecurity Validation" in the oral presentation

category.

Their research focused on developing an innovative system for monitoring

aircraft health using data-driven techniques, integrating IoT technologies,

implementing predictive maintenance strategies, and ensuring robust

cybersecurity measures. The project showcases the students' exceptional

technical skills and their ability to address complex challenges in the

field of aerospace engineering.

This achievement highlights the high caliber of research and academic

excellence fostered at VIT. Mr. Narang and Ms. Chaturvedi were guided and

mentored by Dr. Sasikumar P, whose expertise and support were instrumental

in their success.

The proceedings of IISU-ASSET 2025 will be published in Springer Nature's

Scopus/ SCI Indexed book series "Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems"

Subject: Congratulations to CodeChef-VIT for Securing First Placeat AI Finance Hackathon, Techkriti’25 – IIT Kanpur
Body:
Dear VITians,

We are thrilled to announce the exceptional achievement of CodeChef-VIT

club members at the AI Finance Hackathon, organized by Techkriti ’25 at

IIT Kanpur in collaboration with the National Financial Reporting

Authority (NFRA), Government of India, from March 28th to 29th, 2025.

Team Error 422-Unprocessable Entity clinched First Place in this

prestigious competition, securing a grand cash prize of Rs. 2,00,000. The

team developed an AI-powered platform that breaks down financial statements

into simplified explanations, visual summaries, and story-driven insights,

making them accessible for individuals with limited financial knowledge.

 - Akshath Rajkumar (23BAI0059)

 - Monami Som Saha (23BCE2093)

 - P Vishwajith (23BCI0128)

panel of judges, Pukhraj Tak and Arun Kumar A. S., both Executive Directors

at NFRA. This remarkable accomplishment has been recognized across various

media platforms, including the official NFRA LinkedIn post and several

prominent news outlets.

Subject: Congratulations to Team Health Intellect for Winning the Yuvamanthan Hackathon
Body:
Dear VITians,

We are proud to share the outstanding achievement of Team Health Intellect,

who represented VIT Vellore at IInvenTiv 2025, India’s largest R&D fair,

hosted at IIT Madras as part of the Yuvamanthan Hackathon on February 28,

2025. The team emerged as the winner of the hackathon, showcasing their

excellence in innovation and healthcare technology, and bringing great

pride to our institution.

The team was felicitated by esteemed dignitaries, including Dr. Sukanta

Majumdar, Honourable Minister of State for Education, Dr. Veezhinathan

Kamakoti, Honourable Director of IIT Madras, and the Honourable Dean of IIT

Madras. They also received virtual wishes from the Honourable Education

Minister of India, Dharmendra Pradhan.

Team Members:

 - Vaibhav Vilas Pawar (21BCE3989) – Team Lead

 - Adithya Gattadi (21BCT0146)

 - Jigme Nidup (21BCT0400)

 - Rishita Gagrani (21BCT0319)

Their award-winning project, Health Intellect, is an AI-driven, IoT-based

health monitoring system that integrates multiple sensors and deep learning

algorithms to predict potential health risks. It provides real-time

monitoring, instant alerts, and personalized health insights through a

secure web application.

We extend our heartfelt congratulations to Team Health Intellect for their

remarkable achievement.

Subject: Université de Tours , France- Exchange students - Nominations 2025/26
Body:
Dear Students,

University of Tours, France proposes to welcome students interested in

coming to France within the framework of an international mobility of

studies. The University of Tours is opening the nomination period for

mobilities starting during the first semester of the 2025/26 academic

year today, the 27th of March 2025.

In order for you to have a holistic overview upon the aspects connected to

this matter, please find a list of useful information enumerated below.

Having access to this precious information would instigate you to choose

Tours for your international mobility of studies, and you will be received

by them in the Loire Valley https://www.touraineloirevalley.com/!

Academic calendar for nominations and online applications - incoming

exchange students

Term dates

First semester (autumn / winter semester): 4 months (September to December)

Second semester (spring / summer semester): 5 months (January to May)

Nominations calendar

Autumn / winter semester (or full academic year): starting in September 2025

Nomination period: 24.03.2025 – 05.04.2025

Application period: 31.03.2025 – 06.06.2025

Nota bene: a second nomination period will be opened in October – November

2025 for international mobilities of studies taking place during the second

semester of the 2025/26 academic year (starting in January 2026)

Interested Students may fill the Google form on or before the 5th of April

using the link: https://forms.gle/fjKWifDq7g2Q4aHQ7

Following your nominations, you will be contacted with all the

instructions to follow as to pre-register at UT.

Why choose the University of Tours to study abroad in France?

 - Our course offer

 - Online course catalogue (-> course name, credits, content, hours,

 coordinator, level) – disciplinary courses

Students can use the online catalogue that lists the most popular courses

(French/English) for exchange students: Course Catalogue for Exchange

Students. https://cces.univ-tours.fr/Accueil.php?language=EN

Beyond disciplinary courses taught in French, UT also provides students

with more than 150 courses in English in different fields (Humanities,

Science and Technology). Only a beginner-intermediate level of French is

required if students choose disciplinary courses taught in English.

You have the right to choose courses in any discipline (from all faculties

apart from medicine), provided the conditions of our interinstitutional

agreement are fulfilled (the majority of their classes must be taken within

a specific field of studies, for example), that both their academic

coordinators approve it, and that their home university will recognize the

credits obtained in a different discipline than the student’s major at the

end of the mobility, these credits being relevant to the student’s academic

project.

 - French language and culture classes

Exchange students can complete their learning agreement with French courses

https://international.univ-tours.fr/english-version/admission-process-for-exchange-students/6-learn-french-cuefee-crl

 provided by our University Center of French as a Foreign Language

(CUEFEE). They can select up to 3 courses (up to 72 hours), that are

completely free of charge for exchange students. Each course will give

students 4 ECTS, as follows:

§ Written language (24h/semester), 4 ECTS credits

§ Oral language (24h/semester), 4 ECTS credits

§ Cultural options (20h/semester), 4 ECTS credits (from B1 level)

Classes are taught beginning with the A1 CEFR level in French to C1. This

is the main scheme for international exchange students.

 - Our individual support

The University of Tours assists international exchange students prior to

their mobility with every administrative aspect related to their arrival in

France, from the online pre-registration, to the visa procedure (if

applicable), and facilitates their accommodation request in a public

student residency.

 - Visa – Campus France procedure for exchange students that are not

 European citizens (not a citizen of one of the 27 EU member states), or

 citizens of a Schengen / EEA country

 - Accommodation – housing request for public student residencies

 - Learning Agreement and online course catalogue

 - French language and culture classes

 - Academic calendar and timetable

 - Integration – we value the integration of exchange students, and

 different resources exist in order to facilitate it

 - Buddy System: a French student to support them soon after their

 arrival in Tours

 - Erasmus Student Network https://www.facebook.com/ESNTours/: the

 association organizes cooking activities, international dinners, theme

 evenings. The membership gives access to preferential rates for the

 cultural events organized by the international relations

office of the UT

 and gives them the right to have discounts with the partners of the

 association (Ryanair, local stores…).

 - Cultural programme

 - Our International Relations Service organizes a great cultural

 program

 https://international.univ-tours.fr/english-version/welcome-to-ut/cultural-programme

 me for the students with visits to the chateaux of the Loire

 Valley and many other unmissable spots of the region and France.

 - In addition, the cultural service of the university organizes

 many cultural events and offers discounts to the students who have the

 cultural pass (opera, cinema, shows…).

 - Sports

§ Students have access to a wide variety of sports at the UT. They can

subscribe to the Pack’Sport and take up to 3 different sport classes a

week, absolutely free of charge! They can also do sports trainings during

week-ends on different themes (hiking at the Mont-Saint-Michel, canyoning,

skiing…) and attend sport events or wellness activities (badminton, fitness

night, rugby…).

o Orientation maps

§ A map of UT’s campuses, faculties, and student services

https://www.google.com/maps/d/u/1/edit?mid=1Oe2Q_yuy9VbAkhtfCiHYJhzh8K8iYXA&usp=sharing

§ A map allowing students to discover the city

https://www.google.com/maps/d/viewer?mid=1KeCNJLFEccVbzUZTNfD3VfNAz-ktLv0&ll=47.38009226217868%2C0.688595800000007&z=13

from

an extracurricular point of view

· Warm welcome

The students will be welcomed individually upon their arrival to help

them finalize their registration, and give them all the practical

information they need for their settling in (presentation of the different

useful university services, organized events, information about the ESN,

public transportation, etc.).

Moreover, every September, the UT gathers many actors and welcome services

of international students in a single event, the International Students

Welcome Desk.

https://international.univ-tours.fr/english-version/admission-process-for-exchange-students

UT’s Welcome Desk team is here to direct and give students advice to ensure

a coordinated and efficient setup in Tours.

Useful information - Admission process for Exchange students

You will find detailed information on the admission process for exchange

students (registration, accommodation, visa, learning agreement) on: UT -

Admission process for Exchange students (univ-tours.fr)

https://international.univ-tours.fr/english-version/admission-process-for-exchange-students

Useful resources for partners and students - UT Promotional Materials

Please consult the official web page intended for partner institutions and

exchange students, where you will find communication toolkits (PPT, Fact

sheet), a link to the online course catalogue for exchange students, a list

of supervised projects, as well as some information on French studies:

https://international.univ-tours.fr/english-version/about-ut/useful-documents-aimed-at-international-partners

GOOD REASONS TO STUDY AT UT:

 - A multidisciplinary and dynamic university in the very heart of the

Subject: Academic Regulations on Attendance Requirements - Reg.
Body:
School of Computer Science and Engineering

Academic Regulations on Attendance Requirements

1. The attendance percentage will be calculated from the “date of

registration” into a course to one day before the start of the exam

component. Computerized attendance monitoring system is adopted for posting

the attendance by the faculty.

2. A student is expected to maintain 100% attendance in all courses.

3. A student may need leave due to ill-health or to attend family

emergency is permitted to maintain a minimum of 75% (i.e. absent for 25%

of instructional hours) in each course, without producing any proof for the

absence.

· 25% absence includes medical, personnel, casual, official leave of

absence for organizing events/ seminars/ workshops/ technical/ cultural

festivals/competitions/ participation in co-curricular/ extra-curricular

events/ NSS & NCC camps, any other (valid or otherwise) reason.

4. Since no one is exempted from the minimum attendance requirements,

students who fail to maintain the minimum attendance criteria will not be

permitted to write the next evaluation component of the course (CAT/FAT

Exam component fixed by the course faculty in case of courses), and they

will be debarred from writing the exam.

5. Once the student fails to meet the minimum attendance requirement,

the attendance software will indicate the status of that exam component as

“Debarred” for the respective course.

6. Students having a CGPA of 9.00 and above (CGPA ≥ 9.00) and with no

current backlog courses are exempted from the minimum attendance

requirements.

· It is expected that these students will continue to attend all the

classes without absence and will not take this as an advantage to skip

classes.

· If such students’ CGPA falls below 9.00, they will be subjected to

the minimum attendance requirements again.

· The nine-pointers list will be dynamically generated and applied at

the time of preparation of the debarred list of each exam component

(CAT/FAT) of a course.

7. In case of emergency (Hospitalization/Death in the family), the

first intimation must be given to the proctor.

8. If he/she has been admitted to the hospital as an inpatient due to

medical reasons, they must submit their discharge summary, fitness

certificate, and hospital bills signed by the Proctor to the Programme

Secretary (SJT 322) on the Date of Medical fitness (Forms Enclosed).

· Medical prescriptions are not considered under any circumstances.

· After submitting the request, students are expected to attend all

the classes regularly and if absences are found at later stages, then

medical leave will not be considered.

· Based on the nature of the request, the school-level committee will

decide on Attendance Relaxation. Medical leaves will not be updated on

VTOP.

9. During the exam period to avail permission for Re-CAT and Re-FAT

due to Hospitalization/ Death in the family, Students are required to

follow the circular from Dean Academics and CoE respectively (refer to the

emails from the respective office).

Best Regards,

culture for 6 weeks from the end of June to early August.

the time of application, or graduates (not currently enrolled in Master’s

or PhD program), with foreign nationality (non-Korean)

fields)

the recommendation letter and upload it on the link by March 28, 2025 

(KST).

Dear Students,

foundation, preparing students for seamless transition into leading

universities abroad for their second year.

Masters Overseas Program and prepare them for global careers. We invite the

pathway.

Universities in USA, UK and Canada, to earn a Master’s degree in areas of

Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Business Analytics and Cybersecurity.

Dear Students

I am writing to let you know that our next webinar will be delivered by Dr

Carlos Reyes Aldasoro on the topic of Biomedical Image Analysis on Wednesday

12th March 2025 from 10am UK time. Please register for the webinar using

this link

https://city-ac-uk.zoom.us/meeting/register/tZcrcO6hqTsrGdGS2_bCi4cIH9GYw9168-Md#/registration.

An abstract for the topic is as follows:

Biomedical Image Analysis is a truly interdisciplinary area, a crossroad

of medicine, physics, biology, chemistry and computer science. In this

talk, Dr Reyes-Aldasoro will explain how these disciplines are related,

with emphasis on the importance of computer science to automate processes

and to find patterns that would not be easy to detect by simple human

observation. He will illustrate the process of biomedical image analysis

with examples related to cancer research.

Dr Carlos Reyes Aldasoro is a Senior Lecturer in the School of Computer

https://www.citystgeorges.ac.uk/about/people/academics/constantino-carlos-reyes-aldasoro

Subject: Generation Connect Young Leadership Programme (GCYLP) by ITU in partnership with Huawei - reg
Body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to inform you about an exceptional opportunity: the Generation

Connect Young Leadership Programme (GCYLP), organized by the International

Telecommunication Union (ITU) in partnership with Huawei. This programme

aims to engage, empower, and inspire young digital leaders and changemakers

by supporting innovative, community-driven projects that foster an

inclusive digital future.

Key Highlights of the Programme:

Eligibility: Applicants aged 18-28, currently enrolled in or recently

graduated from a STEM or related academic programme, with proficiency in

English.

Support Provided: Selected fellows will receive virtual mentorship and

leadership training sessions from ITU and Huawei. Additionally, they will

participate in an in-person global Development Week in Geneva, Switzerland,

in July 2025.

Each fellow will receive an initial grant of $5,000 USD to implement

their digital development project. Projects demonstrating significant

impact by the end of the year may receive an additional $5,000 USD to

scale up.

Application Details:

Deadline: Submit your application by 23:59 CET on Monday, 31 March 2025.

Application Form: https://itu.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_diIwpELBoUTmbxc

For more details, including FAQs, visit the official programme:

https://www.itu.int/generationconnect/empower/generation-connect-young-leadership-programme-in-partnership-with-huawei/

.

We encourage all eligible students to consider applying for this programme

to contribute to digital development and make a meaningful impact in your

communities.

Subject: IWD'25 Stalls Exhibition at SMV Pathway - reg
Body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students' Welfare extends warm greetings to all on the

occasion of International Women’s Day. This is a day to honor the

achievements and contributions of women across the world, and at VIT, we

are proud of our continuous efforts towards empowering women and fostering

an environment that promotes equality and development.

In celebration of this significant day, we invite you to visit the stalls

set up by our talented female students in front of the SMV Pathway. These

stalls will feature a variety of exciting activities such as games, face

painting, and other fun-filled events. Your presence and support will be

greatly appreciated as we come together to recognize and celebrate the

remarkable contributions of women in all spheres of life.

Let us join hands in commemorating this day and contribute to the continued

growth of women empowerment within our vibrant VIT community.

Intellectual Property Rights and the intricacies of patent filing.

Chennai

Vellore

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students' Welfare invites you for Special Event - VITMUN'25.

VIT Model United Nations Conference '25

VITMUN’25 is a three-day Model United Nations conference featuring seven

committees. It brings together some of the sharpest minds to engage in

rigorous debate, policy analysis, and strategic negotiations. With seven

diverse committees, delegates will tackle contemporary global challenges,

security crises, and governance issues with depth and precision.

From UNSC and DISEC addressing international security to SOCHUM and AIPPM

focusing on human rights and Indian politics, each committee is designed to

foster analytical thinking and diplomatic problem-solving. The flagship

CHAOS committee introduces a high-stakes, alternate reality scenario, while

JHES and ORF offer interdisciplinary approaches to policy discussions.

With expert executive boards and well-researched agendas, VITMUN’25

delivers a structured, high-impact MUN experience where delegates refine

their skills in negotiation, policymaking, and leadership.

Where Dialogue Drives Change. Where Your Voice Matters.

attachment.

Sub.: Code of Conduct for Students

Dear VITians,

VIT upholds discipline, integrity, and responsible conduct as its core

values. In this regard, all students are advised to strictly adhere to the

following guidelines to maintain a safe and respectful environment within

and beyond the campus.

Students are strictly advised to avoid using unauthorized rental bikes,

as they pose safety risks and violate campus regulations. Using such

services can lead to unforeseen accidents and disciplinary consequences.

Similarly, students must refrain from visiting places that may compromise

their security or well-being. Engaging in activities in such locations can

lead to serious repercussions, and the university strongly discourages such

behaviour.

It has been observed that some students misuse the leave policies by

providing false information to obtain unnecessary leaves. Such actions

disrupt academic schedules and will not be tolerated. Leaves must only be

taken for genuine reasons and with proper approval. Likewise, student ID

cards are meant strictly for personal identification and campus access.

Any misuse, such as lending, duplicating, or tampering with ID cards, is a

serious offense that will invite strict action.

The university also expects students to uphold the reputation of VIT at

all times. Posting misleading, false, or defamatory content about the

institution or any entity associated with the institution on social media

platforms, creating unwanted WhatsApp groups and making any religious or

racist comments through social media channels in any form is strictly

prohibited. Students are advised to use social media responsibly and ensure

that their online conduct reflects integrity, courtesy and respect for the

institution.

We seek your kind cooperation in maintaining the decorum of the university.

Any violation of these guidelines will result in disciplinary action as per

university policies.

Please refer to the Code of Conduct for students at the link given below.

Subject: Counselling Week- Day-5 Event & Valedictory-reg
Body:
Dear VITians,

Office of Students' Welfare invites you to the Day-5 event & Valedictory of

Counselling Week organised as part of the VIT's 40yrs of Celebration.

Youth Suicide Prevention

Suicide prevention is a crucial topic, especially among youth. We will have

a talk on "YOUTH SUICIDE PREVENTION" by Dr. Anish V. Cherian, Professor

of NIMHANS, Bangalore on 7th March 2025 at Era Sezhiyan, Mahatma Gandhi

Block from 2.30 pm to 04:30 pm. Dr. Cherian is the national representative

of India from 2024-2027 for the International Association of Suicide

Prevention and coordinates the partnership for life in the South-east Asian

region. He will focus on identifying early warning signs, breaking mental

health stigmas and promoting help-seeking behavior. He will provide

valuable insights into crisis intervention strategies and available mental

health resources.

The event will conclude with a valedictory ceremony to honor all

contributors and participants.

Registration through VTop

All are invited.

Subject: Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) - workshop invitation - Regd.
Body:
Dear All,

The Automotive Research Centre (ARC) warmly invites you to attend an

upcoming workshop on Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL). HIL simulation is a

powerful technique to develop and test complex real-time embedded systems,

such as Battery Management Systems (BMS). HIL simulation involves

connecting the controller (in this case, the BMS) to a real-time simulation

of the system. This allows the BMS to interact with a virtual environment

that mimics real-world conditions.

Event date and time: 12th Mar 2025 (Wednesday), 9.50 am - 1:00 pm

Event coordinator: Dr. A. Rammohan

Workshop benefits:

• Avenues for future capstone projects,

• Connections to related jobs and higher education opportunities,

• Possibility of conference presentation and journal publication,

• Patentable ideas for next-generation devices.

Subject: Counselling Week- Day-4 Events-reg
Body:
Dear VITians,

Office of Students' Welfare invites you to the Day-3 events of

Counselling Week organised as part of the VIT's 40yrs of Celebration.

Dance Therapy

Movement and dance can be powerful ways to express emotions and relieve

stress. We will have a workshop on dance therapy by Ms. Sivapriya

Madeswaran, a Dance movement therapy practitioner on 6th March 2025 at Era

Sezhiyan, Mahatma Gandhi block from 11 am to 1 pm.

The workshop will focus on dance movement therapy techniques to boost

confidence, improve body awareness, and promote emotional well-being

through expressive movements.

Street Play

A thought-provoking street play will be performed by our MSW Students on

6th March, 2025 in front of SMV (Sir Mokshagundam Visvesvaraya) building

Portico from 5.30 pm to 6.30 pm. Street play is a simple and effective way

of communicating a strong message which mostly does not involve any props.

The theme of this play is HAPPINESS FROM WITHIN.

The performance will depict real life scenarios, highlighting the

importance of mental health, self care and resilience in everyday life.

Registration through VTop

All are invited.

 Winter 2024-25 Regular Arrear and Fall 24-25 Re-FAT Approved Courses-

Registration

To: All Students (Vellore Campus)

Attention: 2025 Graduating Batch and Timed out Students

Sub: Registration for

(i) Winter 2024-25 Regular Arrear Examinations for 2025

Graduating Batch and Timed out Students for the courses in which they have

appeared and failed to clear ['F' & 'N1' grades] & absent in FAT ( N3

grade) 

(ii) Approved Re-FATs –Fall 2024-25 

Debarred students in FAT (N2 and N4) are NOT Eligible.

Registrations are open for the Re-FAT and Regular Arrear Examinations to be

Scheduled from 19th May 2025 onwards. (Tentatively)

For Re-FAT approved students, only the components to which approval has

been given should be registered and should adhere to the schedule given for

Re-FAT / Regular Arrear. Please note that there will not be any second

chance whatsoever be the reason for not appearing in Re-FAT. There is no

Fee for Re-FAT Process.

For Regular Arrear, Students should register for ALL the Components of a

selected course. Component wise registration is NOT permitted. For

example, if a course has both theory and laboratory components, the student

should register for both theory and laboratory components to clear the

backlog, even though the student would have cleared either the theory or

laboratory component of that particular course earlier. If a course has a

‘J’ component, the student should appear for the final review again. It

will be considered equivalent to FAT for the project component of the

course.

If a student fails to clear in the arrear examination, the student can once

again register for the subsequent arrear examination or for re-registration

in subsequent semester again as a complete course (all components).

No individual component of a course is permitted once someone registers

for an arrear for that course.

Regular Arrear Registration Dates

Registration Link & Online Fee Payment [Open/Close] [available in Student

login]

05-Mar-2025 to 24-Mar-2025

· Under No circumstances late registration/ payment

will be entertained.

· Students should register in V-Top and make necessary

payments (Rs.1000

per course only for Arrear Courses. No need to make any payment for Re-FAT)

.

· Kindly contact SDC for any V-Top login related issues.

· For any exam related queries can be send to support.coe@vit.ac.in

Body:
Dear Colleagues, Scholars, and Students

We are pleased to inform you that the School of Mechanical Engineering, in

collaboration with the Career Development Centre, will be hosting a

three-day Industry Academic Networking Conclave (IANC) 2025 from March 07

to March 09, 2025. The inaugural ceremony of IANC 2025 is set to take place

on March 7, 2025 (Friday) at 10:00 a.m. in Anna Auditorium. This year’s

conclave theme is “ReVITalization for a Sustainable Future”. 

As shared with you all in our earlier mail, the IANC 2025 events cover a

wide range of areas that include:

 - Aviation Technologies

 - Carbon Neutrality

 - Circular Economy

 - Climatic Change

 - Environmental, Social, and Governance

 - Future Materials and Manufacturing

 - Green Energy Technologies

 - Smart Mobility

 - Sustainable Healthcare Systems

This conclave brings together the representatives from more than 65

industries and organisations. Renowned experts in the field will deliver

plenary talks on the relevant issues. The conclave comprises 22 plenary

sessions, 4 panel discussions, and 8 technical challenges, all scheduled

over a span of three days. We firmly believe that the plenary sessions

promote innovative thinking and encourage multidisciplinary collaboration

between students and faculty. Attached is the complete agenda for the

plenary sessions.

 Highlights of the Conclave:

 - Exchange of MoU

 - Technical Challenge | Hack-a-Thon | Design-a-thon contests

 - Poster Presentation

 - Stalls by Industries & Students’ Teams

Furthermore, over 15+ industries will be participating on 06/03/2025 to

offer job opportunities to Diploma students at the Job Fair organised by

our Career Development Centre. Please find attached the inaugural

invitation and event schedule of IANC 2025 for your information.

We, the team of SMEC and CDC, extend a warm invitation to all to partake

in the inaugural ceremony of IANC 2025.

Thank you

Dear Students,

We are excited to announce that IPSA will be hosting its 2025 Summer

School in Paris, and we would like to invite our students to participate

in this exceptional event! 🇫🇷✨

A special discount (partner university) of €500 per student is applicable

once five students are enrolled, to cover the tuition fees! ✅

We hope that this discount will encourage you to study at IPSA!

Here’s a brief overview of the program:

📅 Duration: 3 weeks (July 7 - July 25, 2025)🦾 Courses: Programming,

Robotics, and Drones🗼 Cultural Visits: Eiffel Tower, Palace of Versailles,

Cruise on the Seine and more🌎 Meet students from around the

world💡 Interactive workshops with experts📜 Earn 6 ECTS (European credits)

Prerequisites: 

 - Basics of python and C/C++.

 - Intermediate programming skills.

 - Understanding of Object Oriented Programming.

 - Recommended to have 2 years of higher education in robotics.

Program fees: 

3.200 euros including accommodation, tuition, material kit, cultural

activities, lunch on course days, public transport pass

In order to apply, you must send the following documents in 1 PDF at

freemover@ipsa.fr

<freemover@ipsa.fr>:

1. Application form (attached)

2. Copy of passport

3. Official transcripts from home university

4. Proof of English language proficiency (B2 level)

5. Application fee (60 euros) 

Students from partner universities are exempted from the application fee.

Application deadline: April 30, 2025

If students are interested, there’s still time to register. For more

details, please check out the page here https://lnkd.in/e3D3Dn_h

Subject: Counselling Week- Day-3 Events
Body:
Dear VITians,

Office of Students' Welfare invites you to the Day-3 events of

Counselling Week organised as part of the VIT's 40yrs of Celebration.

Relationship & Mental Health

Healthy relationships play a crucial role in mental well-being. A powerful

talk and interactive sessions on RELATIONSHIPS AND MENTAL HEALTH will be

addressed by Dr. Mary Jessi Rani, Head of Department of Social Work,

Loyola College on 5th March 2025 at Era Sezhiyan, Mahatma Gandhi Block,

from 11 am to 1 pm. She will discuss the impact of relationships on

emotional health, the importance of communication, and strategies for

building meaningful and supportive connections. Dr. Mary will guide us on

how to navigate relationships in a way that fosters positive mental health.

Yoga Therapy Workshop

Exams are around the corner and with the approach of exams, stress levels

tend to rise. Yogacharya Anju Sakthivel, founder of Cosmic Yoga Studios

and Cosmic AYUSH Hospital will be the resource person for the yoga therapy

workshop on exam anxiety. Yogacharya Anju Madam is a distinguished expert

in yoga, naturopathy, and holistic wellness. She will introduce students to

simple yet effective yoga and breathing techniques to manage exam anxiety,

improve focus, and enhance relaxation.

Registration through VTop

All are invited!

Subject: Counselling Week Day-2 Events (March 4th, 2025)
Body:
Dear VITians,

Office of Students' Welfare invites you to the day-2 events of Counselling

Week organised as part of the VIT's 40yrs of Celebration.

Be limitless Be a Possibilitarian

Being a possibilitarian means embracing endless opportunities, thinking

beyond limitations and believing in the power of what can be. It’s about

seeing challenges as stepping stones and unlocking potential in yourself

and others. If you ever feel like you are stuck or unsure of your

potential, this session is for you. Mrs. Gauri Das, Senior Vice President,

India Factoring and Finance Solutions, Pvt. Ltd. is a TEDx speaker,

inspiring countless individuals to embrace possibilities and break through

limitations, passionate in women empowerment and founder of Leanin circle

called leaders lifting leaders. Drawing from real life experiences and

success stories, Mrs. Gauri Das will help students develop a resilient and

growth oriented outlook.

Art Therapy

Art Therapy is a treatment approach that integrates psychotherapy

techniques with the creative process to improve well being. Art therapy can

help people to improve their cognitive sensorimotor functions, build

self-esteem , self-awareness, reduce stress, anxiety, Improve social

skills,Resolve conflicts,Enhance emotional resilience, Promote insight and

Improve quality of life.

Greetings from the offices of the School of Mechanical Engineering &

Career Development Centre!

We are delighted to inform you that the School of Mechanical Engineering,

in association with the Career Development Centre, is organising the Third

Edition of “Industry-Academia Networking Conclave 2025” (IANC 2025)

during March 07-09, 2025. The following organisations have pitched

interdisciplinary

and multidisciplinary problem statements /tech challenges/ Design-a-Thon/

2,00,000/-

Kindly note that this presents a remarkable opportunity to engage with

authentic problem statements and potentially secure intriguing rewards!

The last date for registration regarding the technical problem statements

is March 4, 2025, by 5:00 p.m. In order to finalise and disseminate the

information to the organisations, I kindly ask that you comply with the

established timelines. Kindly adhere to the instructions provided in each

of the problem statements. The registration fee is non-refundable under any

circumstances.

We are pleased to inform you that the problem statements are available to

both undergraduate and postgraduate students across all branches and

disciplines. We kindly ask the Deans of other Schools and Faculty Members

to motivate their students to participate in the Tech-Challenges provided

by the Industries.

limitations, passionate in women empowerment and founder of Leanin circle

success stories, Mrs. Gauri Das will help students develop a resilient and

growth oriented outlook.

Art therapy

Art Therapy is a treatment approach that integrates psychotherapy

techniques with the creative process to improve well being. Art therapy can

help people to improve their cognitive sensorimotor functions, build

self-esteem , self-awareness, reduce stress, anxiety, Improve social

skills,Resolve conflicts,Enhance emotional resilience, Promote insight and

Improve quality of life.

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [1st March] 

events.

Today's Events:

· Catalyst: The Kickoff

· FinCreate- Design-a-thon

· InsightInk

· Basics of Asset Creation

· Empathy in Action: Voices for underprivileged Children

Scroll down for more details

BIF-VIT

Event Name: Catalyst: The Kickoff

Event Time: 04:00 PM - 07:00 PM

Event Description: Catalyst is an engaging and dynamic event designed to

bring together students from across the university in an environment that

encourages collaboration, fresh perspectives, and creative problem-solving.

Through a series of interactive activities and team challenges,

participants will have the opportunity to engage with diverse individuals,

exchange ideas, and build meaningful connections—all while exploring

innovative ways to create a positive impact.

Venue: Ambedkar Auditorium

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/share/p/_ffV6q5XZ

BULLS AND BEARS CLUB

Event Name: FinCreate- Design-a-thon

Event Time: 08:00 AM - 01:00 PM

Event Description: FinCreate – Where Finance Meets Design! Unleash your

creativity and revolutionize finance through design! Whether you're a UI/UX

enthusiast, web developer, or finance wizard, this is your chance to

innovate and create something extraordinary.

Venue: Bhagat Singh Gallery (SJT)

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link:

https://www.instagram.com/p/DGlvTjlzcNq/?igsh=MXJmMHFkcXJtOWltbg==

The Biotech Research Society India

Event Name: InsightInk

Event Time: 02:00 PM - 06:00 PM

Event Description: InsightInk is an event where research meets creativity.

This event is designed to highlight the art of scientific poster making,

transforming complex ideas into compelling visual narratives. Exploring the

principles of effective poster design, learning how to present research

with clarity and impact, and gaining insights into communicating science

through visuals. InsightInk is the gateway to mastering the science of

visual communication.

Venue: Homi Bhabha Gallery, SJT

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/brsivitvellore/?hl=en

Facebook Link: https://www.facebook.com/brsivitvellore/

Technology and Gaming Club

Event Name: Basics of Asset Creation

Event Time: 9:30 AM - 12:30 PM

Event Description: TAG Club will be hosting a asset creation and design.

Whether you're just starting out or looking to refine your workflow, this

session will give you the key principles needed to create high-quality

assets that elevate your projects.

Venue: Shakespeare Gallery, TT

Registration: VTOP

AIChE-VIT

Event Name: Cheme Clash

Event Time: 10:00 AM - 1:00 PM

Event Description: Cheme Clash is an event where technical challenges meet

icebreakers, where 2 randomly assigned teams will analyze and present

opposing perspectives on key engineering and scientific topics. With

limited time for research and poster creation, participants must think

critically, extract key insights, and communicate their arguments

effectively. This event aims at improving analytical skills, rapid

problem-solving, and technical communication in a competitive yet

collaborative environment.

Venue: Ambedkar Auditorium, TT

Registration: VTOP

LinkedIn Link: https://www.linkedin.com/in/aiche-vit-student-chapter/

ideas on how to help those in need. Each participant will have the

opportunity to express their thoughts and contribute to a collective effort

to support underprivileged children.

Event Description: Embark on a journey of discovery, innovation, and

connection with PATH TO PRO, a comprehensive roadmap-based event designed

to navigate the multifaceted landscape of technology. Delve into pivotal

domains such as frontend, backend, UI-UX, and AI-ML, gaining valuable

insights to shape your professional trajectory. Along the way, engage in

meaningful interactions and foster new connections--because in the realm of

technology, every impactful journey begins with collaboration and shared

ideas.

Venue: CS Hall

studies, and gain actionable insights to optimize workflows. Perfect for

leaders, managers, and professionals seeking to improve collaboration,

productivity, and operational success.

 - Clarity

Subject: Events to commemorate the International Women's Day Celebration' 25-reg
Body:
Dear VITians,

“A woman in harmony with her spirit is like a river flowing. She goes

where she will without pretense and arrives at her destination prepared to

be herself and only herself."

— Maya Angelou, late American memoirist, poet, and civil rights activist.

Greetings from the Office of Students’ Welfare!

40 Years of VIT, 40+ Events!

The exciting celebration of International Women’s Day is here, and this

time, we are going bigger than ever! As VIT proudly marks 40 years of

excellence, we are thrilled to bring you a weeklong celebration from March

3rd to March 7th, packed with 40+ events for female students, faculty,

staff, and research scholars, reflecting four decades of growth,

empowerment, and leadership.

This year's IWD theme: #AccelateAction

This special occasion is a tribute to the resilience, achievements, and

contributions of women in every sphere. With a diverse range of events

covering leadership, innovation, arts, and social impact, the week promises

a vibrant mix of learning, networking, and fun! Gear up for electrifying

cultural performances every evening as clubs, chapters, and literary

associations take the stage with mesmerizing acts at Greenos!

And to culminate this grand celebration, a special program is lined up on

March 8th to take this Women's Day celebration up a notch with inspiring

talks, recognitions, and memorable moments. Adding to the excitement,

special stalls will be set up on that day, bringing you a vibrant mix of

experiences, interactive activities, and delightful surprises.

Enjoy this weeklong celebration and be part of the excitement!

The registration links for students, faculty, staff, and research scholars

are given below and rules and regulations for the specific events are also

attached herewith.

Registration Links:

For Faculty/ Staff/ Research Scholars- https://forms.gle/kqEvDVLoVz3aEL876

For Students- https://forms.gle/PB7PSnqZ5LV8xXqi8

Stay tuned for more details on the schedule of events and activities

planned for this special occasion!

Subject: Team Levitate Hyperloop - Achievements at the Global Hyperloop Competition 2025
Body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to inform you that Team Levitate Hyperloop participated

in the Global Hyperloop Competition 2025, held from February 21st to

February 24th at IIT Madras. We competed in the DesignX Blueprint and

Innoquest tracks and are proud to share our achievements:

 - Best DesignX Blueprint Award (Overall DesignX Winners)

 - DesignX Blueprint Best Subsystem Award - Electrical

 - DesignX Blueprint Best Subsystem Award - Traction

 - DesignX Blueprint (Special Mention) - Embedded Systems

 - Innoquest First Runner- Up Award - Technical Research

 - Best Documentation Award

GHC 2025, Asia’s largest hyperloop competition, is hosted by IIT Madras in

collaboration with the Indian Railways and SAEINDIA. Amongst 10 teams, they

presented their innovative designs to national and international delegates,

industry experts, academia, and researchers over four days of rigorous

technical evaluations, design presentations, and workshops. Their

exceptional performance earned them six prestigious awards, highlighting

the team’s commitment to innovation and engineering excellence, further

solidifying their role in advancing hyperloop technology and bringing pride

to VIT on a global stage.

The First Memorial Lecture in the series, “Puratchi Thalaivar Dr. M.G.R.

Memorial Lectures” was launched on 26 February 2025 at 10:30 a.m. at Anna

Auditorium. Dr. M.G. Ramachandran was a mentor and guide to our Hon’ble

Chancellor throughout our Chancellor's career.

In commemoration of this event, a photo exhibition which includes rare

items from the collection of Dr. M.G.R. has been arranged at C. S. Hall.

Our Hon’ble Chancellor and the Chief Guest inaugurated the photo exhibition

before the lecture.

The exhibition is open for two days, 27 and 28 Feb. 2025 (Thursday and

Friday), for public viewing from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.

All are invited to visit and enjoy the photo exhibition.

Subject: Quality Week 24-25: Day-2 Special Events- reg
Body:
Dear VITians,

VIT celebrates Quality Week 24-25, a four-day journey of learning,

innovation, and performance, presented by the Office of Students' Welfare.

In celebration of VIT’s 40 years of excellence, we proudly bring you 40

impactful events. This year’s theme, “QUALITY: From Compliance to

Performance”, embodies our dedication to exceeding standards and fostering

a culture of excellence in all that we do. The Office of Students’ Welfare

invites you for today’s [Day 2] Quality Week events, brought to you by

the Student Council and various Clubs and Chapters.

Day 2 Events:

· Quality Week: Cybersecurity

· Quality Week: Clash of Minds

· Quality Week: Reelay

· Quality Week: AutoShield

· EcoVision

· PCB NEXUS

· Tashan-e-Bhangra

· Alochonar Ashor

Scroll down for more details

IEEE-ComSoc

Event Name: Quality Week: Cybersecurity

Event Time: 2:30 PM – 5:30 PM

Event Description: As part of Quality Week 2025, IEEE ComSoc VIT presents

an insightful session on "Quality in Cybersecurity", led by S. M. Farooq,

Assistant Professor. This session will delve into the critical aspects of

cybersecurity quality assurance, including secure software development,

risk management, compliance standards, and best practices for building

robust defense mechanisms. Join us in exploring how quality and

cybersecurity go hand in hand to create a safer digital future.

Venue: Shakespeare Gallery, TT

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/vitieeecomsoc/

LinkedIn link: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ieeecomsocvit/

ROTARACT CLUB-VIT

Event Name: Quality Week: Clash of Minds

Event Time: 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM

Event Description: Clash of Minds is a dynamic debate event where

participants shape the conversation. Engage in lively discussions on

societal, technological, and ethical issues. Raise a red flag to vote

someone out, a green flag to challenge an opponent, or vote yourself in if

you have the strongest argument. This event encourages critical thinking,

persuasive communication, and active participation. Whether experienced or

new, step in and control the debate!

Venue: Ambedkar Auditorium, TT

Registration: VTOP

MATRIX

Event Name: Quality Week: Reelay

Event Time: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM

Event Description: Reelay is a two-phase event where participants will

first search for movie clips based on a given theme. In the second half,

they creatively edit the clips into a seamless video using transitions,

effects, and music. The event tests creativity, storytelling, and editing

skills under a time limit.

Venue: Rajaji Hall, MB (Offline)

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/matrix.vit?igsh=MTdkYWRzZ21zMGFkNw

SAE-VIT

Event Name: Quality Week: Quality Week: AutoShield

Event Time: 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM

Event Description: Get ready for another exhilarating event AutoShield by

SAE VIT! An exciting challenge where teams pick a vehicle safety standard,

craft a Business Model Canvas and pitch an innovative safety product or

compliance strategy to tackle modern automotive safety challenges. Think

big, innovate, and drive the future of safety.

Venue: Kamaraj Auditorium, TT

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/sae_vit?igsh=dnJ2eG5pNWt4YnMz

ASCE-VIT

Event Name: EcoVision

Event Time: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Event Description: ASCE-VIT presents EcoVision, a workshop and competition

focused on enhancing the efficiency of solar and wind energy systems using

Autodesk Forma.

As part of Quality Week, this event emphasizes the role of data-driven

design in achieving sustainable and high-performance renewable energy

solutions.

Venue: CDMM 303

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/asce.vit?igsh=NGYxdHRvcXRsMDBj

IEEE-CAS

Event Name: PCB NEXUS

Event Time: 2:00 PM – 5:00 PM

Event Description: Precise and error free PCBs are essential for any

robotics and automation project, helping to enhance their quality and

performance. Join IEEE-CAS for an immersive PCB Design & Automation

Bootcamp! Learn PCB designing from scratch using industry tools, and apply

your skills in a hands-on project, integrating microcontrollers, sensors,

and motor drivers for high-quality designs. Perfect for students eager to

explore hardware design & embedded systems. Build, innovate, and automate!

Venue: TT VOC Gallery

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/ieee_cas_vit?igsh=eWMwYjA1OXUxanN5

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ieee-circuits-and-systems-vit/

Whatsapp channel:

https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaosmJC8PgsGrZIEts08

PLA-VIT

Event Name: Tashan-e-Bhangra

Event Time: 2:30 PM – 6:30 PM

Event Description: Learn the dynamic moves of Bhangra in a high-energy,

supportive environment. No experience necessary just bring your enthusiasm

and get ready to groove! From basic steps to signature moves, we'll guide

you through the exciting world of Bhangra.

Venue: CS Hall

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/pla_vit?igsh=em44aG5zcDdlMWd2

BLA-VIT

Event Name: Alochonar Ashor

Event Time: 8:00 AM – 11:00 AM

Event Description: On the occasion of National Science Day, Join BLA for an

inspiring event featuring a screening of Archaya Jagadish Chandra Bose, a

documentary that explores his contributions in the field of science.

Following the screening, we’ll open the floor for an interactive Open Mic

Discussion. Participants can share their thoughts, personal experiences,

and reflections on the documentary. Whether they have a story to tell, a

poem to share, or simply want to listen and engage, your voice matters!

Venue: Kamaraj Auditorium (offline)

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://instagram.com/aikyataan_vit?igshid=MzRlODBiNWFlZA

Body:
Dear VITians,

VIT celebrates Quality Week 24-25, a four-day journey of learning,

innovation, and performance, presented by the Office of Students' Welfare.

In celebration of VIT’s 40 years of excellence, we proudly bring you 40

impactful events. This year’s theme, “QUALITY: From Compliance to

Performance”, embodies our dedication to exceeding standards and fostering

a culture of excellence in all that we do. The Office of Students’ Welfare

invites you for today’s [Day 1] Quality Week events, brought to you by

Student Council and various Clubs and Chapters.

Day 1 Events:

· Quality in Ethics

· BOTM February Edition

· Unveiling React.js 

· Designing Dimensions with Figma, Spline and Dora 

· Astrogenesis

· Ezhuthu Sudar

· Shabdmanthan

· Debscope - The Social Network

Scroll down for more details

VIT LEO Club

Event Name: Quality in Ethics

Event Time: 2:00 PM – 5:30 PM

Event Description: Join us for Quality Week, where we offer a hands-on

workshop tackling real-life ethical dilemmas in professional and personal

relationships. Gain valuable insights on handling such challenges with

integrity and accountability. We are also excited to have Ms. Beulah

Valarmathi, VIT's esteemed counselor, who will lead a session on the

importance of ethics in today's world. Don’t miss this chance to learn from

experts and strengthen your ethical decision-making skills in both personal

and professional spheres.

Venue: TT VOC Gallery

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link : https://www.instagram.com/vit_leo_club/

Facebook Link: https://www.facebook.com/vitlionsclub/

The Next Chapter (TNC)

Event Name: BOTM February Edition

Event Time: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM

Event Description: Buckle up and get ready, because Book of the Month is

back! This February, Patroclus narrates his love for Achilles and the

turmoil he endured in the Trojan War in the novel “The Song of Achilles -

by Madeline Miller”.

Join us as we delve into their heroics, and the bond that they shared over

discussions and fun activities!

Venue: Homi Bhabha Gallery

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link:

https://www.instagram.com/p/DGTbJK2Bwif/?igsh=djJ4MW9reDZieW1z

IEEE Computer Society (CS)

Event Name: Unveiling React.js 

Event Time: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM

Event Description: Join us for an immersive React.js workshop, where you'll

explore the fundamentals of modern frontend development and build your

first dynamic web application. Designed for beginners, this session

emphasizes best coding practices to ensure clean, maintainable, and

high-quality software.

Venue: TT VOC Gallery

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link: https://www.instagram.com/ieeecs_vit/

LinkedIn Link: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ieee-cs-vit

Innovators Quest 

Event Name: Designing Dimensions with Figma, Spline and Dora 

Event Time: 8:00 AM – 1:00 PM

Event Description: Join us for an exciting workshop where you'll create a

basic UI layout in Figma, integrate 3D models with Spline, and add

interactive elements with Dora. By the end, you'll gain hands-on experience

in building immersive web experiences and get the chance to build your

personal portfolio!

Venue: TT Kamaraj Auditorium

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link:

https://www.instagram.com/p/DGcsL85za9I/?igsh=MXZ0emQ1M3NmeHRvZg==

Astronomy Club - VIT Stellar

Event Name: Astrogenesis

Event Time: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM

Event Description: Astrogenesis explores how Robotics and AI are

revolutionizing space research. Learn about cutting-edge innovations

enabling remote exploration, automated observations, and cosmic

discoveries. Discover how these technologies shape the future of astronomy,

pushing the boundaries of our understanding of the universe. Join us for an

exciting journey into space technology!

Venue: MB 210 (Smart Classroom)

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link:

https://www.instagram.com/vit_stellar?igsh=MWxldm13cGs1eW13dg==

PB - Tamil literary association 

Event Name: Ezhuthu Sudar

Event Time: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM

Event Description: Join us for an inspiring and interactive Tamil Writing

Workshop, organized by PB TLA, where creativity meets technique! Whether

you're an aspiring writer, a seasoned storyteller, or simply looking to

refine your Tamil writing skills, this workshop is designed to spark your

imagination and enhance your writing skills.

Venue: SAROJINI NAIDU GALLERY

Registration: VTOP

Hindi Literary Association (HLA)

Event Name: Shabdmanthan

Event Time: 2:00 PM – 7:00 PM

Event Description: Shabd Manthan – A special event exploring Hindi

literature, effective communication, and the essence of Rasa (emotions) in

literary expression. This program delves into the depth of language,

literary trends, and how emotions shape communication. Through the richness

of Hindi literature and Rasa theory, we aim to refine our expression and

understanding.

Venue: Shakespeare gallery (TT)

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link: https://www.instagram.com/hla_vitu?igsh=MWY0NDlrOWk0N2V1ZQ==

The Debate Society

Event Name: Debscope - The Social Network

Event Time: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM

Event Description: Join us for an engaging session on The Social Network,

organized by VIT Debate Society! We'll start with a screening of the film,

followed by a thought-provoking discussion on how movies shape public

awareness, challenge social norms, and influence cultural and political

discourse, offering fresh perspectives on the power of media in shaping the

world.

Note: Registration on VTOP is mandatory for the session to be counted

towards EXC attendance

Venue: Rajaji Hall

Registration: VTOP

Subject: Outstanding achievement of Team Orcus-reg
Body:
Dear VITians,

With great pride, we celebrate the outstanding achievement of Team Orcus,

who have secured FIRST PLACE in the 15kg category at RoboWars, held as

part of Kurukshetra 2025 at Anna University on 21st February 2025. Their

hard work, technical expertise, and unwavering commitment have brought

laurels to VIT.

Team Members:

Rohan Agrawal - 21BCE3957

Abdealy Zaveri- 21BME0080

Chaitanya Tejaswi - 22BCT0285

Shivam Pasi - 22BEI0102

Harsh Trushar Patel - 23BEE0021

A special appreciation to Dr. Senthil Kumar M (Emp ID: 10347), SMEC, the

faculty coordinator for his mentorship and guidance, which played a crucial

role in the team’s success. This victory is a testament to the technical

brilliance and competitive spirit of our students, reaffirming VIT’s

excellence in robotics and innovation.

Once again, congratulations to the team for this phenomenal accomplishment!

CC: Vice Chancellor <vc@vit.ac.in>, PROVC Vellore Campus <provc.vlr@vit.ac.in>, Aswani Kumar Cherukuri <aswani@vit.ac.in>, "Assistant Directors (Student Welfare) Group, Vellore Campus" <asstdirector.sw@vit.ac.in>, Secretary Student Welfare <secretary.sw@vit.ac.in>, studentcouncil.2024_25@vitstudent.ac.in, Yantra Student Welfare <yantra.sw@vit.ac.in>
Subject: Yantra'25 - Winners Announcement-reg
Body:
Dear VITians,

We are thrilled to celebrate the grand success of Yantra’25 - A week of

Technical Innovation, the 5th edition of VIT’s flagship techno-event, held

under the vibrant banner of VIT’s 40th year of excellence. This week-long

festival of innovation witnessed participation from students, bringing

together bright minds across disciplines to engage in cutting-edge

workshops, technical talks, hackathons, and competitions.

At the heart of Yantra'25 was Central Hack—VIT’s biggest and most

prestigious hackathon, where students collaborated to develop

interdisciplinary solutions addressing real-world challenges. This year’s

theme, AI for Sustainable Development Goals, provided a platform for young

innovators to craft impactful solutions that align with global economic,

social, and environmental progress.

We are delighted to announce the winners of all the events, and their

details are available in the attachment.

Checkout the results at yantra.swvit.in

Congratulations to all participants and winners for making Yantra’25 a

resounding success! Your passion, creativity, and dedication have truly

embodied the spirit of technological excellence and collaboration.

For any queries or clarifications, feel free to reach out to us at

yantra.sw@vit.ac.in.

Subject: Reminder: Hackathon 2025: Celebrating 10 years of innovation
Body:
UBS Campus Hackathon 2025 is here - where talent meets tech and coding

skills are put to the test!

We’re excited to invite students from your campus to join our on-site

Hackathon at offices in Mumbai and Pune, where they’ll collaborate and

compete in a professional, dynamic environment.

As we celebrate 10 years of impact in India, we remain committed to

engineering

excellence, simplification, and continuous learning to deliver

best-in-class solutions to our colleagues and clients.

What’s in it for them?

· Tackle real-world tech challenges

· Receive mentorship from industry experts

· Engage with UBS senior leadership

· Get a chance to fast-track into our Graduate Program

· What’s more? Winner gets a Home Pod mini by Apple; 1st Runner Up gets

JBL Live headphones and 2nd Runner up gets the JBL Bud earphones

How can they join?

The journey starts with a HackerRank test at your respective campus. The

top performers will qualify for the in-person Hackathon in March 2025!

HackerRank test details

· Test dates: 27 / 28 February (final date as confirmed by Training and

Placement Office)

· Test link: Sent one day in advance to eligible candidates via email

· Eligibility: Students pursuing their second/third year of Bachelor’s

Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and

Communication, Data Science with a CGPA of 8+ (applications to be

processed through campus Training and Placement Office)

· Results announced: Between 28 February to 1 March (confirmation from

respective Training and Placement Office)

Hackathon details

· Teams of up to six members

· In-person event at UBS Mumbai and Pune offices in March 2025

· UBS will cover travel, accommodation, and meals for outstation

participants

Local candidates from Mumbai and Pune will manage their own travel. UBS

will cover flights and cabs for outstation participants.

Interested and eligible students can register in the link below on or

before 21st Feb 2025 on or before 5.00 pmWithout fail.

https://forms.gle/TqNV5eCJ3Pc5Ejkq6

--
