Subject: Amateur Radio License Campaign by VARC - Reg.
Body:
Dear Students,

The VIT Amateur Radio Club (VARC) stands at the forefront of innovation in

radio communication. Based at VIT, they are committed to fostering a

community of technology enthusiasts and aspiring amateur radio operators.

The club is dedicated to promoting learning, exploration, and collaboration

through the fascinating world of HAM radio communication.

Discover more about their initiatives at https://vitarc.github.io.

HAM Radio, or amateur radio, is a globally recognized platform for

enthusiasts to engage in technical experimentation, emergency

communications, and cross-border collaboration through radio frequencies.

The Amateur Station Operator’s Certificate (ASOC), issued by the Ministry

of Communications, India, is a credential that authorizes individuals to

legally operate HAM radios.

VARC is thrilled to announce the license campaign for ASOC certification

and HAM Radio license. Inviting all faculty, students, research scholars,

and anyone with a passion for communication technology to take advantage of

this unique opportunity to become a licensed HAM radio operator. This

opportunity is open to all individuals, regardless of prior experience or

technical background.

The last date to submit your willingness through the form is 28-02-2025

(Friday) 11:59 pm. Join us to gain exclusive insights into the world of

radio communication and enhance your technical expertise.

Form Link: https://forms.gle/wvaEnmW9t4KQfw8Z6

To learn more about the certification process, eligibility criteria, and

training schedules, please visit the website or email us at vitarc@vit.ac.in.

Our team is ready to guide you through the application process and answer

any queries.

We look forward to welcoming you to the vibrant community of HAM radio

enthusiasts. Together, let’s explore the boundless possibilities of radio

communication!

Body:
Ref:

VIT/Regr./2025/036

 19 February 2025

CIRCULAR

Sub: Riviera 2025 Pro-Shows – Guidelines to be followed

The Riviera 2025 Pro-Show events will be held from 20.02.25 to 23.02.25 at

the SJT Ground from 6:00 p.m. onwards. The students are requested to abide

by the following guidelines for the same.

1. Students who have purchased tickets ONLY are permitted to enter the

venue from 5:00 p.m. onwards.

2. No students will be permitted after 7:00 p.m. to enter the venue.

3. Students are requested to confirm their registration through Face

Recognition System at the entry counter at the venue.

4. Pro-Shows tickets are not transferable under any circumstance

to other students.

5. Students have to undergo frisking before they reach the entry

counter.

6. Outside food, beverages, water bottles, backpacks, bags, and

all other takeaway items are strictly prohibited inside the venue.

7. Separate zones for standing and sitting have been arranged at the

venue. Zones B1 to B4 are for standing and Zones B5 to B8 are for sitting

on the boy’s side and similarly G1 and G2 are for standing and G3 and

G4 are for sitting on the girl’s side (Layout of the venue is attached

herewith).

8. A restricted number of students will be allowed in each zone and

they will be filled on first-cum-first-serve basis.

9. Students wanting to leave the venue in between the show will not be

permitted to

re-enter.

10. Any act of indiscipline by the student will be viewed seriously and

subject to severe actions as per the student code of conduct.

11. The Pro-Show venue is under CCTV surveillance.

12. Food stalls, drinking water, restrooms, and ambulance facilities are

available inside the venue. For any emergency, the student can contact the

faculty coordinators in the respective zones.

13. Eating places are provided near the food stalls. Taking food and

beverages inside the Zones is strictly prohibited.

14. Men's Hostel students are requested to enter the venue ONLY through

the Railway Underground Bridge (RUB) between SJT and PRP buildings. Entry

is not permitted through any other subway.

15. Day scholar boys will be permitted to enter the venue near RUB

adjacent to PRP (VAIAL entrance) through Gate 11 only.

16. Ladies Hostel students and day scholar girl students are requested to

enter the Pro-Show venue through the F-Block Ladies' Hostel gate. Day

scholar girls are allowed into the campus only through the Main Gate.

17. Students who are not attending the Pro-Shows are requested to leave

the campus before 7:00 p.m. from 20.02.25 to 23.02.25. The hostel-in-time

is 7:00 p.m. for students who are not attending the Pro-Shows.

18. Students are requested to collect their online deliveries before 5:00

p.m. from 20.02.25 to 23.02.25.

Your cooperation in this regard is highly solicited.

Enjoy the events and make Riviera 2025 a grand success!!!

Attachment_Names: ['Going to unsafe places.jpg', 'No rental vehicle.jpg', 'VIT Student-Code-of-Conduct_2024.pdf']
Body:
Dear Students,

Greetings from the Office of Students' Welfare!

Many cases of students travelling to remote locations and facing accidents

while using rental bikes have been reported in recent days. Exploring

unknown or remote places can put you in unsafe situations, especially in

case of encountering unfamiliar individuals whose intentions are far from

friendly. Poor network coverage, unpredictable terrain, and the lack of

immediate help can make emergencies worse. Ensuring students safety is our

utmost priority and hence we would like to bring to your attention the

potential risks associated with venturing into remote locations and renting

bikes, both of which can lead to serious consequences and should be

avoided.

Dangers of Travelling to Remote Locations:

Exploring unknown or remote places can put you in unsafe situations,

especially if you encounter unfamiliar locals with bad intentions. Poor

network coverage, unpredictable terrain, and the lack of immediate help can

make emergencies worse. Traveling in well-known areas with proper

precautions is always safer.

Rental Bikes – A Risk Not Worth Taking:

Renting bikes may seem like a convenient option, but poorly maintained

vehicles, lack of proper documentation, and legal issues can lead to

accidents and fines. Many rental services operate without proper

authorization, making you liable in case of an incident.

We strongly advise you to make responsible choices for your safety and

well-being. Students found travelling to remote places and using rental

bikes will face serious consequences.

VIT Student Code of Conduct:

https://vit.ac.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Student-Code-of-Conduct.pdf

Xavier’s University, Kolkata on 15th February 2025. The honour was bestowed

Dear Students,

 Darmstadt, Germany wishes to inform you about

1. Call for nominations for the winter 2025/26 semester

2. STIBET (DAAD) scholarship opportunities for students from certain

(overseas) partner universities

1. Call for nominations (winter 2025/26):

Nomination deadline:

15 March 2025

For overseas partners and partners from Turkey, we strongly recommend

nominating your students about 2 to 3 weeks before the deadline, as h_da

's application procedure may take up to 6 weeks, which in turn might lead

to a delay in your students‘ visa application procedure.

Application deadlines for students: 

· 1 May 2025 for students from overseas and Turkey

· 15 May 2025 for Erasmus and EUt+ students

Please see the attached pdf info sheet (h_da Application infos for

students) and/or the link to our Application website which is

https://international.h-da.de/en/index.php?id=22859. The application

website provides all the information you need.

2. STIBET (DAAD) scholarship opportunities for students

General information:

Here you may check whether or not you qualify for STIBET (DAAD) funding:

https://international.h-da.de/en/index.php?id=23187#c132092. Please note

that due to a change in funding, some changes have been made to the list of

universities eligible for STIBET funding. 

Procedure:

1. Students are nominated for an exchange semester.

2. Students apply within the deadline.

3. Students are officially admitted for an exchange semester at h_da.

4. Students apply for STIBET funding. Applying for STIBET funding can

only happen after students have been officially admitted (i.e. in

May/June for spring semesters, or November/December for winter semesters)

Interested students may register yourselves by filling the attached Google

Form using the link on or before the 15th of March, 2025

https://forms.gle/RzmFW7Hs2iUuktsLA https://forms.gle/RzmFW7Hs2iUuktsLA

Switzerland, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, and the United

States.

In addition to the exhibition, ACREX India 2025 will feature concurrent

events such as workshops, seminars, and the ACREX Awards of Excellence,

providing attendees with opportunities to gain insights into the latest

industry trends and advancements.

Subject: Congratulations SBE for their remarkable achievement at iCUBE 4.0!
Body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to announce that students of our very own club, Society

for Biological Engineering (SBE) have secured 1st place in “Idea-o-Lite” a

sub-event of iCUBE 4.0, conducted by Sri Venkateswara College of

Engineering, Sriperumbudur, Tamil Nadu on 7th & 8th February 2025.

Winners:

 - Krut Doshi (22BBT0134)

 - Rachit Upadhyay (22BBT0120)

 - Ratnadeep Das (23BBT0066)

 - Aanavi Patel (23BBT0017)

 - Harshita Kumar (23BBT0130)

iCUBE 4.0, is a National Level Intercollegiate Technical Hackathon

organized by Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering (SVCE), Sriperumbudur,

Tamil Nadu. It consists of two sub-events or tracks, namely- Innowel

(Innovation for Well-being) and Idea-o-Lite (Ideate to Illuminate).The

event was an ideathon where teams were challenged to develop innovative

ideas and solutions addressing real-world problems under the theme "Shaping

the Future: Innovations for a Better World." In addition to conceptualizing

their solutions, participants were also required to present business

proposals and models, which were evaluated as part of the competition. Each

team pitched their ideas to a distinguished panel of faculty members and

entrepreneurs.

Congratulations to our winners on this outstanding achievement! A special

appreciation to the faculty coordinator, Dr. Debasish Mishra (Emp ID:

13735), for his unwavering guidance and support throughout the journey.

Wishing them more success in their future endeavors! Congratulations to the

whole team once again.

Subject: Congratulations Team KalkiNI Runner up at GSEA-Chennai-reg
Body:
Dear VITians,

We are proud to celebrate the outstanding achievement of Team KalkiNI, a

pre-incubated startup at VITTBI, for their exceptional performance at the

Global Student Entrepreneur Awards (GSEA) Chennai. Out of 350 teams, Team

KalkiNI was selected among the top 5 finalists and went on to secure the

Runner-Up position, winning a cash prize of ₹75,000.

Their groundbreaking innovation—a multipurpose AI surveillance system

leveraging advanced computer vision for enhanced safety—has now earned them

a spot in the GSEA National Finals, placing them among the top 30 student

startups in India.

We extend a heartfelt congratulations to the following students who

represented Team KalkiNI and brought back laurels:

 -

 Ujjwal Aggarwal - 22BCE3499

 -

 Ved Raut - 22BCE2713

 -

 Shreyansh Shashwat - 22BCE2378

We once again congratulate and celebrate Team KalkiNI’s success and look

forward to cheering them on as they take their vision to the national stage.

Subject: Awareness Campaign on Chickenpox and Dengue Fever!
Body:
>

> Dear Students,

>

> Greetings from the Office of Students' Welfare

>

> Many cases of chickenpox and dengue fever have been reported at our health

> center in recent days. The changing season often leads to an increase in

> these illnesses, and it is crucial to stay informed and take preventive

> measures. As part of our commitment to ensuring the health and well-being

> of all students, we would like to bring your attention to two prevalent

> health concerns: chickenpox and dengue fever.

>

> Chickenpox

> Chickenpox is a contagious viral infection characterized by fever,

> fatigue, and a rash. To prevent its spread in shared living spaces:

> 1. Avoid contact with individuals showing symptoms.

> 2. Maintain proper hygiene, including regular handwashing.

> 3. Refrain from sharing personal items such as towels, clothing, or

> bedding.

>

> If you notice any symptoms, inform the hostel warden immediately and seek

> medical attention. Isolation will be arranged to ensure the safety of other

> residents.

>

> Dengue Fever

> Dengue fever, caused by the bite of the Aedes mosquito, is another

> concern. Preventive measures are crucial, particularly in hostel premises:

> 1. Keep doors and windows closed or use mosquito screens.

> 2. Wear full-sleeved clothing, especially during early morning and evening

> hours.

> 3. Regularly use mosquito repellents.

> 

>

> In case of symptoms such as high fever, severe headache, muscle pain, or

> rash, report immediately to the warden or hostel authorities for medical

> assistance.

> We urge all students to remain informed and proactive in maintaining

> personal hygiene and environmental cleanliness. Your cooperation is

> essential to mitigate the spread of these illnesses. For further assistance

> or queries, please contact the Office of Student Welfare.

>

> Let us work together to ensure a healthy and safe campus environment.

>

> Regards,

Dear VITians,

I am delighted to share that research conducted at our CO₂ Centre by two

second-year M.Sc. Chemistry students, Ms. Sreeshma (Reg. No. 23MSH0019) and

Ms. Tharinidevi (Reg. No. 23MSH0124), in collaboration with the Department

of Chemistry, SAS, has been published in the prestigious Chemical

Engineering Journal (Elsevier, Impact Factor: 13.4). This achievement

builds upon their contributions to previous SET conferences.

Publication Details:

Yesudas K. Yashly, S.P. Sreeshma, S.K. Tharinidevi, G. Buvaneswari, and

Annamalai Senthil Kumar, "Tailoring spinel cobalt-oxide geometry for

ultrahigh-sensitive nonenzymatic electrocatalytic oxidation and sensing of

glucose in batch injection analysis."

Chemical Engineering Journal, 2025. [DOI: 10.1016/j.cej.2025.160611 (In

Press)]

https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S1385894725014329?via%3Dihub

I sincerely appreciate these students' hard work and dedication to this

research project. Congratulations on this well-deserved accomplishment!

Body:
Dear VITians,

We are thrilled to announce the integration of VIT Community Radio 90.8

 with Suryan FM 93.9 Vellore in celebration of World Radio Day 2025 from

February 11th to 13th.

On February 11th, RJ Karthick, RJ Jawahar, RJ Sathish, RJ Barathi,

and RJ Sandhiya from Suryan FM co-hosted shows on VIT Community Radio.

On February 12th, our VIT Community Radio RJs co-hosted shows on Suryan

FM.

 1. RJ Shanjana R (22MID0215),

 2. RJ Aarthi S.K (23MSI0007),

 3. RJ Sriganth C (23BEC0124),

 4. RJ Jeevan S (23BBA0178),

 5. RJ Kalaiarasi N.G (23MIS0216) &

 6. RJ Srinivasan N (23BBP0015)

Join us on 13th February 2025 for a full day of live shows in Tamil,

English, Telugu and Hindi languages on VIT Community Radio 90.8! This

year's World Radio Day theme is "Radio & Climate Change," and all our

programs will explore the impact of climate change and ways we can

contribute to a greener future.

Tune in to 90.8 FM or listen live on our YouTube channel:

https://youtube.com/@vitradiolive?si=yVCMvEYoH2wPgFMY

Stay connected, stay informed!

Subject: 13th February - Today's events by Clubs and Chapters - Reg
Body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [13th February] 

events.

 Today's Events:

· The Grand Speech A Thon

· Blog Fury 1.17

· Tech Elevate 1.22

· Seed bank

· Echoes of Wetlands

· From Beginner to Leader: Your MUN Journey Starts Here

· SynergyX: Igniting change

· Reinventing Waste:- Sustainable Manufacturing Solutions

Scroll down for more details

Toastmaster International

Event Name: The Grand Speech A Thon

Event Time: 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM

Event Description: The Grand Speech A Thon is a dynamic event where

speakers captivate audiences with powerful storytelling, humor, and

inspiration. It’s an entertaining and educational experience, offering

insights into public speaking. With surprises, energy, and interactive

moments, this event ensures an engaging time for all—whether you’re here to

learn or laugh!

Venue: Shakespeare Gallery,TT

Registration: VTOP Registration

Instagram Link:

https://www.instagram.com/toastmastersvit?igsh=eGV1ZWZxcXUxOGZr

ASME-VIT

Event Name: Blog Fury 1.17

Event Time: 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM

Event Description: Blog Fury 1.17, a technical blog writing competition

exploring the complexities of space exploration. Participants will analyze

key challenges such as extreme environments, resource limitations, and

spacecraft sustainability while proposing innovative engineering solutions.

This event encourages in-depth research and critical thinking to highlight

the future of human and robotic missions beyond Earth.

Venue: GDN G07 (Offline)

Registration: VTOP Registration

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/asme.vit/

ASME-VIT

Event Name:Tech Elevate 1.22

Event Time: 3:00 PM – 5:00 PM

Event Description: TECH ELEVATE 1.22 features Dr. Rajya Lakshmi, Professor

at VIT, discussing Optimization Methods for Engineering Excellence. The

session will cover techniques like linear programming, genetic algorithms,

and gradient-based methods, highlighting their role in improving

efficiency, reducing waste, and enhancing product quality in design,

manufacturing, and resource management.

Venue: GDN G07 (Offline)

Registration: VTOP Registration

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/asme.vit/

Nature Lovers Club

Event Name: Seed bank

Event Time: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Event Description: Nature club is organising a seed bank event to discover

the wonders of the plant kingdom! This interactive event showcases a

diverse collection of seeds, highlighting their importance in conservation,

biodiversity. Through interactive displays, participants can learn about

seed conservation, and marvel at the unique characteristics of various seed

species on display.

Venue: SMV Portico (Offline)

Registration: VTOP Registration

Instagram Link: https://instagram.com/natureclubvit?igshid=YmMyMTA2M2Y

Nature Lovers Club

Event Name: Echoes of Wetlands

Event Time: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM

Event Description: Nature Club presents Echoes of Wetlands, a poster-making

competition to celebrate World Wetlands Day, encouraging creativity and

awareness about the importance of wetlands in preserving biodiversity,

combating climate change, and sustaining ecosystems. Participants will

visually express the significance of these vital ecosystems and inspire

action for their conservation.

Venue: CBMR hut

Registration: VTOP Registration

Instagram Link: https://instagram.com/natureclubvit?igshid=YmMyMTA2M2Y

MUNSoc-VIT

Event Name: From Beginner to Leader: Your MUN Journey Starts Here

Event Time: 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM

Event Description: Curious about MUN but don’t know where to start? Want to

sharpen your debating and diplomacy skills? Join us for an exciting

introductory MUN session/workshop designed to help beginners step into the

world of MUN! Learn MUN basics, from rules and research to public speaking

and strategy. Engage in fun activities, and get insights from experienced

MUNers.

Venue: Channa Reddy Auditorium

Registration: VTOP Registration

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/vitmunsoc?igsh=MXV5YXVhYW1kdzV6bw

BRSI-VIT

Event Name: SynergyX: Igniting change

Event Time: 11:00 AM – 12:00 PM

Event Description: Join us for a full-fledged guest lecture event, where an

expert in molecular biology and biotechnology will delve into the

transformative impact of these fields on drug discovery and industrial

applications. The talk will be infused with extensive passion and in-depth

understanding of the world of research, providing participants with

valuable knowledge to enhance their academic and professional journeys.

Venue: SMV209

Registration: VTOP Registration

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/brsivitvellore/?hl=en

Facebook Link: https://www.facebook.com/brsivitvellore/

SME-VIT

Event Name: Reinventing Waste:- Sustainable Manufacturing Solutions

Event Time: 5:30 PM – 6:30 PM

Event Description: Explore how sustainable manufacturing turns waste into

valuable products through innovative green practices. This presentation

highlights companies reducing waste, conserving resources, and adopting

circular economies. Discover real-world case studies and advancements

driving eco-friendly production for a more sustainable future.

Venue: GDN107

Registration: VTOP Registration

Event)

Event)

outstanding performance. Their hard work and passion have brought immense

pride to VIT. A special appreciation to Dr. Saravanan V (15247) the faculty

coordinator, for his invaluable support.

Once again, congratulations to the entire team of the ELA Club for their

extraordinary achievements!

Body:
Dear VITians,

As we commemorate 40 years of excellence at VIT, The Office of Students'

Welfare invites you to the 5th edition of Yantra – a weeklong tech fest.

Yantra 2025, scheduled from February 3rd to February 9th, 2025, promises

an exhilarating journey into the world of innovation and technology.

This edition will feature 60+ diverse events, designed to inspire,

educate, and challenge participants from all backgrounds. Our theme, “AI

for SDGs” (Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Development

Goals), highlights

the transformative role of AI in shaping a sustainable future.

Do not miss the opportunity to showcase and also enhance your technical

skills and talents!

Following are the events for YANTRA 2025 Day 7:

YANTRA SPECIAL EVENT

Event name : Yantra: Yantra Central Hack

Date : 07-02-2025 to 09-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 8PM

Venue : Anna Auditorium

Event Details : Yantra Central Hack is an event where participants from

diverse fields collaborate to solve real-world challenges. It fosters

teamwork, creative problem-solving, and technical skill development. The

event also offers opportunities for networking, learning, and staying

updated with industry trends and technologies.

 Registration: Register on VTOP

AMERICAN SOCIETY OF MECHANICAL ENGINEERS (ASME)

Event name : Yantra: CADvertise

Date : 08-02-2025 to 09-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 6PM

Venue : SJTG07

Event Details : CADvertise, organized by ASME VIT, is a dynamic product

development competition designed to cultivate innovation and

entrepreneurial skills among undergraduate students from mechanical and

interdisciplinary backgrounds. With a focus on fostering creativity,

technical expertise, and real-world problem-solving, participants will

ideate, design, and present a comprehensive 3D model of their product,

complemented by a promotional video showcasing its feasibility, societal

relevance, and market potential.

Registration: Register on VTOP

VIT MODEL UNITED NATIONS SOCIETY (VITMUNSOC)

Event name : Yantra: Muntra : "Engineering Solutions, Redefining

Diplomacy"

Date : 08-02-2025 to 09-02-2025

Time : 9AM to 5PM

Venue : MB210

Event Details : A two-day event where students will discuss pressing tech

issues like AI governance, cybersecurity, and data privacy. Topics will be

addressed sequentially, leading to a collaborative discussion to formulate

actionable solutions. The event aims to encourage critical thinking,

diplomacy, and problem-solving skills. Delegates will engage in structured

debates and negotiations to understand the global impact of technology. It

promises an enriching experience for participants passionate about

technology and global governance.

[image: ae6dca8c-2bdb-4faf-b7ce-9b3676d7dd00 - Jetty Venkata Hrishi Samay

23BCT0220.jpeg]

Registration: Register on VTOP

IEEE ENGINEERING IN MEDICINE & BIOLOGY SOCIETY (IEEE-EMBS)

Event name : Yantra: TrackCal

Date : 09-02-2025 to 09-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 6PM

Venue : Kamaraj Auditorium

Event Details : TrackCal is a one day workshop from 9 am to 7 pm where

participants get to build a heart rate sensor and a pedometer and the data

from the two is fed into a ML model that calculates the calories burnt. The

event starts with a theory session followed by a lunch break and then the

hands on workshop session.

Body:
Dear VITians,

As we commemorate 40 years of excellence at VIT, The Office of Students'

Welfare invites you to the 5th edition of Yantra – a weeklong tech fest.

Yantra 2025, scheduled from February 3rd to February 9th, 2025, promises

an exhilarating journey into the world of innovation and technology.

This edition will feature 60+ diverse events, designed to inspire,

educate, and challenge participants from all backgrounds. Our theme, “AI

for SDGs” (Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Development

Goals), highlights

the transformative role of AI in shaping a sustainable future.

Do not miss the opportunity to showcase and also enhance your technical

skills and talents!

Following are the events for YANTRA 2025 Day 6:

YANTRA SPECIAL EVENT

Event name : Yantra: Yantra Central Hack

Date : 07-02-2025 to 09-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 8AM

Venue : Anna Auditorium

Event Details : Yantra Central Hack is an event where participants from

diverse fields collaborate to solve real-world challenges. It fosters

teamwork, creative problem-solving, and technical skill development. The

event also offers opportunities for networking, learning, and staying

updated with industry trends and technologies.

Registration: Register on VTOP

BULLS AND BEARS CLUB

Event name :

Yantra: Dalal Street 2.0Date : 07-02-2025 to 08-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 8PM

Venue : CS Hall

Event Details : Yantra-Dalal Street Do you know how trading used to happen

back in the day? Find out at our event! Relive the thrill of classic market

action with a modern twist in Dalal Street 2.0! From IPOs to stock indexes,

dive into a dynamic experience that bridges the past and present of the

financial world. Get ready to trade like never before!

Registration: Register on VTOP

ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING SOCIETY OF INDIA (AMSI)

Event name :

Yantra: Pixel to Product 2.0Date : 07-02-2025 to 08-02-2025

Time : 9AM to 8PM

Venue : Bhagat Singh Gallery

Event Details : Join us for an extraordinary journey into the world of

additive manufacturing, where innovation meets reality. Discover the

limitless possibilities of 3D printing, enhance your skills in CAD/CAM, and

showcase your creativity by solving real-world design challenges. Selected

teams will bring their ideas to life through 3D printing, with the top team

earning the unique opportunity to metal print their creation.

Registration: Register on VTOP

IEEE PROFESSIONAL COMMUNICATION SOCIETY (IEEE-PCS) AND SCRS

Event name :

Yantra: Survival.exeDate : 07-02-2025 to 08-02-2025

Time : 10AM to 8PM

Venue : Era Shzyian, MGB

Event Details : Experience the thrill of coding like never before with

Survival.exe, a Squid Game-inspired elimination-based competition. Over

1-2 days, face a series of dynamic challenges designed to test your coding

skills, problem-solving, and adaptability under pressure. With each round

more intense than the last, only the sharpest and fastest will survive to

the end. Perfect for both beginners and seasoned coders, this event

promises high-energy competition, real-world coding scenarios, and a chance

to prove your mettle.

Registration: Register on VTOP

SOCIETY OF AUTOMOTIVE ENGINEERS ( SAE-VIT )

Event name : Yantra: DriveAble

Date : 07-02-2025 to 08-02-2025

Time : 9PM to 8AM

Venue : Sarojini Naidu Gallery

Event Details : Develop an integrated system for smart cars that empowers

elderly or disabled drivers with mobility challenges. Your system should

prioritize user safety and independence by offering personalized assistance

features.

 Registration: Register on VTOP

TEAM ROTORFPV - SOCIETY OF AUTOMOTIVE ENGINEERS (SAE)

Event name : Yantra: Drone it Yourself

Date : 07-02-2025 to 08-02-2025

Time : 9AM to 6PM

Venue : TT VOC Gallery II

Event Details : Team Rotor FPV presents a 2-day drone design-a-thon where

participants learn drone CAD design, collaborate in teams, and create drone

prototypes to tackle real-world problems. The event features workshops,

mentoring sessions, and a final pitch to showcase designs and receive

expert feedback. Open to all skill levels, it’s an opportunity to innovate,

iterate, and shape the future of drone technology. No prior experience

required! The only prerequisite is to install Fusion 360 before the event.

Registration: Register on VTOP

NATURE LOVERS CLUB

Event name : Yantra: AI for Resilient Cities: “Engineering Sustainability

and Climate Harmony”

Date : 08-02-2025 to 08-02-2025

Time : 10AM to 1PM

Venue : Kamaraj Auditorium

Event Details : Are you ready to shape the cities of tomorrow? Step into

the world of cutting-edge AI and discover its transformative potential to

create sustainable, disaster-resilient urban spaces. This unique Ideathon

challenges you to push the boundaries of innovation and develop AI-powered

solutions that align with SDG 11 (Sustainable Cities) and SDG 13 (Climate

Action). Showcase your creativity, inspire change, and contribute to a

smarter, greener future!

 Registration: Register on VTOP

AMERICAN SOCIETY OF MECHANICAL ENGINEERS (ASME)

Event name : Yantra: CADvertise

Date : 08-02-2025 to 09-02-2025

Time : 2PM to 8PM

Venue : Kamaraj Auditorium

Event Details : CADvertise, organized by ASME VIT, is a dynamic product

development competition designed to cultivate innovation and

entrepreneurial skills among undergraduate students from mechanical and

interdisciplinary backgrounds. With a focus on fostering creativity,

technical expertise, and real-world problem-solving, participants will

ideate, design, and present a comprehensive 3D model of their product,

complemented by a promotional video showcasing its feasibility, societal

relevance, and market potential.

Registration: Register on VTOP

STUDENTS FOR EXPLORATION AND DEVELOPMENT OF SPACE (SEDS-VIT)

Event name : Yantra: Ouranos

Date : 08-02-2025 to 08-02-2025

Time : 9AM to 3PM

Venue : Homi Bhabha Gallery

Event Details : Join our beginner-friendly Spacecraft Workshop, where

you'll delve into the fundamentals of coding, design, and simulation. This

hands-on experience is perfect for anyone interested in space technology,

regardless of their prior knowledge. You'll learn how to design and build a

space-inspired project, code using Arduino, and bring your ideas to life

through simulation. The workshop is designed to be accessible and engaging,

making it ideal for anyone passionate about learning and creativity.

Registration: Register on VTOP

SOCIETY OF AUTOMOTIVE ENGINEERS (SAE)

Event name : Yantra: Helios Hack: Designathon and Ideathon

Date : 08-02-2025 to 08-02-2025

Time : 9AM to 7PM

Venue : Sarojini Naidu Gallery

Event Details : Join us for Helios Hack, a dynamic workshop centered on the

fundamentals of solar-powered electric vehicles. This immersive program

includes an engaging Ideathon and Designathon, where participants will

tackle real-world problem statements provided by us, also discussing the

applications of autonomous systems in the vehicle. Through collaborative

brainstorming and design sessions, we aim to guide participants in

developing innovative solutions tailored to our specific needs.

Registration: Register on VTOP

THE BIOTECH RESEARCH SOCIETY, INDIA (BRSI)

Event name : Yantra: BioXchange

Date : 08-02-2025 to 08-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 1PM

Venue : MB210

Event Details : An intellectual Panel Discussion on the interplay of AI and

biotechnology to achieve real time solutions to real world problems under

SDG's. A panel will be assembled consisting of esteemed faculties and the

discussion will begin based on their area of expertise. All the

participants will get an opportunity to express themselves and there will

be an interactive session at the end to get complete clarity on what has

been discussed and understood throughout the fruitful discussion.

 Registration: Register on VTOP

IOTHINC

Event name : Yantra: Innovate for Impact: Driving the SDG agenda with IOT

(IOTHINC)

Date : 08-02-2025 to 08-02-2025

Time : 2PM to 8PM

Venue : MB210

Event Details : This initiative explores how Internet of Things (IoT)

technologies can help achieve the United Nations' Sustainable Development

Goals (SDGs). By using IoT solutions for real-time data collection and

system optimization, it addresses global challenges like poverty, health,

clean energy, and climate action. The focus is on creating impactful,

scalable projects that contribute to sustainability, improve quality of

life, and promote equitable access to resources, all while fostering

collaboration between innovators, industries, and communities.

 Registration: Register on VTOP

VIT MODEL UNITED NATIONS SOCIETY (VITMUNSOC)

Event name : Yantra: Muntra : "Engineering Solutions, Redefining

Diplomacy"

Date : 08-02-2025 to 09-02-2025

Time : 9AM to 5PM

Venue : Rajaji Hall

Event Details : A two-day event where students will discuss pressing tech

issues like AI governance, cybersecurity, and data privacy. Topics will be

addressed sequentially, leading to a collaborative discussion to formulate

actionable solutions. The event aims to encourage critical thinking,

diplomacy, and problem-solving skills. Delegates will engage in structured

debates and negotiations to understand the global impact of technology. It

promises an enriching experience for participants passionate about

technology and global governance.

[image: ae6dca8c-2bdb-4faf-b7ce-9b3676d7dd00 - Jetty Venkata Hrishi Samay

23BCT0220.jpeg]

Registration: Register on VTOP

SOCIETY OF AUTOMOTIVE ENGINEERS (SAE)

Event name : Yantra: Model Mania

Date : 08-02-2025 to 08-02-2025

Subject: Congratulations Team Rotor FPV bagged the First prize!
Body:
Dear VITians,

Happy to share that Team Rotor FPV bagged the First prize in the

International

Space Drone Competition, organized by the Space Robotics Society

(SPROS) at BITS

Pilani Goa from 31st January to 2nd February 2025. It is one of the world's

largest space robotics events. A total of 50 teams registered Worldwide and

23 teams qualified for final participation, out of these our Team Rotor FPV was

the overall winner of the International Space Drone Competition 2025.

The team performed navigation mission, PIMA presentations, and Space mission,

in all the missions secured top scores which led to overall champions

worldwide.

Congratulations to team members and the Faculty coordinator Dr. Tapano

Kumar Hotta (Emp. ID-14800), SMEC for the support and guidance for the team.

Body:
Dear VITians,

As we commemorate 40 years of excellence at VIT, The Office of Students'

Welfare invites you to the 5th edition of Yantra – a weeklong tech fest.

Yantra 2025, scheduled from February 3rd to February 9th, 2025, promises

an exhilarating journey into the world of innovation and technology.

This edition will feature 60+ diverse events, designed to inspire,

educate, and challenge participants from all backgrounds. Our theme, “AI

for SDGs” (Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Development

Goals), highlights

the transformative role of AI in shaping a sustainable future.

Do not miss the opportunity to showcase and also enhance your technical

skills and talents!

Following are the events for YANTRA 2025 Day 5:

YANTRA SPECIAL EVENT

Event name : Yantra: Yantra Central Hack

Date : 07-02-2025 to 09-02-2025

Time : 3PM to 8AM

Venue : Anna Auditorium

Event Details : Yantra Central Hack is an event where participants from

diverse fields collaborate to solve real-world challenges. It fosters

teamwork, creative problem-solving, and technical skill development. The

event also offers opportunities for networking, learning, and staying

updated with industry trends and technologies.

 Registration: Register on VTOP

IEEE SOCIETY ON SOCIAL IMPLICATIONS OF TECHNOLOGY (IEEE-SSIT)

Event name : Yantra: Code for change 2.0

Date : 05-02-2025 to 07-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 2PM

Venue : Ambedkar Auditorium

Event Details : Code4Change, one of the premier hackathon-ideathon

competitions held at VIT, stands as a beacon of creativity,

problem-solving, and technical innovation. The event, acclaimed for its

seamless organization and widespread participation, focuses on leveraging

technology to address pressing real-world challenges. The 2025 edition

emphasizes Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and Artificial Intelligence

(AI), encouraging participants to create impactful solutions that drive

sustainable progress.

Registration: Register on VTOP

AMERICAN INSTITUTE OF CHEMICAL ENGINEERS (AICHE)

Event name :

Yantra: Elemental Fourfold ForgeDate : 06-02-2025 to 07-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 8PM

Venue : Homi Bhabha Gallery

Event Details : Embrace a challenge where Earth, Water, Fire, and Air spark

creative solutions. This inclusive event welcomes participants of all skill

levels, offering a stress-free environment for collaboration and

innovation. Each element presents a unique challenge, fostering teamwork

and creative problem-solving. Leverage nature’s power to develop impactful,

sustainable solutions. Ready to bring your ideas to life and rise to the

challenge? The elements are waiting for you!

 Registration: Register on VTOP

ASSOCIATION FOR COMPUTING MACHINERY (ACM-VIT)

Event name :

Yantra: Reverse CodingDate : 07-02-2025 to 07-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 8PM

Venue : Anna Auditorium and CS Hall

Event Details : Reverse Coding is ACM-VIT's flagship competitive coding

competition with a twist. Instead of conventional problem statements, teams

will be given test cases and executables to find and understand the logic

and code it in a programming language of their choice.

 Registration: Register on VTOP

SOCIETY FOR INDUSTRIAL AND APPLIED MATHEMATICS (SIAM)

Event name :

Yantra: Coding RelayDate : 07-02-2025 to 07-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 2PM

Venue : MB210

Event Details : Join the Ultimate Coding Relay! Get ready for an

action-packed challenge where teams race against the clock to solve

multiple coding problems. The twist? At regular intervals, you’ll switch

tasks with your teammates, keeping everyone on their toes and ensuring no

one can stay in their comfort zone. This event will push your agility,

teamwork, and problem-solving skills to the limit. Can your team handle the

pressure, adapt quickly, and emerge as the ultimate champions?

 Registration: Register on VTOP

IEEE WOMEN IN ENGINEERING (IEEE-WIE)

Event name :

Yantra: WIEnfluenceDate : 07-02-2025 to 07-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 2PM

Venue : Bhagat Singh Gallery

Event Details : WIEnfluence is a beginner-friendly workshop where we'll

guide you to create and host your very own digital resume using HTML, CSS,

JavaScript, GitHub, and AI. Build your web portfolio step-by-step with us,

and customize it with AI to showcase the perfect 'you'!

Registration: Register on VTOP

BULLS AND BEARS CLUB

Event name :

Yantra: Dalal Street 2.0Date : 07-02-2025 to 08-02-2025

Time : 9PM to 8PM

Venue : CS Hall

Event Details : Yantra-Dalal Street Do you know how trading used to happen

back in the day? Find out at our event! Relive the thrill of classic market

action with a modern twist in Dalal Street 2.0! From IPOs to stock indexes,

dive into a dynamic experience that bridges the past and present of the

financial world. Get ready to trade like never before!

Registration: Register on VTOP

ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING SOCIETY OF INDIA (AMSI)

Event name :

Yantra: Pixel to Product 2.0Date : 07-02-2025 to 08-02-2025

Time : 2PM to 8PM

Venue : Bhagat Singh Gallery

Event Details : Join us for an extraordinary journey into the world of

additive manufacturing, where innovation meets reality. Discover the

limitless possibilities of 3D printing, enhance your skills in CAD/CAM, and

showcase your creativity by solving real-world design challenges. Selected

teams will bring their ideas to life through 3D printing, with the top team

earning the unique opportunity to metal print their creation.

Registration: Register on VTOP

SOCIETY FOR BIOLOGICAL ENGINEERING

Event name :

Yantra: Sustain-a-cityDate : 07-02-2025 to 07-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 8PM

Venue : TT Gallery 1 (Shakespeare Gallery)

Event Details : Sustain-a-city is an engaging and strategy-driven event

where participants will compete to build and develop their own cities

across various core sectors. By integrating biotechnology or artificial

intelligence, participants will craft creative and feasible ideas to

develop the city. Participants will have to adapt to dynamic changes and

remain calm under pressure.

Registration: Register on VTOP

IEEE: INFORMATION THEORY SOCIETY

Event name :

Yantra: TechTrek 3.0Date : 07-02-2025 to 07-02-2025

Time : 9AM to 4PM

Venue : Kamaraj Auditorium

Event Details : Join us for TechTrek 3.0: sustAIn, an enlightening event

featuring Thangadurai Muthusamy as we delve into the transformative role of

AI in achieving Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Explore how AI is

tackling global challenges like climate change, clean energy, and

sustainable industries through innovative solutions.

Registration: Register on VTOP

IEEE PROFESSIONAL COMMUNICATION SOCIETY (IEEE-PCS) AND SCRS

Event name :

Yantra: Survival.exeDate : 07-02-2025 to 08-02-2025

Time : 10AM to 8PM

Dear VITians,

As we commemorate 40 years of excellence at VIT, The Office of Students'

Welfare invites you to the 5th edition of Yantra – a weeklong tech fest.

Yantra 2025, scheduled from February 3rd to February 9th, 2025, promises

an exhilarating journey into the world of innovation and technology.

This edition will feature 60+ diverse events, designed to inspire,

educate, and challenge participants from all backgrounds. Our theme, “AI

The competition was an exhibition-based event where teams pitched their

innovations and projects. Our team primarily focused on showcasing our

student research and the components developed for the rocket, which became

a key highlight for the judges.

played a significant role in achieving this success. We would like to

congratulate the team members and the faculty coordinator Dr. Senthil

Team Sammard.

Body:
Dear VITians,

As we commemorate 40 years of excellence at VIT, The Office of Students'

Welfare invites you to the 5th edition of Yantra – a weeklong tech fest.

Yantra 2025, scheduled from February 3rd to February 9th, 2025, promises

an exhilarating journey into the world of innovation and technology.

This edition will feature 60+ diverse events, designed to inspire,

educate, and challenge participants from all backgrounds. Our theme, “AI

for SDGs” (Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Development

Goals), highlights

the transformative role of AI in shaping a sustainable future.

Do not miss the opportunity to showcase and also enhance your technical

skills and talents!

Following are the events for YANTRA 2025 Day 3:

CODECHEF-VIT

Event name : Yantra: DevSOC'25

Date : 03-02-2025 to 05-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 1PM

Venue : ANNA AUDITORIUM

Event Details : DevSOC'25, the flagship hackathon by CodeChef-VIT, returns

for its sixth edition—an intense 48-hour sprint fostering innovation,

creativity, and collaboration. As a FOSS event, it empowers young minds to

connect, solve challenges, and push technological boundaries.

Registration: Register on VTOP

IEEE SOCIETY ON SOCIAL IMPLICATIONS OF TECHNOLOGY (IEEE-SSIT)

Event name : Yantra: Code for change 2.0

Date : 05-02-2025 to 07-02-2025

Time : 2PM to 2PM

Venue : Anna Auditorium

Event Details : Code4Change, one of the premier hackathon-ideathon

competitions held at VIT, stands as a beacon of creativity,

problem-solving, and technical innovation. The event, acclaimed for its

seamless organization and widespread participation, focuses on leveraging

technology to address pressing real-world challenges. The 2025 edition

emphasizes Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and Artificial Intelligence

(AI), encouraging participants to create impactful solutions that drive

sustainable progress.

Registration: Register on VTOP

IEEE PROFESSIONAL COMMUNICATION SOCIETY (IEEE-PCS)

Event name : Yantra: Connectron

Date : 05-02-2025 to 06-02-2025

Time : 10AM to 8PM

Venue : Ambedkar Auditorium

Event Details : "Connectron" is a two-day, one-night immersive event

designed to bring together innovators, technologists, and changemakers to

create solutions aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The

event kicks off with an inspiring speaker session, where industry leaders

share insights on the impact of technology in advancing sustainability.

Participants will then dive into an intensive hackathon, spanning two days

and one night, centered around four key tracks: Web Development, IoT

Solutions, Embedded Systems and Electronics, and AI/ML.

Registration: Register on VTOP

IEEE SIGNAL PROCESSING SOCIETY (IEEE-SPS)

Event name : Yantra: Hardware Hustle

Date : 05-02-2025 to 05-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 8PM

Venue : Kamaraj Auditorium

Event Details : It is an exciting hardware hackathon with a fun twist.

Participants will start with a set number of points to trade for components

and problem statements. Simpler problems cost more, adding a risk-reward

dynamic to the competition. Earn extra points by competing in fun technical

and aptitude mini-games held at intervals, testing innovation, strategy and

time management.

Registration: Register on VTOP

IEEE-ROBOTICS & AUTOMATION SOCIETY (IEEE-RAS)

Event name : Yantra: Reboot

Date : 05-02-2025 to 05-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 8PM

Venue : TT VOC Gallery II

Event Details : Reboot is a 36-hour hackathon centred on the theme

“Sustainable AI: Tackling Global Challenges Through Technology.” It

Subject: Technical Team Proposal on "AI based Waste Segregation Solutions" - reg
Body:
Dear VITians,

Calling all AI Enthusiasts!

The Office of Students' Welfare is pleased to invite applications from

students passionate about artificial intelligence and its real-world

applications. We are forming a dedicated technical team to develop an

AI-based prototype for a waste segregation system. This initiative aims to

enhance efficiency in waste management, promote sustainability, and

contribute to a cleaner environment through innovative AI solutions.

Eligibility: Minimum CGPA of 7.00

This team will provide a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in

AI-driven waste segregation, collaborate on impactful projects, and enhance

technical and problem-solving skills. It will also offer exposure to

real-world applications of AI in sustainability, fostering a culture of

innovation within VIT.

We believe that this initiative will be a valuable addition to the VIT

community, empowering students to explore their AI ambitions while

addressing critical environmental challenges.

Interested students are required to submit their applications through the

following Google Form by 01st March 2025:

https://forms.gle/ks82vrJHxXSLNE7q9

Shortlisted applicants will be invited for an interview to further discuss

their skills and interests.

We look forward to enthusiastic participation from students who are eager

to contribute to this initiative.

Last Date: 01st March, 2025

Body:
Dear VITians,

As we commemorate 40 years of excellence at VIT, The Office of Students'

Welfare invites you to the 5th edition of Yantra – a weeklong tech fest.

Yantra 2025, scheduled from February 3rd to February 9th, 2025, promises

an exhilarating journey into the world of innovation and technology.

This edition will feature 60+ diverse events, designed to inspire,

educate, and challenge participants from all backgrounds. Our theme, “AI

for SDGs” (Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Development

Goals), highlights

the transformative role of AI in shaping a sustainable future.

Do not miss the opportunity to showcase and also enhance your technical

skills and talents!

Following are the events for YANTRA 2025 Day 2:

YANTRA SPECIAL EVENT

Event Name : Yantra: Proctor Proctee Hack

Date : 03-02-2025 to 05-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 8PM

Venue : CS Hall

Event Details : Unlock the opportunity to work together with a proctor who

will mentor the proctees. You can form teams to work on groundbreaking

projects which will drive innovation, fostering teamwork and creativity.

Registration: Register on VTOP

ALPHA BIO CELL (ABC)

Event name : Yantra: Hack-A-Pill

Date : 04-02-2025 to 04-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 7PM

Venue : Era Shzyian, MGB

Event Details : The workshop is designed to provide participants with the

skills to carry out qualitative analysis of drug-likeness and its ADME

(Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, and Excretion) properties through

interactive problem-solving sessions. Participants will gain hands-on

experience with Weka, a free and user-friendly data mining software. Along

with the application of neural networks, participants will explore the

quantitative analysis of drug structures and their effect on bodily

activity.

Registration: Register on VTOP

VIT STELLAR - THE ASTRONOMY CLUB

Event name : Yantra: Spinfinity

Date : 04-02-2025 to 04-02-2025

Time : 9AM to 1PM

Venue : MB210

Event Details : Join VIT Stellar on a one day workshop which will take you

on a pulse journey into the world of technical astronomy. Here, you will be

shown how the actual telescope data is used to capture information about

one of the densest objects in our universe - Pulsars. Learn about how these

behemoths are formed and bizarre properties and analyse their breathtaking

beauty.

Registration: Register on VTOP

IEEE POWER ELECTRONICS SOCIETY (IEEE - PELS)

Event name :

Yantra: Sustainable prototyping with TinkercadDate : 04-02-2025 to

04-02-2025

Time : 3PM to 6PM

Venue : Shakespeare Gallery

Event Details : This hands-on workshop introduces participants to

Tinkercad, a beginner-friendly tool for electronics and 3D modeling,

focusing on sustainability-driven designs. Participants will learn to

design and simulate electronic circuits and 3D models. Work on prototypes

addressing SDGs, such as smart irrigation systems, waste management

devices, and renewable energy solutions. Gain practical skills to develop

innovative technology prototypes with real-world applications.

Registration: Register on VTOP

ADVERTISING AND MARKETING CLUB, MOZILLA FIREFOX CLUB

Event name : Yantra: InnovationX 2.0

Date : 04-02-2025 to 06-02-2025

Time : 8PM to 10AM

Venue : Sarojini Naidu Gallery

Event Details : Join us for an exciting 36-hour hackathon centred around AI

for SDGs! While we’re exploring innovative ways to tackle cybercrime

solutions, we also welcome fresh ideas across different domains through

open innovation. This event is open to everyone—whether you’re a seasoned

developer or a complete beginner. Bring your creativity, learn new skills,

and collaborate with like-minded individuals to create impactful AI-driven

solutions.

Registration: Register on VTOP

IEEE CIRCUITS AND SYSTEMS (IEEE-CAS)

Event name : Yantra: Electro-Hack

Date : 03-02-2025 to 04-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 8PM

Venue : Homi Bhabha Gallery

Event Details : IEEE CAS, in collaboration with ISOI, is proud to present

ElectroHack, an electrifying hackathon with innovation and sustainability

at its core. An amalgamation of electronics with AI, this hackathon

inspires participants to work towards sustainability while pushing the

limits of current technology. With cutting-edge tracks of VLSI design, PCB

designing and Embedded Systems with IoT, students get the chance to

integrate AI with hardware such as FPGA and Arduino or design efficient AI

powered PCBs to help find innovative solutions to achieve the Sustainable

Development Goals.

Registration: Register on VTOP

INDIAN SOCIETY FOR TECHNICAL EDUCATION (ISTE)

Event name : Yantra: Synapse

Date : 03-02-2025 to 04-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 8PM

Venue : Sarojini Naidu Gallery

Event Details : Unleash your creativity and coding skills at Synapse, a

thrilling 36-hour hackathon jointly organized by the ISTE and IEEE

chapters! This event promises a packed experience with exciting challenges

that will test your innovation, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities.

The event will feature tracks focused on the Sustainable Development Goals

(SDGs), with opportunities to build projects that incorporate emerging

technologies like AI to address global challenges.

Registration: Register on VTOP

INTERNET OF THINGS COMMUNITY (IOTHINC)

Event name : Yantra: aiOTopia

Date : 03-02-2025 to 04-02-2025

Time : 9AM to 6PM

Venue : SJTG07

Event Details : Aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development

Goals (SDGs), the event focuses on creating transformative solutions to:

SDG 11: Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient, and

sustainable. SDG 13: Take urgent action to combat climate change and its

impacts. Participants will brainstorm, collaborate, and develop

groundbreaking solutions that drive sustainability, equality, and

innovation.

Registration: Register on VTOP

IEEE SIGNAL PROCESSING SOCIETY (IEEE-SPS)

Event name : Yantra: Hardware Hustle

Date : 04-02-2025 to 05-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 8PM

Venue : Kamaraj Auditorium

Event Details : It is an exciting hardware hackathon with a fun twist.

Participants will start with a set number of points to trade for components

and problem statements. Simpler problems cost more, adding a risk-reward

dynamic to the competition. Earn extra points by competing in fun technical

and aptitude mini games held at intervals, testing innovation, strategy and

time management

Registration: Register on VTOP

THE AI & ML CLUB - TAM

Event name : Yantra: Bid-a-thon

Date : 03-02-2025 to 04-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 3PM

Venue : Shakespeare Gallery

Event Details : Bid-a-Thon is a dynamic and competitive event that blends

the excitement of strategic bidding with the power of artificial

intelligence (AI) and problem-solving to tackle real-world challenges. In

this event, teams are challenged to showcase their analytical skills,

decision-making abilities, and collaborative expertise while leveraging AI

technologies to maximize points.

Registration: Register on VTOP

IEEE-ROBOTICS & AUTOMATION SOCIETY (IEEE-RAS)

Event name : Yantra: Reboot

Date : 04-02-2025 to 05-02-2025

Time : 8AM to 8PM

Venue : TT VOC GALLERY

Event Details : Reboot is a 36-hour hackathon centred on the theme

“Sustainable AI: Tackling Global Challenges Through Technology.” It

challenges participants to develop innovative AI solutions addressing

critical issues aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). From

agriculture and environmental sustainability to mental health and

education, Reboot offers a platform to create impactful solutions for a

sustainable future. Join us to push the boundaries of AI and shape

solutions for global impact.

Registration: Register on VTOP

SOCIETY OF MANUFACTURING ENGINEERS (SME)

Event name :

Yantra: Smart Manufacturing for SDGs: AI-Powered InnovationsDate :

04-02-2025 to 04-02-2025

Time : 2PM to 5PM

Venue : SJT507

Event Details : Welcome to Smart Manufacturing for SDGs: AI-Powered

Innovations! This ideathon is all about bringing together creative thinkers

and problem solvers to explore how artificial intelligence can help us

achieve the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) through

manufacturing. In this event, you will have the chance to collaborate with

others passionate about technology, sustainability, and innovation.

Together, we will dive into challenges like improving energy efficiency,

reducing waste, and promoting sustainable production practices—all through

the power of AI.

[image: Smart Manufacturing SME handle (2) - Kalamata Jayanth Naidu

23BMM0019.png]

Registration: Register on VTOP

INDIAN INSTITUTE OF CHEMICAL ENGINEERS (IICHE)

Event name :

Yantra: CodegreenDate : 04-02-2025 to 04-02-2025

Time : 3PM to 7PM

Venue : Rajaji Hall

Event Details : Have you ever thought about how the things you use every

day are actually made? It is interesting that there lies a complex system

of operations and processes behind all these products, each with its own

challenges and potential for innovation. What if it were all to go wrong

with a single, simple mistake? IIChE-VIT presents: CodeGreen, a team event

where participants take the role of industrialists to explore the

intersection of sustainability and technology.

Registration: Register on VTOP

MATRIX- THE MULTIMEDIA CLUB

Event name : Yantra: Voice it out

Date : 04-02-2025 to 04-02-2025

Time : 2PM to 7PM

Venue : MB210

Event Details : Voice It Out - Dubbing and Voiceover Challenge Unleash your

creativity and step into the world of voice artistry with Voice It Out!

This exciting event invites participants to bring their unique flair to the

art of dubbing and voice overs. Whether it is re-dubbing iconic movie

scenes or breathing life into animated characters with original voice

overs, this is your stage to shine. Theme: Reimagine famous dialogues or

give fresh voices to your favourite characters.

 Registration: Register on VTOP

CODECHEF-VIT

Event name : Yantra: DevSOC'25

Date : 03-02-2025 to 05-02-2025

Event Details : DevSOC'25, the flagship hackathon by CodeChef-VIT, returns

for its sixth edition—an intense 48-hour sprint fostering innovation,

connect, solve challenges, and push technological boundaries.

Dear Students,

We are immensely delighted to share with you that Vellore International

School (VIS), Chennai, a fully residential school under the VIT Group of

Institutions, is stepping into its fourth year with remarkable

achievements. We are happy to share that VIS has secured the 5th rank in

Education World’s Indian School Rankings for 2024-25 and has been

recognized by The Times of India for the third consecutive year with two

prestigious awards – Excellence in International Residential School,

Excellent Campus Infrastructure & Architectural Design. 

As we look to the future, our goal remains to empower the students, by

nurturing their talents beyond the classroom. VIS continues to provide a

rich and diverse academic experience, with curricula that cater to both

affiliations from CICSE-ICSE/ISE and CAIE-IGCSE/AS/A Levels (Cambridge)

(Grades 5 to 11).

We invite you to be an integral part of this enriching journey as we open

our doors for admissions for the next upcoming session.

Body:
Dear Students,

Best Wishes !!! The procedure to be followed for Medical/Emergency Leave

Requirements.

NOTE: Application for Medical/ Emergency Leave and/or VTOP Lock are

enclosed. Application must be submitted within two days/ day prior to the

last working day. Students should refrain from making last-minute

requests.

 1. For any kind of leave, students are advised to use the permitted 25%

 relaxation in attendance, including medical reasons, and a minimum of 75%

 is mandatory to appear for the exams.

 2. In case of emergency (Medical reasons / Hospitalization / Death in

 the family), the first intimation must be given to the proctor. Then,

 the request must be sent to the Head of the Department (hod.ss@vit.ac.in

 <hod.ss@vit.ac.in>) recommended by Proctor.

 3. If he/she has been admitted to the hospital as an inpatient due to

 medical reasons, they have to submit their discharge summary, fitness

 certificate, and hospital bills along with a request letter signed by the

 Proctor to the Programme Secretary in SJT322 within two days after

 rejoining or one day prior to the last working day whichever is early.

 4. For Re-CAT, the documents shall be submitted to the Programme

 Secretary and signed by the Proctor. Medical prescriptions are not

 considered under any circumstances. The reFAT is permitted based on CoE

 norms (refer to reFAT norms mail sent by CoE).

 5. Medical leaves will not be updated on VTOP. Instead, based on the

 nature of the request, the school-level committee will decide whether to

 permit or reject the request for Attendance Relaxation for appearing on the

 Exam.

 6. After a medical leave request, a student is expected to attend all

 the classes regularly and if absences are found at later stages, then

 medical leave will not be considered.

Best Regards,

This edition will feature 60+ diverse events, designed to inspire,

educate, and challenge participants from all backgrounds. Our theme, “AI

for SDGs” (Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Development

Goals), highlights

skills and talents!

Subject: Awareness Campaign on Chickenpox and Dengue Fever!
Body:
Dear Students,

Greetings from the Office of Students' Welfare

Many cases of chickenpox and dengue fever have been reported at our health

center in recent days. The changing season often leads to an increase in

these illnesses, and it is crucial to stay informed and take preventive

measures. As part of our commitment to ensuring the health and well-being

of all students, we would like to bring your attention to two prevalent

health concerns: chickenpox and dengue fever.

Chickenpox

Chickenpox is a contagious viral infection characterized by fever, fatigue,

and a rash. To prevent its spread in shared living spaces:

1. Avoid contact with individuals showing symptoms.

2. Maintain proper hygiene, including regular handwashing.

3. Refrain from sharing personal items such as towels, clothing, or bedding.

If you notice any symptoms, inform the hostel warden immediately and seek

medical attention. Isolation will be arranged to ensure the safety of other

residents.

Dengue Fever

Dengue fever, caused by the bite of the Aedes mosquito, is another concern.

Preventive measures are crucial, particularly in hostel premises:

1. Keep doors and windows closed or use mosquito screens.

2. Wear full-sleeved clothing, especially during early morning and evening

hours.

3. Regularly use mosquito repellents.

In case of symptoms such as high fever, severe headache, muscle pain, or

rash, report immediately to the warden or hostel authorities for medical

assistance.

We urge all students to remain informed and proactive in maintaining

personal hygiene and environmental cleanliness. Your cooperation is

essential to mitigate the spread of these illnesses. For further assistance

or queries, please contact the Office of Student Welfare.

Let us work together to ensure a healthy and safe campus environment.

Subject: 2-week University of Plymouth International Summer School from 5th-20th July 2025
Body:
Dear Students,

 A 2-week University of Plymouth International Summer School is planned for

the 5th-20th July 2025.

Students who would like to be nominated, may give the following details by

filling the google form using the link below

 https://forms.gle/gkjxRA75J4chJe4y7

 - The student’s full name

 - Date of Birth (in the DD/MM/YYYY format), please note that students

 will have to be 18 years old before they arrive in the UK.

 - The student’s first and second choice of the subject strand:

 - Business

 - Design with Digital & Creative Media

 - International Relations & Law

There are a limited number of spaces available, so please let us know your

interest on or before the 15th of February 2025

 As part of the programme academic sessions will be delivered by The

Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Business academics and students will be

able to explore three thematic pathways from the School of Art, Design and

Architecture, the School of Society and Culture and Plymouth Business

School.

The fee for the 2-week programme is £2350.00 and they offer a 10% student

discount for all partner students. The brochure for the same is attached

below.

Subject: Reminder: Virtual Information session​ by Wayne State University, Detroit, USA
Body:
On Mon, Jan 27, 2025 at 3:41 PM Dr.R.Seenivasan Director (IR) <

director.ir@vit.ac.in> wrote:

>

>

> Dear Students (Pre-Final and Final Year),

>

> Greetings!!

>

>

>

> I am happy to share the registration link and details for the virtual

> session from Wayne State University, Detroit, USA :

>

> Date : 3rd Feb ‘2025

>

> Topic : Elements of Smart Manufacturing

>

> Time : 7.30 pm – 8.30 pm IST

>

>

>

> Speaker : Dr.Jeremy Rickli , Professor (Department of Industrial &

> Systems Engineering), Wayne State University

>

>

> Link to Register : https://forms.gle/3ncpTSqewyKQpd4d8

>

>

>

> Dr. Jeremy L. Rickli is a Mechanical Engineering graduate from Michigan

> Technological University (B.S. and M.S.) and holds a Ph.D. in Industrial

> and Systems Engineering from Virginia Tech. Since joining Wayne State

> University in 2013, he has established the Manufacturing and

> Remanufacturing Systems Laboratory (MaRSLab). The lab focuses on research

> in manufacturing, remanufacturing, disassembly processes, and systems with

> an emphasis on sustainability and life-cycle thinking.

>

> Key research areas include:

> Uncertainty Management in Remanufacturing and Disassembly

> Data-Driven Decision Making in Digital Manufacturing Enterprises

> Collaborative Robotic Automation in Advanced Manufacturing Systems

>

>

> Research Interests include

>

> 1. Enhancing Disassembly Planning Decisions and Operations

> 2. Remanufacturing Systems Modelling and Analysis & Sustainable

> Manufacturing

> 3. Leveraging Data to Innovate Decision Making in the Digital

> Manufacturing Enterprise

> 4. Point Cloud Quality Monitoring and Inspection Systems in

> Manufacturing

>

> Best Regards,

>

> R Seenivasan

>

> Director International Relations.

>

Registrar madam for the great support.

My special Thanks to Our team Dr. Vivekanandan, Dr. Sasikumar, Mr. Kumar,

Mrs. Mythili, Mr. Bairavan, Mr. Senthilkumar, Mr.Sarathkumar, Late.

J.P.Narayanan, and Mr. Murugan.

discipline and doing quality Research work @VIT. Focus towards social

impactful Research, product developments, patents and Technology Transfer.

The Office of Academic Research made several initiatives during my tenure

as Dean Academic Research from 1 Oct.2021 to till date with the guidance of

top management.

Subject: Invitation to Yantra'25 - Website & Event Details!
Body:
Dear VITians,

Yantra 2025 Events are scheduled to take place from February 3 to

February 9, 2025, promising a week brimming with innovation, learning, and

groundbreaking ideas. This year, Yantra is set to be bigger and better,

bringing together innovation, collaboration, and learning under the theme: “AI

for SDG Goals”.

🌟 What’s in Store?

Get ready for a week filled with hackathons, hands-on workshops, technical

talks, and competitions designed to challenge and inspire you. Whether

you’re a tech enthusiast, a budding innovator, or an industry expert,

Yantra’25 offers a platform to showcase your skills, collaborate with

like-minded peers, and learn from industry leaders.

✨ Exciting News – Official Website Launch! ✨

To enhance your Yantra’25 experience, we’re launching our official website!

Find everything you need—event schedules, registration details, and prize

pool updates—all in one place.

🔹 Website Link: www.yantra.swvit.in http://www.yantra.swvit.in/

📌 Mark Your Calendars!

Don’t miss this opportunity to be a part of “A Week of Technical

Innovation”, where technology meets purpose, and learning meets impact.

Whether you're looking to compete, learn, or simply explore, Yantra’25 has

something for everyone!

Stay tuned for updates on registrations, event schedules, and more! For any

queries, reach out to us at yantra.sw@vit.ac.in.

See you at Yantra’25! 🚀

.

:

Subject: Material Advantage Chapter at VIT Vellore-reg
Body:
Dear Students,

We are pleased to announce the establishment of a Material Advantage

Chapter at VIT Vellore, affiliated with the American Society of Metals

(ASM). This new chapter presents an exceptional opportunity for students

with a keen interest in materials science and engineering to engage with

industry leaders, expand their knowledge, and develop professional networks.

As a member of the Material Advantage Chapter, you will have access to a

wealth of resources, including:

 - Networking opportunities with industry professionals and academic

 experts

 - Technical seminars and workshops on cutting-edge materials research

 - Industry visits and plant tours to gain practical experience

 - Platforms to conduct research projects and present findings

 - Exclusive access to ASM publications and resources

We invite all students with a passion for materials science to join us.

Regardless of your year of study or major, we welcome students from all

backgrounds.

To express your interest in joining the Material Advantage Chapter, please

enroll through VTOP.

VTOP >>> SW EVENTS >>> CLUB/CHAPTER ENROLLMENT >>> MATERIAL ADVANTAGE

STUDENT CHAPTER (ASM)

We look forward to building a vibrant materials science community at VIT

Vellore.

Hi ,

We are excited to have a fruitful engagement.

Subject: CO2 Research Centre Newsletter - Volume 2/Open for New Student Projects & Collaborations.
Body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I am pleased to present the second volume of our CO2 Research and Green

Technologies Centre's newsletter, covering the period from June 2023 to

July 2024. Please find the attached file.

We extend our sincere gratitude to the VIT Management for their unwavering

support in enhancing our Centre's research infrastructure and fostering

research excellence.

Our Centre serves as an interdisciplinary research hub dedicated to:

 - Carbon Capture Utilization Systems (CCUS)

 - Biomass and Biogas-based Energy Production

 - Green Technological Methods: Including electrochemical,

 bio-electrochemical, and biochemical approaches for sensing and energy

 systems.

Since its establishment in 2010, our Centre has achieved a commendable

research output, producing approximately 500 publications with nearly 6000

citations and an average impact factor of 4.1.

A significant milestone in the past year was the publication of a research

article in Nature Energy (Impact Factor: 46.7) focused on Electrochemical

Energy Systems. We are also proud to have successfully transferred

technology based on our patented work (patent no : 372595; Related Green

Cement production) on "Development of Eco-Bacterial Lime Mortars" to ALCON,

LLP, Goa, India, marking a first for VIT, Vellore.

Furthermore, we have secured substantial funding through various government

funding agencies and consultancy projects, totalling ₹2.4 crores from

funding agencies and ₹31 lakhs from consultancy. Notably, the funding

received for consultancy work surpasses that of all other schools and

centres within the VIT, Vellore campus.

We warmly invite enthusiastic students to consider our Centre for their

capstone projects and encourage faculty members to collaborate with us on

interdisciplinary funded projects, consultancy work, publications, and the

development of impactful and target-oriented patents.

For your convenience, the newsletter is also accessible online as an e-book

at https://online.flippingbook.com/view/103136345/

Thank you once again for your continued support.

With best regards,

University in 2013, he has established the Manufacturing and

Remanufacturing Systems Laboratory (MaRSLab). The lab focuses on research

Subject: Live Project to Learn & Upskill in MS Excel
Body:
Hi ,

We are pleased to extend applications for the Finlatics Excel Program, an online live project that helps students learn and gain experience in Microsoft Excel.

Finlatics' projects run at leading campuses, including IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Bangalore, IIT Bombay, IIT Madras and BITS Pilani, among others, and were curated at the prestigious Atal Incubation Centre, supported by the Atal Innovation Mission, NITI Aayog, and the Government of India.

STRUCTURE of the Live Project:

1. Learn the basics of MS Excel, including sorting and filtering data through various formulas and functions.

2. Become proficient in making dynamic Excel dashboards and practice on sales, finance and human resources datasets

3. Understand how to use various Excel techniques and simulations to perform profitability analysis and make pricing decisions

4. Gain an understanding of different Forecasting methods through MS Excel and how they can be used for decision-making

5. Complete industry-specific case projects to understand the application of MS Excel in real-time scenarios

The project is doable along with any other commitment due to its work-from-home and online structure.

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificate of Proficiency in Microsoft Excel

2. Letter of Recommendation on performance

To apply, students can fill out the form below, and we will get in touch:

https://www.finlatics.com/excel_applications?utm_src=ftllpbaup1

https://www.finlatics.com/excel_applications?utm_src=ftllpbaup4

No prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to participate in the program. The program will impart all necessary training in MS Excel

Project Duration: 2 months

Time Commitment: 2 - 3 hours per week.

Project Start: Flexible start date option on selected student choice.

Project Break & Extension: Selected students will be eligible for a break or extension during the project if needed for any exams, assignments, or personal commitments.

If selected, the project has a minimal induction fee of Rs. 1999 + GST.

The application process takes 2-3 mins of your time and is free.

We are excited to have a fruitful engagement.

Subject: 26th January - Today's Special Event-reg
Body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [26th January]

event on the occasion of 76th Republic Day at the open ground opposite to

the Periyar EVR Central Library.

Republic Day is celebrated with great joy across the nation, symbolizing

the values of justice, liberty, equality, and fraternity enshrined in the

Constitution. The day is marked by grand celebrations, including a parade

showcasing India’s cultural diversity, military strength, and achievements,

reminding every citizen of the principles that unite the nation.

Happy Republic Day!

LIVE Streaming of VIT Republic Day Celebrations

Arrangements are made for LIVE Streaming of the republic day celebrations

on our official YouTube Channel.

NCC Parade

The parade by the VIT NCC contingent will start at 09:10 AM.

Patriotic Songs

University Choir will be singing patriotic songs at the republic day

celebration venue from 09:45 AM onwards.

University Technical Team Rally

Display of the University technical team will be held in the plaza area at

10:00 AM.

Sender_Name: VIT Finlatics
Subject: Live Project to Learn & Upskill in Microsoft Excel
Body:
Hi ,

We're pleased to extend applications for the Finlatics Excel Program, an online live project that helps students learn and gain experience in Microsoft Excel at the Vellore Institute of Technology.

This project runs at leading campuses, including IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Madras, and BITS Pilani, among others. Finlatics was curated at the prestigious Atal Incubation Centre, supported by the Atal Innovation Mission, NITI Aayog, and the Government of India.

STRUCTURE of the Live Project:

1. Learn the basics of MS Excel, including sorting and filtering data through various formulas and functions.

2. Become proficient in making dynamic Excel dashboards and practice on sales, finance and human resources datasets

3. Understand how to use various Excel techniques and simulations to perform profitability analysis and make pricing decisions

4. Gain an understanding of different Forecasting methods through MS Excel and how they can be used for decision-making

5. Complete industry-specific case projects to understand the application of MS Excel in real-time scenarios

The project is doable along with any other commitment due to its work-from-home and online structure.

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificate of Proficiency in Microsoft Excel

2. Letter of Recommendation on performance

To apply, students can fill out the form below, and we will get in touch:

https://www.finlatics.com/excel_applications?utm_src=vitv

No prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to participate in the program. The program will impart all necessary training in MS Excel

Project Duration: 2 months

Time Commitment: 2 - 3 hours per week.

Project Start: Flexible start date option on selected student choice.

Project Break & Extension: Selected students will be eligible for a break or extension during the project if needed for any exams, assignments, or personal commitments.

If selected, the project has a minimal induction fee of Rs. 1999 + GST.

We are excited to have a fruitful engagement.
