Body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [09th November]

 events.

Today's Events:

 - Alumni Spotlight: From Campus to Career

 - EcoVision: SDG Poster Challenge

 - Uddeshya

 - Kartavya

 - Teach for Vellore

 - WebWise

 - Inside Google’s DeepMind

 - Emerging technologies in Industrial and Systems Engineering

 - Healthy Eating Habits

 - GreenSpark Initiative

Scroll down for more information

IEEE Communications Society (IEEE ComSoc)

Event Name: Alumni Spotlight: From Campus to Career

Event Time: 04:00 PM to 05:30 PM

Venue: TT204

Event Description: IEEE COMSOC is hosting an alumni event featuring Amiya

Anand, former chairperson of our chapter, who will share his journey beyond

VIT. As a valued alumnus, Amiya will reflect on key experiences and turning

points, offering insights into making the most of opportunities and

achieving personal growth. Join us to reconnect with our alumni,

communicate and be inspired by Amiya's story in this special session hosted

by IEEE COMSOC.

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/vitieeecomsoc/

The Catalyst Club

Event Name: EcoVision: SDG Poster Challenge

Event Time: 10 AM to 8 PM

Platform: Google Drive

Event Description: An online poster-making competition dedicated to raising

awareness and inspiring action toward the United Nations' Sustainable

Development Goals (SDGs). This event invites participants of all

backgrounds to creatively express their vision for a sustainable future by

designing posters that represent one or more of the 17 SDGs.Participants

will have the opportunity to showcase their artistic skills, share powerful

messages, and contribute to a global conversation on critical issues such

as poverty.

Registration: VTOP

RoboVITics

Event Name: Uddeshya

Event Time: 10:00 AM

Venue: Global Public School, Vellore

Event Description: Uddeshya is a social outreach event with a focus on

website design. The session will introduce school students to the basics

building websites through interactive sessions. Through project

demonstrations, the participants will learn about the various features and

utility of the design elements used in websites. A practical session will

help the students gain first-hand experience with website design using HTML

and CSS.

Registration: VTOP

RoboVITics

Event Name: Kartavya

Event Time: 10:00 AM

Venue: Williams Matric Higher Secondary School, Vellore

Event Description: Kartavya is a social outreach event with a focus on

sustainable electronics. The session will introduce school students to the

basics of electronics through interactive presentations. Participants will

be introduced to the world of sustainable electronics and robotics through

project demonstrations. A hands-on segment will give the students a taste

of the exciting world of sustainable electronics.

Registration: VTOP

Indian Society for Technical Education (ISTE)

Event Name: Teach for Vellore

Event Time: 10:00 AM to 12:30 PM

Venue: Global Public School

Event Description: Teach For Vellore is an interactive session that

 brings science concepts to life for young minds through engaging

demonstrations using everyday materials. Students will explore foundational

ideas like electricity, friction, and motion, from lighting circuits with a

torch to launching balloon-powered rocket cars, each connecting science to

real-world applications. With clear explanations and opportunities for

questions, this event aims to spark curiosity and reveal the exciting

possibilities within science and engineering.

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/iste_vit_vellore/

Mozilla Firefox Club

Event Name: WebWise

Event Time: 10:00AM to 12:30PM

Venue: Williams Matriculation School

Event Description: Mozilla Firefox Club VIT Vellore brings web development

skills to the young minds at Williams School! We will lead an interactive

session, introducing students to website creation using basic HTML, CSS,

and JavaScript. We'll also cover essential tips for securing websites from

common online threats and empowering students to build and protect their

digital sites.

Registration: VTOP

Google Developers Student Club (GDSC)

Event Name: Inside Google’s DeepMind

Event Time: 9:30 PM onwards

Platform: YouTube

Event Description: This comprehensive session provides an overview of

Google's cutting-edge AI, offering insights into the architecture and

impact of the Nobel Prize-winning AlphaFold model, which revolutionized

protein folding. You'll explore the potential of Gemini and the Astra

Project, Google's ambitious research initiatives. Additionally, you'll gain

a thorough understanding of Generative Pre-Trained Transformers, their

features, and the underlying technical mechanisms that power these powerful

AI models.

Registration: VTOP

YouTube Link: http://dscv.it/deepmind-session

Institute of Industrial and Systems Engineers (IISE)

Event Name: Emerging technologies in Industrial and Systems Engineering

Event Time: 9:00 PM to 10:00 PM

Platform: Google Meet

Event Description: Join us for a virtual event wherein students will get to

know more about the latest emerging technologies in the industrial and

systems engineering landscape. This enlightening session will be addressed

by our chapter members itself. Career pathways in the respective fields

will also be highlighted.

Registration: VTOP

Innovators Quest

Event Name: Healthy Eating Habits

Event Time: 10am to 12: 30pm

Venue: Global public School

Event Description: Join us for an engaging outreach event, Healthy Eating

Habits, designed to help students identify a variety of foods within

different categories. Through interactive rounds, students will learn about

nutritional benefits and expand their food knowledge, building a diverse

food atlas together for a memorable and educational experience!

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/iquest.vit?igsh=MW0zcGdlMDJ3bGM3Nw==

Indian Geotechnical Society (IGS-VIT)

Event Name: GreenSpark Initiative

Event Time: 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM

Venue: Williams Matriculation Higher Secondary School

Event Description: The Indian Geotechnical Society - VIT Vellore is excited

to host an outreach event focused on sustainable design for eleventh-grade

students. This interactive session will introduce students to the

principles of sustainability and their critical role in modern engineering

and design. Through a PPT presentation on "Sustainable Design," students

from VIT Vellore will guide participants through the fundamentals of

sustainable solutions that address real-world challenges.

Registration: VTOP

https://www.instagram.com/p/DCIe5G2yWh0/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==

Subject: Invitation to Apply for the Linux User's Group Board – Batches '22 and '23 - Reg.
Body:
Dear Students,

We are excited to announce that applications are now open for positions for

the Board of the Linux User's Group. This is a unique opportunity for all

students from the 2022 and 2023 batches to become integral members of the

team.

The objectives of the Linux User's Group are as follows:

 - Linux User's Group helps to understand the benefits of open source

 software over proprietary software.

 - To create awareness and train users to go for open source software.

 - To accelerate development and deployment of free and open source

 technologies, and beyond.

 - Free to use, free to study, free to distribute, free to modify, free

 to access.

 - Familiarize students with Linux Distributions, create awareness about

 FOSS, learn general softwares on Linux such as GIMP, Libre Office.

 - To present Linux as an efficient tool in Cyber security, Get students

 to contribute to FOSS.

 - Make students more industry ready and to promote Linux in General.

To apply, simply fill out the Google form provided below:

https://forms.gle/hp3exR5ukVx8z5QV9

Last Date for Application: 10.11.2024

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

We encourage all interested students from the 2022 and 2023 batches to take

advantage of this opportunity to enhance their university experience and

contribute to the vibrant campus culture.

Subject: Guidelines – Course Registration (Winter Semester 2024 - 25)
Body:
Dear Student,

Guidelines – Course Registration (Winter Semester 2024 - 25)

 1. Senior Students and timed-out students of all the programmes except

 BSc (Agri), BSc Catering & Hotel Management, B. Des., B. Arc., BSc

 Multimedia, BSc Visual Communication, M. Des., MBA, M. Arc., MSW, B.

 Tech Computer Science and Business Systems are permitted to take part

 in the course registration.

 2. Course Registration is scheduled to be conducted on 09. 11. 2024.

 3. Information on course registration schedule and the courses offered

 for the Winter Semester 2024 - 25 is made available on VTOP Student Login.

 (Refer to the screenshot)

 4. During the course registration process (on 09.11.2024), the system

 will prompt to register for the applicable Soft Skill Course, English

 Course, SET, Project and any mandatory course as per the curriculum of the

 respective programmes. Subsequently, UC: University Core, PC: Programme

 Core, FC: Foundation Core, DLESC: Discipline linked Engineering Sciences,

 DC: Discipline Core, PE: Programme Elective, UE: University Elective, DE:

 Discipline Elective, SPE: Specialization Elective, OE: Open Elective and

 compulsory courses with the following options will be permitted:

 Regular / Re-register / Substitution (UE / OE / DE / PE and also in

HSM / Language Basket)

 Regular (UC as UE, PE as UE, DE as OE, SPE as OE)

 Minor & Honour Programmes

Multidisciplinary Elective (applicable to the B. Tech Core Programmes only

except BBS): An option is provided to earn the required credits under the

Discipline Elective / Open Elective category by registering courses listed

under multidisciplinary electives. The eligibility criteria to register

course(s) under multidisciplinary elective is to have completed a minimum

of 9 credits from the courses listed under the Discipline Electives. The

remaining credits can be earned from the courses listed under either

Discipline Electives or Multidisciplinary Electives to complete credit

requirements as per the curriculum.

 5. Add / Drop option will be enabled for all the students from 13.12.24

 to 15.12.2024. During the Add / Drop period, students can register for

 courses under Audit / Grade Improvement / Additional Course.

 6. Removal of courses registered under regular mode is not possible

 unless course registered under ‘Additional’ is removed first.

 7. Student should generate invoice on VTOP (in the timetable menu) and

 proceed for payment (under the menu – Online Payments) for the courses that

 demand course fees. Courses of fee defaulters will be deregistered after

 the deadline (21.12.2024).

 8. Courses cannot be deleted or withdrawn if the fee payment is done.

 9. Students are required to go through the Academic Regulations for

 further clarification on the terminologies.

 10. Queries related to course offering should be addressed to the

 respective Head of the Department.

Dear VITians,

National Cancer Awareness Day

National Cancer Awareness Day is observed every year on November 7 in

India. The main objective of the day is to highlight the significance of

increased awareness about cancer prevention and early detection for the

general public. The National Cancer Control Programme was initiated in 1975

to provide cancer treatment facilities in the country. The program was

modified almost ten years later to provide a boost to prevention and early

detection.

National Cancer Awareness Day was first announced in September 2014.

November 7 was chosen as the date of observance to generate awareness about

early detection and causing-causing lifestyles. November 7 coincides with

the birth anniversary of Nobel-prize winning scientist Madame Curie, who is

remembered for her discovery of radium and polonium and her massive

contribution to the fight against cancer. Curie's work also led to the

development of nuclear energy and radiotherapy for the treatment of cancer.

Body:
Dear VITians,

Greetings!

In continuation of the VIT - BU webinar series, the second session- “Thermal Modeling and Thermal Management of Battery Systems: Challenges and Opportunities” will be held on 06 November 2024 (Wednesday) at 7:00 pm (IST).

Dr. Srikanth Rangarajan- Assistant Professor - School of Systems Science and Industrial Engineering, Binghamton University will be delivering the talk.

Faculty members, research scholars and students can register using the following registration link. After registration, the registrants will receive a Zoom link to join the session.

Registration Link: https://forms.gle/EnKRtnku7MHpMbuJ6https://www.google.com/url?q=https://forms.gle/EnKRtnku7MHpMbuJ6&source=gmail-imap&ust=1731328744000000&usg=AOvVaw1_38FWr5gR8y5MB3uon5l2

(Zoom link provided after registration)

Abstract:

There is a broad consensus that electrification holds the key to realizing a decarbonizing society. Even so, the increasing power densification in battery systems (high C-Rates) necessitates the demonstration and scale-up of innovative and robust thermal management technologies. Most electric vehicle operating environments are transient, thereby demanding the need to have a paradigm shift in our approach to thermal management. The transient load is often a high peak way above the average power, and hence a cooling technology based on peak power or heat load will more often than not be sub-optimal and economically not prudent. Accurate and effective Thermal modeling serves as a precursor to designing optimal thermal management technologies. This talk will introduce the challenges and opportunities involved in the thermal modeling, thermal management of batteries and the use of machine learning to predict battery performance.

 Speaker Biography:

[cid:image002.png@01DB2EE7.21E217B0]

Srikanth Rangarajan joined the School of System Science and Industrial Engineering in Fall 2024. He received his M.S & Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology Madras 2017. He obtained his Bachelor in Engineering in 2011 from Anna University Chennai. His research interests include Energy Storage management systems, electronic packaging, Digital twinning for electronics and batteries, Thermal energy storage, Thermal Management of electronics, and Data center cooling. Srikanth is also the author of the book “Phase Change Material Heat Sinks: A multi-objective Perspective”. His research focuses on thermal management, optimization, digital twinning and sustainability of electronic systems, advanced packaging and heterogeneous integration of electronic systems, data center cooling, digital twinning and optimization of battery systems, and thermal energy storage: design and optimization

Body:
Dear Research Scholars, and Professors,

Greetings,

As part of ‘Publishing 101 with Taylor & Francis’, we are glad to invite

researchers and academic faculty for the last exclusive session of this

series organized by Taylor & Francis Group on ‘Ethics Focus: Plagiarism &

Text Recycling, Authorship & Conflicts of Interest’.

Date & Time: 13th Nov, 3.00 – 4.30 PM IST

Speakers: 

 - Didi Peng, Research Integrity Manager, Taylor & Francis Group

 - Fulu Akinduro-Aje, Research Integrity Manager, Taylor & Francis Group

Registration Link:

https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/register/2864509708110778459?source=VIT

https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/register/2864509708110778459?source=VIT

About the Session:

A researcher’s career rests on the originality and integrity of their

contributions to the scholarly record. In this session, we will examine the

ethical challenges and responsibilities that come with authorship,

conflicts of interest, plagiarism, and text recycling—vital areas to

understand for building a credible and responsible publishing record.

This session will cover:

 - Defining Authorship, Author Responsibilities, and Competing Interests:

 Understand how Taylor & Francis defines authorship, including the roles of

 author and corresponding author, and the responsibilities each carries.

 We’ll explore common issues such as ghost authorship, gift authorship, and

 authorship for sale, as well as guidelines for acknowledging competing

 interests behind authorship.

 - Taylor & Francis’ AI and Authorship Policy: Learn how the use of AI

 interacts with authorship ethics.

 - Plagiarism & Text Recycling: Gain clarity on plagiarism types, where

 the boundaries lie in acceptable similarity under publication standards,

 and the complexities of text recycling. We’ll discuss how Taylor & Francis

 detects plagiarism, handles incidents when it’s found, and where the grey

 areas exist—especially concerning reuse of one’s own prior work.

Why attend? You’ll leave with a well-rounded understanding of how Taylor

& Francis approaches these ethical concerns. By the end, you will feel

equipped to avoid and address issues in authorship, conflicts of interest,

and plagiarism in your work, enhancing your ability to publish responsibly

and transparently.

About the Speakers:

 - Dr Fulu (Olufolake) Akinduro-Aje is a Research Integrity Manager

 within the Publishing Ethics and Integrity Team at Taylor and Francis Group

 Journals where she provides investigative support and advice on research

 ethics and integrity cases and contributes to the continuous improvement of

 editorial processes and policies.

 - Didi Peng is a Research Integrity Manager within the Publishing Ethics

 & Integrity department and as a team they are responsible for providing

 specialist advice and support on ethical, research integrity, and policy

 matters with the aim of minimising risk and ensuring compliance to the

 highest publication ethics standards across Taylor & Francis Journals.

 Looking forward your active participation

Thanks and Regards

Yours Sincerely,

Dear Students (SBST, VAIAL students only),

Slovak University of Agriculture in Nitra, as part of our bilateral

collaboration under the “Semester Abroad Program,” offers free courses and

subjects. Additionally, students have the opportunity to gain practical

experience with certain working groups (also free of charge) on two or

three projects focused on modern agronomic areas such as:

i) Electroculture,

ii) Nanotechnology,

iii) Agricultural Remediation and others (see below).

Planned activities and skills to be gained:

 - Practical laboratory experience with electroculture and germination

 experiments;

 - “On-line” analysis and interpretation of plant physiology using

 infrared spectroscopy;

 - Measurement and evaluation of quantitative parameters of plant in

 interaction with nanofertilizers;

 - Measurement of physico-chemical parameters of nanoparticle solutions

 and cultivation media;

 - Theoretical knowledge and practical skills on the application of

 nanoparticles as the next generation of nanofertilizers in field

 experiments;

 - Result interpretation using the STATISTICA10 statistical program.

Additional planned activities related to the Semester Abroad Program:

 - Completion of a semester course at the bachelor’s level at SUA:

 "Beginners Riding Course" (course code A15-0140-B) or others regarding

 needed incoming students.

 - Practical agronomic training at commercial farm - Blumeria Consulting

 s.r.o.

 - Seminars on 3D printing technologies and their potential applications

 in agriculture and falconry, reflecting Slovakia’s cultural heritage;

 - A botanical excursion to explore plant communities of the Central

 European region;

 - Active publication of results at the 2025 SUA Student Scientific

 Conference in the Plant Agrobiology section, with preparation of a

 SCOPUS-indexed manuscript.

Accepted students only need to cover their living costs, including

accommodation, meals, and travel (no university or research fees) etc. For

Subject: Indian Oil Startup Fund (IndianOilStartupFund) 2024
Body:
Dear Students,

IOCL is providing a Startup Fund, the details are given below. Students who

are working in the key areas: Low-cost efficient vapour recovery systems at

fuel stations, Innovative re-refining of used lubricating oils, Low-cost

hydrogen production, Low-cost seawater desalination, Zero-effluent schemes

for oil refineries, LPG cylinder safety aspects, Waste-to-energy projects

can apply online. If you need any help you can contact us at iic@vit.ac.in

; ecell.coordinator@vit.ac.in

Thanks and Regards

C Ramesh Kumar

Director Innovations

The Indian Oil Startup Fund is an innovative initiative launched by the

Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL) to support promising startups and

foster innovation in the domestic hydrocarbon sector. With a revolving

corpus of ₹30 crore, this scheme aims to promote projects that involve

cutting-edge technology and business process re-engineering ideas with

significant business potential, social relevance, and a focus on

environmental protection.

Objectives and Purpose

The primary objectives of the Indian Oil Startup Fund include:

Supporting projects with innovative technology and business process

re-engineering ideas

Promoting collective research and developing a thriving startup ecosystem

Validating Proof of Concept (PoC) for various technology and business ideas

Enhancing intrapreneurship and technological innovation

Providing financial support to projects offering innovative solutions in

IOCL’s business domain

Reducing ambiguity in existing technology and business processes

Key Focus Areas

Low-cost efficient vapour recovery systems at fuel stations

Innovative re-refining of used lubricating oils

Low-cost hydrogen production

Low-cost seawater desalination

Zero-effluent schemes for oil refineries

LPG cylinder safety aspects

Waste-to-energy projects

Eligibility Criteria

The Indian Oil Startup Fund is open to:

Indian citizens, including Non-Resident Indians willing to work in India

Individuals affiliated with academic institutions having

government-approved incubation centers

Entrepreneurs working for Indian Oil

Selection Process

The selection of projects involves a two-stage screening process:

Level-1 Committee: Shortlists ideas based on set parameters and guidelines.

Projects are evaluated out of 100 marks, with a cut-off of 70 marks to

proceed to the next level.

Level-2 Committee: Evaluates shortlisted projects through presentations and

discussions. Projects are again scored out of 100 marks, with a cut-off of

60 marks for selection. A minimum of 50% is required in each evaluation

category.

Funding Structure

The Indian Oil Startup Fund provides financial support as follows:

A revolving corpus of ₹30 crore for each round of investment

Funding period:

36 months for Technology Process Re-engineering (TPRE) projects

18 months for Business Process Re-engineering (BPRE) projects

Funds are disbursed in installments based on achieved milestones

No royalty is applicable on the funds provided

Incubation Support: Selected projects receive:

Incubation support until the Proof of Concept stage

Financial and mentorship support

Intellectual and logistical support

Technical assistance as required

Statistical Data

As of September 2022:

Total committed startup fund by Oil PSUs: ₹320 crore for 3 years

Selected startup projects: 167

Committed funding: ₹195.30 crore

Disbursed funding: ₹120.65 crore

Application Process

Interested applicants can apply through the official portal:

www.indianoilstartupfund.in. The portal facilitates the entire process from

application submission to project selection and management.

Intellectual Property Rights

The intellectual property rights for work done under the scheme are jointly

owned by Indian Oil Corporation Limited and the entrepreneur/innovator.

Conclusion

The Indian Oil Startup Fund represents a significant step towards fostering

innovation in India’s energy sector. By providing financial support,

mentorship, and resources to promising startups, IOCL is not only driving

technological advancements but also contributing to the country’s economic

growth and job creation. As the scheme continues to evolve, it is expected

to play a crucial role in shaping the future of India’s hydrocarbon

industry and supporting the nation’s startup ecosystem.

World Thrift Day

World Thrift Day is celebrated every year on 31 October. In India, due to

the death of the late Prime Minister Indira Gandhi on the same day in 1984,

this day is being celebrated on 30th October. The day aims to promote the

savings and financial security of individuals and nations as a whole. The

aim of the day is to change the behavior of people towards saving and

constantly remind them of the importance of wealth. Saving wealth helps to

start a business, get a good education, and avail good healthcare

treatment.

The day was established to create awareness among the people about the idea

of saving their money in a bank rather than keeping it at home. The saving

habit of people will give independence to both people as well as the

World Stroke Day

One in four people experience a stroke in their lifetime. And 90% of those

strokes could be prevented by addressing a small number of risk factors

including high blood pressure (hypertension), irregular heartbeat (atrial

fibrillation), smoking, diet and exercise.

In 2023, the theme “Prevention Is Greater Than Stroke” takes center stage,

highlighting the critical role of prevention in mitigating the devastating

effects of stroke. At the forefront of all preventive measures for stroke

lies awareness. Recognizing the risk factors and early warning signs of

stroke is essential.

Sender_Name: VIT Finlatics
Subject: Application Deadline : Online Live Project / Work Experience Program in Data-Driven Decision Making
Body:
Dear VIT students,

As today, 11.59 pm, is the deadline to applyfor the Finlatics Business Analyst Experience Program, please note:

1. Please note that no prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to be a part of this project

2. If you have any upcoming assignments, examinations, or personal commitments, you can pick a project start date after completing the same to help the project fit in with your schedule.

3. You can pick to do the project in 1 or 2 months based on your schedule. You will be allowed a break during the project tenure for any academic or personal commitment. You would also be allowed a Project Extension of an additional month in case you cannot complete it in the required duration.

4. You can apply for the project using the link:

https://82e6v.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfsTSlPYaV0LcO3ykXyRn8u/10WVYJJvVB3a

5. The time commitment required for the project is around 2 - 4 hours per week.

6. Live Sessions would also be conducted to help students learn data analysis via Microsoft Excel by covering topics like Regression Analysis, Sensitivity Analysis and Scenario Building.

The program has a minimal induction fee of Rs. 1999 + GST / Rs. 2999 + GST.

Fee Waiver: A fee waiver of 15 - 25%shall be given to all Vellore Institute of Technologystudents on the abovementioned minimal induction fee. This waiver will reduce the fee to Rs. 1690 + GST / Rs. 2199 + GST.

To be eligible for the waiver, please apply before today's deadline.

The first mail circulated at the campus is attached below:

Dear VIT students,

We're pleased to extend applications for the Finlatics Business Analyst Experience Program, an online live project that helps students gain work experience in data-driven decision-making at the Vellore Institute of Technology.

This project is running at leading campuses, including IIT Bombay, IIT Madras, IIT Delhi, IIM Bangalore, and BITS Pilani among others.

STRUCTURE of the Live Project:

1. Understand research, types of data analytics, their usage, and their benefits across industry segments like Consumer Goods, Tourism, and e-commerce, among others, through a case study-driven approach.

2. Assess business projects and propose solutions using a data-driven decision-making approach

3. Solve business problems of technology-oriented businesses that impact their profitability.

4. Learn & Apply Power BI, a pan-industry business intelligence tool used to analyze data to gain insights into marketing campaigns.

Live Sessions would also be conducted for learning data analysis via Microsoft Excel by covering topics like Regression Analysis, Sensitivity Analysis and Scenario Building.

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificates of Work Experience as a Business Analyst

2. Letter of Recommendation on performance

3. Certificate of Proficiency in Power BI.

To apply, students can fill out the form below :

https://82e6v.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfuMSHurZ4EnekNmuuTEX5Q/AlSP0R-sV2dw

No prerequisites or prior domain knowledge is required to be a part of the program. All necessary training on data-driven decision-making & Power BI will be imparted to the program. The project is doable along with any other commitment due to its work-from-home and online structure.

Project Duration: 1 month /2 months (on student choice)

Time commitment: 3 - 4 hours per week

Project Start: Flexible start date option on selected student choice. Students can choose to start the project post-exams.

Project Break & Extension: Selected students will be eligible for a break or extension during the project if needed for any exams, assignments, or personal commitments.

If selected, the program has a minimal induction fee of Rs.1999 + GST / Rs. 2999 + GST (on student choice).

Fee Waiver: A 15 - 25% fee waiver shall be given to all Vellore Institute of Technologystudents on the abovementioned minimal induction fee. This waiver will reduce the fee to Rs. 1690 + GST / Rs. 2199 + GST.

To be eligible for the waiver, kindly apply through the above mentioned link only.

The application process will take 2-3 mins of your time and is free.

Sender_Name: VIT Finlatics
Subject: Online Live Project / Work Experience Program in Data-Driven Decision Making
Body:
Hi ,

We're pleased to extend applications for the Finlatics Business Analyst Experience Program, an online live project that helps students gain work experience in data-driven decision-making at the Vellore Institute of Technology.

This project is running at leading campuses, including IIT Bombay, IIT Madras, IIT Delhi, IIM Bangalore, and BITS Pilani among others.

STRUCTURE of the Live Project:

1. Understand research, types of data analytics, their usage, and their benefits across industry segments like Consumer Goods, Tourism, and e-commerce, among others, through a case study-driven approach.

2. Assess business projects and propose solutions using a data-driven decision-making approach

3. Solve business problems of technology-oriented businesses that impact their profitability.

4. Learn & Apply Power BI, a pan-industry business intelligence tool used to analyze data to gain insights into marketing campaigns.

Live Sessions would also be conducted for learning data analysis via Microsoft Excel by covering topics like Regression Analysis, Sensitivity Analysis and Scenario Building.

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificates of Work Experience as a Business Analyst

2. Letter of Recommendation on performance

3. Certificate of Proficiency in Power BI.

To apply, students can fill out the form below :

https://82e6v.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfsTSlPYaV0LcO3ykXyRn8u/bGuyxF1odSTi

No prerequisites or prior domain knowledge is required to be a part of the program. All necessary training on data-driven decision-making & Power BI will be imparted to the program. The project is doable along with any other commitment due to its work-from-home and online structure.

Project Duration: 1 month /2 months (on student choice)

Time commitment: 3 - 4 hours per week

Project Start: Flexible start date option on selected student choice. Students can choose to start the project post-exams.

Project Break & Extension: Selected students will be eligible for a break or extension during the project if needed for any exams, assignments, or personal commitments.

If selected, the program has a minimal induction fee of Rs.1999 + GST / Rs. 2999 + GST (on student choice).

Fee Waiver: A 15 - 25% fee waiver shall be given to all Vellore Institute of Technologystudents on the abovementioned minimal induction fee. This waiver will reduce the fee to Rs. 1690 + GST / Rs. 2199 + GST.

To be eligible for the waiver, kindly apply through the above mentioned link only.

The application process will take 2-3 mins of your time and is free.

Subject: VIT Mauritius
Body:
Dear Students, Faculty, and Staff,

As we celebrate our 40th year, we are thrilled to announce that VIT is

expanding its footprint globally with the launch of VIT Mauritius Campus.

VIT Mauritius represents a significant milestone in our journey, offering

unparalleled educational experiences to students from Mauritius, the rest

of Africa, and beyond. This campus also will uphold the VIT legacy of

academic excellence, innovation, and research.

Initially, VIT Mauritius Campus will offer 4-year B.Eng. (Hons) in:

Civil Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Engineering (AI & ML),

and Computer Engineering (Data Science).

The inaugural batch will commence in July 2025. More details can be found

at www.vitmauritius.mu

Please share this happy news with your friends and family.

Subject: Fourth Series-Joint Webinar- VIT-SUNY, BU-Battery Thermal Management Systems (BTMS)-Session 1
Body:
Dear VITians,

Greetings!

We are happy to announce that the 4th series of the webinar sessions between the Automotive Research Centre (ARC) and the State University of New York-Binghamton University (SUNY-BU) will be on “Battery Thermal Management System (BTMS)”. The webinar series will be held at regular intervals. The faculty members from VIT, Vellore and SUNY-BU will be sharing their research experiences.

The first webinar session-“Innovative Cooling Strategies to Improve the Delay Effect in the Thermal Management of Electric Vehicle Batteries” will be held on 24 October 2024 at 6:00 pm (IST).

Dr. Tapano Kumar Hotta, Professor of Mechanical Engineering (SMEC), Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT), Vellore, will be delivering the talk.

Faculty members, research scholars and students can register using the following registration link. Upon registration, the registrants will receive a Google Meet link in their registered email ID, enabling them to join the session.

Registration Link: https://https://www.google.com/url?q=https://forms.gle/Ur3o2M1jtPYzgQ9o7&source=gmail-imap&ust=1730264601000000&usg=AOvVaw2zOlJW6gfTasatl3hbFB8Pforms.gle/Ur3o2M1jtPYzgQ9o7https://www.google.com/url?q=https://forms.gle/Ur3o2M1jtPYzgQ9o7&source=gmail-imap&ust=1730264601000000&usg=AOvVaw2zOlJW6gfTasatl3hbFB8P

 Abstract:

Lithium-ion cells are majorly used as the power source for Electric Vehicles (EVs) due to their density, voltage, and self-discharge properties. Managing the temperature of the EV battery modules is a critical challenge due to the charge mobility and chemical reaction rate of Li-ion cells which lead to their thermal runaway. The development of innovative cooling strategies with the use of Phase Change Materials (PCMs) controls the operating temperature of the battery modules and improves their delay effect. Paraffin/EG composite helps in better heat dissipation and maintains the battery temperature in an optimal range. The deterioration of battery capacity over a significant number of cycles can be minimized by using this PCM-based cooling system, thus enhancing the battery life. A hybrid cooling technique (combining PCM and air) is found to be more effective in reducing the temperature rise by 4℃ compared to Paraffin/EG PCM cooling and by 8℃ compared to air cooling.

 Speaker Biography:

 [Tapano Kumar Hotta]

Dr. Tapano Kumar Hotta is currently a Professor in the School of Mechanical Engineering, Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT) Vellore. He has a PhD from IIT Madras in the area of Electronic Cooling. His research interest lies in the domain of Heat Transfer Enhancement, Optimization of Thermal Systems, Climatic Mitigation Leading to Thermal Comfort, etc. He has about 16 years of teaching cum research experience and has around 65 publications, 2 sponsored projects, 2 industrial consultancies, and 3 patents to his credit. He has guided more than 40 Undergraduates, a dozen Postgraduates, 2 Doctoral students (currently 4 are in progress), and 1 Post-doctoral candidate for their project work. He has also received travel grants from DST, India to attend the international conferences held in Minneapolis (USA), Zurich (Switzerland), Tokyo (Japan), and Cape Town (South Africa).

Body:
Two Days Hands-on Workshop on

 RISC-V VEGA PROCESSORS FOR IoT APPLICATIONS

 (India’s Indigenous

Processor Developed by C-DAC)

 November 8-9, 2024

 organized

by the

 School of Electronics

Engineering, VIT Vellore

 in

association with

 Centre for Development of Advanced Computing

(C-DAC), Thiruvananthapuram

Key Highlights:

The workshop covers everything from the initial setup of VEGA processors to

the detailed operation of various sensors, including LDRs, RFID, BMP, IR,

and more.

Participants will explore practical applications of these sensors, such as

using Light Dependent Resistors (LDRs) for automatic lighting control and

infrared (IR) sensors for motion detection, object detection, and proximity

sensing.

REGISTRATION:

CATEGORY-1 – Rs.1500/- (Rs. 1271 +GST) (inclusive of ARIES V3.0 board

https://www.amazon.in/VEGA-Processor-ARIES-Development-Board/dp/B0CTZWBDV3,

Registration Kit and refreshments) 

CATEGORY-2 - Rs.500/- (Rs. 423+GST) (Registration Kit and Refreshments)

Registration Link: https://events.vit.ac.in

A participation certificate will be provided to all the participants.

Registration Deadline: 27th October 2024. (Limited to 60 seats, first come

first serve basis).

About ARIES v3.0 Development Board ( https://amzn.in/d/6QBN6t0

https://amzn.in/d/6QBN6t0 )

ARIES v3.0 is a development platform based on THEJAS32 ASIC which operates

at a frequency of 100MHz. THEJAS32 SoC includes VEGA ET1031 Microprocessor,

256KB internal SRAM, Three UARTs, Four SPIs, Three TIMERs, Eight PWMs,

Three I2C interface, 32 GPIOs etc. This board contains everything needed to

support the standalone operation. To get started simply connect the board

to a computer with a USB cable or power it with a AC/DC adapter or a

battery.

This board is designed and developed by Centre for Development of Advanced

Computing (C-DAC) as part of the Microprocessor Development Programme

project funded by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology,

Government of India. This board is targeted for a wide variety of

applications which includes low power IoT, Sensor fusion, Smart Meter,

System supervisors, Remote sensors, Wearable devices, Toy and electronic

education equipment, Legacy 8/16-bit applications, Industrial networking

and many more…

Engineer C-DAC Trivandrum and CDAC Team

International Stuttering Awareness Day

Stuttering is a disruption in speech pattern involving disruptions, or

disfluencies, in a person’s speech, but there are nearly as many ways to

stutter as there are people who stutter. This year’s theme is One Size Does

NOT Fit All. This phrase means that a single solution or approach is not

suitable for everyone, as different people have different needs and

circumstances. This is particularly relevant to stuttering because

stuttering is complex and can manifest in so many different ways, including

physically, emotionally, and attitudinally.

It is important to recognize that people’s attitudes toward stuttering are

quite diverse and that it is important to approach stuttering with

sensitivity and respect.

Dear Students,

 - Are you an innovator looking to protect your ideas? 

 - Have you ever wondered how to transform your concepts into

 enforceable patents? 

 - Are you interested in learning how to file a patent?

 - Here’s your chance to gain hands-on experience and valuable insights

 into the world of intellectual property!

The Institution's Innovation Council (IIC) at VIT Vellore is excited to

invite you to the Patent Drafting Workshop on 21st October. This workshop

is designed to equip you with the skills needed to identify patentable

ideas, draft patent applications, and navigate the entire patent filing

process.

Event Details: 

Date: 21st October

Session 1: 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM, led by Mr. Pranay Prabhu Gaonkar, IP expert

and founding member of MG-IP.

Session 2: 2:00 PM - 6:00 PM, led by Dr. Amarendra Samal, Joint

Controller of Patents and Designs, Chennai Patent Office.

What You’ll Learn:

 - Fundamentals of intellectual property and patenting.

 - Hands-on experience in drafting patent applications.

 - Insights into filing patents in India and internationally.

 - Tips on avoiding common mistakes in the patent process.

This workshop will be an incredible opportunity for you to enhance your

knowledge, gain practical experience, and connect with patent experts.

Don’t miss out on the chance to protect your innovative ideas!

Subject: University of Queensland, Australia || Upcoming online workshop for students: Pitching and storytelling- Thursday 7 November - open for registration
Body:
Dear Students,

I am pleased to inform you that the upcoming online workshop offered by the

University of Queensland for students of Global Connect Scheme partners

scheduled for Thursday 7 November is now open for registration.

We would encourage you to promote this opportunity to your students. This

is the final workshop of the year.

Workshop details:

 - Workshop title: Pitching and storytelling

 - Date: Thursday 7 November 2024

 - Time: 2.00- 3.00pm (Brisbane, Australia time)

This is a great opportunity for students to learn to present or pitch to an

audience.

In this workshop participants will:

 - understand the fundamentals of narrative patterns and tools

 - learn how to communicate their message in a simple and concise way

 - learn how to build a compelling story and how to persuade their

 audience

 - practice and master the art of storytelling

For further information and registration, please check this out:

https://global-partnerships.uq.edu.au/event/session/7888

Registration closes on Friday 1 November.

Participation in the workshop is free of charge.

Subject: SAP at Universidade Federal de Santa Catarina (University in Brazil)
Body:
Dear Students of Pre-Final Year,

We are very happy to announce that nominations and applications for

our exchange

program are open to students interested in studying at UFSC in the first

academic semester of 2025 (March to July).

The student nomination/application period starts on October 17, 2025

Please pay attention to the application calendar:

Student nomination by the Home Institution

From 17 October to 01 November 2024

Student application

From 17 October to 01 November 2024

Application confirmation from the Home institution

Until 04 November 2024

Issuance of the acceptance letters

Until 22 December 2024

Enrollment at UFSC

February-March 2025

Semester start date - 2025.1

10/03/2025

Semester end date - 2025.1

12/07/2025

For more information on the application procedures, please visit the

website: https://sinter.ufsc.br/procedimentos-de-inscricao/?lang=en

Important Information

1. Students should apply for at least 15 hours of exchange activities

per week ( totaling 270 hours in the semester), as required by the

Interministerial Ordinance no. 7, of 13 March 2018. Therefore, attendance

in at least 12 hours of undergraduate courses per week is mandatory. The

remaining hours can be completed in language courses, outreach projects,

and other activities to be authorized by the Office of International

Relations at UFSC.

2. In the application system, students can apply for up to seven

courses . To meet the requirements in item 2, acceptance in at least 12

hours of undergraduate courses per week – totaling 216 hours in the

semester – is mandatory. Therefore, when filling in the Learning Agreement,

students are advised to exceed the minimum hours required in courses,

taking into account that enrollment requests are by the responsible

departments and acceptance in all selected courses is not guaranteed.

3. Changes in the selection of courses may be made after enrollment,

upon arrival in Brazil, but they should not exceed 25 class hours a week.

In order to check all the undergraduate courses offered at the university,

including their schedule and descriptions, access the following link:

http://cagr.sistemas.ufsc.br/modules/comunidade/cadastroTurmas/index.xhtml

http://cagr.sistemas.ufsc.br/modules/comunidade/cadastroTurmas/index.xhtml

4. The above deadlines must be strictly observed. Please inform your

students about them.

5. Students can study on any of UFSC's campuses and the choice of

campus must be made upon application. We ask them to choose carefully,

based on the distance between campuses, the programs offered and their

personal interests. More information on the UFSC campuses can be found here:

http://sinter.ufsc.br/incoming/campi/?lang=en

http://sinter.ufsc.br/incoming/campi/?lang=en

NOTE: Students from VIT who are currently on exchange at UFSC and would

like to extend their stay for the first semester of 2025 need to

access the application

system https://incoming.sistemas.ufsc.br/ again to request for an

extension and choose their courses until 01 November 2024 . The home

institution must then access the system to confirm the student's

request ( until

04 November 2024 ).

-- Interested students may fill their details using the google form link

given below on or before 20th October, 5.00 PM.

https://forms.gle/HyidczixR7GSeUn7A

creativity and knowledge on the importance of voting and democratic

participation. The Systematic Voters’ Education and Electoral Participation

(SVEEP) initiative is inviting you to participate in Wall Magazine and

Essay Competition.

magazine that promotes the significance of voting and encourages active

participation in the democratic process. Your magazine should include

informative articles, engaging illustrations, and creative elements that

capture the essence of voting and its impact on society.

Essay Competition: Write an insightful essay on one of the following

topics:

 - The Power of Your Vote: How Your Choice Can Shape the Future

 - The Importance of Informed Voting: The Role of Research and Awareness

 - The Challenges and Opportunities of Youth Participation in Elections

shine through as you inspire others to exercise their voting rights and

actively participate in the democratic process.

Dear Students,

The Indo-US Science and Technology Forum (IUSSTF) and The Viterbi School of

Engineering, University of Southern California (USC) have partnered to

support the IUSSTF-Viterbi Program.

This program provides opportunities to Indian students to undertake

research internship at the Viterbi School of Engineering in the summer of

master’s degree level and for 12, 18 or 36 months at PhD level.

 - monthly allowance of €1,181 (for master’s) and €1,800 (for PhD)

Only French educational institutions can submit the application on

candidate's behalf. Applications submitted directly by the students will

not be considered.

Interested candidates must contact the French institution where they plan

to enroll to express their interest in applying for the Eiffel scholarship.

Each institution has its own deadline for receiving applications and

supporting documents.

Subject: Fwd: Springer Nature India Research Tour 2024 in Collaboration with the Indian Council of Social Science Research (MoE)
Attachment_Names: ['Agenda_VIT Vellore Research Summit_ National Bus Tour(13-10-24).pdf']
Body:
Dear Professors and Research Scholars,

Greetings,

I trust this mail finds all you in good health and high spirits.

We are happy to take part in hosting The India Research Tour 2024

organized by Springer Nature in Collaboration with the Indian Council of

Social Science Research (MoE) on 15th October 2024 @ VIT, Vellore. We

believe that it is a strategic initiative aimed at strengthening the

country’s research landscape by nurturing talent, democratizing, fostering

conversations around accessibility, and promoting the UN’s SDGs, which is

aligned with our VIT Transformative process.

Date : 15th October,2024, Tuesday

Time : 10.00 to 12.30 PM

Venue: Dr. M. Channa Reddy Auditorium, Main Building, VIT, Vellore

The India Research Tour 2024 is a unique and promising initiative

organized by Springer Nature in collaboration with the Indian Council of

Social Science Research (MoE).

The India Research Tour 2024 is aimed at bringing together a diverse

range of key stakeholders, experts, and leaders to engage in meaningful

discussions and collaborate on fostering the advancement of research and

higher education in our nation. The ultimate goal is to leverage the power

of research to contribute positively to the holistic growth and progress of

India.

With these objectives in mind, the India Research Tour seeks to create a

platform where ideas are exchanged, partnerships are forged, and actionable

plans are developed. It is a unique space for researchers to learn in depth

about publishing opportunities, know about new ways of disseminating their

work on global platforms, educate themselves with new trends in research

publishing and harness the full potential of research for the betterment of

our nation.

As Part of the program we are having Panel Discussion on "Transformative

Agreement –Redefining Research Publishing- The impact of Transformative

Agreements on Access and Equity ", and the top 5 Women Researchers from

VIT will be recognized by Springer Nature.

It is mandatory for all the Research scholars and you are requested to fill

the registration form. Please find the registration link for Registration

Form of Springer Nature India Research Tour 2024 to VIT in Collaboration

with the Indian Council of Social Science Research (MoE).

 https://forms.gle/ixCE4P32VYr1dW6UA

Certificates will be issued to all the participants.

Note: Programme scheduled attached

We look forward to your enthusiastic participation and contribution to

the success of The India Research Tour 2024 .

Thanks and Regards

Dr. P. Arulmozhivarman

Body:
Dear Professors and Research Scholars,

Greetings,

I trust this mail finds all you in good health and high spirits.

We are happy to take part in hosting The India Research Tour 2024

organized by Springer Nature in Collaboration with the Indian Council of

Social Science Research (MoE) on 15th October 2024 @ VIT, Vellore. We

believe that it is a strategic initiative aimed at strengthening the

country’s research landscape by nurturing talent, democratizing, fostering

conversations around accessibility, and promoting the UN’s SDGs, which is

aligned with our VIT Transformative process.

Date : 15th October,2024, Tuesday

Time : 10.00 to 12.30 PM

Venue: Dr. M. Channa Reddy Auditorium, Main Building, VIT, Vellore

The India Research Tour 2024 is a unique and promising initiative

organized by Springer Nature in collaboration with the Indian Council of

Social Science Research (MoE).

The India Research Tour 2024 is aimed at bringing together a diverse

range of key stakeholders, experts, and leaders to engage in meaningful

discussions and collaborate on fostering the advancement of research and

higher education in our nation. The ultimate goal is to leverage the power

of research to contribute positively to the holistic growth and progress of

India.

With these objectives in mind, the India Research Tour seeks to create a

platform where ideas are exchanged, partnerships are forged, and actionable

plans are developed. It is a unique space for researchers to learn in depth

about publishing opportunities, know about new ways of disseminating their

work on global platforms, educate themselves with new trends in research

publishing and harness the full potential of research for the betterment of

our nation.

As Part of the program we are having Panel Discussion on "Transformative

Agreement –Redefining Research Publishing- The impact of Transformative

Agreements on Access and Equity ", and the top 5 Women Researchers from

VIT will be recognized by Springer Nature.

It is mandatory for all the Research scholars and you are requested to fill

the registration form. Please find the registration link for Registration

Form of Springer Nature India Research Tour 2024 to VIT in Collaboration

with the Indian Council of Social Science Research (MoE).

 https://forms.gle/ixCE4P32VYr1dW6UA

Certificates will be issued to all the participants.

Note: Programme scheduled attached

We look forward to your enthusiastic participation and contribution to

the success of The India Research Tour 2024 .

Thanks and Regards

Yours Sincerely,

P.Arulmozhivarman

Body:
Dear Students (Pre final year),

 Deakin University is pleased to invite nominations from VIT for Semester

Abroad Program for the T1 2025 session. This is a great opportunity for

students to experience world-class education and diverse cultural exposure

at Deakin.

Important Dates:

 - Nomination Deadline: 15th October 2024

 - Application Deadline: 30th October 2024

 - Program Duration: 3rd March 2025 – 13th June 2025

(Once the nomination is done, students will be provided with an

application link)

Students can select from a pre-approved

https://www.deakin.edu.au/international-students/study-abroad-and-exchange/academic-information/pre-approved-study-options

list

of units tailored for the program based on the credit requirement.

Entry Requirements:

 - Must have completed a minimum of two trimesters of study

 - A GPA of 2.6 out of 4 (or equivalent)

 - Must meet English language requirements (Medium of Instruction letter

 is accepted)

Fee Structure:

 - 4 Credit Points: AUD 11,220 (Please select 6-8 units when you

 apply)

 - 3 Credit Points: AUD 8,415 (Please select 5-6 units when you

 apply)

1 Deakin Credit Point is equivalent to: 7.5 ECTS S

Application process:

 - Students will be provided with an application link once we receive

 nominations from the partner institution

 - You need to upload copy of passport, transcript in English and a proof

 of English language (MOI)

 - Students need to select 5 –6 units

 - Unit selection through Deakin Handbook or pre-approved unit list

Accommodation

• Detailed information about accommodation options are on the website

Offer, health insurance, visas

· Offer letters are issued when all entry requirements are

met, and units assessed and approved by the Faculties

· Offer letters will reflect all selected and approved

units that students can potentially enrol in

· The health cover (OSHC) amount is outlined in the offer

letter

· Deakin is happy to organise the health cover through BUPA

· After offer acceptance, students will receive the eCoE

(Confirmation of Enrolment, an official Australian Government document)

· eCoE and OSHC policy are needed when applying for the visa

· Students will need to apply for the Student Visa 500

–non-award

sector, which currently has reasonable processing times

Arrival & study commencement

• We recommend arriving appr. 2 weeks before teaching commences

• We offer a complimentary airport pickup service for students and provide

instruction in the Welcome Email

• Campus wide orientation week will take place 1 week prior to teaching

• Students need to attend the compulsory Welcome Session (either on campus

or online)

• Enrolment instructions will be sent out 4 weeks prior to commencement of

trimester

• Once enrolled, students can change pre-selected units by submitting the

Enrolment Variation Form to the relevant faculty or Student Central

Interested students may fill the google form using the link below, on or

before the 14th October, 5.00 PM):

https://forms.gle/eDnX78yEQbBqmXbK9

We look forward to receiving nominations from your institution and

continuing our collaboration in fostering academic excellence.

World Mental Health Day

World Mental Health Day is observed on the 10th of October every year, with

the overall objective of raising awareness of mental health issues around

the world and mobilizing efforts in support of mental health. The Day

provides an opportunity for all stakeholders working on mental health

issues to talk about their work, and what more needs to be done to make

mental health care a reality for people worldwide.

Making positive changes can seem so hard, especially during uncertain

times. And sometimes, it can be hard to know where to start. Take the

opportunity this World Mental Health Day to find out more about how you can

start with one thing. This day, each October, thousands of supporters come

to celebrate this annual awareness program to bring attention to mental

illness and its major effects on peoples' lives worldwide.

Congratulations to all the Student Council Members!

World Post day

World Post day happens each year on October 9, the anniversary of the

Universal Postal Union (UPU), which started in 1874 in Switzerland. UPU was

the start of the global communications revolution, introducing the ability

to write letters to others all over the world. World Post Day started in

1969. Since then, countries all over the world take part in celebrations to

highlight the importance of the postal service.

From the 1600s the first national postage systems began springing up in

many countries. These were more organized and many people could use them.

Slowly countries agreed to exchange mail internationally. By the late

1800s, there was a global postal service, but it was slow and complicated.

The birth of the UPU in 1874 opened the way for the efficient postal

service in existence today. In 1948, the UPU become an agency of the United

Nations.

Subject: Online Session on UK Government's Fully Funded Chevening Scholarships & Fellowships - Wed, 9 Oct, 3.45-4.45 PM
Body:
Dear Future Scholars & Fellows

Greetings!

I am pleased to inform you that applications for the prestigious UK

Government flagship Chevening Scholarships are currently open.

The deadline for Scholarships, and two Fellowships (Gurukul and Clore) will

remain open until 5th November.

Chevening Scholarships and Fellowships—funded by the UK government's

Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) and partner

organizations—are a fully funded global awards program. Chevening

Scholarships provide opportunities to study one-year masters in the UK any

course and any subject of choice, while Chevening Fellowships are

short-term, tailored programs in the UK in fields such as Leadership, Cyber

Security, Science & Innovation, and Journalism. All these programmes cover

tuition, living expenses, and return flights. In addition, fellows gain

access to exclusive networking events, workshops, and other valuable

opportunities associated with the UK government and institutions.

To explain the opportunities for this financial year we have organized

an online

45-minute session on the same. The presentation will be delivered by the

Head of Chevening India & Bhutan, Ms Supriya Chawla and will offer a

comprehensive overview of the various programs, including application

guidance, benefits, and the life-changing opportunities they offer. Please

encourage all your students, alumni & faculty to attend the session.

 Date and Time:Wed, 9 Oct, 3.45-4.45 PM

Body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [8th October] 

events.

International Literacy Day

International Literacy Day takes place on September 8th every year to raise

awareness and concern for literacy problems within our local communities

and globally. International Literacy Day was founded by the proclamation of

The United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization, or

UNESCO, in 1966 “to remind the public of the importance of literacy as a

matter of dignity and human rights.”

This year’s International Literacy Day will be celebrated worldwide under

the theme, ‘Promoting literacy for a world in transition: Building the

foundation for sustainable and peaceful societies’.

World Physical Therapy Day

World Physical Therapy Day is observed every year on September 8. It is

celebrated to raise awareness about the critical role of physical

therapists and chronic pain therapies in keeping people healthy and fit.

Physical therapists attempt to treat an injury or deformity, educate

patients about healthy behaviors, and restore lost or damaged functionality.

Arthritis is the theme for World Physical Therapy Day 2023. Rheumatoid

arthritis and axial spondyloarthritis are two types of inflammatory

arthritis that will be highlighted on this day.

Indian Air Force Day

The Indian Air Force (IAF) will be celebrating its 91st anniversary on

October 8. The IAF will unveil its new ensign at the annual Air Force Day

parade at Prayagraj on Sunday to better reflect its values, 72 years after

a similar exercise was undertaken. The Indian Air Force's move comes over a

year after the Navy made changes in its ensign shedding its colonial past.

"October 8 will go down as a momentous day in the annals of IAF history. On

this historic day, the Chief of Air Staff will unveil the new IAF ensign,"

the IAF said.

Dear All,

Greetings!

We are pleased to inform you about an exciting opportunity to participate

in a comprehensive online course on Overview of Geographical Information

System (GIS) conducted by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)

and Indian Institute of Remote Sensing (IIRS). This course, delivered

through the IIRS Learning Management System, will be held from October 14,

2024, to November 1, 2024.

The course is aimed at UG/PG students, research scholars, and faculty

members interested in gaining in-depth knowledge of GIS principles,

spatial analysis, data modeling, and visualization techniques. This

course will also explore GIS applications, open-source software, and the

latest trends in geoinformatics and big data analytics. Resource persons

will be from ISRO.

Key Course Details:

· Duration: October 14, 2024 – November 1, 2024

(Daily 1 hour 30 minutes live interactive sessions, with recorded sessions

available post-session on the portal)

· Mode of Delivery: Online through IIRS Learning Management System

Portal.

· Course Fee: Free (Sponsored by ISRO)

· Nodal Center: Vellore Institute of Technology, Vellore

Coordinator: Dr. Jagannathan J.

· Only limited seats available - Which will be approved by the nodal

centre coordinator based on FCFS and Students, Scholar, Faculty ratio

guidelines. Certificate will be provided by ISRO through Nodal Center

Coordinator. 80% attendance is mandatory to get certificate.

------------------------------

Course Highlights:

 - GIS Overview and Concepts

 - Geographic Phenomena and Map Projections

 - Spatial and Non-Spatial Data Models

 - Data Input, Editing, and Spatial Analysis

 - Open-Source GIS Software and Tools

 - Spatial Data Quality, Uncertainty, and Error Propagation

 - Network Analysis and Map Visualization

 - Big Data Analytics and Emerging Trends in Geoinformatics

------------------------------

Learning Outcomes:

Upon successful completion of this course, participants will:

 - Gain a strong understanding of GIS fundamentals and applications.

 - Learn spatial analysis and data modeling techniques.

 - Familiarize themselves with open-source GIS software and tools.

 - Develop skills in map visualization and spatial data analysis.

 - Stay updated on emerging trends in geoinformatics and big data

 analytics.

------------------------------

How to Enroll:

 1. Use the following link to complete the one-time registration: ISRO-IIRS

 Registration Portal

https://elearning.iirs.gov.in/edusatregistration/ (Use

 official Mail Id only)

 2. Select the course titled "Overview of Geographical Information

 System."

 3. Under “Mode of Registration,” choose Registration Through ISRO Nodal

 Center.

 4. Search for "Vellore Institute of Technology" and select the

 coordinator name "Dr. Jagannathan J."

 5. Complete the remaining details and submit your application.

Note: Your registration will be verified and approved by the coordinator.

To get the certificate with the institution name and to get other

benefits, registration has to be done through a nodal center only.

------------------------------

We highly encourage all those interested in GIS, geoinformatics, and big

data analytics to take advantage of this valuable learning opportunity. If

you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Attached the Detailed schedule for your kind reference.

Looking forward to your participation.

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [7th October] 

events.

Wildlife Week

Wildlife Week is annually celebrated across India between the 2nd to 8th of

October, with an aim to protect and preserve the flora and fauna of India.

The first Wildlife Week was observed in 1957. The Indian Board of Wildlife

was constituted and the idea of Wildlife Week was conceptualized in 1952 to

raise awareness about the long-term goals of protecting the wildlife of

India. Initially, in 1955 Wildlife day was celebrated which was later

upgraded as Wildlife Week in 1957.

World Wildlife Day will be celebrated in 2022 under the theme "Recovering

key species for ecosystem restoration", as a way to draw attention to the

conservation status of some of the most critically endangered species of

wild fauna and flora and to drive discussions towards imagining and

implementing solutions to conserve them. This aligns with UN Sustainable

Development Goals 1, 2, 12, 13, 14, and 15, and their wide-ranging

commitments to alleviating poverty, ensuring sustainable use of resources,

and conserving life land.

Subject: Invitation- UM-Dearborn USA Graduate Programme Virtual information Session
Body:
Dear Students,

This is for your information and participation.

-------------

Greetings from the University of Michigan-Dearborn!

We are excited to invite you and your students to our upcoming Virtual Open

House, specifically designed for those interested in exploring our Graduate

Programs. If you have students considering furthering their education

through one of our graduate programs, this event is an excellent

opportunity to learn more about our offerings and how we can support their

academic journey.

Event details and RSVP links can be found at the link below. We have

several dates available, each hosted by individual colleges and departments

to provide tailored information on specific graduate programs.

https://umdearborn.edu/admissions/graduate-admissions/graduate-campus-visits-and-events/graduate-open-house

During the session, participants will:

 - Discover our diverse range of graduate programs.

 - Learn about our admissions process, financial aid opportunities, and

 how students can seamlessly transition from undergraduate to graduate

 studies.

 - Get answers to their questions in real-time from our admissions team,

 faculty, and staff.

We look forward to hopefully having some of your students join us virtually

and helping them take the next step toward a bright future at UM-Dearborn!

Please don't hesitate to reach out to us if you have any

additional questions.

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [05th October] 

 events.

Wildlife Week

Wildlife Week is annually celebrated across India between the 2nd to 8th of

October with an aim to protect and preserve the flora and fauna of India.

The first Wildlife Week was observed in 1957. The Indian Board of Wildlife

was constituted and the idea of Wildlife Week was conceptualized in 1952 to

raise awareness about the long-term goals of protecting the wildlife of

India. Initially, in 1955 Wildlife day was celebrated which was later

upgraded as Wildlife Week in 1957.

World Wildlife Day will be celebrated in 2022 under the theme "Recovering

key species for ecosystem restoration", as a way to draw attention to the

conservation status of some of the most critically endangered species of

wild fauna and flora and to drive discussions towards imagining and

implementing solutions to conserve them. This aligns with UN Sustainable

Development Goals 1, 2, 12, 13, 14, and 15, and their wide-ranging

commitments to alleviating poverty, ensuring sustainable use of resources,

and conserving life land.

Today's Events:

 - Footsteps through Ages

 - Surya Namaskar 2.0

 - Futurepreneurs 10.0

celebrates the evolution of dance from the 1970s to the 2020s. Each team

will represent a different era with their unique dance style while paying

tribute to a dance legend from their assigned period. Join us for an

exciting journey through the decade of dances to experience and understand

the transformation of dance.

sequence of twelve yoga poses designed to energize the body. Capture a

video of your yogic poses which begin with a prayer pose, and seamlessly

Entrepreneurship Cell ( E-Cell )

Event Name: Futurepreneurs 10.0

Time: 9 AM - 7 PM

Venue: Shakespeare Gallery, TT- 028

Event Details: Propelled by passion and hard work, we are elated to bring

you the 10th edition of Futurepreneurs, the flagship event of E-Cell, VIT,

which reflects its dedication to promoting innovation and entrepreneurship.

This event is designed to offer to all contestants a hands-on experience

with business simulations. Participants will face challenging scenarios

designed to test their business acumen and decision-making abilities.

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/ecell_vit?igsh=YWw3andkZmduN2lo

VIT Debate Society

Event Name: Matter Session 1

Time: 08:00 AM - 01:00 PM

Venue: MB210

Event Details: Our first matter session will delve into the intricacies of

how to go about debating and analysing an education based motion. Education

is something that everyone has some concrete option and knowledge of and is

fairly easy to engage in, thereby making it the perfect introductory theme

to start off with. Our Substantive department will shed insight on the

different ways in which one can build a strong case. Dealing with the

different stakeholders impacted, the mechanisms to bring about change, the

principles on which education is necessary, the culpability of certain

authority figures in enacting these policies and most importantly, how

these stack up against each other. At the end of the session we will have a

mock debate on an education motion using a live example to come up with

case lines.

Registration: VTOP

Yuva Marathi-Marathi Literary Association

Event Name: S.D.G - Sustainable Development Goals 

Time: 03:00 PM - 06:00 PM

Venue: Kamraj Auditorium

Event Details: Join us for an insightful event focused on the Sustainable

Development Goal "Life on Land." The event will kick off with a

presentation on the importance of preserving biodiversity and ecosystems.

Following the presentation, participants can engage in a fun quiz to test

their knowledge on the topic. A faculty member will then deliver a lecture,

deepening our understanding of the challenges and solutions in conserving

terrestrial ecosystems. We will conclude the event by taking a collective

pledge to protect and promote sustainable practices for life on land.

Registration: VTOP

The Next Chapter & VIT Stellar

Event Name: WIKIPEDIA SPEED RUN

Time: 9:30 AM to 12:30 PM

Venue: SMV G-21

Event Details: Get ready for a thrilling race through the cosmos and the

literary universe! In this exciting event, participants will embark on a

journey from a designated starting point to an end point, exploring the

connections between literature and space. Each participant will open the

Wikipedia page for the starting point and navigate through the links on

each page to reach their destination. For instance, you might start with

Macbeth and race your way to Andromeda! It’s not just about speed; it's

about discovering unexpected connections and having a blast while learning.

Registration: VTOP

VIT Stellar & Team Prometheus

Event Name: Crater Quest

Time: 2:00 PM to 07:00 PM

Venue: MB - 210

Event Details: This event will focus on the technical aspects of image

segmentation applied to lunar surface exploration. It will cover

methodologies for analyzing high-resolution lunar images, with the aim of

identifying key surface features such as craters, ridges, and other

geological structures. Participants will engage in hands-on activities to

implement segmentation algorithms, using real-world lunar datasets, and

gain insights into how this technology supports lunar missions and research

in planetary science. The event will also address challenges such as noise,

varying illumination, and data resolution.

Registration: VTOP

Time: 10:00 AM-1:00 PM

Venue: Google forms

Event details: The Nature Lovers Club invites you to participate in an

engaging online crossword puzzle event, "Decipher the Endangered". This

event offers participants a stimulating and interactive experience through

a Wildlife-Themed crossword challenge and gives an opportunity to test your

knowledge about wildlife.Participants will engage in a fun yet

intellectually rewarding activity that encourages learning and creativity.

Body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [04th October] 

 events.

Wildlife Week

Wildlife Week is annually celebrated across India between the 2nd to 8th of

October with an aim to protect and preserve the flora and fauna of India.

The first Wildlife Week was observed in 1957. The Indian Board of Wildlife

was constituted and the idea of Wildlife Week was conceptualized in 1952 to

raise awareness about the long-term goals of protecting the wildlife of

India. Initially, in 1955 Wildlife day was celebrated which was later

upgraded as Wildlife Week in 1957.

World Wildlife Day will be celebrated in 2022 under the theme "Recovering

key species for ecosystem restoration", as a way to draw attention to the

conservation status of some of the most critically endangered species of

wild fauna and flora and to drive discussions towards imagining and

implementing solutions to conserve them. This aligns with UN Sustainable

Development Goals 1, 2, 12, 13, 14, and 15, and their wide-ranging

commitments to alleviating poverty, ensuring sustainable use of resources,

and conserving life land.

Today's Events:

 - Jumanji: Capture the Critters

 - ART OF COEXISTENCE

 - SDG: Eco-coding

 - CASA: Campaign Against Substance Abuse

 - Design Alchemy

 -

Solid State Processing: A Deep Dive into Modern Materials Science. 

Scroll down for more information

Nature Lovers Club

Event Name: Jumanji: Capture the Critters

Time: 4:00 pm - 6:00 pm

Venue: SMV Portico

Event Details: This interactive campus event is designed to raise awareness

about local wildlife and biodiversity. Participants will follow clues to

locate and photograph various wildlife species, including birds, insects,

and small mammals, around the campus. The objective is to accurately

document these species through geo-tagged photographs, highlighting their

natural habitats. This event aims to educate students about campus

biodiversity and promote active engagement in wildlife conservation efforts.

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://instagram.com/natureclubvit?igshid=YmMyMTA2M2Y=

Nature Lovers Club

Event Name: ART OF COEXISTENCE

Time: 08:00 AM - 08:00 PM

Venue: Google forms

Event details: The poster making event is organised to create a platform

for unleashing creativity and at the same time spreading awareness through

it. Participants will have to design a poster based on themes of threats

faced by wildlife or conservative initiatives for their protection. The

event intends to stimulate creativity and spread wildlife conservation

awareness.

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link: https://instagram.com/natureclubvit?igshid=YmMyMTA2M2Y=

Indian Society for Technical Education (ISTE)

Event Name: SDG: Eco-coding

Event Timings: 10:00 AM - 01:00 PM

Event Venue: Homi Bhabha Gallery, SJT

Event Description: Join us for an exciting Green Coding Workshop, where we

explore sustainable software development! Learn to write energy-efficient

code that reduces carbon footprints and supports a greener tech industry.

This workshop promotes SDG 13 (Climate Action) by minimizing the

environmental impact of digital infrastructure and fostering innovation

under SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure). Let's code for a

sustainable future!

Event Registration: VTOP Registration

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/iste_vit_vellore/

Bulls and Bears Club

Event Name: CASA: Campaign Against Substance Abuse

Time: 03:00 PM - 05:00 PM

Venue: TT 725

Event Details: A student-focused initiative aimed at educating the campus

community about the harmful effects of substance abuse and encouraging

healthier choices. This event includes interactive sessions, expert talks,

and peer discussions, promoting a drug-free campus environment with an

emphasis on prevention, peer support, and available resources for students.

 

Registration link: VTOP

Instagram link: https://instagram.com/bullsandbears_vit/

Creativity Club 

Event name: Design Alchemy

Event description : Creative designing is a student-guided workshop where

participants will explore key design concepts and apply them using

industry-standard tools like Figma. This hands-on session provides

participants of all design backgrounds, an opportunity to create original

works, focusing on digital design, prototyping, and collaborative design

workflows.

Registration: VTOP

https://www.instagram.com/creativityclub_vit?igsh=MTVyMTd6OHU2Zms0Ng==

Science

values of non-violence and tolerance he preached, and pays tribute to the

 - About:

 The ThinkSwiss Research Scholarships offers students from India,

 Singapore and Australia fully-funded research stints in a Swiss laboratory

 of their choosing. This provides scholars with an opportunity to experience

 the Swiss research ecosystem first-hand and take the first step to a

 possible future research career in Switzerland

 - Eligibility:

 - Master students or Undergraduate students who have completed their

 2nd year, currently enrolled in an Indian university or institute.

 - The scholarship is open to students in all fields. However, we

 especially encourage students with an interest in Antimicrobial

Resistance

 (AMR), One Health, biodiversity or climate change and action to apply.

 - A written confirmation from a Professor at a Swiss university is

 required stating that he/she will accept you for a research stay

in his/her

 group.

 - Funding:

 This programme is funded by the Swissnex network, part of the Swiss

 State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI). The

 student will receive a stipend of CHF 60/day.

 - Duration: minimum of 2 months and up to a maximum of 3 months.

 - When: Anytime between 1 April 2025 and 31 December 2025.

 - Where: In a public-funded Swiss university or public-funded Swiss
