Re-FAT Approved Courses Registration

To: All Students (Vellore Campus)

Sub: Registration for 

(i) Fall 2024-25 Regular Arrear Examinations for Timed

out Students for the courses in which they have appeared and failed to

clear ['F' & 'N' grades] 

(ii) Approved Re-FATs –Winter 2023-24 & Summer 2023-24

 Debarred and students who were Absent in FAT (N2, N3 and N4) are NOT

Eligible.

Registrations are open for the Re-FAT and Regular Arrear Examinations to be

Scheduled from 21st October 2024 onwards. (Tentatively)

For Re-FAT approved students, only for the components to which approval has

been given should be registered and should adhere to the schedule given for

Re-FAT / Regular Arrear. Please note that there will not be any second

chance what so ever be the reason for not appearing in Re-FAT. There is no

Fee for Re-FAT Process.

For Regular Arrear, Students should register for ALL the Components of a

selected course. Component wise registration is NOT permitted. For

example, if a course has both theory and laboratory components, the student

should register for both theory and laboratory components to clear the

backlog, even though the student would have cleared either the theory or

laboratory component of that particular course earlier. If a course has a

‘J’ component, the student should appear for the final review again. It

will be considered equivalent to FAT for the project component of the

course.

If a student fails to clear in the arrear examination, the student can once

again register for the subsequent arrear examination or for re-registration

in subsequent semester again as a complete course (all components).

No individual component of a course is permitted once someone registers

for an arrear for that course.

login]

International Youth Day

International Youth Day on August 12 focuses on the difficulties that some

young people are experiencing throughout the world. Half the children

between the age of six and 13 lack basic reading and math skills and

childhood poverty is still a prevalent problem globally. International

Youth Day was created by the UN to help draw awareness to these issues as

Youth Day began in 2000 and was organized by the UN to recognize the input

Body:
Flipkart GRiD 6.0 - Software Development Track

Hi Nayan Sharma,

We appreciate your participation in the Flipkart GRiD 6.0 - Software Development Track. As we approach the Level 1: E-Commerce & Tech Quiz, it's imperative to thoroughly review the essential instructions and guidelines provided below. 

Your assessment for Flipkart GRiD 6.0 - Software Development Track is scheduled for 11th August 2024, from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM (Slot - 2)

Make a note of your assessment date, and be aware that slot assignments cannot be changed, and no requests for changes will be entertained.

To attempt the quiz:

  • Go to the Opportunity Page - Click Here
  • You will see a Verify/Play button in the Level 1: E-Commerce & Tech Quiz if you've registered to initiate the quiz.

Timelines & Instructions:

  • Online Assessment Window: 11th August 2024, 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM
  • Online Assessment Duration: 30 Minutes
  • Time Allotted per Question: 75 seconds
  • Total Questions to be answered: 24 multiple-choice questions based on E-Commerce trivia (Reference: https://stories.flipkart.com) and Tech (Technology Awareness + Techstack & Computer Science Fundamentals).
  • You can attempt the assessment anytime between the provided window.
  • Please ensure that you attempt the assessment in one sitting. Once you start, the timer will not stop. 
  • You will have to finish the assessment on or before 11 Aug 24, 08:00 PM IST. To get the complete assessment duration, you need to start the assessment latest by 11 Aug 24, 07:30 PM IST. Otherwise, you’ll get less time to complete the assessment.
  • Participants will be ranked on accuracy (score) and speed (time taken to answer the questions). This means that if two participants have the same score, then the one who answered their last question earlier will be ranked higher.
  • Each question will be timed and you are required to submit the answer to the questions before moving on to the next question. 
  • Your answers won't be auto-saved and you will have to submit answers individually. 
  • Please note that all team members must take the quiz and the average scores of all the members will be considered for shortlisting.
  • Your answers won't be auto-saved and you will have to submit answers individually. 
  • Please ensure that you have a stable internet connection of a minimum of 2 MBPS.
  • The preferred browser to take the quiz is Google Chrome.

Proctoring Related:

  • You can attempt the assessment only on a desktop/laptop with webcam access.
  • The assessment will be hosted in full-screen mode.
  • Anything that disturbs the full-screen mode of the assessment is treated as a violation. It may be due to any of the following reasons but not limited to:
    • Tab Switching
    • Screen Sharing with anyone
    • Clicking on the escape button
    • Computer going on Sleep (Adjust your power or sleep mode settings)
    • Windows or Browser or any Application specific notifications (Put them on DND Mode or switch them off while the assessment is on)
    • Anything else that may result in disturbing the full-screen mode
  • The assessment does not get terminated on the first such instance. Only repeated violations will result in disqualification and termination of the assessment immediately.
  • Your face will be verified before the start of the assessment from the photo that was captured during registration. 
  • Your face may be verified again during the assessment.
  • Your face will be constantly detected and violations will be tracked and reported while the assessment is on. Eg: Two faces in front of the camera, No one in front of the camera, etc.
  • You’ll have to share your screen during the assessment. 

Key Instructions:

  • You can access the assessment from the opportunity page. 
  • You will see a Verify/Play button in the MCQ Assessment round to initiate the assessment.
  • While you are taking the assessment, your answers and the time of their submission are also tracked by the system question-wise.
  • You will not be able to browse through the questions.
  • There is no negative marking for this assessment.
  • Any participant resorting to unfair practices will be directly disqualified from Flipkart GRiD 6.0
  • All decisions in the matter of eligibility, authenticity & final judgment will be with Unstop and Flipkart.

Reporting unfair practices

Please note, that any participant resorting to unfair practices will be directly disqualified from the challenge. In case any participant sees any unfair means, please email us the screenshot (maybe of social media groups) at support@unstop.com. Team ID and Email ID are displayed on the screen while taking the test. Any screenshot circulation of such a team will result in disqualification. 

All the Best!

Regards,
Flipkart Team

greenhouse gas emissions, promoting energy security, and supporting rural

development. It serves as a platform to educate the public and policymakers

Body:
Flipkart GRiD 6.0 - Software Development Track

Hi Nayan Sharma,

We appreciate your participation in the Flipkart GRiD 6.0 - Software Development Track. As we approach the Level 1: E-Commerce & Tech Quiz, it's imperative to thoroughly review the essential instructions and guidelines provided below. 

Your assessment for Flipkart GRiD 6.0 - Software Development Track is scheduled for 11th August 2024, from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM (Slot - 2)

Make a note of your assessment date, and be aware that slot assignments cannot be changed, and no requests for changes will be entertained.

To attempt the quiz:

  • Go to the Opportunity Page - Click Here
  • You will see a Verify/Play button in the Level 1: E-Commerce & Tech Quiz if you've registered to initiate the quiz.

Timelines & Instructions:

  • Online Assessment Window: 11th August 2024, 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM
  • Online Assessment Duration: 30 Minutes
  • Time Allotted per Question: 75 seconds
  • Total Questions to be answered: 24 multiple-choice questions based on E-Commerce trivia (Reference: https://stories.flipkart.com) and Tech (Technology Awareness + Techstack & Computer Science Fundamentals).
  • You can attempt the assessment anytime between the provided window.
  • Please ensure that you attempt the assessment in one sitting. Once you start, the timer will not stop. 
  • You will have to finish the assessment on or before 11 Aug 24, 08:00 PM IST. To get the complete assessment duration, you need to start the assessment latest by 11 Aug 24, 07:30 PM IST. Otherwise, you’ll get less time to complete the assessment.
  • Participants will be ranked on accuracy (score) and speed (time taken to answer the questions). This means that if two participants have the same score, then the one who answered their last question earlier will be ranked higher.
  • Each question will be timed and you are required to submit the answer to the questions before moving on to the next question. 
  • Your answers won't be auto-saved and you will have to submit answers individually. 
  • Please note that all team members must take the quiz and the average scores of all the members will be considered for shortlisting.
  • Your answers won't be auto-saved and you will have to submit answers individually. 
  • Please ensure that you have a stable internet connection of a minimum of 2 MBPS.
  • The preferred browser to take the quiz is Google Chrome.

Proctoring Related:

  • You can attempt the assessment only on a desktop/laptop with webcam access.
  • The assessment will be hosted in full-screen mode.
  • Anything that disturbs the full-screen mode of the assessment is treated as a violation. It may be due to any of the following reasons but not limited to:
    • Tab Switching
    • Screen Sharing with anyone
    • Clicking on the escape button
    • Computer going on Sleep (Adjust your power or sleep mode settings)
    • Windows or Browser or any Application specific notifications (Put them on DND Mode or switch them off while the assessment is on)
    • Anything else that may result in disturbing the full-screen mode
  • The assessment does not get terminated on the first such instance. Only repeated violations will result in disqualification and termination of the assessment immediately.
  • Your face will be verified before the start of the assessment from the photo that was captured during registration. 
  • Your face may be verified again during the assessment.
  • Your face will be constantly detected and violations will be tracked and reported while the assessment is on. Eg: Two faces in front of the camera, No one in front of the camera, etc.
  • You’ll have to share your screen during the assessment. 

Key Instructions:

  • You can access the assessment from the opportunity page. 
  • You will see a Verify/Play button in the MCQ Assessment round to initiate the assessment.
  • While you are taking the assessment, your answers and the time of their submission are also tracked by the system question-wise.
  • You will not be able to browse through the questions.
  • There is no negative marking for this assessment.
  • Any participant resorting to unfair practices will be directly disqualified from Flipkart GRiD 6.0
  • All decisions in the matter of eligibility, authenticity & final judgment will be with Unstop and Flipkart.

Reporting unfair practices

Please note, that any participant resorting to unfair practices will be directly disqualified from the challenge. In case any participant sees any unfair means, please email us the screenshot (maybe of social media groups) at support@unstop.com. Team ID and Email ID are displayed on the screen while taking the test. Any screenshot circulation of such a team will result in disqualification. 

All the Best!

Regards,
Flipkart Team

International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples

Indigenous peoples already face food insecurity as a result of the loss of

their traditional lands and territories or even climate change effects.

They also confront even graver challenges in accessing food. With the loss

of their traditional livelihoods, which are often land-based, many

indigenous peoples, who work in traditional occupations and subsistence

economies or in the informal sector, will be adversely affected by the

In order to raise awareness of the needs of indigenous peoples, every 9

August commemorates the International Day of the World’s Indigenous

Peoples. Especially now, they need us. Especially now, we need the

Subject: Fall 2024 - 25: CAT - I, General Instructions
Body:
Dear Student / Scholar,

Continuous Assessment Test - I for all the students of all the programmes

(Except MBA and BSc Agriculture) and Research Scholars is scheduled to be

conducted as per the Academic Calendar from 25th to 31st August 2024.

Students are advised to check the date and reporting time on

their individual VTOP Login (Under the menu examination - schedule).

For Soft Skill Courses and Quantitative / Qualitative Skills Practice it

will be a Computer Based Test (CBT) scheduled in different

dates/venues/duration. Kindly check the details carefully and attend the

exam.

(Use this link for attending the tests of soft skill courses:

https://vtopexams.vit.ac.in/softskills/ VTOP username (only Reg.

No. not nickname), Password: VTOP password

less than 75% attendance will be debarred from attending the Test.

debarred status if there is any valid reason. (HoDs' decision is final)

technical symposium “Mechnovate 2024, from the 08th of August 2024 to the 10

lectures scheduled in this three-day symposium.

Channa Reddy Auditorium.

Event Name: NLP and Robotics 101

Time: 11:00am to 1:00pm

Venue: TT 208

Event Description: This session will offer a comprehensive introduction to

Natural Language Processing (NLP), exploring its fundamental concepts and

key tools. Participants will delve into applications of NLP in robotics,

gaining insights into how machines will interpret and process human

language. The course will also cover essential text pre-processing

techniques, providing a solid foundation for further study and practical

implementation of NLP in various fields.

participants through an invigorating session, which will cover common

participants the negative effects of different drugs and how to combat

substance abuse. Students will also gain knowledge on the role of robotics

in prevention and combating substance abuse.

Mandatory Psychometric Test Orientation scheduled on 7th August 2024 by

11.15 am for 2026 Batch & 2027 Batch - Virtually

As part of understanding every student’s aspiration toward their student

progression, the CDC office will be conducting a

MANDATORY Psychometric Test for all students (All fall semester).

Tests will be conducted at their own location and the details will be

shared at the earliest.

We are conducting an orientation session on 7th August 11.15 am virtually

all are asked to join in the link below. Students who are attending the

orientation are only eligible for the Campus Recruitment.

https://youtube.com/live/qhFKKivKt-w?feature=share

https://youtube.com/live/qhFKKivKt-w?feature=share

The outcome of the Test: 

Effective work performance results from the right combination of knowledge

and skills, cognitive abilities, emotional intelligence, workplace

behavioural style (rooted in personality), alignment to work culture and

key work competencies. Knowing these personal success drivers will equip

you with the understanding of what makes you unique, what your strengths

are, and what areas of development will help you in launching a successful

and rewarding career. The litq.io smart assessment The litq.io smart

assessment is a scientifically designed immersive game that takes roughly

30 minutes to complete. Designed by experts with over 50 years of

experience in assessing and aligning human potential, the Litq

assessment stitches

together a series of game-based work simulations with situational judgment

scenarios and cognitive games to provide useful insights into work

potential.

Instructions:

 - To get started, open an incognito mode in the Chrome browser

 - Sign up at: https://litq.io/signup

 - Input the promo code exactly as given, including the hyphen, with no

 spaces

 - Refer to the instructions beside the password icon to set the password

 in the right format

 - Input the first and last name without gaps. If a middle name exists,

 it can be included with the first or last name without spaces.

 - Email address used for signing up should also remain unchanged.

 - College name is pre-filled and should remain unchanged.

 - Provide accurate details, including official email ID, roll number,

 and current educational information (e.g., Masters, M.Sc. Chemistry).

Subject: Academic Regulations on Attendance Requirements - Reg.
Body:
Dear Students,

KIND ATTENTION: Academic Regulations on Attendance Requirements

1. The attendance percentage will be calculated from the ‘date of

registration’ into a course to one day before the start of the exam

component. A computerized attendance monitoring system is adopted for

posting the attendance by the faculty.

2. A student is expected to maintain 100% attendance in all courses.

3. A student who may need leave due to ill health or to attend a

family emergency is permitted to maintain a minimum of 75% (i.e. absent for

25% of instructional hours) in each course, without producing any proof for

the absence.

· 25% absence includes medical, personnel, casual, official leave

of absence for organizing events/ seminars/ workshops/ technical/ cultural

festivals/competitions/ participation in co-curricular/ extra-curricular

events/ NSS & NCC camps, any other (valid or otherwise) reason.

4. Since no one is exempted from the minimum attendance requirements,

students who fail to maintain the minimum attendance criteria will not be

permitted to write the next evaluation component of the course (CAT/FAT

Exam component fixed by the course faculty in case of courses), and they

will be debarred from writing the exam.

5. Once the student fails to meet the minimum attendance requirement,

the attendance software will indicate the status of that exam component as

“Debarred” for the respective course.

6. Students having a CGPA of 9.00 and above (CGPA ≥ 9.00) and with no

current backlog courses are exempted from the minimum attendance

requirements.

· It is expected that these students will continue to attend all

the classes without absence and will not take this as an advantage to skip

classes.

· If such students’ CGPA falls below 9.00, they will be subjected

to the minimum attendance requirements again.

· The nine-pointers list will be dynamically generated and applied

at the time of preparation of the debarred list of each exam component

(CAT/FAT) of a course.

7. In case of emergency (Hospitalization / Death in the family)

· The first intimation must be given to the proctor.

· If he/she has been admitted to the hospital as an inpatient due

to medical reasons, they must submit their discharge summary, fitness

certificate, and hospital bills to the Head of the Department (

hod.ss@vit.ac.in) through the Proctor with a copy to the Programme

Secretary (secretary.ss@vit.ac.in) within three days after rejoining or

before the last working day whichever is early.

· Medical prescriptions are not considered under any circumstances.

· Based on the nature of the request, the school-level committee

will decide on Attendance Relaxation. Medical leaves will not be updated on

VTOP.

· After submitting the request, students are expected to attend all

the classes regularly and if absences are found at later stages, then

medical leave will not be considered.

8. During the exam period to avail permission for Re-CAT and Re-FAT

due to Hospitalization / Death in the family, Students are expected to

follow the circular from Dean Academics and CoE respectively (refer to the

emails from the respective office).

Hiroshima Day

Hiroshima Day is observed annually on 6 August. Hiroshima Day 2022 marks

the 77th year of walking the path of the atomic bomb. Hiroshima Day

commemorates the remembrance of the bombing attack on Hiroshima and

Nagasaki by the United States during World War II in 1945. The bombings

ended the Second World War. The day aims to promote peace politics against

the war. Hiroshima day aims to raise awareness about the threat of nuclear

energy.

History of Hiroshima Day: On 6th August 1945, the more than 9,000-pound

uranium-235 bomb was loaded aboard a modified B-29 bomber dropped the

world’s first deployed atomic bomb over the Japanese city of Hiroshima.

This happened during World War II, that is, 1939-45. The explosion which

was caused due to the bombing wiped out 90% of the city. It immediately

killed 70,000 people and tens of thousands later died due to radiation

exposure.

Subject: Recruitment Drive for Team Levitate Hyperloop - Reg.
Body:
Dear Students,

We invite students to be part of the Team Levitate Hyperloop. The

recruitment drive would focus on the following domains:

1. Mechanical

-->This domain focuses on designing the pod, including its chassis,

aerodynamic shell, propulsion and levitation system, thermal management

system, and other components. We will focus on research, simulation, and

prototyping.

2. Electrical

-->This domain focuses on power and energy systems, especially the battery

system, involved in the hyperloop system and related areas.

3. Civil and Architecture

-->This domain focuses on the development of the track, tube and other

infrastructure involved in the hyperloop technology ecosystem. Advances in

architectural and civil technology will be applied to advance hyperloop

technology.

4. Electronics

-->This domain focuses on the development of the embedded, communication

and control systems of the hyperloop system. It also involves data

acquisition and analytics, as well as instrumentation.

5. Materials Science

-->This domain focuses on the use of novel materials as well as repurposing

existing materials and structures to enhance the performance, efficiency

and safety of the hyperloop system.

6. Computer Science / Artificial Intelligence / Data Science

-->This domain focuses on the development of software systems to control

the hyperloop system. Roles extend across the entire computer science

spectrum, including software development, cybersecurity, internet of

things, artificial intelligence, to name a few. AI will be utilised to

enhance the performance, efficiency and safety of the hyperloop system.

7. Marketing / Outreach / PR

-->This domain focuses on planning, structuring and executing marketing,

outreach and PR campaigns, aiding in brand building, and helping forge

partnerships.

8. Editorial and Technical Writing

-->This domain focuses on research, technical as well as creative writing,

proofreading, and formatting a wide variety of written media, including

articles, reports, blog posts, website content, social media post captions

and content, amongst several more.

9. Graphic and UI/UX Design (Canva / Figma / Photoshop / Illustrator / etc.)

-->This domain focuses on visual ideation and concept creation, with the

aim to create designs and graphic elements for use in various materials

(including posters and brochures). This domain also extends into the design

of UI/UX for our website.

10. Video Animation, Design and Editing (Blender / Maya / 3DS Max / etc.)

-->This domain focuses on ideating, creating, animating, editing, producing

our team's video content. which can be of use in either technical areas and

for marketing purposes. This includes the creation of social media reels,

documentaries, and short films.

11. Photography and Videography

-->This domain focuses on capturing photos and recording videos of the team

at various times for marketing purposes.

various UG programmes can avail of the monthly assistance under the Pudhumai

Penn Scheme. A similar scheme named as Tamizh Pudhalvan Scheme has also

been launched for male students. All students who have studied in

government schools from sixth to twelfth standard, and are natives of Tamil

Nadu are eligible to apply for this scholarship.

integrated programmes (up to 3rd year) are encouraged to apply for the

scholarship. Students whose applications were rejected earlier can also

apply.

herewith, and submit it to the Students' Record Section, Room No G-14, Dr.

MGR Block on or before 8 August 2024. Students should fulfill the

following criteria to avail of this scholarship.

 Also, the student should have a bank account in any one of the following

banks:

1. Indian Bank

2. Canara Bank

3. State Bank of India

4. Indian Overseas Bank

Eligible students are advised to avail of this opportunity provided by the

Government of Tamil Nadu.

Subject: Invitation to take part in India Semiconductor Mission - VDAT 2024 - avail Early bird registration
Body:
28th IEEE International Symposium on 

VLSI Design and Test (VDAT) 2024

VIT, Vellore, India

September 1-3, 2024

 Call for Participation 

India is a rising player in the global semiconductor industry, with the

region’s chip market projected to surpass $55 billion in size by 2026!. The

India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) aims to strengthen the semiconductor

industry in India, which in turn contributes to the country's overall

economic growth. It creates employment opportunities, attracts investments,

reduces imports, promotes technological self-reliance, and fosters

innovation. The semiconductor industry's growth has a multiplier effect on

various sectors, including electronics, telecommunications, healthcare,

automotive, and defense, leading to sustainable economic development.

We are excited to present our upcoming annual flagship event from the VLSI

Society of India, the 28th International Symposium on VLSI Design and Test

(VDAT-2024), scheduled to be held from 1st to 3rd September 2024 at Vellore

Institute of Technology (VIT), Vellore, Tamil Nadu, India. This event is

organized in collaboration with our Industry Partners Marvel, Synopsys,

Microchip, Keysight Technologies, Western Digital, Mirafra Technologies,

Siemens, Elmac Engineering Services etc.

VDAT 2024 has taken this to the next level with the technical contents

(both in quantity and quality) as well as the overall contents of the

program (something for everyone from academia, industry, and

associations). VLSI Design Conference 2025 will follow after VDAT 2024, to

continue accelerating the ecosystem growth on semiconductor and VLSI.

www.vit.ac.in/vdat2024 http://www.vit.ac.in/vdat2024

Highlights

Keynote & Tutorial Speakers

 - 6 Keynotes

 - 9 Tracks of Tutorials on Day 1 (September 1, 2024)

o Mixed Signal ASIC

o Emerging Technologies

o VLSI Testing and Testability (With Hands-on Labs)

o System Design

o Internet of Things

o Physical Verification

o VLSI Design Verification

o Design Implementation – RTL to GDSII (With Hands-on Labs)

o Standard Cell Characterization

 - Exhibits from Industry and 100+ Industry delegates

 - 600+ Attendees from 100+ Academic Institutions

 - PhD Research forum, Design Contest and Career Guidance forum for

 students

 - Panel Discussions - Future of UG Students in Semiconductor Industry

 - Mr. Navin Bishnoi, Country Head, Marvell Technology

 - Dr. Poki Chen, Taiwan National University, Taiwan

 - Shamitha Rao, Sr. Manager, Synopsys India

 - Alok Kuchlous, CEO, Mirafra Technologies

 - Dr.Renold Sam Vethamuthu, Microchip

 - Yadu Krishnan, Microchip

 - Janet Christina & Sneha Tanwar, ChipEdge Technologies

 - Putta Satish, Principal Engineer - Maven Silicon

 - Lalit Mohan, Cadence

 - Sachin Shrivastava, Cadence

 - Vishal Rastogi, Cadence

 - Deepak Karnatak, Cadence

 - Sakshi Arora, Manikandan R R – IIIT Bangalore

 - Prof. Sudeb Dasgupta, IIT Roorkee

 - Dr. Noor Mohammed, IIIT Kancheepuram

 - Venkata Reddy Kolagatla, Shramona Roy

 - Vivian Desalphine, C-DAC, Bangalore

 - Aquib Quraishi, Marvel Technologies

 and more …

You can visit the conference website for a detailed schedule of Tutorials

https://streaklinks.com/CELFlIwVVUp7w_20UAryXRDV/https%3A%2F%2Fvit.ac.in%2Fvdat2024%2Ftutorial_schedule.html

and Technical programs.

Why attend?

 - It exposes attendees to cutting-edge research and innovative projects

 - Offers practical skill development through tutorials and hands-on

 sessions

 - Direct interactions with the industry showcasing their latest

 products, tools, and solutions

 - Provides unparalleled networking opportunities to Connect with

 industry leaders, fostering collaborations and career advancements

 - Enhances knowledge through the latest trends, technology, and research

 presented in tutorials, keynotes, design contests, PhD forum and technical

 sessions

 - Networking opportunities with industry leaders, experts, and potential

 partners

 - Access to the latest technological advancements and market trends

 - Exploring business opportunities and collaborations in the

 semiconductor sector

Who can participate?

 - Engineers working in VLSI, Embedded, and automotive electronic sectors

 - Faculty members teaching/plan to teach VLSI and Embedded Systems

 courses.

 - UG/PG students/ Research scholars from circuit branches to network

 with industry professionals and want to learn the advancement in industry

 and explore career opportunities.

 - HoD/Dean/Principal of institutions offering VLSI courses at UG/PG

 level.

How Can participate?

Interested professionals can register for the event using the following

registration link:

https://vit.ac.in/vdat2024/registration.html

 - Last date for Early bird registration: August 10, 2024

 - The registration fee includes a conference kit, refreshments, and

 lunch during the conference.

 - Accommodation is not included in the registration fee

10% discount on the registration fee will be provided to participants who

wish to complete bulk registrations (more than 5 members) from the same

institution. Interested participants or head of the organization may

contact vdat.registration@vit.ac.in for further details.

Please pass this notification to your known contacts working in the

relevant domain

For more details: https://vit.ac.in/vdat2024/

Subject: Swami Dayanand Education Foundation Merit-cum-Means Scholarships 2024 - Reg.
Body:
Dear Students,

Swami Dayanand Education Foundation (SDEF) provides Merit-cum-Means

Scholarships to exceptionally talented but poor students who cannot afford

to study at reputed colleges, owing to financial constraints. The

foundation awards scholarships on the basis of school merit or to the top

rankers in national/state level common entrance tests based on which they

have secured admissions to quality institutes/colleges. The Scholarship is

offered to students pursuing Engineering, MBBS, Pharmacy, IT, Architecture,

and all undergraduate courses in Government or private Institutes,

including IITs, NITs, and others.

Eligibility Criteria:

 -

 The scholarship is available for all undergraduate courses –

 engineering, medical, architecture and other undergraduate courses.

 -

 Secured at least 85% in CBSE Board or 75% or above Marks in Other Boards

 in 12th Class

 -

 CGPA of at least 8.0 for Second year students

 -

 Annual Family Income should be between 1.2 Lacs to 8 Lacs per annum

 -

 Only first and second year students are allowed to apply for this program

 -

 Only one year drop is allowed for technical courses

 -

 Applicant studied from Govt or Govt aided schools

 -

 All India Overall Rank should be less than 90,000 for Engineering &

 Architecture courses and 40,000 for medical courses

 -

 Age limit - 19 years for first year students and 20 years for second

 year students

Visit https://www.swamidayanand.org/scholarship-india for more information.

To apply, click on https://www.swamidayanand.org/scholarship-india

50% scholarship reserved for female applicants.

For more information, please send an email to

scholarships@swamidayanand.org <scholarships@swamidayanand.org> or WhatsApp

Guidelines for course registration and evaluation process

# Students are advised to check the curriculum and plan accordingly.

For the students of B. Tech Core Programmes, this project type course will

be considered under Programme Elective Category and for the students of

"Specialization Programmes", it will be considered under "Open Elective

Category". If the students of "Specialization Programmes" have already

earned sufficient credits under "Open Elective Category", then it is not

necessary to register for this project type course.

# Students are expected to form a team and identify a faculty guide

from any School to initiate the process.

# Project Team should comprise a minimum of two to a maximum of five

students only from any B. Tech Programme of any School / Five Year

Integrated Programme as applicable. (students of B. Tech Programme and Five

Year Integrated Programme can not be in the same team)

# Domain specific / Interdisciplinary / Multidisciplinary /

Cross-disciplinary projects are encouraged.

the team of students to work on each project. Course Registration is opened

on VTOP Login for the faculty members (Guide). (Preliminary discussion

between the guide and the student is essential)

# Students can work for one project type course at any point of

time.

Guide will fill in the necessary data (Project title and the Registration

Number of all the students proposed to work on each of the projects) on

VTOP Faculty Login.

# Subsequently the course will reflect on the list of registered

courses for that particular semester on VTOP Student Login. This three

credit course will not affect the upper limit of 27 credits allowed for a

regular semester.

# Once the Project work is completed and a tangible outcome (Research

/ Review Paper published / accepted in Scopus / WoS, Journal / Conference

Proceedings: Product Design / Patent Application) is reached, the Guide

will post the marks out of 100 for each student on VTOP and submit.

# HoDs will be given access to verify the outcome (Paper / Patent

etc) and approve for further processing.

# Absolute Grading System will be followed for the listed project

type courses as per VIT Grading Policy

The International Day of Friendship was proclaimed in 2011 by the UN

cultures, and individuals can inspire peace efforts and build bridges

between communities. The resolution places emphasis on involving young

people, as future leaders, in community activities that include different

entrepreneurship.

your academic journey and beyond.

your innovative ideas.

- Meet potential mentors who can guide and support you.

- Connect with fellow students who share your interests and passions.

potential.

We are an organization with boundless potential ready to add more firepower

into our ranks to take VIT forward in the world of advancing technologies.

Don't miss this fantastic opportunity to meet fellow innovators,

entrepreneurs, and inventors! Mark your calendars for 31st July and get

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today's [29th July] events.

International Tiger Day

International Tiger Day, is an annual celebration to raise awareness for

tiger conservation, held annually on 29 July. It was created in 2010 at the

Saint Petersburg Tiger Summit. The goal of the day is to promote a global

system for protecting the natural habitats of tigers and to raise public

awareness and support for tiger conservation issues. There are a number of

other issues that tigers all around the world face. Some of the threats

that tigers face include poaching, conflict with humans, and habitat loss.

Presently, there are 13 tiger range countries including India, China,

Bangladesh, Cambodia, Lao PDR, Bhutan, Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Nepal,

Malaysia, Russia, and Myanmar.

Subject: Avoiding any unpleasant interactions on campus - Reg.
Body:
Dear Students,

As we embark on another academic year, let us remember about our commitment

to creating a safe, inclusive, and respectful environment on campus.

Ragging, in any form, is strictly prohibited on our campus. It is a

practice that not only undermines the dignity of individuals but also

disrupts the harmony and camaraderie that we strive to foster. As you know,

our institution has a zero-tolerance policy towards ragging, and we ensure

that every student feels secure and respected.

Ragging includes any act of physical or mental abuse, bullying, harassment,

or any conduct by one student towards another that causes harm, fear, or

humiliation. Engaging in ragging can result in severe disciplinary action,

including suspension, expulsion, and legal consequences as per the law. We

have established a dedicated anti-ragging committee and helpline to support

and protect students.

If you or your friend is experiencing or witnessing ragging, please do not

hesitate to report it immediately. All reports will be handled with

confidentiality and sensitivity. Your cooperation and active participation

are essential in upholding our values and maintaining a safe and nurturing

atmosphere. Let us stand united against ragging and support each other in

creating a community where everyone can thrive without fear or intimidation.

Students from the Freshers Batch of 2024 are requested to inform/report any

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today's [27th July] events.

Today's Events:

 - TALES OF THE SCALE

 - Finance Workshop for Beginners

 - Chemically Doped: Exploring Nanotechnology and MXene with Dr. Yuri

 Gogots

 - ಅಜೇಯರ ನೆನಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ (Remembering the brave)

Scroll down for more information

Nature Lovers' Club

Event Name: TALES OF THE SCALES

Event Time: 9:00 am to 7:00 pm

Platform: Google Drive

Event Description: Nature Club takes pride in organizing a documentation

event on reptiles. Unleash your creativity as a wildlife photographer! join

our survey to discover the hidden gems across the VIT campus. Our thriving

surroundings provide an ideal home for reptiles, but they often go unseen.

With this survey, you can help us better learn about the species at this

budding monsoon. The participants will upload the file via Google Drive.

Let us bring these often-overlooked inhabitants to the spotlight!

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://instagram.com/natureclubvit?igshid=YmMyMTA2M2Y=

Bulls and Bears

Event Name: Finance Workshop for Beginners

Event Time: 05:00 PM - 07:00 PM

Platform: Zoom

Event Description: Join our workshop on quantitative finance using Excel.

Covering derivative pricing, valuation, and model risk management. Explore

career opportunities, top employers, and salaries. Get a hands-on demo of

our product for real-world challenges.

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://instagram.com/bullsandbears_vit/

VIT COMMUNITY RADIO

Event Name: Film Appreciation Session

Event Time: 10:00 am to 1:00 pm

Venue: VCR Studio - SJT 804

Event Description: This event enhances participants' understanding and

enjoyment of cinema through film screenings and guided discussions. Led by

a knowledgeable facilitator, attendees will explore direction, screenplay,

cinematography, and acting. The goal is to deepen appreciation for cinema

and provide a platform for sharing insights, encouraging critical thinking

and a greater appreciation of the medium.

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/vitradio?igsh=YnZmbXBncTMwYWtr

AIChE - VIT

Event Name: Chemically Doped: Exploring Nanotechnology and MXene with Dr.

Yuri Gogotsi 

Event Time: 5:00 pm to 5:30 pm

Platform: YouTube Live

Event Description: The Chemically Doped podcast includes an interview with

Dr. Yuri Gogotsi, a famous Ukrainian scientist and professor at Drexel

University. Known as the "Father of MXene," the episode highlights MXenes,

a new type of 2D nanomaterial, and explores Dr. Gogotsi's research in this

innovative area.

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/aiche_vit/?hl=en

YouTube Link: https://youtu.be/YuoaN7hsNmc

Facebook Link: https://www.facebook.com/aichevit/

LinkedIn Link: https://www.linkedin.com/in/aiche-vit-student-chapter/

Kannada Literary Association

Event Name: ಅಜೇಯರ ನೆನಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ (Remembering the brave)

Event Time: 8 pm to 9 pm

Platform: Google Meet

Event Description: "Remembering the Brave: Kargil Vijay Divas

Commemoration". Join us on July 27th as we pay tribute to the heroes of the

Kargil War on the occasion of Kargil Vijay Divas. Our speaker event

features an ex army officer Dr. Kushwant Kolibailu. We will also pay a

special tribute to the martyrs who laid down their lives during the war.

Let us come together to honor the bravery and sacrifice of our soldiers and

remember the significance of this pivotal moment in Indian history.

Body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you to today’s (26th July) Special

Events to commemorate Kargil Vijay Diwas. This day marks a significant

moment in our nation's history, and we aim to honor the bravery and

sacrifice of our soldiers who fought valiantly during the Kargil War. The

celebration will include a series of events designed to reflect on the

heroism of our armed forces and to instill a sense of patriotism and pride

among us all.

26th July, 2024, marks the 25th Anniversary of Kargil Vijay Diwas. It

is celebrated

every year, as a significant day in the history of India. It is observed to

pay tribute to the bravery of Indian soldiers who sacrificed their lives

for the country during the Kargil War of 1999.

Additionally, it also commemorates the country’s victory over Pakistan in

the Kargil War of 1999 and marks the successful culmination of Operation

Vijay. In this operation, the Indian Armed Forces reclaimed the territories

in the Kargil district of Jammu and Kashmir that had been infiltrated by

Pakistani soldiers and militants. Kargil Vijay Diwas is a solemn reminder

of their sacrifices and a celebration of their valour, serving as a

unifying moment of national pride and gratitude.

Dastaan-e-Kargil

Time: 05:30 PM

Venue: SMV Portico

Event Description: Join us on Kargil Diwas for a powerful street

play"Dastaan-e-Kargil", honoring our brave soldiers. Watch our talented

actors bring to life stories of courage, sacrifice, and patriotism through

compelling performances. This play will take you on an emotional journey,

celebrating the heroes who fought for our country. Expect drama, action,

and heartfelt moments that will leave a lasting impression. Don’t miss this

special event that celebrates the spirit of Kargil Diwas and the bravery of

our soldiers.

Kargil Vijay Diwas - Saluting Kargil Heroes

Time: 06:00 PM - 08:00 PM

Venue: Greenos

Event Description:Join us for a cultural evening commemorating the

sacrifices, bravery and patriotism of our jawans who fought for the nation

and the people!

Body:
Dear Students,

Centre for Clean Environment (CCE) at Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT)

was established and formally inaugurated on 30th April 2024 with the

intention to associate with Global Sustainable Development Goals adopted by

the United Nations. CCE focuses on finding innovative technologies and

sustainable solutions for the environmental issues from local to global

scale. The centre addresses environmental concerns by collaborating with

government, industry, non-government organizations and leading academic

partners through national and international research networks. Our thrust

area of research and consultancy revolves around water & wastewater

treatment & management, solid waste management, waste to wealth, emerging

contaminants, novel methods for environmental remediation,

multidisciplinary approach towards environmental monitoring, bioremediation

of organic pollutants in soil and water, environmental systems design,

computations & modelling, heavy metal removal, air pollution & climate

change, environmental forensic analysis, health risks & environmental

impact assessment, environmental awareness, and other relevant areas of

environmental concerns. The centre has several ongoing consultancy and

research projects both at regional, national, and international level. The

centre targets to use transdisciplinary approach in solving the

environmental issues. Environmental Analytical Lab is the integral part of

the centre which has the facilities for the environmental monitoring and

assessment.

Currently, we are welcoming the undergraduate/postgraduate students to join

our team to carry out the research in the thrust areas mentioned above.

The interested students can fill the google form given below to get

involved in research at CCE.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1QgGZAPuWY1o8E_hSxZ0On6WkV_-BttkI_UaHRFWflMM

Kindly submit the form on or before 16.08.2024.

Subject: Fwd: You're Invited: Ice Breaker 2024 - Unlock Your Potential with IIC-VIT!
Body:
Dear Students,

A warm welcome to VIT! As you embark on this exciting new chapter, we

invite you to attend the VIT's Institution's Innovation Council (IIC-VIT)

latest event for an unforgettable Fresher Ice-Breaker event!

Date: 31st July

Time: 11 A.M. to 1 P.M.

Location: TT VOC GALLERY II [2nd Floor]

 - Are you passionate about Innovation, Entrepreneurship, Inventions, and

 Adventure?

 - Do you dream of being your own boss or collaborating with like-minded

 individuals to bring your design ideas to life?

 - Look no further! Our Fresher Ice-Breaker is the perfect platform to

 kick-start your journey.

What we do at IIC:

- Witness a vibrant community that encourages innovation and

entrepreneurship.

- Access resources and support to turn your ideas into reality.

- Develop valuable skills and networks that will benefit you throughout

your academic journey and beyond.

What to Expect:

- Learn about the state-of-the-art facilities available in VIT to foster

your innovative ideas.

- Meet potential mentors who can guide and support you.

- Connect with fellow students who share your interests and passions.

- Engage in fun and interactive sessions designed to unlock your creative

potential.

We are an organization with boundless potential ready to add more firepower

into our ranks to take VIT forward in the world of advancing technologies.

Don't miss this fantastic opportunity to meet fellow innovators,

entrepreneurs, and inventors! Mark your calendars for 31st July and get

ready to break the ice.

Please contact our student coordinator, Abhranil Sarkar (+91 9800949008)

for further details.

We look forward to seeing you there!

We are excited to announce that the Institutions Innovation Council (IIC)

Dear Students of VIT

Greetings from Teachnook(IIT ROORKEE)

Final Reminder for VIT college students 

This Internship and Training will be conducted after your exams!!!

Interested students must fill out the form, if you get shortlisted you

will get a call from our HR Team:

The students must fill out the form to get this opportunity:

https://forms.gle/dd9UA7bGq4orjCut6 https://forms.gle/dd9UA7bGq4orjCut6

IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT : Once You filled the form kindly share the form to

your friends and make sure everyone fill the form

FIND THE BELOW ATTACHMENTS FOR REFERENCE:

First month: IIT training has been designed in the form of Live lectures

along with living mentorship from industry professionals. (Login

credentials will be provided to students after registration)

Second month: Internship with live mentorship for projects from

professionals. The LIVE INDUSTRY PROJECT will give students experience in

solving real-world problems.

Third month: Based on your performance during the program's first two

months, we will conduct a technical interview in the same company during

the third month. You will be offered a stipend-based Internship if you

perform well in the interview and there will be high chances of getting

placed in the particular company itself .

Project 1:- 10 individual projects are assigned to each intern, which they

must complete with their mentor.

Project 2:- Capstone Project: It's a group project assigned to 15

interns. For each intern particular work will be assigned to them, and they

have to work on it.

(Essential data and materials required for the project will be provided by

the company side itself)

Here are two types of Classes we are providing:

1. Blended Program/Recorded classes: You will receive recorded sessions,

whatever doubts you have you can clear them in live doubt-clearing sessions

organized every weekend.

2. Mentor-led/Live classes: You will have live Zoom classes at 6:30 PM 2

to 3 days a week. You will get your recorded sessions as well

You will have access to the LMS(Learning Management System) portal for 6

months.

Program Highlights:

: India's First - offering programs with low-code and no code tools, with a

promise of 100% outcome-driven results

: linkedIn Top Startup 2023

: Certifications from Cognizance - IIT Roorkee verified through Wipro Dice

ID

: Learn from tech-gaint mentors and industry leaders

: Cutting-edge curriculam including generative AI and prompt engineering

: Exclusive masterclasses with students, founders, and CXos from top global

companies

Personalized instructors for comprehensive guidance from start to finish

Secure your spot now to pave the way for a successful carrer journey with

Teachnook !

👨🏻‍🎓 Student Testimonials:

during interviews." - (

Sarangi.

"The mentorship and guidance provided by industry experts were Top-notch."

- (https://www.linkedin.com/in/vnr-nitish/), Nitish Raj Vinnakota.

our Upskilling Career Program. Limited slots are available, so act now to

secure your spot and gain a competitive edge in the dynamic job market.

Subject: SAY NO TO RAGGING-Reg
Body:
Dear Students,

As we embark on another academic year, I am writing this mail to you about

our commitment to creating a safe, inclusive, and respectful environment on

campus.

Ragging, in any form, is strictly prohibited on our campus. It is a

practice that not only undermines the dignity of individuals but also

disrupts the harmony and camaraderie that we strive to foster. Our

institution has a zero-tolerance policy towards ragging, and we ensure that

every student feels secure and respected.

Ragging includes any act of physical or mental abuse, bullying, harassment,

or any conduct by one student towards another that causes harm, fear, or

humiliation.

Engaging in ragging can result in severe disciplinary action, including

suspension, expulsion, and legal consequences as per the law.

We have established a dedicated anti-ragging committee and helpline to

support and protect students. If you or your friend is experiencing or

witnessing ragging, please do not hesitate to report it immediately. All

reports will be handled with confidentiality and sensitivity.

Your cooperation and active participation are essential in upholding our

values and maintaining a safe and nurturing atmosphere. Let us stand united

against ragging and support each other in creating a community where

everyone can thrive without fear or intimidation.

For any help, Contact:

On July 23rd, India commemorates National Broadcasting Day to honor the

profound influence of radio in our lives. This significant day marks the

inception of India's first-ever radio broadcast.

Indian radio played a significant role in the formation of an independent

India. Prior to gaining independence, Azad Hind Radio led by Netaji Subhash

Chandra Bose and Congress Radio both played instrumental roles in inspiring

and mobilizing Indians against British colonial rule. Furthermore, during

the 1971 war, Akashvani played a crucial role in supporting Bangladesh’s

liberation struggle. These historical contributions highlight the immense

impact of radio broadcasting in shaping the nation’s destiny. As a result,

National Broadcasting Day holds immense importance as a significant

occasion for our country, celebrating the power of broadcasting and its

role in shaping India’s history.

Pi Approximation Day

Pi Approximation Day is observed on July 22 (22/7 in the day/month format),

since the fraction 22⁄7 is a common approximation of π, which is accurate

to two decimal places and dates from Archimedes.

Mr. Rajveer Meena, who has a B.Tech degree from VIT, participated in the 'Most

Pi Places Memorised' was hosted at VIT University on March 21, 2015. He

has set a Guinness World Record by memorizing 70,000 post-decimal

digits of Pi, beating Lu Chao, a Chinese who had held the record for 10

years (67,890 digits).

He was awarded the certificate of Guinness World Record for memory on

October 1, 2015. Rajveer wore a blindfold throughout the entire recall,

which took nearly 10 hours," the official website of the Guinness World

Records states. The record-breaking event was held in VIT.

https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/most-pi-places-memorised

Dear Mam,

 Kindly forward the workshop invitation to all faculty, scholars and

students

At the outset, on behalf of the School of Computer Science Engineering and

Information Systems, VIT, Vellore, I cordially invite you to the One-day

International Workshop Series on “Workshop on smart methods for monitoring

and mitigating effluents in water bodies using IoT and AI”, scheduled on

July 25th 2024.

The workshop is a part of the sponsored research project “Environmental

Monitoring and Evaluation via Remote Advanced LoRa-Driven Detectors

(EMERALD) for Heavy Metal Contamination” (P3228), under the SPARC-UKIERI

funded by the SPARC and British Council.

 Registration link: https://tinyurl.com/mswtp97m

https://tinyurl.com/mswtp97m 

The workshop intends to discuss the Impact of effluents in water bodies

around Vellore involving Industry 5.0 & Enabling Technologies. The

perspectives of academic experts and industry partners on developing a

smart framework for monitoring and mitigating water pollutants will be

presented. The students’ perspectives on the awareness of pollutants and

innovative mitigation schemes are also encouraged to bridge the

industry-academic gap.

-- 

Thanks

Dr Siva Rama Krishnan

SPoC AWS

International Moon Day

The General Assembly declared International Moon Day, a United

Nations-designated international day to be observed annually on 20

July. International

Moon Day marks the anniversary of the first landing by humans on the Moon

as part of the Apollo 11 lunar mission. With the birth of space activities,

the Moon became the ultimate destination of countless missions, including

crewed flights that brought the first human footprints to another place in

the universe.

The theme for International Moon Day 2024 is “Illuminating the Shadows.” To

commemorate International Moon Day the United Nations Postal Administration

(UNPA is issuing six postage stamps and three souvenir sheets featuring

various pictures from lunar missions.

International Chess Day

On 12 December 2019, the General Assembly proclaimed 20 July as

International Chess Day to mark the date of the establishment of the

International Chess Federation (FIDE) in Paris in 1924. Under the

initiative of FIDE, July 20 has been observed as International Chess Day by

chess players around the world since 1966. As it was recognised by UNESCO

in 1966, the day underscores chess’s role in fostering cultural exchange,

mutual understanding, and social interaction among players worldwide.

It is believed that the game of chess, which was once known as

“Chaturanga”, dates back almost 1500 years and originated in India. The

purpose of International Chess Day 2024 is to promote chess as a game for

everyone, regardless of age, gender, or background.

 CGPA expectation (6 out of 10), attendance & conduct etc.

Body:
Office of the Controller of Examinations

 Ref.No. : VIT/CoE/2024/24021

 Date:

18-July-2024

Paper Seeing, Revaluation and Re-FAT Process for 

Summer Semester 2023-24 FAT – Theory 

 Paper Seeing and Revaluation:

· In the VTop student login, (“Examination → Marks → Summer

Semester 2023-24”) Marks for the Courses to which FAT was held during July

2024 has been made available now.

· Actual Grades will be released on 22 July 2024 (Monday). The

Pass criteria and Grading Procedure are available in Academics → Regulations

Tab in your login.

· If you want to know the question wise marks awarded to your

answers by the evaluator, you need to apply for it through V-Top. This is

referred as “Paper Seeing” process. It requires payment of Rs. 100 for each

paper. You can apply through: Examinations →Papersee/Rev → Summer Semester

2023-24→Paper Seeing. You can choose course(s) you want to apply for

paper seeing. After Generating the Invoice, you need to make a payment

through “Online Payments” Tab in the same V-Top login.

· Once you have paid, within one or two working days, the

paper and question

wise marks awarded will be made available in CodeTantra login. You need

to use the same portal https://vit.codetantra.com for this process. After

seeing the paper, if you feel the mark awarded to a particular question is

not sufficient and the evaluator has missed something and there is a need

to recheck the mark, then you can apply for Revaluation of the Course. You

need to give suitable reason for the same in the comments section available

just below the mark awarded by the faculty.

· Please note that the Revaluation has to be applied only in V-Top

(in the same way as you have applied for paper seeing) and necessary

payments also needs to be paid through online payments tab. (Rs. 300 per

paper).

· Also note that “Paper seeing” and Revaluation is applicable only

for the Theory Courses to which FAT was conducted by CoE office . For other

components and Courses (like Laboratory / Project Courses IBL mode courses)

there is No Paper seeing and Revaluation Process.

· Actual Grades will be released after the completion of

“Paper-Seeing” and Revaluation Registration Processes. The links for Paper

seeing and Revaluation payments have been enabled in VTop Students login.

Paper seeing and feedback / comments are mandatory for re-evaluation and

is in online mode only.

· The students who were involved in Summer Semester 2023-24

examination malpractices are not eligible for paper seeing/ Re-valuation

process.

 Once the Paper seeing request is approved, the evaluated copy of answer

sheets would be made available in CodeTantra as per the above

schedule. Use your VTop login credentials for login.

· After login, follow the instructions given in the platform for

giving comments to the questions which needs to be re-examined.

· Give your feedback with respect to the need for revaluation. If

no feedback is given for any question, your answer script will not be

considered for revaluation and No refund will be given for any approved

requests.

· Students should not approach or give any sort of request to any

faculty related to revaluation (increase of marks or grades). If we

receive any complaints from faculty, it will be treated as ‘Malpractice’

and revaluation request will summarily be rejected.

Re-FAT:

As per VIT Academic regulations (Page 22) Re-FAT will be permitted for the

following reasons only:

S. No.

Description

Supporting Evidence(s) Required

1.

Calamity in the family [Death of father / mother / own brother / sister]

Death certificate or Prior communication to the Proctors

2.

Hospitalization of the student

(for in-patient treatment only)

Medical Certificate, Investigation Report, Bills and Discharge Summary.

· Eligible students should apply in VTop student login (

Examination > Re-Exam Application) between 22nd July 2024 and 28th July

2024 and upload the necessary evidences.

· Re-FAT requests will be scrutinized by the School Dean and then

by the ‘Re‐examinations Committee’. If needed the student may be asked to

appear before the Committee for presenting the case.

· For the ReFAT approved courses the Grade assigned will be

converted to “---“ by August end. ReFAT will be scheduled along with the

Fall 2024-25 Regular Arrear and the Regular Arrear Process will be followed

for Re-FAT.

· Any student who fails to apply for Re‐FAT through VTop will NOT

be considered for further processing and has to repeat the course(s) by

registering again in subsequent semesters. 

· Please note that this process is only for getting approval for

Re-FAT. After it is approved, students need to register in Arrear / Re-FAT

Tab for registering the course when it is permitted. The schedule will be

available only in Arrear/ Tab. If someone misses the approved Re-FAT, no

second chance will be given and it will be treated as absent accordingly

grade will be published.

World Day for International Justice, also referred to as Day of

International Criminal Justice or International Justice Day, is an

international day celebrated throughout the world on July 17 as part of an

effort to recognize the emerging system of international criminal justice.

July 17 is the date of the adoption of the treaty that created the

International Criminal Court.

July as the Day of International

Criminal Justice. Each year, people around the world use this day to host

Subject: VIT Study Buddy programme 2024-25 ​: A​ wonderful opportunity to interact with the International Students
Body:
Kind Attention : 2nd & 3rd Year Undergraduate students

VIT International Relations Office 

Launches the 

 Study Buddy programme

A wonderful opportunity to interact with the International Students

Objectives :

 - The Study Buddy Program brings international students together with

 other students

 - The program matches newly arrived international students (Mentees)

 with a VIT student (Buddy) who helps them as they start their studies and

 adjust to life in VIT.

 - The Buddies give tips, advice and assistance that make it easier for

 their Mentees to become familiar with the University and get settled in VIT

Expectation from the Buddy :

 - An interest in spending time with international students

 - Good English language skills

 - Time and willingness to help one to two international students for one

 semester (especially before and during the initial weeks of the semester

Benefits of being the Study Buddy :

 - An opportunity to make new friends with international students and

 other Buddies

 - Improved language skills

 - Participation in activities with other members of the Study Buddy

 Program

 - Long-term friendships with foreign students and intercultural learning.

 - First-hand information about a country or partner university where you

 will study

 - Information to help you make or revise preparations for your own

 foreign stay

ARE YOU INTERESTED? Register now for an exciting program of

intercultural exchange. Here is a link...

https://forms.gle/2tin3EhZCwV1mhcS6

Thank you,

Best Wishes,

Dr.R.Seenivasan

Director -International Relations

International Malala Day

International Malala Day: Malala Day is observed on July 12 to honor the

prominent activist for women's education and the youngest Nobel Prize

laureate, Malala Yousafzai. For her efforts toward promoting women’s

education, in October of 2012, she was attacked and left in critical

condition by the Taliban. She was rushed to a UK hospital, where she

recovered.

After her recovery, Malala bravely continued to advocate for women’s

education. And on her 16th birthday, 12 July 2013, she delivered a moving

speech at the UN in favor of women’s rights to education. She also founded

the Malala Fund to help young girls have access to education. Malala Day is

a time to remember the story of Malala Yousafzai and to stand up for

women’s rights to education the world over.

World Population Day

World Population Day, which seeks to focus attention on the urgency and

importance of population issues. Current estimates indicate that roughly 83

million people are being added to the world’s population every year. Even

assuming that fertility levels will continue to decline, the global

population is expected to reach 8.6 billion in 2030, 9.8 billion in 2050,

and 11.2 billion in 2100, according to the medium-variant projection.

The United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) works to support family planning

by ensuring a steady, reliable supply of quality contraceptives;

strengthening national health systems; advocating for policies supportive

of family planning; and gathering data to support this work.

The Vellore Mutiny

The Vellore mutiny, or Vellore Revolution, occurred on 10 July 1806 and was

the first instance of a large-scale and violent mutiny by Indian sepoys

against the East India Company, predating the Indian Rebellion of 1857 by

half a century. The revolt, which took place in the South Indian city of

Vellore, lasted one full day, during which mutineers seized the Vellore

Fort and killed or wounded 200 British troops. The mutiny was subdued by

cavalry and artillery from Arcot. Total deaths amongst the mutineers were

approximately 350; with summary executions of about 100 during the

suppression of the outbreak, followed by the formal court-martial of

smaller numbers.

On 10th July 1806, the sepoys who had gathered killed 14 British officers

and 115 Englishmen of the 69th Regiment. The mutiny started during midnight

and by dawn, the fort had been captured by them. They raised the flag of

the Mysore Sultanate over the fort. They also declared Tipu Sultan’s son

Fateh Hyder the king. But a British officer who had escaped the fort

alerted the British force present at Arcot. From Arcot, British troops

arrived led by Sir Rollo Gillespie. He was able to quell the rebellion.

About 100 Indian soldiers were brought out of the palace where they had

sought refuge. They were then ordered to stand against a wall and shot

dead. In all, 350 Indian soldiers were killed and 350 wounded.

World Zoonoses Day

World Zoonoses Day is held every year on July 6. The day commemorates

July 6, 1885, when Louis Pasteur successfully administered the first

vaccine against Rabies virus, a zoonotic disease. Theme day raises

awareness of the risk of zoonotic diseases.

A zoonosis is any disease or infection that is naturally transmissible from

vertebrate animals to humans. Animals thus play an essential role in

maintaining zoonotic infections in nature. Zoonoses may be bacterial,

viral, or parasitic, or may involve unconventional agents. As well as being

a public health problem, many of the major zoonotic diseases prevent the

efficient production of food of animal origin and create obstacles to

international trade in animal products. The pandemic of Coronavirus disease

(COVID-19) caused by SARS-CoV-2 has been classified as a zoonotic disease,

however, no animal reservoir has yet been found, so this classification is

premature.

Hello VITians,

Unleash Your Creativity this Summer: 70 Days of Online Contests!

DAY-62 (06th July-Saturday)CELLPHONE PHOTOGRAPHY CONTEST

TOPIC:

 Moment of Reflection

We would like to see your unique perspective of this. Capture a pic through

your cell phone!

Here's how to participate:

 - Take the most captivating photo showcasing the given topic.

 - Upload the photo on your Instagram page.

 - Tag SW page in the post @sw_vit (Make sure your post & profile are

 public)

The winning photo will be chosen based on two factors:

 - Creativity and composition: Does your photo capture the essence in a

 unique and interesting way?

 - Capturing campus vibes in stunning photographs.

 - Engagement: How many likes does your photo receive by tomorrow 05:00

 pm.

 - Plagiarism: Uploading photos from any other sources will disqualify

 you from the contest.

The grand prize? A cool ₹500 as prize!

Contest Duration:The contest starts tomorrow morning at 06:00 am and ends

by 05:00 pm.

So, start clicking and share your best shots!

For more information: events.sw@vit.ac.in

Office of the Controller of Examinations

Winter Semester 2023-24 Regular Arrear Paper Seeing and Revaluation

· The links for Paper seeing and Revaluation have been enabled in

VTop Students login. Paper seeing and feedback / comments are mandatory for

re-evaluation and is in online mode only.

· If you want to know the question wise marks awarded to your

answers by the evaluator, you need to apply for it through V-Top. We call

this as the Paper Seeing Process. It requires payment of Rs.100 for each

paper. You can apply through: ExaminationsàRegular Arrear/Re-FATà

Papersee/RevàWinter Semester 2023-24àPaper Seeing. You can choose course(s)

you want to apply for paper seeing. After Generating the Invoice, you need

to make a payment through “Online Payments” Tab in the same V-Top login.

· Once you have paid, within one to two working days, the

paper and question

wise marks awarded and total marks out of 100 will be made available in

CodeTantra login. You need to use the same portal

https://vit.codetantra.com for this process. After seeing the paper, if you

feel the mark awarded to a particular question is not sufficient and the

evaluator has missed something and there is a need to recheck the mark,

then you can apply for Revaluation of the Course. You need to give suitable

reason for the same in the comments section available just below the mark

awarded by the faculty.

· Please note that the Revaluation has to be applied only in V-Top

(in the same way as you have applied for paper seeing) and necessary

payments also needs to be paid through online payments tab. (Rs. 300 per

paper).

· There might be a tab in CodeTantra platform also for Revaluation

which is NOT for our use. It is their default settings. Kindly IGNORE it.

·

Particulars

Dates

Paper seeing registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 100]

04-Jul-2024 to 06-Jul-2024

Revaluation registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 300]

05-Jul-2024 to 07-Jul-2024

Paper Seeing in https://vit.codetantra.com/

05-Jul-2024 to 07-Jul-2024

Once the Paper seeing request is approved, the evaluated copy of answer

sheets would be made available in CodeTantra after 1 or 2 working days. Use

your VTop login credentials for login.

· After login, follow the instructions given in the platform for

giving comments to the questions which needs to be re-examined.

· Give your feedback with respect to the need for revaluation. If

no feedback is given for any question, your answer script will not be

considered for revaluation and No refund will be given for any approved

requests.

· Students should not approach or give any sort of request to any

faculty related to revaluation (increase of marks or grades). If we receive

any complaints from faculty, it will be treated as ‘Malpractice’ and

revaluation request will summarily be rejected.

Dear Students of VIT

Greetings from Teachnook(IIT ROORKEE)

Final Reminder for college students 

This Internship and Training will be conducted after your exams!!!

Interested students must fill out the form, if you get shortlisted you

will get a call from our HR Team:

The students must fill out the form to get this opportunity:

 https://forms.gle/dd9UA7bGq4orjCut6 https://forms.gle/dd9UA7bGq4orjCut6

IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT : Once You filled the form kindly share the form to

your friends and make sure everyone fill the form

Join Our Official WhatsApp Group For More Information;

https://chat.whatsapp.com/Dnu8jR2hdSa7p4hEnwrx1S

https://chat.whatsapp.com/Dnu8jR2hdSa7p4hEnwrx1S

FIND THE BELOW ATTACHMENTS FOR REFERENCE:

First month: IIT training has been designed in the form of Live lectures

along with living mentorship from industry professionals. (Login

credentials will be provided to students after registration)

Second month: Internship with live mentorship for projects from

professionals. The LIVE INDUSTRY PROJECT will give students experience in

solving real-world problems.

Third month: Based on your performance during the program's first two

months, we will conduct a technical interview in the same company during

the third month. You will be offered a stipend-based Internship if you

perform well in the interview and there will be high chances of getting

placed in the particular company itself .

Project 1:- 10 individual projects are assigned to each intern, which they

must complete with their mentor.

Project 2:- Capstone Project: It's a group project assigned to 15

interns. For each intern particular work will be assigned to them, and they

have to work on it.

(Essential data and materials required for the project will be provided by

the company side itself)

Here are two types of Classes we are providing:

1. Blended Program/Recorded classes: You will receive recorded sessions,

whatever doubts you have you can clear them in live doubt-clearing sessions

organized every weekend.

2. Mentor-led/Live classes: You will have live Zoom classes at 6:30 PM 2

to 3 days a week. You will get your recorded sessions as well

You will have access to the LMS(Learning Management System) portal for 6

months.

Program Highlights:

✅ Subject mentors for outcome-driven training.

✅ 36+ hours of comprehensive training.

✅ 10+ practical sessions for hands-on experience.

✅ Course completion certificate from AICTE.

✅ Internship completion certificate from IBM.

✅ Letter of Recommendation (LOR) from IBM based on performance.

✅ Access to a thriving community for further Stipend-Based Internship

Opportunities and Placement Assistance.

✅ Access to the Growth Community

YOUR SUCCESS AWAITS! Don't miss the chance to supercharge your career with

our Upskilling Career Program. Limited slots are available, so act now to

secure your spot and gain a competitive edge in the dynamic job market.

🚀 Embark on Your Journey to Success with TEACHNOOK !

Subject: Guidelines – Course Registration (Fall Semester 2024 - 25)
Body:
Dear student,

Guidelines – Course Registration (Fall Semester 2024 - 25)

 1. Senior Students and timed-out students of all the programmes except

 BSc (Agri), BSc Catering & Hotel Management, B. Des., B. Arc., BSc

 Multimedia, BSc Visual Communication, M. Des., MBA, M. Arc., MSW, B.

 Tech Computer Science and Business Systems are permitted to take part

 in the course registration.

 2. Course Registration is scheduled to be conducted on 06. 07. 2024.

 3. Information on courses offered for the Fall Semester 2024 - 25 is

 made available on VITian Mobile App (with an advanced search option).

 4. Information on the course registration schedule for the Fall Semester

 2024 - 25 (time and duration for various groups of students) will be made

 available on 04.07.2024 on VITian Mobile App.

 5. During the course registration process (on 06.07.2024), the system

 will prompt to register for the applicable Soft Skill Course, English

 Course, SET and NASSCOM Course as per the curriculum of the respective

 programmes. Subsequently, UC: University Core, PC: Programme Core, FC:

 Foundation Core, DLESC: Discipline linked Engineering Sciences, DC:

 Discipline Core, PE: Programme Elective, UE: University Elective, DE:

 Discipline Elective, SPE: Specialization Elective, OE: Open Elective and

 compulsory courses with the following options will be permitted:

 Regular / Re-register / Substitution (UE / OE / DE / PE and also in

HSM / Language Basket)

 Regular (UC as UE, PE as UE, DE as OE, SPE as OE)

 Minor Programmes

Multidisciplinary Elective (applicable to the B. Tech Core Programmes only

except BBS): An option is provided to earn the required credits under the

Discipline Elective / Open Elective category by registering courses listed

under multidisciplinary electives. The eligibility criteria to register

course(s) under multidisciplinary elective is to have completed a minimum

of 9 credits from the courses listed under the Discipline Electives. The

remaining credits can be earned from the courses listed under either

Discipline Electives or Multidisciplinary Electives to complete credit

requirements as per the curriculum.

 6. Add / Drop option will be enabled for all the students from 15.07.24

 to 17.07.2024. During the Add / Drop period, students can register for

 courses under Audit / Grade Improvement / Additional Course / Honour

 options.

 7. Removal of courses registered under regular mode is not possible

 unless course registered under ‘Additional’ is removed first.

 8. Student should generate invoice on VTOP (in the timetable menu) and

 proceed for payment (under the menu – Online Payments) for the courses that

 demand course fees. Courses of fee defaulters will be deregistered after

 the deadline (26.07.2024).

 9. Courses cannot be deleted or withdrawn if the fee payment is done.

 10. Students are required to go through the Academic Regulations for

 further clarification on the terminologies.

 11. Queries related to course offering should be addressed to the

 respective Head of the Department.

Kind Attn: 2021 Batch B. Tech Students (except BBS)

BXXX497J - Project – I (3 credits) is compulsory for 2021 batch B.Tech

students. During course registration students should select a guide and the

tentative title of the project. (Guide change option will be enabled during

Add / Drop period)

Event Coordinated by SPIC MACAY, VIT

We would like to see your unique perspective of this. Capture a pic through

your cell phone!

Here's how to participate:

 - Upload the photo on your Instagram page.

 - Tag SW page in the post @sw_vit (Make sure your post & profile are

 public)

 you from the contest.

by 05:00 pm.

International Plastic Bag Free Day

International Plastic Bag Free Day, celebrated on July 3, is a global

initiative that aims to eliminate the use of plastic bags. Plastic bags may

seem like a grocery shopping convenience, but they are also a huge strain

on the environment. It can take up to 500 years for plastic bags to

disintegrate, so they make up a large portion of what stays in our

landfills and pollutes our waterways.

International Plastic Bag Free Day looks for safer alternatives to

demonstrate that a world without the use of so much plastic is possible. It

is part of the Break Free from Plastic Movement, which began in September

2016, and has been joined by nearly 1,500 different organizations. The

movement is looking for solutions to the plastic pollution crisis, to make

the planet safer for humans, the environment and wildlife.

World UFO Day

World UFO Day is an awareness day for people to gather together and watch

the skies for unidentified flying objects. July 2 commemorates the supposed

UFO crash in the 1947 Roswell UFO Incident. In the late 1940s and through

the 1950s, UFOs became popularly known as ‘flying saucers’ or ‘flying

discs’. Today, many believe that we are not alone in the universe and that

extraterrestrial life that did not originate on Earth exists.

With so much interest in UFOs, World UFO Day Organisation (WUFODO)

organized a World UFO Day in 2001 to bring together believers and the

evidence they have gathered to support their existence. The stated goal of

the July 2 celebration is to raise awareness of "the undoubted existence of

UFOs" and to encourage governments to declassify their files on UFO

sightings.
