Body:
Dear Students,

Do you have a brilliant startup idea?

This is your chance to turn it into reality! We're inviting interested

students to participate in the Student Startup Venture (SSV) platform

designed to spark your entrepreneurial spirit and help you communicate your

ideas to the world.

SSV support has been extended to students since 2017, over 160 projects

have been supported and 19 startups have emerged…

Successful Startups like https://vicara.co/ https://vicara.co/ ;

https://alfaleus.in/

https://alfaleus.in/ ; https://www.punar.in/ https://www.punar.in/;

kuppismart solutions pvt ltd/ have emerged with the support of SSV.

SSV comes with a grant of up to Rs. 2.00 lakhs for prototype development

activities. The duration of the project will be from August 2024 to May

2025. All students of UG, PG programs, and Research Scholars on the campus

are eligible to apply. A faculty mentor is mandatory for every team

of SSV (Maximum of 3 students + 1 faculty mentor). Only those who are

engaged in technology product development (hardware) can apply. This call

is not for app development, pure software products and research activities.

This fund purely supports technology innovations leading to novel products,

prototypes, and venture creation.

Innovations in the following themes are encouraged.

1. Sustainability (including energy/ renewable energy technologies)

2. Cleantech/ GreenTech Revolution

3. HealthTech Horizons

4. Smart Cities and Digital Realities

5. AgriTech – including post-harvest technologies

6. Clean Energy Breakthroughs

7. Smart devices based on AI/ML (including consumer & enterprise AI

solutions), IoT and IIoT

8. BioTech and Life Sciences

9. Robotics, Drones and Automation

10. Sports tech

To avail of this opportunity, please register on the below link on or

before the 20thof July 2024.

 Registration link for SSV: https://tinyurl.com/SSV2024-25

Kindly find attached the guidelines, which will help you with the

submission process. Kindly make sure that the outcomes are met during the

completion of the project. Once the ideas have been shortlisted, we will

be contacting you on how to take further steps. The projects completed

through SSV will be given the opportunity to be Pre-incubated/ Incubated at

VIT-TBI.

 For Details Pls Contact:

Dr. Vidhya, E-Cell Co-ordinator

 ecell.coordinator@vit.ac.in <ecell.coordinator@vit.ac.in>

 Regards

Dr. C Ramesh KumarProfessor and Director

Office of Innovation Startup and Technology Transfer 

Vellore Institute of Technology

National Doctor’s Day | July 1st

India celebrates National Doctor’s Day on July 1 each year, in honor of

the birth and death anniversary of the great physician and the second Chief

Minister of West Bengal, Dr. Bidhan Chandra Roy. Since then India has grown

by leaps and bounds in the medical field, not just to further Dr. B.C.

Roy’s work but also with new and innovative techniques. This day serves to

show gratitude to all those who have selflessly aided us in our time of

need and tirelessly worked for the health of their patients by

commemorating the greatest representative of these ideals.

Doctor’s Day was established by the Government of India in 1991 to be

recognized and celebrated every year on July 1 every year in India.

Doctor’s Day is observed on different dates across the world. If we did not

recognize the importance of doctors before, we are certainly learning just

how much they contribute to society, amid the coronavirus pandemic. While

we are self-isolating, it is the doctors who are constantly fighting for

the lives of people who have been infected with the deadly virus.

Body:
Hello everyone,

SW is excited to invite you all for an online hackathon coordinated and

organized by The VIT Anchoring Club. HackAttack is a 24-hour hackathon

that challenges participants to tackle societal issues and develop

innovative solutions. The event comprises three rounds:

Round 1- Design Hackathon - Create designs using tools like Figma, Canva,

or graphic design software.

Round 2- Presentation Round - Present your solutions creatively through

creative writing (stories, poems, or scripts).

Round 3- Video Making Round - Produce short videos or reels to demonstrate

your solutions as creatively as possible.

We have a prize pool of INR 6000 for the winners, and all participants

will receive certificates. Teams can range from 2 to 4 members, and people

who are unable to find a team, we would be glad to assist them. Remember,

creativity is the key to this hackathon.

Details:

Date: 30th June to 1st July

Time: 10:00 PM to 10:00 PM (tomorrow)

Platform: Online via MS Teams

All the members must join the commencement meet. A Google Meet session will

follow each round, and at least one member from each team must attend.

For any queries, please contact:

Parth Sharma: +91 85957 30083

Vrindha Nair: +91 79072 28331

International Day of the Tropics

The International Day of the Tropics celebrates the extraordinary

diversity of the tropics while highlighting unique challenges and

opportunities nations of the Tropics face. It provides an opportunity to

take stock of progress across the tropics, to share tropical stories and

expertise, and to acknowledge the diversity and potential of the region.

The Tropics are a region of the Earth, roughly defined as the area between

the tropic of Cancer and the tropic of Capricorn.

The International Day of the Tropics was designated to raise awareness of

the specific challenges faced by tropical areas, the far-reaching

implications of the issues affecting the world’s tropical zone and the

need, at all levels, to raise awareness and to underline the important role

that countries in the tropics will play in achieving the Sustainable

Micro-, Small, and Medium-sized Enterprises Day

27th June is declared as Micro-, Small, and Medium-sized Enterprises Day,

to raise public awareness of their contribution to sustainable development

and the global economy. These enterprises, which generally employ fewer

than 250 persons, are the backbone of most economies worldwide and play a

key role in developing countries.

learn the manual alphabet and faced adversity herself because of it. She

was called a miracle worker for helping teach her pupil how to read and

write when no one thought she would learn.

Body:
Dear Students of VIT

Greetings from Teachnook(IIT ROORKEE)

Final Reminder for VIT college students 

This Internship and Training will be conducted after your exams!!!

Interested students must fill out the form, if you get shortlisted you

will get a call from our HR Team:

The students must fill out the form to get this opportunity:

https://forms.gle/Vz6CW7gpquYheaSe7 https://forms.gle/Vz6CW7gpquYheaSe7

IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT : Once You filled the form kindly share the form to

your friends and makesure everyone fill the form

Join Our Official WhatsApp Group For More Information;

https://chat.whatsapp.com/DM6Y3ckMwIYKhjr7g1jyAF

https://chat.whatsapp.com/DM6Y3ckMwIYKhjr7g1jyAF

FIND THE BELOW ATTACHMENTS FOR REFERENCE:

First month: IIT training has been designed in the form of Live lectures

along with living mentorship from industry professionals. (Login

credentials will be provided to students after registration)

Second month: Internship with live mentorship for projects from

professionals. The LIVE INDUSTRY PROJECT will give students experience in

solving real-world problems.

Third month: Based on your performance during the program's first two

months, we will conduct a technical interview in the same company during

the third month. You will be offered a stipend-based Internship if you

perform well in the interview and there will be high chances of getting

placed in the particular company itself .

Project 1:- 10 individual projects are assigned to each intern, which they

must complete with their mentor.

Project 2:- Capstone Project: It's a group project assigned to 15

interns. For each intern particular work will be assigned to them, and they

have to work on it.

(Essential data and materials required for the project will be provided by

the company side itself)

Here are two types of Classes we are providing:

1. Blended Program/Recorded classes: You will receive recorded sessions,

whatever doubts you have you can clear them in live doubt-clearing sessions

organized every weekend.

2. Mentor-led/Live classes: You will have live Zoom classes at 6:30 PM 2

to 3 days a week. You will get your recorded sessions as well

You will have access to the LMS(Learning Management System) portal for 6

months.

Program Highlights:

✅ Subject mentors for outcome-driven training.

✅ 36+ hours of comprehensive training.

✅ 10+ practical sessions for hands-on experience.

✅ Course completion certificate from AICTE.

✅ Internship completion certificate from IBM.

✅ Letter of Recommendation (LOR) from IBM based on performance.

✅ Access to a thriving community for further Stipend-Based Internship

Opportunities and Placement Assistance.

✅ Access to the Growth Community

YOUR SUCCESS AWAITS! Don't miss the chance to supercharge your career with

our Upskilling Career Program. Limited slots are available, so act now to

secure your spot and gain a competitive edge in the dynamic job market.

🚀 Embark on Your Journey to Success with TEACHNOOK

International Day Against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking

The General Assembly decided to observe 26 June as the International Day

against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking as an expression of its

determination to strengthen action and cooperation to achieve the goal of

an international society free of drug abuse. Supported each year by

individuals, communities, and various organizations all over the world,

this global observance aims to raise awareness of the major problem that

illicit drugs represent to society. The theme for this year's International

Day against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking is "The evidence is clear:

invest in prevention". 

The day is also meant to commemorate Lin Zexu’s efforts toward the

strategic dismantling of the opium trade in Human, Guangdong in China right

before the First Opium War on the Chinese Mainland. The Day is observed for

the need to improve the understanding of the world drug problem and how in

turn, better knowledge will foster greater international cooperation for

countering its impact on health, governance, and security. The day is

dedicated to eradicating drug abuse and neutralizing the systemic

challenges which sustain the illegal drug issues.

Hello VITians,

Unleash Your Creativity this Summer: 70 Days of Online Contests!

DAY-52 (26th June-Wednesday)CELLPHONE PHOTOGRAPHY CONTEST

TOPIC:

 Creating a Safer Community

The International Day against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking, or World

Drug Day, is marked on 26 June every year to strengthen action and

cooperation in achieving a world free of drug abuse. The global drug

problem presents a multifaceted challenge that touches the lives of

millions worldwide. Through collective action and a commitment to

evidence-based solutions, we can create a world where individuals are

empowered to lead healthy, fulfilling lives.

We would like to see your unique perspective of this. Capture a pic through

your cell phone!

Here's how to participate:

 - Take the most captivating photo showcasing the given topic.

 - Upload the photo on your Instagram page.

 - Tag SW page in the post @sw_vit (Make sure your post & profile are

 public)

The winning photo will be chosen based on two factors:

 - Creativity and composition: Does your photo capture the essence in a

 unique and interesting way?

 - Capturing campus vibes in stunning photographs.

 - Engagement: How many likes does your photo receive by today 05:00 pm.

 - Plagiarism: Uploading photos from any other sources will disqualify

 you from the contest.

The grand prize? A cool ₹500 as prize!

Contest Duration:The contest starts today at 06:00 am and ends by 05:00

pm.

So, start clicking and share your best shots!

For more information: events.sw@vit.ac.in

Theranostics (CBCMT) at the Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT).

of Bioengineering, George Mason University

·Date: 01.07.2024 to 05.07.2024

· Time: 10:00 Am to 05:00 PM

· Location: MB 210, Vellore Institute of Technology

· Organizers: SMEC and CBCMT

· Google site: https://tinyurl.com/vit-sparc

· Registration Link: https://tinyurl.com/SPARCREG

Themes

ü INTRODUCTION TO BIOINSPIRED SURFACES

ü CONCEPT OF WETTABILITY & SURFACE TOPOGRAPHY

ü CONCEPT OF BIOINSPIRED FUNCTIONS

ü FABRICATION OF BIOINSPIRED SURFACES

ü DEVICES BASED ON BIOINSPIRED SURFACES

üSURFACE ROUGHNESS AND TOPOGRAPHY IN BIOMATERIALS

stunning, invigorating season starts to feel like it's happening. Formerly

barren trees burst into a million tiny blossoms, you get a handful of long,

perfect days, and everyone is just in a good mood.

April was a month of cultural vibrance at VIT. Various regional New Year

Celebrations like Ugadi, Chitirai, Utkal Divas, Gudhi Padwa, Baisakhi and

Vishu were organised, clearly displaying the cultural diversity and

inclusiveness on our campus. Traditional attire, games, cuisines and

cultural performances made it a memorable celebration of the diverse

heritage and cultural pride among the student community.

Outreach events on the occasion of World Art Day, National Civil Service

Day and World Earth Day were organised at the Bethel Institute and the Hope

House respectively. Paavendhar Bharathidaasan - Tamil Literary Association

organised a Movie Screening of the popular Tamil Movie "Gilli" which saw an

audience of 250 students.

Day of the Seafarer

The International Maritime Organization, which is a specialized agency of

the United Nations responsible for regulating shipping, decided in 2010 to

designate June 25 as the Day of the Seafarer. This was done to highlight

the fact that almost everything we use in our daily lives is either

directly or indirectly affected by sea transport. Apart from highlighting

the work they do, the purpose of the day is to also thank them for their

contribution to civil society and the world economy. The role of seafarers

often goes underappreciated within the maritime industry and by the general

public. Seafarers are an essential component in world trade, keeping the

economy moving and delivering goods and fuels we use every day and

recognizing the contribution that seafarers make to our everyday lives.

It is hoped that by holding the Day of the Seafarer, the general public

will become more aware of the role that seafarers play in their lives and

why they are so fundamental in determining the prosperity of the worldwide

economy. Seafarers Day will continue to campaign for greater governmental

support for seafarers, while also highlighting the need for all seafarers

to receive the same standards of care when it comes to training

opportunities, safety standards and workplace welfare both now and in the

future.

Hello VITians,

Unleash Your Creativity this Summer: 70 Days of Online Contests!

DAY-51 (25th June-Tuesday)CELLPHONE PHOTOGRAPHY CONTEST

TOPIC:

 The Art of Navigation

Day of the Seafarer (25th June) is recognized by the United Nations as an

observance day. Seafarers are an essential component in world trade,

keeping the economy moving and delivering the goods and fuels we use every

day.

We would like to see your unique perspective of this. Capture a pic through

your cell phone!

Here's how to participate:

 - Take the most captivating photo showcasing the given topic.

 - Upload the photo on your Instagram page.

 - Tag SW page in the post @sw_vit (Make sure your post & profile are

 public)

The winning photo will be chosen based on two factors:

 - Creativity and composition: Does your photo capture the essence in a

 unique and interesting way?

 - Capturing campus vibes in stunning photographs.

 - Engagement: How many likes does your photo receive by tomorrow 05:00

 pm.

 - Plagiarism: Uploading photos from any other sources will disqualify

 you from the contest.

The grand prize? A cool ₹500 as prize!

Contest Duration:The contest starts tomorrow morning at 06:00 am and ends

by 05:00 pm.

So, start clicking and share your best shots!

For more information: events.sw@vit.ac.in

Hello VITians,

Unleash Your Creativity this Summer: 70 Days of Online Contests!

DAY-50 (24th June-Monday)CELLPHONE PHOTOGRAPHY CONTESTTOPIC:

 Sportsmanship Beyond Competition

International Olympic Day is celebrated to commemorate the day when the

International Olympic Committee was founded in 1894. It is meant to

motivate individuals around the world to become their best selves. One

doesn’t have to be an Olympian to participate in this day. The first-ever

Olympic day was celebrated on June 23, 1948, to commemorate the birth of

the modern Olympic Games on 23 June 1894 at the Sorbonne in Paris. The goal

was to promote participation in sports across the globe regardless of age,

gender, or athletic ability.

We would like to see your unique perspective of this. Capture a pic through

your cell phone!

Here's how to participate:

 - Take the most captivating photo showcasing the given topic.

 - Upload the photo on your Instagram page.

 - Tag SW page in the post @sw_vit (Make sure your post & profile are

 public)

The winning photo will be chosen based on two factors:

 - Creativity and composition: Does your photo capture the essence in a

 unique and interesting way?

 - Capturing campus vibes in stunning photographs.

 - Engagement: How many likes does your photo receive by today 05:00 pm.

 - Plagiarism: Uploading photos from any other sources will disqualify

 you from the contest.

The grand prize? A cool ₹500 as prize!

Contest Duration:The contest starts today at 06:00 am and ends by 05:00

pm.

So, start clicking and share your best shots!

Dear Students of VIT

Greetings from Teachnook(IIT ROORKEE)

Interested students must fill out the form, if you get shortlisted you

will get a call from our HR Team:

 https://forms.gle/dd9UA7bGq4orjCut6 https://forms.gle/dd9UA7bGq4orjCut6

https://chat.whatsapp.com/Dnu8jR2hdSa7p4hEnwrx1S

https://chat.whatsapp.com/Dnu8jR2hdSa7p4hEnwrx1S

FIND THE BELOW ATTACHMENTS FOR REFERENCE:

First month: IIT training has been designed in the form of Live lectures

along with living mentorship from industry professionals. (Login

credentials will be provided to students after registration)

Second month: Internship with live mentorship for projects from

professionals. The LIVE INDUSTRY PROJECT will give students experience in

solving real-world problems.

Third month: Based on your performance during the program's first two

months, we will conduct a technical interview in the same company during

the third month. You will be offered a stipend-based Internship if you

perform well in the interview and there will be high chances of getting

placed in the particular company itself .

Project 1:- 10 individual projects are assigned to each intern, which they

must complete with their mentor.

Project 2:- Capstone Project: It's a group project assigned to 15

organized every weekend.

months.

Opportunities and Placement Assistance.

✅ Access to the Growth Community

our Upskilling Career Program. Limited slots are available, so act now to

secure your spot and gain a competitive edge in the dynamic job market.

Dear Students,

The role of Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB), under the Ministry of Home

Affairs, Govt. of India, as the nodal agency on the matter of drug law

enforcement in India has gained prominence in recent times.Over the years,

NCB has generated quality intelligence leading to detection and disruption

of organized drug trafficking groups. It has also been acting as a

coordinating entity between various narcotics and drug law enforcement

agencies within the country and also as India’s nodal point with

international agencies.

To create awareness about the ill-effects of drugs on the society and the

health of individuals, the Narcotics Control Bureau has requested all the

students from the Educational Institutions to take the e-pledge during 20th

to 26th of June, 2024.

You are requested to take the e-pledge during the above mentioned week and

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [21st June] 

 events

The International Day of Yoga

United Nations proclaimed 21 June as the International Day of Yoga. June

21, which is the Summer Solstice, is the longest day of the year in the

Northern Hemisphere and has special significance in many parts of the

world. International Yoga Day aims to raise awareness worldwide of the many

benefits of practicing yoga. Yoga is an ancient physical, mental and

spiritual practice that originated in India. The word ‘yoga’ derived from

Sanskrit and means to join or to unite, symbolizing the union of body and

consciousness.

Practiced in India since the 5th century, Yoga has been beneficial in

keeping the body and mind in sound health. A holistic approach, Yoga

targets all the different systems of the body and mind. It is said that

asanas make the body strong and flexible, and as health improves; the mind

too is renewed with confidence. The practice of Pranayama regulates the

purification of the internal system and the organs, acting as a superior

and able supplement to asanas. The energy that is generated in the body

through these physical practices is then channeled into meditation or Dhyan

for stability, peace, and calm.

Hello VITians,

Unleash Your Creativity this Summer: 70 Days of Online Contests!

DAY-47 (21st June-Friday)CELLPHONE PHOTOGRAPHY CONTESTTOPIC:

 Yoga for a Healthy Life

The International Day of Yoga is celebrated June 21 every year with an

aim to raise awareness worldwide of the many benefits of practicing yoga.

We would like to see your unique perspective of this. Capture a pic through

your cell phone!

Here's how to participate:

 - Take the most captivating photo showcasing the given topic.

 - Upload the photo on your Instagram page.

 - Tag SW page in the post @sw_vit (Make sure your post & profile are

 public)

The winning photo will be chosen based on two factors:

 - Creativity and composition: Does your photo capture the essence in a

 unique and interesting way?

 - Engagement: How many likes does your photo receive by today 05:00 pm.

 - Plagiarism: Uploading photos from any other sources will disqualify

 you from the contest.

The grand prize? A cool ₹500 as prize!

Contest Duration:The contest starts today at 06:00 am and ends by 05:00

pm.

So, start clicking and share your best shots!

For more information: events.sw@vit.ac.in

Body:
Dear VIT Students,

Please note that tonight, 11.59pm is the deadline at the Vellore Institute of Technology to apply for the Finlatics Data Science & Machine Learning Experience Program, an online live project that helps students gain experience in data science with Python and using machine learning algorithms

This project runs at leading campuses, including IIT Bombay, IIT Madras, IIT Delhi, and BITS Pilani.

STRUCTURE of the live project:

1. Learn the basics of Python and Machine Learning and how it can be used in data science.

2. Get hands-on learning and experience in writing various Python codes.

3. Dive into practical data manipulation and visualization using essential Python libraries.

4. Become proficient in using the Google Collab Notebook for machine learning

5. Gain an understanding of supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms using Python libraries

6. Explore statistical methods crucial for accurate data analysis, empowering learners with essential analytical skills.

7. Complete industry-specific case projects to understand the application of Python and Machine Learning in business scenarios

The project is doable along with any other commitment due to its work-from-home and online structure.

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificate of Work Experience in Data Science

2. Letter of Recommendation on performance

3. A Certificate of Proficiency in Python and Machine Learning

To apply, students can fill out the form below, and we will get in touch with them:

https://www.finlatics.com/bads_application?src=vitve3d

As Python would be taught in the program, all students must note that no prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to be a part of the program.

Personalized guidance & mentoring would also be provided to help students learn Python.

Live Sessions will be provided to help you practice coding with Python.

Project Duration: 2 months

Project Start: Flexible on selected student choice. Students can choose to start the project post-exams to balance the project along with any upcoming exams, assignments, or personal commitments.

Project Break & Extension: Selected students will be eligible for a break during the project if needed for any exams, assignments, or personal commitments. They can also take an extension in duration if they cannot complete it in the given time.

Time Commitment: 3 - 4 hours per week

If selected, the program has a minimal induction fee of Rs. 1999 + GST / Rs. 2999 + GST (on student choice)

Fee Waiver: A 20% fee waiver shall be given to all Vellore Institute of Technology students on the above mentioned minimal induction fee. This waiver will reduce the fee to Rs. 1999 + GST / Rs. 2399 + GST.

To be eligible for the waiver, kindly apply before tonight's deadline.

Applying from the link takes 2-3 mins of your time and is free of charge.

We are excited to have a fruitful engagement.

World Refugee Day

World Refugee Day is an international day designated by the United Nations

to honor refugees around the globe. It falls each year on June 20 and

celebrates the strength and courage of people who have been forced to flee

their home country to escape conflict or persecution. World Refugee Day is

an occasion to build empathy and understanding for their plight and to

recognize their resilience in rebuilding their lives. World Refugee Day

shines a light on the rights, needs, and dreams of refugees, helping to

mobilize political will and resources so refugees can not only survive but

also thrive. While it is important to protect and improve the lives of

refugees every single day, international days like World Refugee Day help

to focus global attention on the plight of those fleeing conflict or

persecution. Many activities held on World Refugee Day create opportunities

to support refugees.

Refugees are among the most vulnerable people in the world. They are the

only global legal instruments explicitly covering the most important

aspects of a refugee’s life. According to their provisions, refugees

deserve, as a minimum, the same standards of treatment enjoyed by other

foreign nationals in a given country and, in many cases, the same treatment

as nationals.

World Sickle Cell Day

World Sickle Cell Day is a United Nations recognized day to raise awareness

of sickle cell at a national and international level on June 19th. On 22nd

December 2008, the United Nations General Assembly adopted a resolution

that recognizes sickle cell disease as a public health problem and “one of

the world’s foremost genetic diseases.” Sickle cell disease (SCD) is a

group of inherited red blood cell disorders. Healthy red blood cells are

round, and they move through small blood vessels to carry oxygen to all

parts of the body. In someone who has SCD, the red blood cells become hard

and sticky and look like a C-shaped farm tool called a “sickle”. The sickle

cells die early, which causes a constant shortage of red blood cells. Also,

when they travel through small blood vessels, they get stuck and clog the

blood flow.

People with sickle cell are also at risk of complications from stroke,

acute chest syndrome, blindness, bone damage, and priapism. Over time

people with sickle cell can experience damage to organs such as the liver,

kidney, lungs, heart, and spleen. Death can also result from complications

of the disorder. Treatment of sickle cell mostly focuses on preventing and

treating complications.

Dear Students,

Swami Dayanand Education Foundation (SDEF) provides Merit-cum-Means

Scholarships to exceptionally talented but poor students who cannot afford

to study at reputed colleges, owing to financial constraints. The

foundation awards scholarships on the basis of school merit or to the top

rankers in national/state level common entrance tests based on which they

have secured admissions to quality institutes/colleges. The Scholarship is

offered to students pursuing Engineering, MBBS, Pharmacy, IT, Architecture,

and all undergraduate courses in Government or private Institutes,

including IITs, NITs, and others.

Eligibility Criteria:

 -

 The scholarship is available for all undergraduate courses –

 engineering, medical, architecture and other undergraduate courses.

 -

 Secured at least 85% in CBSE Board or 75% or above Marks in Other Boards

 in 12th Class

 -

 CGPA of at least 8.0 for Second year students

 -

 Annual Family Income should be between 1.2 Lacs to 8 Lacs per annum

 -

 Only first and second year students are allowed to apply for this program

 -

 Only one year drop is allowed for technical courses

 Applicant studied from Govt or Govt aided schools

 -

 All India Overall Rank should be less than 90,000 for Engineering &

 Age limit - 19 years for first year students and 20 years for second

Subject: Live Project in Data Science & Machine Learning with Python
Body:
Dear VIT Students,

We're pleased to open applications for the Finlatics Data Science & Machine Learning Experience Program, an online live project that helps students gain experience in data science with Python and using machine learning algorithms at the Vellore Institute of Technology.

This project runs at leading campuses, including IIT Bombay, IIT Madras, IIT Delhi, and BITS Pilani.

Finlatics is recognized for Skill Development & Assessment by the Department for Promotion of Industry & Internal Trade, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, and was incubated at the Atal Incubation Centre - NMIMS, supported by Atal Innovation Mission, NITI Aayog and Government of India.

STRUCTURE of the live project:

1. Learn the basics of Python and Machine Learning and how it can be used in data science.

2. Get hands-on learning and experience in writing various Python codes.

3. Dive into practical data manipulation and visualization using essential Python libraries.

4. Become proficient in using the Google Collab Notebook for machine learning

5. Gain an understanding of supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms using Python libraries

6. Explore statistical methods crucial for accurate data analysis, empowering learners with essential analytical skills.

7. Complete industry-specific case projects to understand the application of Python and Machine Learning in business scenarios

The project is doable along with any other commitment due to its work-from-home and online structure.

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificate of Work Experience in Data Science

2. Letter of Recommendation on performance

3. A Certificate of Proficiency in Python and Machine Learning

To apply, students can fill out the form below, and we will get in touch with them:

https://www.finlatics.com/bads_application?src=vitve3

As Python would be taught in the program, all students must note that no prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to be a part of the program.

Personalized guidance & mentoring would also be provided to help students learn Python.

Live Sessions will be provided to help you practice coding with Python.

Project Duration: 2 months

Project Start: Flexible on selected student choice. Students can choose to start the project post-exams to balance the project along with any upcoming exams, assignments, or personal commitments.

Project Break & Extension: Selected students will be eligible for a break during the project if needed for any exams, assignments, or personal commitments. They can also take an extension in duration if they cannot complete it in the given time.

Time Commitment: 3 - 4 hours per week

If selected, the program has a minimal induction fee of Rs. 1999 + GST / Rs. 2999 + GST (on student choice)

Fee Waiver: Vellore Institute of Technology students will be given a 20% fee waiver on the above mentioned minimal induction fee. This waiver will reduce the fee to Rs. 1999 + GST / Rs. 2399 + GST.

To be eligible for the waiver, kindly apply via the link above.

We are excited to have a fruitful engagement.

World Day to Combat Desertification and Drought

The World Day to Combat Desertification and Drought is a United Nations

observance celebrated each year on 17 June. Its purpose is to raise

awareness of the presence of desertification and drought, highlighting

methods of preventing desertification and recovering from drought. Each

year's global celebration has a unique, novel emphasis that had not been

developed previously. The day is a unique moment to remind everyone that

land degradation neutrality is achievable through problem-solving, strong

community involvement, and cooperation at all levels. To have enough

productive land to meet the demands of ten billion people by 2050,

lifestyles need to change.

Dryland ecosystems, which cover over one-third of the world‘s land area,

are extremely vulnerable to overexploitation and inappropriate land use.

Desertification is the degradation of land in arid, semi-arid, and dry

sub-humid areas; it is caused primarily by human activities and climatic

variations and affects the world's poorest. The decisions we make every day

on what to buy, eat, drink, wear, and how to travel – all have an impact on

land resources. The Desertification and Drought Day will focus on turning

degraded land into healthy land. Restoring degraded land brings economic

resilience, creates jobs, raises incomes, and increases food security. It

helps biodiversity to recover. It locks away the atmospheric carbon warming

the Earth, slowing climate change. It can also lessen the impacts of

climate change and underpin a green recovery.

World Sea Turtle Day

World Sea Turtle Day, June 16, is a day used to honor and highlight

the importance

of sea turtles. These creatures, like any other creature, are magnificent

in their own way. Not only are sea turtles beautiful animals, but they also

show incredible perseverance and resiliency– after all, they have been

nesting on beaches for millions of years. So of course they deserve their

own day dedicated to their awesomeness!

Sea turtles are ancient animals that have been around since the time of

dinosaurs. Although they have been around for millions of years, they’ve

remained mostly unchanged. It is important that we continue to do what is

necessary to preserve these magnificent animals that have been around for

110 million years to guarantee that they stick around for another 110

million years.

Father's Day

Father’s Day falls on the third Sunday of June, every year. Father's Day

has a fascinating history that dates back over a century. Father's Day has

a fascinating history that dates back over a century. The idea for this

celebration is believed to be first conceived by Sonora Smart Dodd, a

loving daughter from Spokane, Washington. Inspired by Mother's Day, which

had already been established as a national holiday,Jackson Smart, a Civil

War veteran who had single-handedly raised her and her siblings after their

mother passed away.

Father's Day is an occasion to honour one's father, as well as fatherhood,

paternal bonds, and the influence of fathers in society.

Dear Students,

Commemorating the spirit of Jambudweep Prakadanam (Proclamation), the

Office of Students' Welfare is organising various events and competitions

on 16.06.2024 (Sunday).

The British came into India only to do business and trade, but their

supremacy over weaponry, divide and rule policy, turning Indians against

each other, be it for economic reasons, caste-wise, enslaving them for

their own purpose, led to our fall. The first ever voice of proclamation

against the atrocities of the Britishers was done by the Maruthu brothers

who ruled over Sivagangai, Tamil Nadu. This was even before the Vellore

mutiny in 1807 and the Sepoy mutiny in 1857. In 1801, the Maruthu brothers

made the Jambudweep Prakadanam (Proclamation) challenging the British,

who angered by the actions of the Maruthu brothers, sought extreme revenge

against them, by setting fire to their territory with the sole intention to

bring it down. On October 24, 1801, the Maruthu brothers and about 500

others were executed.

Global Wind DayGlobal Wind Day is a worldwide event that occurs annually

on 15 June. It is a day for discovering wind, its power, and the

possibilities it holds to change our world. It is also a day for discovery

of the work that has already begun by pioneers around the Global Wind Day.

The day is celebrated to spread awareness about wind energy, the various

uses of wind energy, and the ways and possibilities as to how wind energy

can help change the world. European Wind Energy Association (EWEA)

established the day as Wind Day in the year 2007 and later in 2009, EWEA

and GWEC (Global Wind Energy Council) teamed up with aims to coordinate the

events globally and the name was changed to Global Wind Day aka World Wind

Day. Various kinds of competitions are held on the occasion of World Wind

Day.World Wind Day not only sheds light on the importance

of wind energy but also promotes the economic growth of a nation by

creating various jobs, particularly in the energy department. Hence, the

economic growth that is promoted by wind energy helps to solve the issues

of employment. In more than 80 countries around the world, wind farms are

in operation, generating energy from a clean and renewable source. Global

Wind Day is the day when you can visit wind farms, meet experts, attend

events, and find out everything you want to know about wind energy.

Hi VITians,

Calling All Innovators! Be a part of VIT Startup Club!

The Students' Welfare Office is excited to announce the formation of the

VIT Startup Club!

For the students with a strong passion for entrepreneurship. We are writing

this to propose the establishment of a Startup Club at our institute. This

initiative aims to foster innovation and collaboration within the student

body by building a team dedicated to startup's.

Eligibility: Open to all VIT students with a strong interest

in entrepreneurship and startups.

Minimum CGPA of 7.00 and above.

This club would create a vibrant community for students interested in the

exciting world of startups. We believe it will offer numerous benefits to

our fellow students, including: Developing entrepreneurial skills, Building

a network, Gaining practical experience, and Sparking innovation. We

envision the Startup Club as an open and inclusive space for all students,

regardless of their academic background or experience. We plan to organize

a variety of activities, such as: Speaker Series, Idea Incubator,

Skill-Building

Workshops, Networking Events, etc.

We are confident that a Startup Club will be a valuable addition to VIT's

vibrant community. It will empower students to pursue their entrepreneurial

ambitions, foster innovation, and contribute to the future of business.

How to Apply: If you are passionate about entrepreneurship and excited to

be part of this initiative, please submit the following google form by 25th

JUNE,2024.

https://forms.gle/QuwvhiV1Vpt6Bb1q9

Selection Process: Shortlisted applicants will be invited for an

interview to discuss their skills and interest further.

For inquiries, please contact: events.sw@vit.ac.in

We look forward to receiving your application and building a dynamic team

to contribute to the future of business.

Last Date: 25th JUNE,2024.

World Blood Donor Day

World Health Organisation-designated World Blood Donor Day takes place on

14 June each year. The aim is to raise global awareness of the need for

safe blood and blood products for transfusion and of the critical

contribution voluntary, unpaid blood donors make to national health

systems. The day also provides an opportunity to call to action to

governments and national health authorities to provide adequate resources

and put into place systems and infrastructures to increase the collection

of blood from voluntary, non-remunerated blood donors. For 2021, the World

Blood Donor Day slogan will be “Give blood and keep the world beating”. The

message highlights the essential contribution blood donors make to keeping

the world pulsating by saving lives and improving others’ health. It

reinforces the global call for more people all over the world to donate

blood regularly and contribute to better health.

Safe blood and blood products and their transfusion are critical aspects of

care and public health. They save millions of lives and improve the health

and quality of life of many patients every day. The need for blood is

universal, but access to blood for all those who need it is not. Blood

shortages are particularly acute in developing countries. A blood service

that gives patients access to safe blood and blood products in sufficient

quantity is a key component of an effective health system. The global theme

of World Blood Donor Day changes each year in recognition of the selfless

individuals who donate their blood to people unknown to the

On the occasion of World Blood Donor Day, CC are organising two events.

Debate Society

Event Time: 1 pm - 5 pm

Event Description: Donating blood is an extremely important charity service

that any healthy young adult should opt into to make a difference. VIT

Debsoc brings an engaging online session which deals with exactly that,

i.e., the necessity of blood drives, the large-scale impact of this

collectivism and the appropriate mechanisms to go about doing it.

Given our close proximity to CMC, we believe delving into an interactive

session would bring about significant positive impacts.

Registering would educate its participants on the crucial nature of blood

drives!

Venue: Google Meet (Online)

Theme: Promoting Blood Donation

Instagram Page: https://www.instagram.com/vitdebsoc/?hl=en

Youth Red Cross Association

Event Name: The Gift of Life: Celebrating the Spirit of Blood Donation

Time: 5:00-6:00pm

Platform: Instagram Live

Event description: World Blood Donation Day, observed on June 14th, raises

awareness about the need for safe blood and blood products. We YRC club are

The World Day Against Child Labour

The World Day Against Child Labour, which is held every year on June 12, is

intended to foster the worldwide movement against child labor. The

International Labour Organisation (ILO) launched the World Day Against

Child Labor in 2002. Since then, the day has focused attention on the

prevalence of child labor throughout the world and the action and efforts

essential to eliminating it. Around the world, there are 152 million

children in child labor; 73 million of them are engaged in hazardous work

that directly harms their health, safety, or moral development. The

International Labour Organization defines child labor as "work that

deprives children of their childhood, their potential, and their dignity,

and that is harmful to physical and mental development." Not all work done

by children is child labor. Activities that contribute to a child’s

positive development and provide skills and experience for them to become

productive members of society are not child labor.

Children around the world are routinely engaged in paid and unpaid forms of

work that are not harmful to them. However, they are classified as child

laborers when they are either too young to work, or are involved in

hazardous activities that may compromise their physical, mental, social, or

educational development. In the least developed countries, slightly more

than one in four children (ages 5 to 17) are engaged in labor that is

considered detrimental to their health and development.

ADG-VIT

Event Title: Trackit with IOS

Event Timings: 3 PM - 6 PM

Event Description: Join our workshop to build a fully functional Expense

Tracker App using SwiftUI, perfect for students eager to start iOS

development. We'll cover Swift basics, introduce SwiftUI for UI design, and

guide you through hands-on sessions to set up your environment, design

layouts, manage state, and implement data persistence. By the end, you'll

have a practical app and a solid foundation in Swift and SwiftUI.

Event Name: Pinpoint

Time: 9 AM to 9 PM

Welcome to "PinPoint: Night Sky Challenge" an interactive astronomy event

designed for college students and stargazing enthusiasts. Throughout the

day, we will post clips of the night sky, each showcasing various celestial

objects. Participants are invited to identify celestial bodies,

constellations, and other astronomical phenomena in the comment section.

The quickest and most accurate responses will earn points, and the

participant with the highest cumulative score at the end of the day will be

crowned the winner.

Body:

"MathWorks" 

Dear Nayan, 

You are receiving this email because you have a license for Filter Design HDL Coder. As of Release 2025a, Filter Design HDL Coder will no longer be available for purchase or renewal. 

 Technical support will continue to be available until R2025a, after which the product will be discontinued, and technical support will be offered on a limited basis. 

You can continue to use current and previous versions of Filter Design HDL Coder up to R2024b. 

Alternative Products - 

MathWorks recommends the use of DSP HDL Toolbox https://www.mathworks.com/products/dsp-hdl.html?s_v1=54691&elqem=4416902_EM_WW_DIR_24-06_GENL-NO-COMP-HDL-SUNSET&elqTrackId=7368fd9bd75e4d0b9f4adec2ba5b30db&elq=1be7ed75c7f84dfc97d42801666a78bd&elqaid=54691&elqat=1&elqCampaignId=20868, which encompasses the filter structures available in Filter Design HDL Coder, while also offering advanced and high-performance filters and signal processing support for FPGAs and ASICs. It includes templates for interfacing MATLAB and Simulink as well as reference examples. To generate synthesizable VHDL or Verilog code you will require HDL Coder https://www.mathworks.com/products/hdl-coder.html?s_v1=54691&elqem=4416902_EM_WW_DIR_24-06_GENL-NO-COMP-HDL-SUNSET&elqTrackId=5f98750686134536a2e02b4296f40822&elq=1be7ed75c7f84dfc97d42801666a78bd&elqaid=54691&elqat=1&elqCampaignId=20868.   

In the interim, if you have any questions about your specific license or the alternative products, contact your sales representative. 

Sincerely,

Indian Geotechnical Society (IGS)

Event Title: Introduction to Advanced Study of Soil-Water Interaction

Time: 08:00 PM-11:45 PM

Platform: Google Meet

Event Description: Join us for the "Advanced Study of Soil-Water

Interaction" course introductory session. Explore the fascinating world of

soil and water dynamics, followed by an exciting quiz to test your

knowledge and kickstart your learning journey! Don't miss it!

Event Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/igs.vit_/

Google Form Link: https://forms.gle/JAsKbkkK6sZx5JeVA

IEEE Computer Society (IEEE COMSOC)

Event Title: DotDash: Network Protocols

Time: 09:00 AM to 07:00 PM

Platform: Google Forms

Event Description: Gear up for this weekend's edition of the DotDash Weekly

Quiz Series as we delve into the essential world of Network Protocols.

Network protocols are the backbone of communication systems, enabling

devices to connect, communicate, and exchange data efficiently and

securely. This quiz will challenge your understanding and broaden your

knowledge of these critical technologies. Prepare to immerse yourself in

the intricate world of network protocols and put your knowledge to the

test. Register now and join us for an enlightening and competitive quiz

session with DotDash!

Event Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/vitieeecomsoc/

Google Forms Link: https://forms.gle/ECUGFBdP61AYouNC6

International Society of Automation (ISA -VIT)

Event Title: Git & GitHub Primer: Navigating the Basics of Version Control

Time: 09:00 PM to 10:30 PM

Platform: Google Meet

Event Description: Join us for an introductory session on Git and GitHub,

essential tools for modern software development and collaboration. Whether

you're a seasoned developer or just starting, this session will cover the

fundamentals of version control, including repository management,

branching, merging, and collaborative workflows. By the end, you'll

understand how Git and GitHub work together to streamline development and

empower teamwork.

Event Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link:

https://www.instagram.com/p/C74SWQmNo5C/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==

Google Meet Link: https://meet.google.com/uhg-hucm-hru

American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME-VIT)

Event Title: Blog Fury 1.2

Time: 09:00 PM - 10:00 PM

Platform: Google Meet

Event Description: Get ready to explore the forefront of mechanical

engineering with our weekly ASME Blog Writing Series! Craft your insights

and be part of the conversation!

Event Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/asme.vit/

English Literary Association (ELA)

Event Title: New Choice

Time: 09:00 PM

Platform: Discord

Event Description: New choice is an impromptu speaking event where a

scenario will be given and participants have to come up with a dialogue

matching their character. The host will say the phrase "new choice" upon

which the dialogue must be changed.

Event Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/elaavit?igsh=d3g4OWs1MG5iNzZv

SAE-VIT

Event Title: Weekend Trivia : Ferrari 12 Cilindri

Time: 9 am - 9 pm

Platform:

Event Description: The Ferrari 12 Cilindri is inspired from the legendary

Grand Tourers of the 1950s and 1960s, embodying the front-mounted Ferrari

V12. Successor to the very triumphant 812 Superfast, the 12 Cilindri is a

V12 of the new generation, giving out 820 bhp and a mighty V12 that revs up

to 9,500 rpm. This Italian beauty is Ferrari's latest take on a Super-GT.

No turbos, no hybrids, just a big V12 with active aero. Head over to our

Weekend trivia this Saturday, 8th June to know more.

Event Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/sae_vit/

Creativity Club

Event Title: Planet Canvas

Time: 9 am - 11 pm

Platform: Google Drive

Event Description: Planet Canvas is an inspiring initiative held during

Environment Awareness Week, designed to harness the power of art to raise

awareness about environmental issues. This unique competition invites

artists of all levels to create impactful posters (digital and handmade)

that promote environmental consciousness and sustainability.

Event Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link:

https://www.instagram.com/creativityclub_vit?igsh=MTVyMTd6OHU2Zms0Ng==

Bulls and Bears

Event Title: SpeedTrade 101: An Introduction to HFT

Time: 08:00 PM - 10:00 PM

Platform: Google Meet

Event Description: Join us for an insightful one-hour session hosted by

Ansh Tayal, a distinguished representative from the National Stock Exchange

(NSE). Discover the world of High-Frequency Trading (HFT) and Market

Microstructure as we delve into the evolution of HFT, the technological

arms race, key components of trading systems, and the impact of HFT on

market structure. Gain valuable insights into career prospects in HFT and

learn how to build a knowledge base in this dynamic field.

Event Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://instagram.com/bullsandbears_vit/

Bulls and Bears

Event Title: BNB Quiz Quest: Reserve Bank Of India

Time: 10:00 AM - 08:00 PM

Platform: Quizziz

Event Description: Join our finance club's BNB Quiz Quest: Reserve Bank of

India edition! Test your knowledge on RBI's history, functions, and

policies in this fun online quiz. Compete with fellow enthusiasts and learn

more about India's central bank. Don't miss out on the chance to expand

your financial knowledge.

Event Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://instagram.com/bullsandbears_vit/

The Biotech Research Society India (BRSI)

Event Title: Stem Cell Saga

Time: 9:00 am-9:00 pm

Platform: Google Form

Event Description: Join us for an exciting online quiz event tailored for

biotechnology enthusiasts! This event is designed to challenge and engage

you in the world of stem cell technology. Test your knowledge with 10

thought-provoking multiple-choice questions covering various aspects of

stem cell research, applications, and potential. From understanding

different types of stem cells to exploring their therapeutic potentials,

this quiz will put your biotech acumen to the test.

Event Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/brsivitvellore/?hl=en

Facebook Link: https://www.facebook.com/brsivitvellore/

Google Form Link: https://forms.gle/kMhhzX4YBydZrzsk6

Marathi Literary Association (Yuva Marathi)

Event Title: Shivrajyabhishek Sohala

Time: 09:00 AM Onwards

Platform: Instagram

Event Description: On the occasion of 'Shivrajyabhishek Din', Yuva Marathi

is conducting online trivia on the topic Warriors of the Maratha Empire'.

In the process of establishing and building a strong Maratha empire,

several warriors sacrificed everything. This event is to pay homage to all

those brave Maratha warriors. The motive of this event is to highlight the

bravery of those warriors who fought for the Martha Empire but were lost in

the pages of history.

World Oceans Day

World Ocean Day is an international day that takes place annually on 8

June. The concept was originally proposed in 1992 by Canada's International

Centre for Ocean Development (ICOD) and the Ocean Institute of Canada (OIC)

at the Earth Summit – UN Conference on Environment and Development (UNCED)

in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. "World Oceans Day" was officially recognized by

the United Nations in 2008. The international day supports the

implementation of worldwide Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and

fosters public interest in the protection of the ocean and the sustainable

management of its resources. 

This is one of the multiple reasons why we should celebrate World Oceans

Day: to remind everyone of the major role the oceans have in everyday life.

They are the lungs of our planet, providing most of the oxygen we breathe.

The purpose of the Day is to inform the public of the impact of human

actions on the ocean, develop a worldwide movement of citizens for the

ocean, and mobilize and unite the world’s population on a project for the

sustainable management of the world's oceans.

World Brain Tumour Day

World Brain Tumour Day is celebrated on June 8 every year to raise

awareness among people about the condition, educate people about the

consequences and also help people suffering from a brain tumor. This

initiative was initially taken by the German Brain Tumor Association and is

now celebrated worldwide to raise awareness and educate people about brain

tumors. There are lots of myths and misconceptions about brain tumors among

the general population and we take this opportunity to discuss some basic

facts.

As per the statistics, the prevalence of central nervous system (CNS)

tumors in India is 5-10% per 100,000 population, and the rate seems to be

increasing gradually. Metastatic brain tumors develop when cancer

originating in another organ of the body spreads to the brain and about 40%

of all types of cancer spread to the brain. Reports reveal that the brain

and central nervous system tumors are the second leading cancers in

children and 26 % of childhood cancers.

Body:
Office of the Controller of Examinations

Paper Seeing, Revaluation and Re-FAT Process for 

Winter Semester 2023-24 (Regular & Week End Intra Semester) FAT –

Theory 

 Paper Seeing and Revaluation:

· In the VTop student login, (“Examination → Marks → Winter

Semester 2023-24”) Marks for the Courses to which FAT was held during May

2024 has been made available now.

· Actual Grades will be released on 13 June 2024 (Thursday). The

Pass criteria and Grading Procedure are available in Academics → Regulations

Tab in your login.

· If you want to know the question wise marks awarded to your

answers by the evaluator, you need to apply for it through V-Top. This is

referred as “Paper Seeing” process. It requires payment of Rs. 100 for each

paper. You can apply through: Examinations →Papersee/Rev → Winter

Semester 2023-24→Paper Seeing. You can choose course(s) you want to

apply for paper seeing. After Generating the Invoice, you need to make a

payment through “Online Payments” Tab in the same V-Top login.

· Once you have paid, within one or two working days, the

paper and question

wise marks awarded will be made available in CodeTantra login. You need

to use the same portal https://vit.codetantra.com for this process. After

seeing the paper, if you feel the mark awarded to a particular question is

not sufficient and the evaluator has missed something and there is a need

to recheck the mark, then you can apply for Revaluation of the Course. You

need to give suitable reason for the same in the comments section available

just below the mark awarded by the faculty.

· Please note that the Revaluation has to be applied only in V-Top

(in the same way as you have applied for paper seeing) and necessary

payments also needs to be paid through online payments tab. (Rs. 300 per

paper).

· Also note that “Paper seeing” and Revaluation is applicable only

for the Theory Courses to which FAT was conducted by CoE office . For other

components and Courses (like Laboratory / Project Courses IBL mode courses)

there is No Paper seeing and Revaluation Process.

· Actual Grades will be released after the completion of

“Paper-Seeing” and Revaluation Registration Processes. The links for Paper

seeing and Revaluation payments have been enabled in VTop Students login.

Paper seeing and feedback / comments are mandatory for re-evaluation and

is in online mode only.

· The students who were involved in Winter Semester 2023-24

examination malpractices are not eligible for paper seeing/ Re-valuation

process.

Particulars

Dates

Paper seeing registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 100]

 07- June -2024 to 11- June -2024

Revaluation registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 300]

 08- June -2024 to 12- June -2024

Paper Seeing in https://vit.codetantra.com/

https://vit.codetantra.com/

 08- June -2024 to 12- June -2024

 Once the Paper seeing request is approved, the evaluated copy of answer

sheets would be made available in CodeTantra as per the above

schedule. Use your VTop login credentials for login.

· After login, follow the instructions given in the platform for

giving comments to the questions which needs to be re-examined.

· Give your feedback with respect to the need for revaluation. If

no feedback is given for any question, your answer script will not be

considered for revaluation and No refund will be given for any approved

requests.

· Students should not approach or give any sort of request to any

faculty related to revaluation (increase of marks or grades). If we

receive any complaints from faculty, it will be treated as ‘Malpractice’

and revaluation request will summarily be rejected.

 Re-FAT:

As per VIT Academic regulations (Page 22) Re-FAT will be permitted for the

following reasons only:

S. No.

Description

Supporting Evidence(s) Required

1.

Calamity in the family [Death of father / mother / own brother / sister]

Death certificate or Prior communication to the Proctors

2.

Hospitalization of the student

(for in-patient treatment only)

Medical Certificate, Investigation Report, Bills and Discharge Summary.

· Eligible students should apply in VTop student login (

Examination > Re-Exam Application) between 17th June 2024 and 28th June

2024 and upload the necessary evidences.

· Re-FAT requests will be scrutinized by the School Dean and then

by the ‘Re‐examinations Committee’. If needed the student may be asked to

appear before the Committee for presenting the case.

· For the ReFAT approved courses the Grade assigned will be

converted to “---“ by August end. ReFAT will be scheduled along with the

Fall 2024-25 Regular Arrear and the Regular Arrear Process will be followed

for Re-FAT.

· Any student who fails to apply for Re‐FAT through VTop will NOT

be considered for further processing and has to repeat the course(s) by

registering again in subsequent semesters. 

· Please note that this process is only for getting approval for

Re-FAT. After it is approved, students need to register in Arrear / Re-FAT

Tab for registering the course when it is permitted. The schedule will be

available only in Arrear/ Tab. If someone misses the approved Re-FAT, no

second chance will be given and it will be treated as absent accordingly

grade will be published.

World Food Safety Day

World Food Safety Day (WFSD) , celebrated on 7 June, aims to draw attention

to and inspire action to help prevent, detect and manage foodborne risks,

contributing to food security, human health, economic prosperity,

agriculture, market access, tourism, and sustainable development.

Recognizing the systemic connections between the health of people, animals,

plants, the environment, and the economy will help us meet the needs of the

future.

An estimated three million people around the world in developed and

developing countries die every year from food and waterborne disease. Food

safety is a shared responsibility between governments, producers, and

consumers. Everybody has a role to play from farm to table to ensure the

food we consume is safe and will not cause damage to our health. Through

World Food Safety Day, WHO works to mainstream food safety on the public

agenda and reduce the burden of foodborne diseases globally. Food safety is

everyone's business.

World Environment Day (WED)

World Environment Day (WED) is celebrated annually on 5 June and is the

United Nations' principal vehicle for encouraging awareness and action for

the protection of the environment. First held in 1974, it has been a

platform for raising awareness on environmental issues such as marine

pollution, human overpopulation, global warming, sustainable consumption,

and wildlife crime. World Environment Day is a global platform for public

outreach, with participation from over 143 countries annually. Every World

Environment Day is hosted by a different country, in which official

celebrations take place. Each year, the program has provided a theme and

forum for businesses, non-government organizations, communities,

governments, and celebrities to advocate environmental causes. Millions of

people have taken part over the years, helping drive change in our

consumption habits as well as in national and international environmental

policy.

This year’s observance of World Environment Day will be on the theme "Only

One Earth". It calls for transformative changes to policies and choices to

enable cleaner, greener, and sustainable living in harmony with nature. It

will focus on the need to live sustainably in harmony with nature, and our

possibilities for shifting to a greener lifestyle through both policies and

individual choices.

International Day of Innocent Children Victims of Aggression

International Day of Innocent Children Victims of Aggression is a United

Nations observance held on June 4 every year. It was established on 19

August 1982. Originally focused on victims of the 1982 Lebanon War, its

purpose expanded to "acknowledge the pain suffered by children throughout

the world who are the victims of physical, mental and emotional abuse. This

day affirms the UN's commitment to protecting the rights of children. All

over the world, when it comes to conflicts like wars, the ones who are

affected the most are the little ones – namely children. Unable to

understand or defend themselves, they are often the ones who suffer the

most pain whether it be physical, mental, or emotional.

The day signifies its acknowledgment of the pain suffered by children

throughout the world due to the physical, mental, and emotional abuse they

went through. The day also affirms the United Nation’s commitment to

protecting the rights of children the world over. It carries out its work

under the guidance of the Convention on the Rights of the Child, which is

the most rapidly and widely ratified international human rights treaty in

history.

Subject: 5G University Program-Qualcomm Academy
Body:
Dear all,

Greetings!

I am excited to announce that the School of Electronics Engineering at

Vellore Institute of Technology, Vellore has recently signed a Memorandum

of Understanding (MoU) with NanoCell Networks Pvt Ltd, Bangalore. This

partnership opens up the opportunity for the institute to offer

comprehensive training and certification programs, including Qualcomm

Wireless Academy’s 5G University Program and 5G Introductory-Level

Certification Exam.

This MoU offers an array of benefits such as free 5G training, the

opportunity to earn a 5G certification, and the chance to connect with

Qualcomm recruiters.

The 5G courses, which include "5G Primer" and "Fundamentals of Cellular

Communication & 5G," provide an in-depth understanding of 5G technology,

its functionality, and its global impact. These courses are available in an

eLearning format, allowing students to learn online at their own pace.

Furthermore, the courses are conducted in English and are taught by

industry-leading engineers from Qualcomm Technologies. Both courses are

estimated to take around 10 hours to complete.

For registrations, please visit:

https://assets.qualcomm.com/Qualcomm-Academy-University-Program-Registration.html

The certification exam is optional and requires a payment of Rs. 2400 for

interested students. NanoCell Networks Pvt Ltd, Bangalore, provides exam

coupons.

For those interested in taking the certification exams, they can approach

any of the following faculty members for more information.

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [3rd June] events.

World Bicycle Day

World Bicycle Day is celebrated on 3 June to promote the use of bicycles as

it is an environmentally-friendly means of transportation and affordable

too. It benefits health and society. The day celebrates the uniqueness,

durability, and versatility of the bicycle and promotes it as a simple,

sustainable means of transportation. Bicycling is good for physical and

mental health, also it is good for the environment and the economy. No

doubt cycling is a wonderful workout and keeps you active. It helps to

shape a healthy lifestyle. According to the World Health Organization

(WHO), safe infrastructure for walking and cycling is also a pathway for

achieving greater health equity. For the poorest urban sector, who often

cannot afford private vehicles, walking and cycling can provide a form of

transport while reducing the risk of heart disease, stroke, certain

cancers, diabetes, and even death. Accordingly, improved active transport

is not only healthy; it is also equitable and cost-effective.

The bicycle is a simple, affordable, reliable, clean, and environmentally

fit sustainable means of transportation; The bicycle can serve as a tool

for the development and as a means not just of transportation but also of

access to education, health care, and sport; The synergy between the

bicycle and the user fosters creativity and social engagement and gives the

user an immediate awareness of the local environment; The bicycle is a

symbol of sustainable transportation and conveys a positive message to

foster sustainable consumption and production, and has a positive impact on

climate.

The McCall MacBain Scholars program brings together students who strive to

candidates who demonstrate exceptional character, community engagement,

leadership potential, entrepreneurial spirit, academic strength, and

intellectual curiosity.

nationality.

 August 21, 2024 at 4:00 PM Eastern Time is the deadline for students to

to apply.

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [1st June] events.

Global Day of Parents

Global Day of Parents is celebrated on June 1st, every year. The day was

declared as the Global Day of Parents by the UN General Assembly in 2012.

This was done to appreciate all parents for their "selfless commitment to

children and their lifelong sacrifice towards nurturing this relationship."

 Parents Day wishes can be shared with your parents to show your love,

care, and respect. This day is celebrated to honor all the parents around

the world for their selfless commitment and the lifelong sacrifice they

make for their children.

Parents are the most precious gifts for children. They are our true

guardian angels who show unconditional love. Whether it be mental,

physical, social, financial, or career development, parents are always

there to help us in taking crucial decisions in our life. Hence, to

highlight the sacrifice made by the parents and to appreciate their endless

effort Global Parents Day is celebrated every year. Every parent deserves

to know how much their kids love them. So, on this Parent's day, take out a

moment and show your parents how much you love them. Here are some of the

best Parents Day wishes and quotes which you can share with your parents to

show your love, care, and respect.

Body:
Dear Students,

Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering, Sriperumbudur is offering a 2024

Summer Internship program under DST FIST sponsored Interdisciplinary Nano

Research Centre. 

Government of India has recently released various Production Linked

Incentive Scheme (PLI) to leapfrog semiconductor manufacturing in India.

Under India's Semiconductor mission, the nation has invested over 75000 Cr

in building the foundries for micro/nanoelectronics, display technology,

compound semiconductor, photonics, etc.

This internship is intended to cater to the Undergraduate students who have

completed 2nd or 3rd year studies, and who have the desire to get trained

in the state-of-the-art Semiconductor technology and manufacturing. As an

outcome of this Internship, the students will become industry-ready

(fab-ready) and contribute to the growth of the semiconductor ecosystem in

India.

Topics to be covered:

1. Basics of Semiconductor devices

2. Micro-fabrication technologies

3. Characterization tools

4. Exposure to cleanroom technologies

5. Hands-on training on Nano device fabrication.

6. Modeling and Simulation using Comsol Multiphysics and SCAPS.

7. Industry exposure.

Click here https://forms.gle/RjxPkGpkuw41nhPw8to Register.

Seats Limited to 30 per batch.

Interested students , kindly use this opportunity

Thanks

Yours Sincerely,

P.Arulmozhivarman

World No Tobacco Day

World No Tobacco Day aims to draw attention to the business practices of

tobacco companies to capture generations of consumers and their

interference in policy decisions that undermine effective tobacco control.

It serves to highlight what WHO is doing to fight the tobacco epidemic that

kills up to half its users and contributes to more than eight million

people dying every year, and what people can do to protect future

generations and allow everyone the chance to claim their right to health.

Every year, the theme of World No Tobacco Day addresses a specific issue

related to tobacco and its industry. The theme for World No Tobacco Day

2024 is "Protecting children from tobacco industry interference". The

theme emphasises the need to protect future generations and ensure that

Subject: Deadline to Apply for Live Project in Machine Learning
Body:
Dear VIT Students,

Please note that tonight, 9.00pm is the deadline at the Vellore Institute of Technology to apply for the Finlatics Machine Learning Program, an online live project that helps students learn and gain experience in using machine learning algorithms.

This project is running at leading campuses, including IIT Bombay, IIT Madras, IIT Delhi, and BITS Pilani, among others and was curated at the prestigious Atal Incubation Centre, supported by the Atal Innovation Mission, NITI Aayog, and the Government of India.

STRUCTURE of the live project:

1. Learn the core concepts around Machine Learning algorithms

2. Become proficient in using the Google Collab Notebook for machine learning

3. Engage in data preprocessing - a critical activity to prepare data sets for building machine learning algorithms

4. Gain an understanding of supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms using Python libraries

5. Complete an industry-specific case project to understand the application of Machine Learning in business scenarios

The project is doable along with any other commitment due to its work-from-home and online structure.

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificate of Proficiency in Machine Learning

2. Letter of Recommendation on performance

To apply, students can fill out the form below, and we will get in touch with them:

https://www.finlatics.com/ml_application?src=vitv1d

Project Duration: 1 month / 2 months (on student choice)

Please note that no prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to participate in the program. The program will impart all necessary training on Python and machine learning techniques.

Project Start: Flexible on selected student choice. Students can choose to start the project post-exams to balance the project along with any upcoming exams, assignments, or personal commitments.

Project Break & Extension: Selected students will be eligible for a break during the project if needed for any exams, assignments, or personal commitments. They can also take an extension in duration if they cannot complete it in the given time.

If selected, the program has a minimal induction fee of Rs.1999 + GST.

Fee Waiver: A 15% fee waiver shall be given to all Vellore Institute of Technology students on the abovementioned minimal induction fee. This waiver will reduce the fee to Rs. 1690 + GST.

To be eligible for the waiver, kindly apply before tonight's deadline.

The application process takes 2-3 mins of your time and is free of charges.

We are excited to have a fruitful engagement.

Hello VITians,

Unleash Your Creativity this Summer: 70 Days of Online Contests!

DAY-23 (28th May-Tuesday)CELLPHONE PHOTOGRAPHY CONTESTTOPIC: SummerSummer

Evenings on Campus

We would like to see your unique perspective of this on campus. Capture the

essence through your cell phone.

Here's how to participate:

 - Take the most captivating photo showcasing the given topic.

 - Upload the photo on your Instagram page.

 - Tag SW page in the post @sw_vit (Make sure your post & profile are

 public)

The winning photo will be chosen based on two factors:

 - Creativity and composition: Does your photo capture the essence of our

 campus in a unique and interesting way?

 - Engagement: How many likes does your photo receive by tomorrow 05:00

 pm.

 you from the contest.

The grand prize? A cool ₹500 as prize!

Contest Duration:The contest starts tomorrow morning at 06:00 am and ends

by 05:00 pm.

So, start clicking and share your best shots!

For more information: events.sw@vit.ac.in

Subject: Deadline to Apply for Live Project in Equity & Derivative Markets
Body:
Dear VIT Students,

Please note that tonight, 11.59pm is the deadline at the Vellore Institute of Technology to apply for the Finlatics Equity & Derivative Markets Experience Program, an online Live Project that helps students gain work experience in the equity markets and futures & options .

The project is running at leading campuses, including IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Madras and BITS Pilani among others.

STRUCTURE of the Live Project:

Equity Markets

1. Equity trading, research, and analysis based project.

2. Create, manage and maintain a real-time simulated portfolio on BSE 500 listed companies.

3. The simulated portfolio will be assessed by linking it to the real-time BSE 500 INDEX, akin to an asset management company.

4. Engage in sector-wise and company-specific research on the Indian Economy.

5. Learn and apply Fundamental & Technical Analysis to companies.

Futures & Options (Derivative Markets)

1. Learn and understand derivatives and instruments like forwards, futures, and options

2. Understand how derivative instruments like futures & options are traded

3. Gain insights into the valuation models of futures & options

4. Develop an understanding of various option trading strategies

The project is doable along with any other commitment due to its work from home, and online structure.

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificate of Work Experience in:

a. Equity Markets as an Equity Markets Analyst

b. Futures & Options as a Derivative Markets Analyst

2. Letter of Recommendation on performance

To apply, students can fill out the form below and we will get in touch with them:

https://forms.gle/qwFUpvfjYEe73K7v8

All students must note that no prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to be a part of this project. Personalized guidance and mentoring and live sessions would be provided on equity markets and futures & options to train students during the project .

Project Duration: 2 months

Project Start: Flexible on selected student choice. To balance the project along with any upcoming exams, assignments, or personal commitments, selected students can choose to start it once they are completed.

Project Break & Extension: Selected students will be eligible for a break during the project if they need it for any exams, assignments, or personal commitments. They can also take an extension in duration if they cannot complete it.

Incentives: up to Rs. 6000 (to monthly top-performing students)

If selected, the project has a minimal induction fee: Rs. 2999 + GST / Rs. 3999 + GST (on student choice)

Fee Waiver: A fee waiver of 25% shall be given to all Vellore Institute of Technology students on the abovementioned minimal induction fee. This will reduce the fee to Rs. 2199 + GST / Rs. 3049 + GST.

To be eligible for the waiver, kindly apply before tonight's deadline.

The application process takes 2-3 mins of your time and is free of charges.

We are looking forward to a fruitful engagement.
