Subject: General Instructions - reg.
Body:
Students,

 Stay safe. Welcome to the new era of learning and Fall Semester

and your first Academic Year 2023-24.

ADHERE TO THE GIVEN GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS STRICTLY.

1. Manage your time - Present yourself on time to your classes and for

examinations.

2. Proctor is the top in Hierarchy - The foremost important point.

ANY KIND OF REQUEST MUST BE SUBMITTED TO YOUR PROCTOR and YOUR PROCTOR

SHOULD ADDRESS TO US if necessary ONLY through mail and the same will be

addressed shortly. If your proctor is not aware of the processes, request

them to communicate with the year coordinator. If needed, they will take

the support of HoD. Even if they asked you to escalate the issue, address

only to HoD. DO NOT ADDRESS YOUR MAILS TO ALL THE KNOWN HIGHER OFFICIALS (Dean,

Academics office, International Relations office, Students Welfare office

etc). STRICTLY FOLLOW THIS to address your issues in a timely manner.

Official VIT student mail ID must be used for any kinds of communication.

If parents want to communicate, they need to send mails only from the

registered ID (as per your VTOP).

3. Leave: As per norms, a student can avail leave of any kind (including

medical reasons) to the permissible limit (25%). YOU MUST MAINTAIN 75%

attendance in all the courses. Any other kinds of leave request either from

parents or direct mail submissions won't be considered. Refer to academic

regulations available on our website and in your VTOP login for more

information. Only proctors should send the mail with supporting documents

if you are hospitalized for any reasons and treated as INPATIENT. DISCHARGE

SUMMARY, FITNESS CERTIFICATE and HOSPITAL BILLS are mandatory if your

proctor sends medical leave requests. OTHER KIND OF MEDICAL LEAVE REQUEST

WON'T BE ENTERTAINED. SUBMIT any kind of requests ON TIME (within a week's

time you avail leave).

4. Attendance Status: Faculty members post the attendance on a day-to-day

basis which will be frozen on every Monday. It is your responsibility to

verify your attendance daily. In case of discrepancies communicate only

with the course faculty members and sort out the same.

Only course faculty members can update any student's attendance. For no

reason, this kind of issue should be brought to our notice. If there are

issues with your biometric attendance, contact the CTS office for the same.

Even after that if your issue exists, you can request your course faculty

member to MANUALLY UPDATE your attendance at the end of the particular

class day. Other than this, there are no other options. If your account is

locked for some reasons, it is considered to be ABSENT and no one can

change the status. IF YOU ATTEND THE CLASSES WHEN YOUR ACCOUNT IS LOCKED,

REQUEST YOUR COURSE FACULTY MEMBER TO SEND A MAIL REQUEST WHEN YOUR

ATTENDANCE FALLS BELOW 75%. AVOID SENDING ANY OTHER KIND OF MAILS regarding

attendance update to school.

5. Internal Assessments and Evaluation: Course faculty members are the

owners for their courses. Adhere to the instructions given by them. No

other faculty members (including HoD) can intervene in their schedule or

evaluation strategies. Any kind of issues/requests must be discussed only

with them, and it should be resolved. Submit all the assignments on time

and present without fail for quizzes. Only faculty members must decide on

conduct of re-quiz or extension of assignment submission dates. School will

not interfere in this for any reason. IT IS ONLY UPTO THE DISCRETION OF THE

FACULTY MEMBERS TO CONSIDER YOUR REQUEST FOR Re-Quiz ON MEDICAL GROUNDS.

Updating marks is also carried out regularly. If there are mistakes, report

to the course faculty members on time. AVOID REQUESTING after all the

related processes are frozen.

6. Quality Circle Meeting: Usually the QCM meeting is conducted 3 times

in a semester to improve our teaching-learning process. Participate in

these meetings conducted by year coordinators and record your common

academic issues. School will initiate the necessary process to solve the

problems. Issues recorded only in QCM meetings will alone be considered and

suitable actions will be initiated. Don't submit any other means of

complaints against any course faculty member with HoD in person.

7. Discipline: Students, let us all be self-disciplined in all the

aspects starting from time management to display of behaviour in public. A

mail sent from the Registrar regarding mandatory wearing of ID cards will

be viewed seriously in all the places.

8. Bonafide Certificate: You can apply for bonafide from your VTOP login

for various reasons. Avoid requesting such certificates through mailto

school. Explore various options in your login and then apply. Such

applications will be processed by the Students Record Section and not by

schools. It will take some time for the process.

9. Stay Updated: Check your inbox at least twice in a day. Read all the

mails communicated from any officials without ignoring. They may contain

some vital information. Even though mails are communicated, some students

used to enquire about the same information which was already communicated.

10. Academic Calendar: Dean Academics has shared the details of all the

academic activities and the academic calendar is also available in your

login. Refer to the academic calendar and then plan everything. Understand

that schools are not scheduling any examinations. The exam schedules are

prepared by the Academics office (for CAT) and by the CoE office (for FAT)

and it won't be changed. Requests related to prepone or postpone can't be

considered from our side.

11. Finance related matters: Schools are not authorized to interfere in

the matters related to finance. Any such requests must be made only to the

respective offices. Schools do not have the permissions to LOCK/UNLOCK any

student's VTOP account. If your account is locked for any reasons, contact

respective offices based on your issue. Whenever your account is

locked, those days will be considered ONLY as ABSENT and no one will be

permitted to update the attendance (as already stated above)

12. On-Duty: If you are representing any events through some

clubs/chapters, OD must be initiated and updated by the respective offices

through concerned coordinators. If you want to request OD for other

academic events from school, the request must be submitted through proctor

with supporting documents and prior approval is MANDATORY. After attending

the event without prior approval from school can't be considered.

13. While reporting any issues, be sure that your claim must be supported

with proper supporting evidence.

AVOID WASTING YOUR TIME TO MEET HoD in person. 

FOLLOW THE HIERARCHY and ACADEMIC NORMS.

Please note that outing is not permitted for you and your parents/guardian

need to accompany you in case of LEAVE REQUESTS from your proctor.

HAVE A PLEASANT STAY and HAPPY LEARNING.

With Thanks and Regards,

Dr. S Vairamuthu,

Head, Department of Software Systems,

School of Computer Science and Engineering,

VIT. Vellore.

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today's [15th August] event.

77th INDEPENDANCE Day

On August 15, 1947, India achieved independence after years of struggle. On

this day, it ceased to be a colonial nation and secured full autonomy from

the British that ruled over it for years. The day holds great significance

in the heart of every Indian citizen.

How did August 15 become India’s independence day? Well, Lord Mountbatten

had been given a mandate by the British parliament to transfer the power by

June 30, 1948. Based on Mountbatten’s inputs the Indian Independence Bill

was introduced in the British House of Commons on July 4, 1947, and passed

within a fortnight. It provided for the end of the British rule in India,

on August 15, 1947, and the establishment of the Dominions of India, which

were allowed to secede from the British Commonwealth.

77 years on, India celebrates hard-fought independence with patriotic

fervor. The dates, in any case, hold far less significance than the mission

to deliver the fruits of independence to the vast multitude of people in

the country. Today, August 15, 2023, marks the 77th Independence Day of our

country……. HAPPY INDEPENDENCE DAY!

Body:
Office of the Controller of Examinations

 Ref.No. : VIT/CoE/2023/22021

 Date: 12-August-2023

Paper Seeing, Revaluation and Re-FAT Process for 

Fall 2023-24 (2021 B.Tech) FAT – Theory 

 Paper Seeing and Revaluation:

· In the VTop student login, (“Examination → Marks → Fall

Semester 2023-24”) Marks for the Courses to which FAT was held during July

2023 has been made available now.

· Actual Grades will be released on 18 August 2023 (Friday). The

Pass criteria and Grading Procedure are available in Academics → Regulations

Tab in your login.

· If you want to know the question wise marks awarded to your

answers by the evaluator, you need to apply for it through V-Top. This is

referred as “Paper Seeing” process. It requires payment of Rs. 100 for each

paper. You can apply through: Examinations →Papersee/Rev → Fall

Semester 2023-24→Paper Seeing. You can choose course(s) you want to

apply for paper seeing. After Generating the Invoice, you need to make a

payment through “Online Payments” Tab in the same V-Top login.

· Once you have paid, within one or two working days, the

paper and question

wise marks awarded will be made available in CodeTantra login. You need

to use the same portal https://vit.codetantra.com for this process. After

seeing the paper, if you feel the mark awarded to a particular question is

not sufficient and the evaluator has missed something and there is a need

to recheck the mark, then you can apply for Revaluation of the Course. You

need to give suitable reason for the same in the comments section available

just below the mark awarded by the faculty.

· Please note that the Revaluation has to be applied only in V-Top

(in the same way as you have applied for paper seeing) and necessary

payments also needs to be paid through online payments tab. (Rs. 300 per

paper).

· Also note that “Paper seeing” and Revaluation is applicable only

for the Theory Courses to which FAT was conducted by CoE office . For other

components and Courses (like Laboratory / Project Courses IBL mode courses)

there is No Paper seeing and Revaluation Process.

· Actual Grades will be released after the completion of

“Paper-Seeing” and Revaluation Registration Processes. The links for Paper

seeing and Revaluation payments have been enabled in VTop Students login.

Paper seeing and feedback / comments are mandatory for re-evaluation and

is in online mode only.

Particulars

Dates

Paper seeing registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 100]

 12- Aug-2023 to 16- Aug -2023

Revaluation registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 300]

13- Aug -2023 to 17- Aug -2023

Paper Seeing in https://vit.codetantra.com/

https://vit.codetantra.com/

12- Aug -2023 to 17- Aug -2023

 Once the Paper seeing request is approved, the evaluated copy of answer

sheets would be made available in CodeTantra as per the above

schedule. Use your VTop login credentials for login.

· After login, follow the instructions given in the platform for

giving comments to the questions which needs to be re-examined.

· Give your feedback with respect to the need for revaluation. If

no feedback is given for any question, your answer script will not be

considered for revaluation and No refund will be given for any approved

requests.

· Students should not approach or give any sort of request to any

faculty related to revaluation (increase of marks or grades). If we

receive any complaints from faculty, it will be treated as ‘Malpractice’

and revaluation request will summarily be rejected.

Re-FAT:

As per VIT Academic regulations (Page 22) Re-FAT will be permitted for the

following reasons only:

S. No.

Description

Supporting Evidence(s) Required

1.

Calamity in the family [Death of father / mother / own brother / sister]

Death certificate or Prior communication to the Proctors

2.

Hospitalization of the student

(for in-patient treatment only)

Medical Certificate, Investigation Report, Bills and Discharge Summary.

· Eligible students should apply in VTop student login (

Examination > Re-Exam Application) between 21st August 2023 and 31st

August 2023 and upload the necessary evidences.

· Re-FAT requests will be scrutinized by the School Dean and then

by the ‘Re‐examinations Committee’. If needed the student may be asked to

appear before the Committee for presenting the case.

· For the ReFAT approved courses the Grade assigned will be

converted to “---“ by November end. ReFAT will be scheduled along with

the Winter 2023-24 Regular Arrear and the Winter/Regular Arrear Process

will be followed for Re-FAT.

· Any student who fails to apply for Re‐FAT through VTop will NOT

be considered for further processing and has to repeat the course(s) by

registering again in subsequent semesters. 

· Please note that this process is only for getting approval for

Re-FAT. After it is approved, students need to register in Arrear / Re-FAT

Tab for registering the course when it is permitted. The schedule will be

available only in Arrear/ Tab. If someone misses the approved Re-FAT, no

second chance will be given and it will be treated as absent accordingly

grade will be published.

International Youth Day

International Youth Day on August 12 focuses on the difficulties that some

young people are experiencing throughout the world. Half the children

between the age of six and 13 lack basic reading and math skills and

childhood poverty is still a prevalent problem globally. International

Youth Day was created by the UN to help draw awareness to these issues as

we strive to find solutions. It’s a day for reflection but also a day for

taking action so get involved.

It’s an initiative that honors the traits of young people and that

acknowledges the challenges that today’s fledging youth face. International

Youth Day began in 2000 and was organized by the UN to recognize the input

that young people make in education, community development, environmental

groups, and volunteering for different social projects.

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today's [09th August] event.

International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples

Indigenous peoples already face food insecurity as a result of the loss of

their traditional lands and territories or even climate change effects.

They also confront even graver challenges in accessing food. With the loss

of their traditional livelihoods, which are often land-based, many

indigenous peoples, who work in traditional occupations and subsistence

economies or in the informal sector, will be adversely affected by the

pandemic. The situation of indigenous women, who are often the main

providers of food and nutrition to their families, is even graver.

In order to raise awareness of the needs of indigenous peoples, every 9

August commemorates the International Day of the World’s Indigenous

Peoples. Especially now, they need us. Especially now, we need the

traditional knowledge, voices, and wisdom of indigenous peoples.

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today's [08th August] event.

Quit India Movement Day

Quit India Movement or Bharat Chodo Andolan was a turning point in India's

freedom struggle. Under the leadership of Mahatma Gandhi, people across

India came together to uproot British imperialism. In 1942, in a fiery

speech in Mumbai, Mahatma Gandhi gave a 'do or die' call to the people of

India in a final push to make the British quit. Following the start of Quit

India Movement, many Congress leaders including Jawaharlal Nehru, Sardar

Vallabhbhai Patel, Abul Kalam Azad, and others along with Mahatma Gandhi

were jailed for sedition.

The movement began from Mumbai's Gawalia Tank Maidan also called the August
